**8** He waits in hidden places near the villages. He kills innocent people in secret places. His eyes secretly watch for helpless people.

**9** He waits in a hidden place like a lion in its den. He waits to catch the poor man. He catches the poor man and pulls him into his net.

**10** The wicked man bends low and waits. Helpless people fall under his strength.

**11** He says in his heart, "God forgets. God hides his face. He will never see what I do."

**12** Stand up, LORD! God, lift up your hand to punish. Do not forget the helpless.

**13** Why does the wicked man hate God? He says in his heart, "God will not ask me to explain."

**14** But you see trouble and sorrow. You look at it, and you take it into your hand. The helpless man gives himself to you. You help the orphan.

**15** Break the arm of the wicked and evil man. Punish his evil until there is no more evil.

**16** The LORD is King for all time. The nations will disappear from his land.

**17** LORD, you hear the desire of the humble. You give them courage. You listen to them.

**18** You give justice to the orphan and the oppressed. Then man, who comes from the earth, will not cause terror again.

## Chapter 11

**1** I go to the LORD for protection. How can you say to me, "Fly like a bird to your mountain"?

**2** Look, the wicked bend their bows. They put their arrows on the string. They prepare to shoot from the darkness at people with honest hearts.

**3** If someone destroys the foundations, what can the righteous do?

**4** The LORD is in his holy temple. The throne of the LORD is in heaven. His eyes watch all people. He examines them.

**5** The LORD examines the righteous and the wicked. He hates the person who loves violence.

**6** He will send hot coals, fire and sulfur on the wicked like rain. A hot wind will be their punishment.

**7** The LORD is righteous, and he loves righteous actions. Honest people will see his face.

## Chapter 12

**1** Help, LORD! There are no more godly men. The faithful people disappear from among men.

**2** Each person tells lies to his neighbor. They speak with false praise and with a dishonest heart.

**3** Let the LORD cut off all lips that use false praise. Let him cut off the tongue that boasts.

**4** These people say, "Our tongues will make us win. Our lips are our own. No person is our master."

**5** The LORD says, "The helpless suffer, and the poor cry. Thus now I will stand up. I will keep them safe from the people who attack them."

**6** The words of the LORD are pure. They are like silver that a person melts in a clay furnace 7 times.

**7** LORD, you will protect the poor. You will keep them safe from these evil people for all time.

**8** The wicked walk around everywhere when people give honor to evil things.

## Chapter 13

**1** How long, LORD? Will you forget me for all time? How long will you hide your face from me?

**2** How long must I fight against my thoughts? How long must I have sorrow in my heart every day? How long will my enemy win over me?

**3** Look at me and answer me, LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, or I will die.

**4** If you do not, my enemy will say, "I defeated him." My enemies will be glad when I fall.

**5** But I trust in your faithful love. My heart will be glad because you save me.

**6** I will sing to the LORD, because he is very good to me.

## Chapter 14

**1** The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." Fools do evil and terrible things. No person does good.

**2** The LORD looks down from heaven at all people. He looks for any person who understands and looks for God.

**3** All people turn away from God. All of them are bad. No person does good, not even one person.

**4** Do the people who do evil not know anything? They destroy my people as they eat bread. They do not pray to the LORD.

**5** There they are in great fear, because God is with the righteous people.

**6** You stop the plans of the poor, but the LORD is the safe place of the poor.

**7** I want the salvation of Israel to come from Zion! The LORD will make his people prosperous again. Then Jacob will be glad, and Israel will be happy.

## Chapter 15

**1** LORD, who can stay in your tent (tabernacle)? Who can live on your holy hill?

**2** The person who lives an honest life can live there. He does what is right. He speaks the truth from his heart.

**3** He does not tell lies about other people. He does not do evil to his neighbor. He does not say bad things about his friends.

**4** He hates evil people. He gives honor to people who respect the LORD with fear. He keeps his promise even when it hurts him.

**5** He lends money without interest. He does not take money to hurt innocent people. The person who does these things will always stand firm.

## Chapter 16

**1** Keep me safe, God, because I go to you for protection.

**2** I say to the LORD, "You are my Lord. I have no good thing without you."

**3** The holy people in the land are wonderful. I am very glad with them.

**4** People who run after other gods will have many troubles. I will not give their drink offerings of blood. I will not speak the names of their gods.

**5** The LORD gives me all that I have and need. You keep my future safe.

**6** You gave me good land. I have a beautiful inheritance.

**7** I will praise the LORD, who gives me advice. My heart also teaches me at night.

**8** I always keep the LORD in front of me. He is at my right hand, thus nothing will move me.

**9** Thus my heart is glad, and I am happy. My body also will live in safety.

**10** You will not leave my soul in the place of the dead (Sheol). You will not let your Holy One decay.

**11** You show me the path of life. With you there is complete joy. At your right hand there are pleasures for all time.

## Chapter 17

**1** Hear my just case, LORD. Listen to my cry for help. Listen to my prayer, which comes from honest lips.

**2** Let my judgment come from you. Let your eyes see what is right.

**3** You examine my heart. You come to me at night. You test me, and you find nothing wrong. I decide that my mouth will not sin.

**4** Other people do evil things. But I obey your words, and I do not go on the paths of violent people.

**5** My steps stay on your paths. My feet do not slip.

**6** I call to you, God, because you will answer me. Turn your ear to me, and hear my words.

**7** Show your wonderful love. With your right hand you save the people who go to you for protection from their enemies.

**8** Protect me as you protect the pupil of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings.

**9** Hide me from the wicked people who attack me. Hide me from my deadly enemies who are all around me.

**10** They have no mercy in their hearts. Their mouths speak with pride.

**11** They follow my steps and are now all around me. They watch for a chance to throw me to the ground.

**12** They are like a lion that wants to tear its food. They are like a young lion that waits in a hidden place.

**13** Stand up, LORD! Fight against them and throw them down. Save my life from the wicked with your sword.

**14** LORD, save me with your hand from such men. Their reward is only in this life. You fill their stomachs with your treasure. Their sons have much food, and they leave their wealth to their children.

**15** But I will see your face because I am righteous. When I wake up, I will be happy because I see you.

## Chapter 18

**1** I love you, LORD. You are my strength.

**2** The LORD is my rock, my fortress and my rescuer. My God is my rock, and I go to him for protection. He is my shield and my strong salvation. He is my high tower.

**3** I call to the LORD, who deserves praise. Thus he saves me from my enemies.

**4** The ropes of death were around me. The floods of evil frightened me.

**5** The ropes of the grave were around me. The traps of death were in front of me.

**6** In my trouble, I called to the LORD. I cried to my God for help. He heard my voice from his temple. My cry for help came into his ears.

**7** Then the earth shook. The foundations of the mountains moved, because God was angry.

**8** Smoke went up from his nose. Fire came out of his mouth and burned. Hot coals burned in front of him.

**9** He opened the sky and came down. Dark clouds were under his feet.

**10** He flew on a cherub. He flew quickly on the wings of the wind.

**11** He covered himself in darkness. He put dark rain clouds around him like a tent.

**12** From the brightness in front of him, his thick clouds came out with hail and coals of fire.

**13** The LORD thundered in the sky. The Most High made his voice loud among hail and coals of fire.

**14** He shot his arrows and scattered his enemies. He sent much lightning and made them confused.

**15** Then people saw the bottom of the sea. The foundations of the world were open to view. This happened when you shouted, LORD, and when you blew the breath from your nose.

**16** He reached down from above and took me. He pulled me out of the deep waters.

**17** He saved me from my strong enemy. He saved me from the people who hated me. They were too strong for me.

**18** They attacked me on the day of my trouble. But the LORD supported me.

**19** He brought me out into an open place. He saved me because he was happy with me.

**20** The LORD gave me a reward because I did what was right. He rewarded me because my hands were clean.

**21** I obeyed the ways of the LORD. I did not turn away from my God to do evil.

**22** I kept all his laws in front of me. I did not refuse his rules.

**23** I was without fault in front of him. I kept myself from sin.

**24** Thus the LORD rewarded me because I did what was right. He saw that my hands were clean.

**25** You are faithful to the faithful. You are honest with the honest man.

**26** You are pure with the pure. But you are clever with the dishonest.

**27** You save humble people. But you bring down people with proud eyes.

**28** You keep my lamp bright. The LORD my God makes my darkness light.

**29** With your help I can attack an army. With my God I can climb over a wall.

**30** The way of God is perfect. The word of the LORD is true. He is a shield for all people who go to him for protection.

**31** Only the LORD is God. Only our God is a rock.

**32** God makes me strong. He makes my way perfect.

**33** He makes my feet like the feet of a deer. He causes me to stand on high places.

**34** He trains my hands for battle. My arms can bend a bow of bronze.

**35** You give me your shield of salvation. Your right hand supports me. Your help makes me great.

**36** You make a wide path for my feet. Thus my feet do not slip.

**37** I chased my enemies and caught them. I did not turn back until I destroyed them.

**38** I hit them, and they could not stand up. They fell under my feet.

**39** You gave me strength for the battle. You put my attackers under my control.

**40** You caused my enemies to turn and run from me. I destroyed the people who hated me.

**41** They cried for help, but no person saved them. They cried to the LORD, but he did not answer them.

**42** I beat them into small pieces like dust in the wind. I threw them out like mud in the streets.

**43** You saved me from the attacks of the people. You made me the leader of the nations. People who I did not know serve me.

**44** When they hear about me, they obey me. Foreigners bow down to me.

**45** The foreigners lose their courage. They come out of their strong places and shake with fear.

**46** The LORD is alive! Praise my rock! Give honor to the God who saves me!

**47** God gives me revenge. He puts the nations under my control.

**48** He saves me from my enemies. You lift me up above my attackers. You save me from violent men.

**49** Thus I will thank you among the nations, LORD. I will sing praises to your name.

**50** God gives great victories to his king. He shows faithful love to his anointed king, to David and to his descendants for all time.

## Chapter 19

**1** The sky shows the glory of God. The sky shows the work of his hands.

**2** Each day tells about him to the next day. Each night gives knowledge to the next night.

**3** The sky does not speak. It has no words. People do not hear its voice.

**4** But its message goes out through all the earth. Its words go to the farthest parts of the world. God put a tent in the sky for the sun.

**5** The sun comes out like a husband from his room after the wedding. The sun is glad like a strong man who runs a race.

**6** The sun goes out from one end of the sky. It moves across to the other end. Nothing can hide from its heat.

**7** The law of the LORD is perfect. It gives new life to the soul. The rules of the LORD are true. They make simple people wise.

**8** The commands of the LORD are right. They make the heart glad. The commands of the LORD are pure. They give light to the eyes.

**9** The respect for the LORD is clean. It continues for all time. The judgments of the LORD are true. All of them are righteous.

**10** They are more valuable than gold, more than much pure gold. They are sweeter than honey, sweeter than honey from the comb.

**11** Your laws warn your servant. A person who obeys them gets a great reward.

**12** No person can see all of his own errors. Forgive me for my hidden faults.

**13** Keep your servant from sins of pride. Do not let these sins control me. Then I will be without fault. I will be innocent of great sin.

**14** LORD, let the words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart please you. You are my rock and my rescuer.

## Chapter 20

**1** I pray that the LORD answers you in the day of trouble. I pray that the name of the God of Jacob protects you.

**2** I pray that he sends you help from the holy place. I pray that he gives you support from Zion.

**3** I pray that he remembers all your offerings. I pray that he accepts your burnt sacrifices. Selah.

**4** I pray that he gives you what your heart wants. I pray that he makes all your plans successful.

**5** We will shout with joy when you win. We will raise our flags in the name of our God. I pray that the LORD gives you all that you ask.

**6** Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed king. God answers him from his holy heaven. God saves him with the great strength of his right hand.

**7** Some people trust in chariots, and some people trust in horses. But we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

**8** Those people fall down. But we stand up and stay firm.

**9** LORD, save the king! Answer us when we call.

## Chapter 21

**1** LORD, the king is glad in your strength. He is very happy because you give him victory!

**2** You give him what his heart wants. You do not refuse the request of his lips. Selah.

**3** You come to him with many good blessings. You put a crown of pure gold on his head.

**4** He asked you for life, and you gave it to him. You gave him a long life for all time.

**5** You make him very famous because you give him victory. You give him honor and majesty.

**6** You give him blessings for all time. You make him very glad because you are with him.

**7** The king trusts in the LORD. The faithful love of the Most High keeps him safe.

**8** Your hand will find all your enemies. Your right hand will find the people who hate you.

**9** When you come, you will burn them as in a hot oven. In his anger, the LORD will destroy them. The fire will burn them up.

**10** You will destroy their children from the earth. You will remove their descendants from among all people.

**11** They plan evil against you. They make bad plans, but they cannot be successful.

**12** You will cause them to turn and run away. You will aim your arrows at their faces.

**13** Be great, LORD, in your strength! We will sing and praise your power.

## Chapter 22

**1** My God, my God, why did you leave me? Why are you so far from my help? Why are you far from my cries of pain?

**2** My God, I cry out during the day, but you do not answer. I cry out at night, and I do not stop.

**3** But you are holy. You sit as King on the praises of Israel.

**4** Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you saved them.

**5** They cried to you, and you saved them. They trusted in you, and they did not have shame.

**6** But I am a worm and not a man. People insult me and hate me.

**7** All people who see me laugh at me. They make faces at me and shake their heads. They say,

**8** "He trusts in the LORD. Let the LORD save him. Let the LORD rescue him, because the LORD likes him."

**9** But you brought me out of the womb. You caused me to trust you when I was a baby with my mother.

**10** I depended on you from my birth. You were my God from the time that my mother gave birth to me.

**11** Do not be far from me, because trouble is near. No person is here to help me.

**12** My enemies are around me like many bulls. They are like the strong bulls of Bashan.

**13** They open their mouths wide against me. They are like lions that roar and tear their food.

**14** I am like water that a person pours out. All my bones are out of their joints. My heart is like wax. It melts inside me.

**15** My strength is dry like a piece of broken pot. My tongue sticks to the top of my mouth. You put me in the dust of death.

**16** My enemies are around me like dogs. A group of evil people is around me. They made holes through my hands and my feet.

**17** I can count all my bones. People look at me and stare.

**18** They divide my clothes among them. They throw lots for my clothing.

**19** But you, LORD, do not be far away. You are my strength. Come quickly to help me.

**20** Save my life from the sword. Save my precious life from the power of the dogs.

**21** Save me from the mouth of the lion. Save me from the horns of the wild oxen. You answer me.

**22** I will tell my brothers about your name. I will praise you in the middle of the assembly.

**23** You people who respect the LORD with fear, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, give him honor! All you descendants of Israel, respect him with fear!

**24** He does not hate or ignore the pain of the person who suffers. He does not hide his face from him. When that person cries to him for help, the LORD hears him.

**25** I will praise you in the great assembly. I will keep my promises in front of the people who respect him with fear.

**26** The poor will eat and be full. The people who look for the LORD will praise him. Let your hearts live for all time.

**27** All the farthest parts of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down in front of you.

**28** The kingdom belongs to the LORD. He rules over the nations.

**29** All the rich people of the earth will eat and worship. All people who go down to the dust will bow down in front of him. No person can keep himself alive.

**30** Future descendants will serve him. People will tell the next generation about the Lord.

**31** They will come and tell about his righteousness to people who are not yet born. They will say that the LORD did this.

## Chapter 23

**1** The LORD is my shepherd. I will have all that I need.

**2** He causes me to lie down in green fields. He leads me near calm waters.

**3** He gives new life to my soul. He guides me on the correct paths for the honor of his name.

**4** I can walk through the valley of very deep darkness, but I will not be afraid of evil. You are with me. Your rod and your staff comfort me.

**5** You prepare a table of food for me in front of my enemies. You put oil on my head. You give me more than I need.

**6** It is certain that goodness and faithful love will follow me all the days of my life. I will live in the house of the LORD for all time.

## Chapter 24

**1** The earth and everything on it belong to the LORD. The world and all the people who live in it belong to him.

**2** He put the foundations of the earth on the seas. He made it firm on the deep waters.

**3** Who can go up the hill of the LORD? Who can stand in his holy place?

**4** The person with clean hands and a pure heart can go there. He does not trust in false gods. He does not make false promises.

**5** He will get blessings from the LORD. God, who saves him, will say that he is righteous.

**6** These are the people who look for the LORD. They look for the face of the God of Jacob. Selah.

**7** Open wide, you gates! Open, you ancient doors! Then the King of glory will come in.

**8** Who is this King of glory? He is the LORD, strong and mighty. He is the LORD, mighty in battle.

**9** Open wide, you gates! Open, you ancient doors! Then the King of glory will come in.

**10** Who is this King of glory? The LORD of armies is the King of glory. Selah.

## Chapter 25

**1** LORD, I give my soul to you.

**2** My God, I trust you. Do not let me feel shame. Do not let my enemies win against me.

**3** No person who waits for you will feel shame. But the people who do wrong without a reason will feel shame.

**4** LORD, show me your ways. Teach me your paths.

**5** Lead me in your truth and teach me. You are the God who saves me. I wait for you all day.

**6** LORD, remember your kind mercy and your love. You showed them from the start of time.

**7** Do not remember the sins that I did when I was young. Do not remember my wrong acts. LORD, remember me because of your mercy and your goodness.

**8** The LORD is good and honest. Thus he teaches sinners the correct way.

**9** He guides the humble people to do what is right. He teaches his way to the humble people.

**10** All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth for the people who obey his covenant and his laws.

**11** LORD, forgive my sin because of your name. My sin is very large.

**12** Who is the man that fears the LORD? The LORD will teach him the way that he must choose.

**13** That man will live in peace. His children will get the land.

**14** The LORD is a friend to the people who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

**15** My eyes always look to the LORD. He will pull my feet out of the net.

**16** Turn to me and be kind to me. I am alone and I suffer.

**17** The troubles of my heart become larger. Bring me out of my distress.

**18** Look at my trouble and my pain. Forgive all my sins.

**19** Look at my enemies. There are many enemies. They hate me with a cruel hate.

**20** Keep my soul safe and save me. Do not let me feel shame, because I trust you.

**21** Let honesty and good conduct keep me safe, because I wait for you.

**22** God, save Israel from all its troubles.

## Chapter 26

**1** LORD, judge me. I lived an honest life. I trusted the LORD and I did not fall.

**2** LORD, examine me and test me. Examine my mind and my heart.

**3** I always see your love in front of my eyes. I live by your truth.

**4** I did not sit with false people. I will not go with people who lie.

**5** I hate the group of evil people. I will not sit with the wicked.

**6** I will wash my hands to show that I am innocent. LORD, then I will go around your altar.

**7** I will thank you with a loud voice. I will tell about all your wonderful works.

**8** LORD, I love your house. I love the place where your glory lives.

**9** Do not take my soul away with the sinners. Do not take my life with men who kill.

**10** Their hands do evil things. Their right hands are full of bribes.

**11** But I will live an honest life. Save me and be kind to me.

**12** My feet stand on level ground. I will praise the LORD in the large groups of his people.

## Chapter 27

**1** The LORD is my light and he saves me. Thus I will fear no person. The LORD gives strength to my life. Thus I will be afraid of no person.

**2** Evil people, my enemies, attacked me to destroy me. But they tripped and fell.

**3** An army can camp around me, but my heart will not be afraid. A war can start against me, but I will still trust God.

**4** I asked the LORD for 1 thing, and I will try to get it. I want to live in the house of the LORD all my life. I want to see the beauty of the LORD and to pray in his temple.

**5** In a time of trouble, he will hide me in his shelter. He will hide me in his tabernacle. He will put me high on a rock.

**6** Then my head will be high above the enemies around me. I will give sacrifices with joy in his tabernacle. I will sing praises to the LORD.

**7** LORD, hear me when I call with my voice. Be kind to me and answer me.

**8** You said, "Look for my face." My heart said to you, "LORD, I will look for your face."

**9** Do not hide your face from me. Do not send your servant away in anger. You helped me before. God who saves me, do not leave me alone.

**10** My father and my mother can leave me, but the LORD will take care of me.

**11** LORD, teach me your way. Lead me on a level path because of my enemies.

**12** Do not give me to my enemies. False witnesses stand against me. They say cruel things about me.

**13** I almost lost hope. But I believed that I will see the goodness of the LORD while I live.

**14** Wait for the LORD. Be brave, and he will make your heart strong. Wait for the LORD.

## Chapter 28

**1** LORD, my rock, I call to you. Do not be silent to me. If you are silent, I will become like the dead people in the grave.

**2** Hear my voice when I ask you for help. Hear me when I lift my hands toward your holy place.

**3** Do not pull me away with the wicked people and with the people who do evil. They speak peace to their neighbors, but evil is in their hearts.

**4** Give them the result of their acts and of their wickedness. Give them the result of the work of their hands. Give them what they must get.

**5** They do not respect the works of the LORD or what his hands made. Thus he will destroy them. He will not build them again.

**6** Praise the LORD, because he heard my voice when I asked for help.

**7** The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart trusted him, and he helped me. Thus my heart is very happy. I will praise him with my song.

**8** The LORD is the strength of his people. He is the strength that saves his anointed king.

**9** Save your people and bless the people who are yours. Be their shepherd and carry them always.

## Chapter 29

**1** You strong beings in heaven, give glory and strength to the LORD.

**2** Give to the LORD the glory that his name must get. Worship the LORD in his holy beauty.

**3** The voice of the LORD is above the waters. The God of glory makes thunder. The LORD is above the many waters.

**4** The voice of the LORD is powerful. The voice of the LORD is full of majesty.

**5** The voice of the LORD breaks the cedar trees. The LORD breaks the cedars of Lebanon.

**6** He makes Lebanon jump like a calf. He makes Sirion jump like a young wild ox.

**7** The voice of the LORD sends out flames of lightning.

**8** The voice of the LORD shakes the desert. The LORD shakes the desert of Kadesh.

**9** The voice of the LORD makes the deer give birth. It takes the leaves from the forests. In his temple, all the people say, "Glory!"

**10** The LORD sat as King above the flood. The LORD is King always.

**11** The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.

## Chapter 30

**1** LORD, I will praise you, because you lifted me up. You did not let my enemies be happy about me.

**2** LORD my God, I called to you for help, and you healed me.

**3** LORD, you brought my soul up from the grave. You kept me alive. I did not go down into the pit.

**4** Sing to the LORD, you holy people of his. Give thanks when you remember his holy name.

**5** His anger stays for only a short time, but his favor gives life for all of life. You can cry at night, but joy comes in the morning.

**6** When I had a good life, I said, "Nothing will ever move me."

**7** LORD, with your favor you made me strong like a mountain. Then you hid your face, and I was afraid.

**8** LORD, I called to you. I asked the LORD for mercy.

**9** What good will my death give you if I go down into the grave? Can dust praise you? Can dust tell about your truth?

**10** LORD, hear me and be kind to me. LORD, help me.

**11** You changed my sorrow into a dance. You took off my clothes of sorrow and you gave me joy.

**12** Thus I will sing praise to you and not be silent. LORD my God, I will thank you always.

## Chapter 31

**1** LORD, I trust you. Do not let me feel shame. Save me because you are righteous.

**2** Listen to me. Save me quickly. Be my strong rock and a strong fort that keeps me safe.

**3** You are my rock and my fort. Thus lead me and guide me because of your name.

**4** Pull me out of the hidden net that my enemies put for me. You are my strength.

**5** I put my spirit into your hand. LORD, God of truth, you saved me.

**6** I hate the people who worship false gods. But I trust the LORD.

**7** I will be glad and happy in your mercy. You saw my trouble. You knew the pain of my soul.

**8** You did not give me to my enemy. You put my feet in a wide place.

**9** LORD, be kind to me, because I am in trouble. My eyes become weak with sorrow. My soul and my body are weak.

**10** Sorrow uses up my life. My years go with sad sounds. My strength becomes weak because of my sin. My bones become weak.

**11** All my enemies insult me. My neighbors insult me more. My friends are afraid of me. People who see me in the street run away from me.

**12** People forget me as they forget a dead man. I am like a broken pot.

**13** I hear many people say false things about me. There is fear all around me. They make plans together against me. They plan to kill me.

**14** But LORD, I trust you. I said, "You are my God."

**15** My life is in your hand. Save me from my enemies and from the people who attack me.

**16** Let your face shine on your servant. Save me because of your mercy.

**17** LORD, do not let me feel shame, because I called to you. Let the wicked people feel shame. Let them be silent in the grave.

**18** Make the lying lips silent. They speak proud and cruel words against the righteous people.

**19** Your goodness is very great! You keep it for the people who fear you. You give it to the people who trust you in front of all people.

**20** You hide them near you from the proud plans of men. You keep them safe in your shelter from the attacks of tongues.

**21** Praise the LORD. He showed his wonderful love to me when I was in a city under attack.

**22** When I was afraid, I said, "God took me away from his eyes." But you heard my voice when I called to you for help.

**23** All you holy people of the LORD, love him. The LORD keeps the faithful people safe. But he punishes the proud people completely.

**24** All you who hope in the LORD, be brave. The LORD will make your hearts strong.

## Chapter 32

**1** The person whose wrong acts God forgives is happy. The person whose sin God covers is happy.

**2** The man that the LORD does not find guilty is happy. That man does not lie in his spirit.

**3** When I did not tell about my sin, my bones became weak. I cried all day long.

**4** Day and night your hand pushed hard on me. My strength became dry like a plant in the summer heat. Selah.

**5** Then I told you about my sin. I did not hide my wrong acts. I said, "I will tell the LORD about my sins." Then you forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah.

**6** Thus all godly people must pray to you while they can find you. Then the floods of great water will not come near them.

**7** You are my place of safety. You will keep me safe from trouble. You will put songs of rescue around me. Selah.

**8** The LORD says, "I will teach you and show you the way that you must go. I will guide you and watch you."

**9** Do not be like a horse or a mule that does not understand. A person must control them with a bit and a bridle, or they will not come near you.

**10** Wicked people will have many sorrows. But the mercy of the LORD will be around the person who trusts the LORD.

**11** You righteous people, be glad in the LORD and be happy. All you who have honest hearts, shout with joy.

## Chapter 33

**1** You righteous people, be happy in the LORD. It is good for honest people to praise him.

**2** Praise the LORD with the harp. Sing to him with a harp that has 10 strings.

**3** Sing a new song to him. Play well and shout with joy.

**4** The word of the LORD is right. He does all his work faithfully.

**5** He loves what is right and fair. The earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.

**6** The LORD made the heavens by his word. He made all the stars by the breath of his mouth.

**7** He collects the waters of the sea into a pile. He puts the deep waters into storerooms.

**8** All the earth must fear the LORD. All the people of the world must respect him with fear.

**9** He spoke, and the world came into existence. He gave the command, and it stood firm.

**10** The LORD stops the plans of the nations. He makes the plans of the people fail.

**11** The plans of the LORD stay always. The thoughts of his heart stay for all generations.

**12** The nation whose God is the LORD is happy. The people that he chose as his own are happy.

**13** The LORD looks down from heaven. He sees all people.

**14** From his home, he looks at all the people who live on the earth.

**15** He made the hearts of all people. He understands all their acts.

**16** A large army does not save a king. Much strength does not save a strong man.

**17** A horse cannot make sure that you are safe. Its great strength cannot save you.

**18** But the LORD watches the people who fear him. He watches the people who hope in his mercy.

**19** He saves them from death. He keeps them alive in a time of famine.

**20** We wait for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.

**21** Our hearts are happy in him, because we trust his holy name.

**22** LORD, let your mercy be on us, because we hope in you.

## Chapter 34

**1** I will praise the LORD at all times. My mouth will always praise him.

**2** My soul will be proud of the LORD. The humble people will hear and be glad.

**3** Praise the LORD with me. Let us honor his name together.

**4** I looked for the LORD, and he answered me. He saved me from all my fears.

**5** The people who look to him shine with joy. Their faces are never ashamed.

**6** This poor man called, and the LORD heard him. The LORD saved him from all his troubles.

**7** The angel of the LORD camps around the people who fear him. He saves them.

**8** Taste and see that the LORD is good. The man who trusts in him is happy.

**9** You holy people of the LORD, fear him. The people who fear him have all that they need.

**10** Young lions can be weak and hungry. But the people who look for the LORD will have all good things.

**11** Children, come and listen to me. I will teach you to fear the LORD.

**12** Do you want a long and good life?

**13** Then do not say evil things. Do not tell lies.

**14** Stop evil and do good. Look for peace and follow it.

**15** The eyes of the LORD watch the righteous people. His ears hear their call for help.

**16** The LORD is against the people who do evil. He will remove all memory of them from the earth.

**17** The righteous people call, and the LORD hears them. He saves them from all their troubles.

**18** The LORD is near the people who have a broken heart. He saves the people whose spirit is sad.

**19** A righteous person has many troubles. But the LORD saves him from all of them.

**20** The LORD keeps all his bones safe. Not 1 of his bones will break.

**21** Evil will kill the wicked people. God will punish the people who hate the righteous person.

**22** The LORD saves the lives of his servants. God will not punish any person who trusts in him.

## Chapter 35

**1** LORD, oppose the people who oppose me. Fight against the people who fight against me.

**2** Take your small shield and your large shield. Stand up and help me.

**3** Lift your spear and stop the people who chase me. Tell my soul, "I will save you."

**4** Let the people who try to kill me feel shame. Let the people who plan to hurt me go back in confusion.

**5** Let them be like chaff that the wind blows away. Let the angel of the LORD push them away.

**6** Let their path be dark and slippery. Let the angel of the LORD chase them.

**7** They hid a net in a pit for me without a reason. They dug a hole for me without a reason.

**8** Let destruction come on my enemy when he does not expect it. Let the net that he hid catch him. Let him fall into his own hole and die.

**9** Then my soul will be happy in the LORD. My soul will be glad because he saves me.

**10** All my body will say, "LORD, no person is like you. You save the weak person from the person who is too strong for him. You save the poor and needy people from the thief."

**11** Cruel witnesses stand up against me. They accuse me of things that I do not know about.

**12** They do evil to me in return for good. My soul is sad.

**13** But when they were sick, I wore sackcloth to show sorrow. I made myself humble and did not eat. I prayed for them with my head down.

**14** I acted as if they were my friends or my brothers. I bowed my head with sorrow, as a man who cries for his mother.

**15** But when I fell, they were happy and came together. Bad people came together against me without my knowledge. They attacked me with words and did not stop.

**16** They mocked me as godless people do at feasts. They showed their anger with their teeth.

**17** Lord, how long will you only watch? Save my life from their attacks. Save my only life from these lions.

**18** I will thank you in the large group of your people. I will praise you among many people.

**19** Do not let my enemies be happy about me without a reason. Do not let the people who hate me without a reason make signs with their eyes.

**20** They do not speak peace. They plan lies against the quiet people of the land.

**21** They open their mouths wide against me. They say, "Aha! Aha! We saw what you did!"

**22** LORD, you saw this. Do not be silent. Lord, do not be far from me.

**23** Wake up! Stand up and defend me. My God and my Lord, fight for me.

**24** LORD my God, judge me because you are righteous. Do not let my enemies be happy about me.

**25** Do not let them say in their hearts, "Good! We have what we want." Do not let them say, "We destroyed him."

**26** Let all the people who are happy about my pain feel shame and confusion. Let shame and dishonor cover the people who are proud against me.

**27** Let the people who want me to win shout with joy and be glad. Let them always say, "The LORD is great. He is happy when his servant has peace."

**28** Then my tongue will speak about your righteousness. I will praise you all day long.

## Chapter 36

**1** I know in my heart about the sin of the wicked man. He does not fear God.

**2** He thinks that he is very good. Thus he does not see his sin and he does not hate it.

**3** The words of his mouth are evil and false. He stopped being wise and he stopped doing good.

**4** He plans evil while he lies on his bed. He goes on a path that is not good. He does not refuse evil.

**5** LORD, your mercy is as high as the heavens. Your faithfulness goes up to the clouds.

**6** Your righteousness is like the high mountains. Your judgments are like the deep sea. LORD, you keep people and animals safe.

**7** God, your love is very valuable! People find safety in the shadow of your wings.

**8** They eat the good food from your house until they are full. You let them drink from your river of joy.

**9** You are the source of life. Your light lets us see light.

**10** Continue to give your love to the people who know you. Continue to give your righteousness to the people with honest hearts.

**11** Do not let the foot of proud people step on me. Do not let the hand of wicked people push me away.

**12** Look! The people who do evil fell down. Someone threw them down, and they cannot stand up.

## Chapter 37

**1** Do not be angry because of evil people. Do not want what the wicked people have.

**2** They will soon die like the grass. They will become dry like green plants.

**3** Trust in the LORD and do good. Live in the land and be safe.

**4** Be happy in the LORD. He will give you the things that your heart wants.

**5** Give your life to the LORD. Trust him, and he will help you.

**6** He will make your righteousness shine like the light. He will make your honest cause shine like the sun at noon.

**7** Be calm in front of the LORD and wait patiently for him. Do not be angry when a man has success with his evil plans.

**8** Stop your anger. Do not be angry. Do not be upset, because that causes only evil.

**9** God will remove the evil people. But the people who wait for the LORD will get the land.

**10** After a short time, the wicked person will not be there. You will look for him carefully, but you will not find him.

**11** But the humble people will get the land. They will be happy in much peace.

**12** The wicked person makes plans against the righteous person. He shows his anger with his teeth.

**13** The Lord laughs at the wicked person, because he knows that the day of punishment will come.

**14** The wicked people take out their swords and pull back their bows. They want to kill the poor and needy people. They want to kill the honest people.

**15** But their swords will go into their own hearts. Their bows will break.

**16** The little that a righteous man has is better than the wealth of many wicked people.

**17** The LORD will break the power of the wicked people. But the LORD keeps the righteous people safe.

**18** The LORD knows the lives of the honest people. What they get from him will stay always.

**19** In bad times they will not feel shame. In times of famine they will have sufficient food.

**20** But the wicked people will die. The enemies of the LORD will be like flowers of the fields. They will disappear like smoke.

**21** The wicked person borrows money and does not pay it back. But the righteous person is kind and gives.

**22** The people that the LORD blesses will get the land. The people that he curses will die.

**23** The LORD makes the steps of a good man firm. He is happy with the life of that man.

**24** The good man can fall, but he will not stay down. The LORD holds him with his hand.

**25** I was young and now I am old. But I never saw the LORD leave a righteous person. I never saw the children of a righteous person ask for bread.

**26** The righteous person is always kind and he lends money. His children are a blessing.

**27** Stop evil and do good. Then you will live in the land always.

**28** The LORD loves justice. He will not leave his holy people. He will keep them safe always. But he will destroy the children of the wicked people.

**29** The righteous people will get the land. They will live there always.

**30** The righteous person speaks wisdom. His tongue speaks what is fair.

**31** The law of his God is in his heart. His feet do not slip.

**32** The wicked person watches the righteous person and tries to kill him.

**33** But the LORD will not leave the righteous person in the power of the wicked person. The LORD will not let the court find him guilty.

**34** Wait for the LORD and obey his way. He will give you honor and you will get the land. You will see when he destroys the wicked people.

**35** I saw a wicked and cruel man. He grew strong like a large green tree.

**36** But he died and disappeared. I looked for him, but I did not find him.

**37** Look at the honest man and watch the good man. The man of peace will have a future.

**38** But God will destroy all the sinners. The wicked people will have no future.

**39** The LORD saves the righteous people. He is their strength in the time of trouble.

**40** The LORD helps them and saves them. He saves them from the wicked people, because they trust in him.

## Chapter 38

**1** LORD, do not correct me when you are angry. Do not punish me in your hot anger.

**2** Your arrows went into me. Your hand pushes down hard on me.

**3** My body is sick because of your anger. My bones have no rest because of my sin.

**4** My sins are higher than my head. They are like a heavy load that is too heavy for me.

**5** My wounds smell bad and are full of disease because of my foolish acts.

**6** I am bent over and very low. I am sad all day long.

**7** My back is full of hot pain. My body is sick.

**8** I am weak and completely broken. I cry out because my heart has no peace.

**9** Lord, you know all that I want. You hear all my sad sounds.

**10** My heart beats fast and my strength goes away. The light also goes from my eyes.

**11** My friends and my companions stay away from me because of my sickness. My family stays far away.

**12** The people who want to kill me put traps for me. The people who want to hurt me speak about my destruction. They plan lies all day long.

**13** But I am like a deaf man who does not hear. I am like a man who cannot speak and does not open his mouth.

**14** I am like a man who does not hear. My mouth gives no answer.

**15** LORD, I hope in you. Lord my God, you will answer me.

**16** I said, "Do not let my enemies be happy about me. Do not let them be proud against me when my foot slips."

**17** I am about to fall. My pain is always with me.

**18** I tell you about my sin. My sin makes me sad.

**19** But my enemies are strong and full of energy. Many people hate me without a reason.

**20** They do evil to me in return for good. They are my enemies because I try to do good.

**21** LORD, do not leave me. My God, do not be far from me.

**22** Lord, you save me. Come quickly and help me.

## Chapter 39

**1** I said, "I will be careful about what I do. I will not sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth shut while the wicked people are near me."

**2** I was completely silent. I did not even say good things. But my pain became worse.

**3** My heart became hot inside me. While I thought, the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:

**4** "LORD, show me the end of my life and the number of my days. Let me know how short my life is.

**5** You made my days very short. My life is like nothing to you. Each man is only a breath, also when he is strong. Selah.

**6** Each man moves like a shadow. He works hard for nothing. He collects wealth, but he does not know who will get it.

**7** Lord, what do I wait for now? My hope is in you.

**8** Save me from all my sins. Do not let foolish people insult me.

**9** I was silent. I did not open my mouth, because you caused my trouble.

**10** Stop your punishment of me. The blows from your hand destroy me.

**11** You punish people for their sins. You destroy what they love, as a moth destroys clothes. Each man is only a breath. Selah.

**12** LORD, hear my prayer. Listen to my call for help. Do not be silent when I cry. I am a visitor with you, a stranger, as all my ancestors were.

**13** Look away from me so that I can be happy again before I die and go away."

## Chapter 40

**1** I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me and heard my call for help.

**2** He pulled me out of a terrible pit. He pulled me out of the deep mud. He put my feet on a rock and made my steps firm.

**3** He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God. Many people will see this and fear. They will trust in the LORD.

**4** The man who trusts in the LORD is happy. He does not respect proud people. He does not go to people who follow lies.

**5** LORD my God, you did many wonderful works. You have many plans for us. No person can compare with you. If I try to speak about all of them, I cannot count them.

**6** You did not want sacrifices and offerings. You opened my ears to hear you. You did not ask for burnt offerings and sin offerings.

**7** Then I said, "Look, I come. The book tells about me.

**8** My God, I want to do what you want. Your law is in my heart."

**9** I told about your righteousness to the large group of your people. LORD, you know that I did not close my lips.

**10** I did not hide your righteousness in my heart. I spoke about your faithfulness and how you save. I did not hide your love and your truth from the large group of your people.

**11** LORD, do not keep your mercy from me. Let your love and your truth always keep me safe.

**12** Too many troubles are around me. My sins caught me, and I cannot see. My sins are more than the hairs of my head. My heart is weak.

**13** LORD, please save me. LORD, come quickly and help me.

**14** Let the people who want to kill me feel shame and confusion. Let the people who want to hurt me go back in shame.

**15** Let the people who say "Aha! Aha!" to me feel shock because of their shame.

**16** Let all the people who look for you be happy and glad in you. Let the people who love your salvation always say, "The LORD is great!"

**17** But I am poor and needy. The Lord thinks about me. You are my help and you save me. My God, do not wait.

## Chapter 41

**1** The person who helps the poor people is happy. The LORD will save him in the time of trouble.

**2** The LORD will keep him safe and alive. He will be happy in the land. You will not give him to his enemies.

**3** The LORD will help him when he is sick in bed. You will make him healthy again.

**4** I said, "LORD, be kind to me. Heal me, because I sinned against you."

**5** My enemies say evil things about me. They say, "When will he die? When will people forget his name?"

**6** When an enemy comes to see me, he says false words. His heart collects bad news. Then he goes out and tells it to other people.

**7** All the people who hate me speak quietly together about me. They plan evil against me.

**8** They say, "A bad disease holds him. He lies down and he will not stand up again."

**9** Also my close friend, whom I trusted, turned against me. He ate my bread, but now he is my enemy.

**10** But LORD, be kind to me. Lift me up so that I can pay them back.

**11** I know that you are happy with me, because my enemy does not win against me.

**12** You hold me safe because I am honest. You keep me near you always.

**13** Praise the LORD, the God of Israel, from the start of time to the end of time. Amen and Amen.

## Chapter 42

**1** A deer wants to drink from the streams of water. My soul wants you in the same way, God.

**2** My soul is thirsty for God, the God who lives. When can I come to God and stand in front of him?

**3** I cry day and night, and my tears are my food. All day, people say to me, "Where is your God?"

**4** I remember these things and I pour out my soul. I went with the crowd to the house of God. We went with shouts of joy and praise. We were a big crowd at a festival.

**5** My soul, why are you sad? Why are you troubled inside me? Hope in God. I will praise him again, because he helps me.

**6** My God, my soul is sad inside me. Thus I will remember you from the land of the Jordan. I will remember you from the mountains of Hermon and from Mount Mizar.

**7** The deep waters call to each other at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves go over me.

**8** In the day the LORD shows his love to me. In the night I sing his song. I pray to the God of my life.

**9** I will say to God, my rock, "Why did you forget me? Why must I be sad because my enemy attacks me?"

**10** The insults of my enemies are like a sword in my bones. All day they say to me, "Where is your God?"

**11** My soul, why are you sad? Why are you troubled inside me? Hope in God. I will praise him again. He saves me, and he is my God.

## Chapter 43

**1** God, judge me. Defend me against a nation of people who do not obey you. Save me from the lies of the unjust man.

**2** You are the God who gives me strength. Why did you send me away? Why must I be sad because my enemy attacks me?

**3** Send your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you live.

**4** Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my great joy. God, my God, I will praise you with the harp.

**5** My soul, why are you sad? Why are you troubled inside me? Hope in God. I will praise him again. He saves me, and he is my God.

## Chapter 44

**1** God, we heard with our ears what you did in the old times. Our ancestors told us about the work that you did in their days.

**2** With your hand you pushed the nations out of the land. Then you put our ancestors in the land. You punished the other peoples and you sent them away.

**3** Our ancestors did not take the land with their swords. Their strength did not save them. Your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face saved them, because you loved them.

**4** God, you are my King. Give the command, and save the people of Jacob.

**5** With your help we will push back our enemies. With your name we will walk on the people who attack us.

**6** I will not trust in my bow. My sword will not save me.

**7** But you saved us from our enemies. You made the people who hate us ashamed.

**8** We are proud of God all day long. We will praise your name always. Selah.

**9** But now you sent us away and made us ashamed. You do not go out with our armies.

**10** You made us run away from the enemy. The people who hate us take our property.

**11** You gave us away like sheep for food. You sent us to live among the nations.

**12** You sold your people for very little money. You got no profit from the sale.

**13** Our neighbors insult us because of you. The people around us laugh at us and mock us.

**14** The nations use our name as a joke. The peoples shake their heads at us.

**15** All day I feel shame. Shame covers my face.

**16** I hear the insults of the people who mock God. I see the enemy who wants revenge.

**17** All these things happened to us. But we did not forget you. We did not break your covenant.

**18** Our hearts did not turn away from you. Our feet did not go away from your path.

**19** But you crushed us and you put us in the place where jackals live. You covered us with deep darkness.

**20** We did not forget the name of our God. We did not lift our hands to pray to a foreign god.

**21** If we did, God will find out about it. He knows the secrets of the heart.

**22** Because of you, our enemies kill us all day long. They think that we are only sheep for the butcher.

**23** Lord, wake up! Why do you sleep? Get up! Do not send us away always.

**24** Why do you hide your face? Why do you forget our pain and our trouble?

**25** We lie in the dust. Our bodies lie flat on the ground.

**26** Stand up and help us. Save us because of your love.

## Chapter 45

**1** My heart is full of good words. I speak my poem for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a fast writer.

**2** You are the most handsome of all men. You speak with grace. Thus God blessed you always.

**3** Strong king, put your sword on your side. Show your glory and your majesty.

**4** Ride out with majesty and win. Fight for truth, humility, and righteousness. Your right hand will do terrible acts.

**5** Your sharp arrows go into the hearts of the enemies of the king. The nations fall under your feet.

**6** God, your throne will stay always. You rule your kingdom with justice.

**7** You love righteousness and you hate wickedness. Thus God, your God, anointed you with the oil of joy. He put you above your companions.

**8** All your clothes smell of myrrh, aloes, and cassia. The music from the ivory palaces makes you glad.

**9** The daughters of kings are among the women of your court. The queen stands at your right side. She wears gold from Ophir.

**10** Daughter, listen and think. Hear me. Forget your people and the house of your father.

**11** The king will want your beauty. He is your lord, thus bow to him.

**12** The people of Tyre will bring you a gift. The rich people will try to get your favor.

**13** The daughter of the king is very beautiful in her room. Her clothes have gold in them.

**14** The servants will bring her to the king in clothes of beautiful needlework. Her young women companions will follow her. The servants will bring them to you.

**15** They will come with joy and happiness. They will go into the palace of the king.

**16** Your sons will take the place of your ancestors. You will make them princes in all the land.

**17** I will make your name famous for all generations. Thus the people will praise you always.

## Chapter 46

**1** God is our safe place and our strength. He is always there to help us in trouble.

**2** Thus we will not be afraid when the earth shakes. We will not be afraid when the mountains fall into the sea.

**3** We will not be afraid when the seas make a loud noise and the waves are high. We will not be afraid when the mountains shake. Selah.

**4** There is a river whose streams make the city of God happy. That city is the holy place where the Most High God lives.

**5** God is in that city, and it will not fall. God will help it at the start of the day.

**6** The nations are angry, and the kingdoms fall. God speaks, and the earth melts.

**7** The LORD of armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our safe place. Selah.

**8** Come and see the works of the LORD. See the destruction that he caused on the earth.

**9** He stops wars in all the world. He breaks the bow and cuts the spear into pieces. He burns the chariots in the fire.

**10** God says, "Stop and know that I am God. All the nations will honor me. All the earth will honor me."

**11** The LORD of armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our safe place. Selah.

## Chapter 47

**1** All you peoples, clap your hands. Shout to God with songs of joy.

**2** The LORD Most High causes fear. He is a great King over all the earth.

**3** He puts the peoples under our control. He puts the nations under our feet.

**4** He chose our land for us. It is the pride of Jacob, whom he loves. Selah.

**5** God went up while the people shouted. The LORD went up while the trumpets sounded.

**6** Sing praises to God. Sing praises. Sing praises to our King. Sing praises.

**7** God is the King of all the earth. Sing a song of praise to him.

**8** God rules over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

**9** The leaders of the nations come together with the people of the God of Abraham. The kings of the earth are under the control of God. God is very great.

## Chapter 48

**1** The LORD is great. All people must praise him in the city of our God, on his holy mountain.

**2** Mount Zion is high and beautiful. It gives joy to all the earth. Mount Zion, in the far north, is the city of the great King.

**3** God is in the palaces of the city. He shows that he is its strong fort.

**4** Look! The kings came together. They came to attack the city.

**5** They saw the city and they felt surprise. They were afraid and they ran away quickly.

**6** Fear took hold of them there. They felt pain like a woman when she gives birth.

**7** You destroyed the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

**8** We heard about it, and now we saw it in the city of the LORD of armies. We saw it in the city of our God. God will make the city safe always. Selah.

**9** God, we think about your love while we are in your temple.

**10** God, all the earth knows your name. Thus people praise you to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

**11** Let the people of Mount Zion be happy. Let the towns of Judah be glad because of your judgments.

**12** Walk around Zion. Go around the city and count its towers.

**13** Look carefully at its walls. Examine its palaces. Then you can tell the next generation about them.

**14** This God is our God always. He will guide us until we die.

## Chapter 49

**1** Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you who live in the world.

**2** Listen, poor people and important people, rich people and poor people.

**3** My mouth will speak wisdom. The thoughts of my heart will give knowledge.

**4** I will listen to a proverb. I will explain my puzzle while I play the harp.

**5** Why must I be afraid in bad times? Why must I be afraid when evil people are all around me?

**6** Some people trust in their wealth. They are proud because they have much money.

**7** But no man can pay to save the life of his brother. No man can pay God a price for another man.

**8** The price for a life is too high. No person can ever pay it.

**9** No person can pay to live always and never go into the grave.

**10** All people see that wise men die. Foolish and stupid people also die. They all leave their wealth to other people.

**11** They think that their houses will stay always. They think that their homes will stay for all generations. They give their names to their lands.

**12** But a man does not stay with his honor. He is like the animals that die.

**13** That is the path of the foolish people and of the people who follow them. Selah.

**14** They are like sheep that will go to the grave. Death will be their shepherd. In the morning the honest people will rule over them. Their bodies will decay in the grave, far from their homes.

**15** But God will save my life from the power of the grave. He will take me to him. Selah.

**16** Do not be afraid when a man becomes rich. Do not be afraid when his house becomes more beautiful.

**17** When he dies, he will take nothing with him. His wealth will not go down with him into the grave.

**18** While he lived, he thought that he was happy. People praise you when you have success.

**19** But he will die and go to his ancestors. They will never see the light again.

**20** A man who has wealth but no good sense is like the animals that die.

## Chapter 50

**1** The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks. He calls to the earth from the east to the west.

**2** God shines out of Zion, the most beautiful city.

**3** Our God comes, and he will not be silent. A fire burns in front of him. A strong storm is around him.

**4** He calls to the heavens above and to the earth. He will judge his people.

**5** He says, "Bring my holy people to me. They made a covenant with me with a sacrifice."

**6** The heavens tell about his righteousness, because God himself is the judge. Selah.

**7** "My people, listen, and I will speak. Israel, I will speak against you. I am God, your God.

**8** I do not criticize you for your sacrifices. You always give me your burnt offerings.

**9** I do not need a bull from your farm. I do not need goats from your animal pens.

**10** All the animals of the forest are mine. The cattle on 1,000 hills are mine.

**11** I know all the birds of the mountains. All the animals in the fields are mine.

**12** If I am hungry, I will not tell you. The world and all things in it are mine.

**13** Do I eat the meat of bulls? Do I drink the blood of goats?

**14** Give thanks to God as your sacrifice. Do what you promised to the Most High.

**15** Call to me when you are in trouble. I will save you, and you will honor me."

**16** But God says to the wicked person, "You have no right to speak my laws. You have no right to speak about my covenant.

**17** You hate my correction. You throw my words away.

**18** When you see a thief, you join him. You do the same as people who commit adultery.

**19** You use your mouth to speak evil. Your tongue tells lies.

**20** You sit and speak against your brother. You say false things about the son of your mother.

**21** You did these things, and I was silent. You thought that I was the same as you. But now I will accuse you. I will show your sins to you.

**22** All you who forget God, think about this. If you do not, I will tear you into pieces, and no person will save you.

**23** The person who gives thanks as his sacrifice honors me. I will show the salvation of God to the person who lives correctly."

## Chapter 51

**1** God, be kind to me because of your love. You have much mercy, thus remove my sins.

**2** Wash away all my guilt. Make me clean from my sin.

**3** I know my sins. I always see my sin in front of me.

**4** I sinned against you, only you. I did what is evil in your eyes. Thus you are right when you speak. You are fair when you judge.

**5** I was a sinner from the time of my birth. I was a sinner from the time when my mother became pregnant with me.

**6** You want truth inside me. You teach me wisdom in my heart.

**7** Make me clean with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

**8** Let me hear joy and happiness. You broke my bones, but now let them be happy.

**9** Do not look at my sins. Remove all my guilt.

**10** God, make a clean heart in me. Give me a new and faithful spirit.

**11** Do not send me away from you. Do not take your Holy Spirit from me.

**12** Give me again the joy that comes when you save me. Give me a spirit that wants to obey you and keeps me strong.

**13** Then I will teach your ways to sinners. Sinners will come back to you.

**14** God, you are the God who saves me. Save me from the guilt of murder. Then my tongue will sing loudly about your righteousness.

**15** Lord, open my lips. Then my mouth will praise you.

**16** You do not want a sacrifice. If you want one, I will give it. Burnt offerings do not make you happy.

**17** The sacrifice that God wants is a humble spirit. God, you will not refuse a heart that is humble and sorry.

**18** Be good to Zion because it pleases you. Build the walls of Jerusalem again.

**19** Then the correct sacrifices will make you happy. Burnt offerings and whole burnt offerings will make you happy. Then people will give bulls on your altar.

## Chapter 52

**1** Strong man, why are you proud of your evil acts? The goodness of God stays all day long.

**2** Your tongue plans destruction. It is like a sharp razor. You tell lies.

**3** You love evil more than good. You love lies more than the truth. Selah.

**4** You love all words that hurt people. You have a tongue that tells lies.

**5** But God will destroy you always. He will take you and pull you out of your tent. He will remove you from the land of people who live. Selah.

**6** The righteous people will see this and they will fear. They will laugh at him. They will say,

**7** "Look at this man. He did not make God his strength. He trusted in his large wealth. He became strong through his evil."

**8** But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God. I trust in the love of God always.

**9** I will praise you always because of what you did. I will hope in your name, because it is good. I will do this in front of your holy people.

## Chapter 53

**1** The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." Fools are corrupt and they do terrible evil. No person does good.

**2** God looks down from heaven at all people. He looks for a person who understands. He looks for a person who tries to find God.

**3** All people turned away from God. They all became corrupt. No person does good, not even 1.

**4** Do the people who do evil know nothing? They destroy my people as they eat bread. They do not pray to God.

**5** They were very afraid when there was no reason for fear. God scattered the bones of the people who attacked you. You made them ashamed, because God refused them.

**6** I want salvation for Israel to come from Zion! God will make his people successful again. Then Jacob will be happy and Israel will be glad.

## Chapter 54

**1** God, save me with the power of your name. Defend me with your strength.

**2** God, hear my prayer. Listen to the words of my mouth.

**3** Strangers attack me. Cruel men try to kill me. They do not respect God. Selah.

**4** Look, God helps me. The Lord keeps me alive.

**5** God will punish my enemies for their evil. You are faithful, thus destroy them.

**6** I will freely give you a sacrifice. LORD, I will praise your name, because it is good.

**7** God saved me from all my trouble. My eyes saw the defeat of my enemies.

## Chapter 55

**1** God, listen to my prayer. Do not hide from my request for help.

**2** Listen to me and answer me. My troubles make me sad and I cry out.

**3** I hear the voice of the enemy. The wicked people attack me. They bring trouble on me and they hate me with anger.

**4** My heart has much pain inside me. The fear of death fell on me.

**5** Fear comes on me, and my body shakes. Horror covers me.

**6** I said, "I want wings like a dove. Then I can fly away and be at rest.

**7** I can go far away and live in the desert. Selah.

**8** I can quickly go to a safe place, away from the strong wind and the storm."

**9** Lord, confuse the wicked people and confuse their languages. I see violence and fights in the city.

**10** Day and night they go around the city on its walls. Evil and trouble are in the city.

**11** Destruction is in the city. Cruelty and lies never leave its streets.

**12** An enemy did not insult me. If he did, I can accept it. A person who hates me did not attack me. If he did, I can hide from him.

**13** But you did it. You are a man like me. You are my companion and my close friend.

**14** We talked together as good friends. We walked together with the crowd to the house of God.

**15** Let death take my enemies suddenly. Let them go down alive into the grave. Evil lives in their homes and in their hearts.

**16** But I will call to God, and the LORD will save me.

**17** In the evening, in the morning, and at noon, I pray and cry out. He hears my voice.

**18** He saved my life and kept me safe in the battle against me, because many people fought against me.

**19** God, who is King from the start of time, will hear and punish them. Selah. They do not change and they do not fear God.

**20** My friend attacked the people who were at peace with him. He broke his promise.

**21** His words were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart. His words were softer than oil, but they were like swords.

**22** Give your troubles to the LORD, and he will take care of you. He will never let the righteous person fall.

**23** But God, you will send the wicked people down into the pit of destruction. Murderers and liars will not live half their lives. But I will trust in you.

## Chapter 56

**1** God, be kind to me. Men attack me. All day long they fight and push me down.

**2** My enemies attack me all day long. Most High God, many people fight against me.

**3** When I am afraid, I will trust in you.

**4** I praise the word of God. I trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can a man do to me?

**5** All day long they change my words. They always plan to hurt me.

**6** They come together and they hide. They watch my steps. They wait to kill me.

**7** Do not let them escape because of their evil. God, in your anger, throw down the nations.

**8** You count my travels. Put my tears into your bottle. You write them in your book.

**9** When I call to you, my enemies will run away. I know that God is on my side.

**10** I praise the word of God. I praise the word of the LORD.

**11** I trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can a man do to me?

**12** God, I must do what I promised to you. I will give you offerings of thanks.

**13** You saved my life from death. You kept my feet from a fall. Thus I can walk with God in the light of life.

## Chapter 57

**1** Be kind to me, God, be kind to me, because I trust in you. I will hide in the shadow of your wings until the danger goes away.

**2** I call to God Most High. I call to God, who does all things for me.

**3** He will send help from heaven and save me. He will defeat the people who attack me. Selah. God will send his love and his faithfulness.

**4** I live among lions. I lie down among people who want to eat me. Their teeth are like spears and arrows. Their tongues are like sharp swords.

**5** God, show your greatness above the heavens. Let your glory be above all the earth.

**6** My enemies put a net in front of my feet. I was very sad. They dug a hole in front of me, but they fell into it. Selah.

**7** God, my heart is firm. My heart is firm. I will sing and play music.

**8** Wake up, my soul! Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

**9** Lord, I will praise you among the peoples. I will sing to you among the nations.

**10** Your love is as high as the heavens. Your faithfulness goes up to the clouds.

**11** God, show your greatness above the heavens. Let your glory be above all the earth.

## Chapter 58

**1** You rulers, do you speak what is right? Do you judge people fairly?

**2** No! In your hearts you plan evil. Your hands do violence in the land.

**3** The wicked people go away from God from the time of their birth. They tell lies from the time that their mothers give birth to them.

**4** Their poison is like the poison of a snake. They are like a deaf cobra that closes its ears.

**5** The cobra does not hear the music of the snake charmer, also when he plays very well.

**6** God, break the teeth in their mouths. LORD, break the large teeth of these young lions.

**7** Let them disappear like water that flows away. When they shoot their arrows, let the arrows have no power.

**8** Let them be like a snail that melts away. Let them be like a baby that dies before birth and never sees the sun.

**9** God will quickly take them away with a strong wind in his anger. He will take them away before a pot can get hot on a fire of thorns.

**10** The righteous person will be happy when God punishes the wicked people. He will walk through the blood of the wicked people.

**11** Then people will say, "Truly, there is a reward for the righteous people. Truly, there is a God who judges the earth."

## Chapter 59

**1** My God, save me from my enemies. Keep me safe from the people who attack me.

**2** Save me from the people who do evil. Save me from murderers.

**3** Look! They wait to kill me. Strong men come together against me. LORD, I did not do wrong or sin against them.

**4** I did nothing wrong, but they run to attack me. Wake up and help me! Look at my trouble!

**5** LORD God of armies, God of Israel, wake up and punish all the nations. Do not show mercy to the evil people who betray you. Selah.

**6** They come back in the evening. They growl like dogs and go around the city.

**7** Look at the bad words that come out of their mouths. Their words are like swords. They say, "Who will hear us?"

**8** But LORD, you laugh at them. You mock all the nations.

**9** God, you are my strength. I will watch for you, because you are my fort.

**10** My God loves me and he will come to me. God will let me see the defeat of my enemies.

**11** Do not kill them. If you do, my people will forget. Make them wander by your power. Lord, our shield, throw them down.

**12** They sin with their mouths. Let their words catch them in their pride. They speak curses and lies.

**13** Destroy them in your anger. Destroy them until they are gone. Then all people to the ends of the earth will know that God rules over Jacob. Selah.

**14** They come back in the evening. They growl like dogs and go around the city.

**15** They walk around and look for food. They growl if they do not get sufficient food.

**16** But I will sing about your strength. In the morning I will sing loudly about your love. You are my fort. You are my safe place when I am in trouble.

**17** My strength, I will sing praises to you. God, you are my fort. You are the God who loves me.

## Chapter 60

**1** God, you sent us away and broke our defenses. You were angry. Now come back to us.

**2** You made the land shake and you broke it open. Repair its cracks, because it shakes.

**3** You made your people see hard times. You gave us wine that makes us fall down.

**4** You gave a flag to the people who fear you. They can go to it and be safe from the bow. Selah.

**5** Save us with your right hand and answer us. Then the people that you love will be safe.

**6** God spoke from his holy place: "I will win and I will be happy. I will divide Shechem. I will measure the Valley of Succoth.

**7** Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

**8** Moab is my wash bowl. I will throw my shoe on Edom. I will shout in victory over Philistia."

**9** Who will bring me into the strong city? Who will lead me to Edom?

**10** God, you sent us away. You do not go out with our armies. But will you help us now?

**11** Give us help against the enemy, because the help of men is useless.

**12** With God we will win. He will walk on our enemies.

## Chapter 61

**1** God, hear my cry. Listen to my prayer.

**2** I call to you from the end of the earth, when my heart is weak. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I am.

**3** You are my safe place. You are a strong tower that keeps me safe from the enemy.

**4** I will live in your tent always. I will be safe under your wings. Selah.

**5** God, you heard my promises. You gave me what you give to the people who fear your name.

**6** Make the life of the king long. Let his years continue for many generations.

**7** Let him rule in front of God always. Let your love and your faithfulness keep him safe.

**8** Then I will always sing praise to your name. I will do what I promised each day.

## Chapter 62

**1** My soul waits quietly for God alone. My salvation comes from him.

**2** Only God is my rock and my salvation. He is my fort, and I will not fall.

**3** How long will all of you attack 1 man? You want to push him down as people push down a wall that leans. You want to push him down like a fence that is about to fall.

**4** They only plan to throw him down from his high position. They like lies. They speak good words with their mouths, but in their hearts they curse. Selah.

**5** My soul, wait quietly for God alone. My hope comes from him.

**6** Only God is my rock and my salvation. He is my fort, and I will not fall.

**7** My salvation and my honor come from God. God is my strong rock and my safe place.

**8** You people, trust in him at all times. Tell him all that is in your hearts. God is our safe place. Selah.

**9** Poor men are only a breath. Important men are only a lie. If you put them on a scale, they weigh less than a breath.

**10** Do not trust in cruelty. Do not hope in what you steal. If your wealth increases, do not put your trust in it.

**11** God spoke 1 time, and I heard it 2 times. Power belongs to God.

**12** Lord, love also belongs to you. You give to each person what his work must get.

## Chapter 63

**1** God, you are my God. I look for you with all my heart. My soul is thirsty for you. My body wants you, as a dry land with no water wants water.

**2** I saw you in your holy place. I saw your power and your glory.

**3** Your love is better than life. Thus my lips will praise you.

**4** I will praise you all my life. I will lift up my hands and pray to you.

**5** My soul will be full, as if I eat the best food. My mouth will praise you with happy lips.

**6** I remember you while I lie on my bed. I think about you through the night.

**7** You helped me. Thus I sing with joy in the shadow of your wings.

**8** My soul stays near you. Your right hand holds me.

**9** But the people who want to kill me will go down into the grave.

**10** They will die by the sword. Wild dogs will eat their bodies.

**11** But the king will be happy in God. All the people who make promises in his name will praise him. But God will close the mouths of the liars.

## Chapter 64

**1** God, hear my voice when I complain. Keep my life safe from the danger of the enemy.

**2** Hide me from the secret plans of the wicked people. Hide me from the crowd of people who do evil.

**3** They make their tongues sharp like swords. They aim their cruel words like arrows.
