**4** They shoot from hidden places at the innocent man. They shoot at him suddenly and they are not afraid.

**5** They help each other to do evil. They talk about where to hide their traps. They say, "Who will see the traps?"

**6** They plan crimes and they say, "We made a perfect plan!" The mind and the heart of man are very deep.

**7** But God will shoot his arrows at them. Suddenly the arrows will wound them.

**8** Their own words will cause their destruction. All people who see them will shake their heads.

**9** Then all people will fear. They will tell about the works of God. They will think carefully about what he did.

**10** The righteous people will be glad in the LORD and trust in him. All the people with honest hearts will praise him.

## Chapter 65

**1** God, we praise you in Zion. We will do what we promised to you.

**2** You hear prayer. All people will come to you.

**3** Our sins are too strong for us. But you forgive our sins.

**4** The man that you choose to come near you is happy. He lives in your courtyards. We will be happy with the good things of your house, your holy temple.

**5** God our Savior, you answer us with wonderful acts of righteousness. All the people in the ends of the earth and on the far seas hope in you.

**6** You made the mountains firm with your strength. You are very powerful.

**7** You make the loud seas and their waves quiet. You make the noise of the nations stop.

**8** The people who live far away are afraid of your wonderful acts. You make the people in the east and in the west shout with joy.

**9** You take care of the land and give it water. You make it very rich. The streams of God are full of water. You give the people grain, because you prepared the land.

**10** You give much water to the fields. You make the ground level. You make the ground soft with rain. You bless the plants that grow.

**11** You give a good harvest at the end of the year. Wherever you go, there is much food.

**12** The fields in the desert have much grass. The hills are full of joy.

**13** The fields are full of sheep. The valleys are full of grain. They shout and sing with joy.

## Chapter 66

**1** All the earth, shout with joy to God.

**2** Sing about the glory of his name. Give him glorious praise.

**3** Say to God, "Your works are wonderful! Your power is very great. Thus your enemies bow down to you in fear.

**4** All the earth worships you and sings to you. They sing praises to your name." Selah.

**5** Come and see what God did. He did wonderful things for people.

**6** He changed the sea into dry land. Our ancestors walked through the river on foot. There we were happy in him.

**7** He rules always with his power. His eyes watch the nations. Do not let the people who do not obey him become proud. Selah.

**8** All peoples, praise our God. Let all people hear the sound of his praise.

**9** He keeps us alive. He does not let our feet slip.

**10** God, you tested us. You made us pure as people make silver pure with fire.

**11** You let enemies catch us in a net. You put heavy loads on our backs.

**12** You let men ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water. But you brought us to a place with much food.

**13** I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will do what I promised to you.

**14** I promised these things with my lips when I was in trouble.

**15** I will give you fat animals as burnt offerings. I will give rams with the smoke of the sacrifice. I will give bulls and goats. Selah.

**16** Come and listen, all you who fear God. I will tell you what he did for me.

**17** I called to him with my mouth. I praised him with my tongue.

**18** If I kept sin in my heart, the Lord did not hear me.

**19** But truly God heard me. He listened to my prayer.

**20** Praise God! He did not refuse my prayer. He did not stop his love for me.

## Chapter 67

**1** God, be kind to us and bless us. Let your face shine on us. Selah.

**2** Then all the earth will know your ways. All nations will know how you save.

**3** God, let the peoples praise you. Let all the peoples praise you.

**4** Let the nations be glad and sing with joy. You judge the peoples fairly. You guide the nations of the earth. Selah.

**5** God, let the peoples praise you. Let all the peoples praise you.

**6** The land gave its harvest. God, our God, will bless us.

**7** God will bless us. All the people to the ends of the earth will fear him.

## Chapter 68

**1** Let God stand up and scatter his enemies. Let the people who hate him run away from him.

**2** The wind blows smoke away. In the same way, blow the wicked people away. Wax melts in a fire. In the same way, let the wicked people die in front of God.

**3** But let the righteous people be glad. Let them be happy in front of God. Let them be very happy.

**4** Sing to God. Sing praises to his name. Praise him who rides on the clouds. His name is Yah. Be happy in front of him.

**5** God lives in his holy home. He is a father to children who have no father. He defends the widows.

**6** God gives a family to people who are alone. He brings prisoners out to freedom and joy. But the people who do not obey him live in a dry land.

**7** God, you went out in front of your people. You marched through the desert. Selah.

**8** Then the earth shook. Rain fell from the sky in front of God. Mount Sinai shook in front of God, the God of Israel.

**9** God, you sent much rain. You made your tired land strong again.

**10** Your people lived there. God, in your goodness, you gave food to the poor people.

**11** The Lord gave the command. A large group of women told the good news.

**12** "The kings of the armies run away quickly!" The women at home divide the things that the army took.

**13** You stay among the sheep pens. But you will be like the wings of a dove with silver on them. Its feathers have yellow gold on them.

**14** The Almighty scattered the kings in the land. It was like snow that falls on Mount Zalmon.

**15** The mountains of Bashan are large mountains. The mountains of Bashan have many high tops.

**16** You high mountains, why do you look with envy at the mountain that God chose? God wants to live there. The LORD will live there always.

**17** God has 20,000 chariots, thousands and thousands of chariots. The Lord came from Sinai into his holy place.

**18** You went up to the high place. You took many prisoners. You got gifts from people, also from the people who did not obey you. Now the LORD God lives there.

**19** Praise the Lord, who carries our troubles each day. He is the God who saves us. Selah.

**20** Our God is a God who saves. The LORD, the Lord, rescues us from death.

**21** But God will crush the heads of his enemies. He will crush the heads of the people who continue to sin.

**22** The Lord said, "I will bring my enemies back from Bashan. I will bring them back from the deep sea.

**23** Then your feet will go through the blood of your enemies. Your dogs will lick their blood."

**24** God, people saw your procession. They saw my God and King go into the holy place.

**25** The singers went first. The musicians followed them. Young women who played tambourines were among them.

**26** Praise God in the large groups of people. Praise the LORD, all you people of Israel.

**27** The small tribe of Benjamin leads them. The leaders of Judah are there with their group. The leaders of Zebulun and of Naphtali are there.

**28** God, show your power. God, show the strength that you used for us before.

**29** Because of your temple in Jerusalem, kings will bring gifts to you.

**30** Stop the animal in the reeds. Stop the nations who are like bulls and calves. Make them bow down and bring silver. Scatter the nations who like war.

**31** Leaders will come out of Egypt. Ethiopia will quickly lift its hands to God in prayer.

**32** Kingdoms of the earth, sing to God. Sing praises to the Lord. Selah.

**33** Sing to God, who rides through the highest heavens, the old heavens. Listen! He speaks with a powerful voice.

**34** Say that God is strong. His majesty is over Israel. His power is in the clouds.

**35** God, you are awesome in your holy place. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise God!

## Chapter 69

**1** God, save me. The water comes up to my neck.

**2** I go down into deep mud. I have no place to stand. I am in deep water. The flood goes over me.

**3** I cried for help until I have no strength. My throat is dry. My eyes become weak because I wait for my God.

**4** The people who hate me without a reason are more than the hairs on my head. Strong people want to destroy me with lies. They make me give back things that I did not steal.

**5** God, you know my foolish acts. You see all my sins.

**6** Lord GOD of armies, do not let the people who hope in you feel shame because of me. God of Israel, do not let the people who look for you feel shame because of me.

**7** People insult me because of you. Shame covers my face.

**8** I am a stranger to my brothers. The sons of my mother think that I am a foreigner.

**9** My love for your house burns inside me. The insults of the people who insult you fell on me.

**10** When I cried and did not eat, people insulted me.

**11** When I wore sackcloth to show sorrow, people laughed at me.

**12** The people who sit at the city gate speak against me. The drunk people sing songs about me.

**13** But LORD, I pray to you at a good time. God, answer me because of your large love. Answer me because you always save.

**14** Pull me out of the mud. Do not let me go down. Save me from the people who hate me. Save me from the deep water.

**15** Do not let the flood go over me. Do not let the deep water take me. Do not let the pit close its mouth on me.

**16** LORD, answer me, because your love is good. Turn to me because your mercy is large.

**17** Do not hide your face from your servant. I am in trouble. Answer me quickly.

**18** Come near to me and save me. Save me from my enemies.

**19** You know how people insult me. You know my shame and my dishonor. You see all my enemies.

**20** Insults broke my heart and I am very sad. I looked for pity, but I got none. I looked for people to comfort me, but I found none.

**21** They gave me poison for food. When I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar to drink.

**22** Let their feasts become a trap for them. Let their peace become a trap.

**23** Make their eyes dark so that they cannot see. Make their bodies always shake.

**24** Pour your anger on them. Let your hot anger catch them.

**25** Let their homes be empty. Let no person live in their tents.

**26** They attack the man that you punished. They talk about the pain of the people that you wounded.

**27** Count all their sins against them. Do not let them get your righteousness.

**28** Remove their names from the book of life. Do not write their names with the righteous people.

**29** But I am poor and I have pain. God, save me and put me in a high, safe place.

**30** I will praise the name of God with a song. I will honor him with thanks.

**31** This will please the LORD more than an ox. It will please him more than a bull with horns and hoofs.

**32** The humble people will see this and be glad. You who look for God, let your hearts live.

**33** The LORD hears the poor people. He does not forget his people who are prisoners.

**34** Let heaven and earth praise him. Let the seas and all the things that move in them praise him.

**35** God will save Zion and build the cities of Judah again. His people will live there and own the land.

**36** The children of his servants will get the land. The people who love his name will live there.

## Chapter 70

**1** God, come quickly and save me. LORD, come quickly and help me.

**2** Let the people who want to kill me feel shame and confusion. Let the people who want to hurt me go back in shame.

**3** Let the people who say "Aha! Aha!" go back because of their shame.

**4** Let all the people who look for you be happy and glad in you. Let the people who love your salvation always say, "God is great!"

**5** But I am poor and needy. God, come quickly to me. You are my help and you save me. LORD, do not wait.

## Chapter 71

**1** LORD, I trust you. Do not let me feel shame.

**2** Save me and rescue me, because you are righteous. Listen to me and save me.

**3** Be my rock where I can always hide. Give the command to save me. You are my rock and my fort.

**4** My God, save me from the power of the wicked people. Save me from the power of the evil and cruel man.

**5** Lord GOD, you are my hope. I trusted you from the time that I was young.

**6** You helped me from the time of my birth. You took me out of the body of my mother. I will always praise you.

**7** Many people look at me with surprise. But you are my strong safe place.

**8** My mouth is full of your praise. I speak about your glory all day.

**9** Do not send me away when I am old. Do not leave me when my strength goes.

**10** My enemies speak against me. The people who wait to kill me make plans together.

**11** They say, "God left him. Chase him and catch him. No person will save him."

**12** God, do not be far from me. My God, come quickly and help me.

**13** Let my enemies feel shame. Let them come to an end. Let insults and shame cover the people who want to hurt me.

**14** But I will always hope. I will praise you more and more.

**15** All day my mouth will tell about your righteousness and your salvation. I cannot know the full number of your good acts.

**16** I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD. I will speak about your righteousness, only yours.

**17** God, you taught me from the time that I was young. I still tell about your wonderful works.

**18** God, do not leave me now when I am old and have gray hair. Let me tell this generation about your strength. Let me tell all the people who will come after them about your power.

**19** God, your righteousness is very high. You did great things. God, no person is like you!

**20** You let me see many bad troubles. But you will give me life again. You will bring me up again from the deep places of the earth.

**21** You will give me more honor. You will comfort me again.

**22** My God, I will praise you with the harp because you are faithful. Holy One of Israel, I will sing praises to you with the lyre.

**23** My lips will shout with joy when I sing praises to you. My soul, which you saved, will shout with joy.

**24** All day long my tongue will speak about your righteousness. The people who wanted to hurt me feel shame and confusion.

## Chapter 72

**1** God, give your justice to the king. Give your righteousness to the son of the king.

**2** He will judge your people with righteousness. He will judge your poor people fairly.

**3** Let the mountains and the hills give peace to the people because of righteousness.

**4** He will defend the poor people. He will save the children of the needy people. He will crush the cruel people.

**5** People will fear you as long as the sun and the moon shine, through all generations.

**6** He will be like rain that falls on cut grass. He will be like showers that give water to the earth.

**7** While he rules, the righteous people will grow strong. There will be much peace until the moon stops.

**8** He will rule from sea to sea. He will rule from the River Euphrates to the ends of the earth.

**9** The people who live in the desert will bow in front of him. His enemies will lie down in the dust.

**10** The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring gifts to him. The kings of Sheba and Seba will bring gifts.

**11** All kings will bow down in front of him. All nations will serve him.

**12** He will save the needy person who calls to him. He will save the poor person who has no person to help him.

**13** He will have pity on the weak and needy people. He will save the lives of the needy people.

**14** He will save them from cruel people and from violence. Their lives are valuable to him.

**15** Let the king live long! Let the people give him gold from Sheba. Let the people always pray for him. Let them bless him all day long.

**16** Let there be much grain in the land, also on the tops of the hills. Let the crops move in the wind like the trees of Lebanon. Let the people of the cities grow like the grass in the fields.

**17** His name will stay always. His name will continue as long as the sun shines. All nations will be blessed through him. All nations will call him happy.

**18** Praise the LORD God, the God of Israel. Only he does wonderful things.

**19** Praise his glorious name always. Let his glory fill all the earth. Amen and Amen.

**20** This is the end of the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.

## Chapter 73

**1** Truly, God is good to Israel. He is good to the people who have a clean heart.

**2** But my feet almost slipped. I almost fell.

**3** I had envy of the proud people when I saw the success of the wicked people.

**4** They have no pain. Their bodies are healthy and strong.

**5** They do not have troubles as other people do. They do not have sickness as other people do.

**6** Thus they wear pride like a necklace. They wear violence like clothes.

**7** Their eyes are fat. They have more than their hearts want.

**8** They mock other people and speak evil. They are proud and they make threats against other people.

**9** They speak against heaven with their mouths. Their tongues speak proud words through all the earth.

**10** Thus the people of God turn to them. The people drink in their words as if the words are water.

**11** They say, "How can God know? Does the Most High know anything?"

**12** Look at these wicked people. They always have an easy life. They become more rich.

**13** I kept my heart clean for nothing. I washed my hands to show that I am innocent, but it was for nothing.

**14** All day long I have trouble. Each morning God punishes me.

**15** If I said such things, I betrayed your children.

**16** I tried to understand this, but it was too difficult for me.

**17** Then I went into the holy place of God. There I understood what will happen to the wicked people at the end.

**18** Truly, you put them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

**19** Suddenly they come to ruin! Terrible things destroy them completely.

**20** Lord, they are like a dream that a person forgets when he wakes up. When you stand up, you will forget them.

**21** My heart was sad. My spirit had pain.

**22** I was foolish and I did not understand. I was like an animal in front of you.

**23** But I am always with you. You hold my right hand.

**24** You guide me with your advice. After that, you will take me into glory.

**25** I have only you in heaven. I want nothing on earth more than you.

**26** My body and my heart become weak. But God is the strength of my heart. He is all that I need always.

**27** The people who are far from you will die. You destroy all the people who are not faithful to you.

**28** But it is good for me to be near God. I made the Lord GOD my safe place. I will tell about all your works.

## Chapter 74

**1** God, why did you send us away always? Why does your anger burn against your own sheep?

**2** Remember your people that you bought long ago. You saved them to be your tribe. Remember Mount Zion, where you lived.

**3** Walk through the places that are always destroyed. The enemy destroyed all the things in your holy place.

**4** Your enemies shouted in the place where your people come together. They put up their flags as signs of victory.

**5** They were like men who cut a forest with axes.

**6** They broke all the carved wood with axes and hammers.

**7** They burned your holy place. They destroyed the home of your name and threw it to the ground.

**8** They said in their hearts, "We will destroy all of them." They burned all the places in the land where people came together to worship God.

**9** We do not see signs from God. There are no more prophets. No person among us knows how long this will continue.

**10** God, how long will the enemy insult you? Will the enemy insult your name always?

**11** Why do you hold back your hand, your right hand? Take your hand out and destroy them!

**12** But God is my King from the old times. He saves people on the earth.

**13** You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

**14** You crushed the heads of Leviathan. You gave him as food to the animals of the desert.

**15** You opened springs and streams. You made large rivers dry.

**16** The day is yours, and the night is yours. You made the moon and the sun.

**17** You made all the borders of the earth. You made summer and winter.

**18** LORD, remember that the enemy insulted you. Remember that foolish people insult your name.

**19** Do not give the life of your dove to the wild animals. Do not forget the lives of your poor people always.

**20** Remember your covenant. Cruel people fill the dark places of the land.

**21** Do not let the people who suffer go back in shame. Let the poor and needy people praise your name.

**22** God, stand up and defend your cause. Remember how the foolish people insult you all day long.

**23** Do not forget the shouts of your enemies. The noise of the people who attack you always becomes louder.

## Chapter 75

**1** God, we thank you. We thank you, because you are near. People tell about your wonderful works.

**2** God says, "I will choose the correct time. Then I will judge fairly.

**3** When the earth and all its people shake, I hold its pillars firm. Selah.

**4** I tell the proud people, 'Do not be proud.' I tell the wicked people, 'Do not show your strength.

**5** Do not show your strength against heaven. Do not speak with pride.'"

**6** Honor does not come from the east or from the west. It does not come from the desert.

**7** God is the judge. He puts down 1 person and lifts up another person.

**8** The LORD holds a cup in his hand. The cup is full of strong wine with spices. He pours the wine out. All the wicked people of the earth will drink it to the last drop.

**9** But I will always tell about the God of Jacob. I will sing praises to him.

**10** God says, "I will cut off the power of the wicked people. But I will give more power to the righteous people."

## Chapter 76

**1** People in Judah know God. His name is great in Israel.

**2** His tabernacle is in Salem. His home is in Zion.

**3** There he broke the arrows, the shields, the swords, and the weapons of war. Selah.

**4** You are glorious. You are more majestic than the mountains where the wild animals hunt.

**5** The brave soldiers lost all their things. They died. None of the strong soldiers could lift their hands.

**6** God of Jacob, when you shouted at them, the horses and the chariots fell down dead.

**7** You alone cause fear. No person can stand in front of you when you are angry.

**8** You spoke your judgment from heaven. The earth was afraid and silent.

**9** God, you stood up to judge. You stood up to save all the humble people of the earth. Selah.

**10** The anger of men will cause people to praise you. You will stop the anger that remains.

**11** Make promises to the LORD your God, and do what you promised. All the nations around him must bring gifts to God, who causes fear.

**12** He breaks the pride of leaders. The kings of the earth fear him.

## Chapter 77

**1** I called to God with my voice. I called to God with my voice, and he heard me.

**2** When I was in trouble, I looked for the Lord. At night I lifted my hands and prayed. My soul did not let anything comfort me.

**3** I remembered God, and I felt pain in my heart. I thought about it, and my spirit became weak. Selah.

**4** You kept my eyes open. I was so troubled that I could not speak.

**5** I thought about the old days. I thought about the years long ago.

**6** At night I remembered my song. I thought about it in my heart. My spirit tried to understand.

**7** "Will the Lord send us away always? Will he never be kind to us again?

**8** Did his love stop always? Did his promise fail always?

**9** Did God forget to be kind? Did his anger stop his mercy?" Selah.

**10** Then I said, "This is my pain: the Most High does not help us with his right hand now."

**11** But I will remember the works of the LORD. I will remember your wonderful works from long ago.

**12** I will think about all your work. I will think about what you did.

**13** God, your way is holy. No god is as great as our God.

**14** You are the God who does wonderful acts. You showed your strength among the nations.

**15** With your strong arm you saved your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

**16** God, the waters saw you. The waters saw you and were afraid. The deep waters shook.

**17** The clouds poured down rain. The skies made thunder. Your arrows of lightning went in all directions.

**18** The sound of your thunder was in the strong wind. The lightning lit the world. The earth shook.

**19** Your path went through the sea and through the great waters. But no person saw your footprints.

**20** You led your people like a flock of sheep. You led them by Moses and Aaron.

## Chapter 78

**1** My people, listen to my law. Hear the words of my mouth.

**2** I will speak a story to you. I will tell you the secrets from long ago.

**3** We heard these things and we know them. Our ancestors told them to us.

**4** We will not hide them from our children. We will tell the next generation about the praises of the LORD. We will tell about his strength and the wonderful works that he did.

**5** He gave a law to Jacob. He gave instructions to Israel. He told our ancestors to teach them to their children.

**6** Then the next generation will know them, and also the children who will come in the future. Then they will tell them to their own children.

**7** Then they will hope in God. They will not forget the works of God. They will obey his commands.

**8** They will not be like their ancestors. Their ancestors did not obey God and they turned against him. Their hearts were not loyal, and their spirits were not faithful to God.

**9** The men of Ephraim had weapons and bows. But they ran away on the day of battle.

**10** They did not obey the covenant of God. They refused to live by his law.

**11** They forgot what he did. They forgot the wonderful works that he showed them.

**12** He did wonderful things in front of their ancestors. He did them in the land of Egypt, in the area of Zoan.

**13** He divided the sea and led them through it. He made the waters stand like a wall.

**14** In the day he led them with a cloud. All night he led them with a light of fire.

**15** He broke open rocks in the desert. He gave them much water, as if it came from the deep sea.

**16** He made streams come out of the rock. He made the water flow down like rivers.

**17** But they continued to sin against him. They did not obey the Most High in the desert.

**18** They tested God in their hearts. They asked for the food that they wanted.

**19** They spoke against God. They said, "Can God give us food in the desert?

**20** He hit the rock, and water came out. Streams flowed. But can he also give us bread? Can he give meat to his people?"

**21** The LORD heard this and he was very angry. His fire burned against Jacob. His anger rose against Israel.

**22** They did not believe in God. They did not trust that he will save them.

**23** But he gave a command to the clouds above. He opened the doors of heaven.

**24** He made manna fall like rain for them to eat. He gave them grain from heaven.

**25** People ate the bread of angels. He sent them all the food that they wanted.

**26** He made the east wind blow in the sky. By his power, he made the south wind blow.

**27** He made meat fall on them like rain. There were as many birds as the dust. There were as many birds as the sand of the sea.

**28** He made the birds fall in their camp, all around their tents.

**29** They ate and they were very full. He gave them what they wanted.

**30** But they still wanted more. While the food was still in their mouths,

**31** God became angry with them. He killed the strongest of them. He killed the best young men of Israel.

**32** But they continued to sin. They did not believe in his wonderful works.

**33** Thus he ended their days like a breath. He ended their years in terror.

**34** When God killed some of them, the others looked for him. They turned back and looked for God with all their hearts.

**35** They remembered that God was their rock. They remembered that the Most High God saved them.

**36** But they spoke false words to him with their mouths. They lied to him with their tongues.

**37** Their hearts were not loyal to him. They were not faithful to his covenant.

**38** But God had much mercy. He forgave their sins and did not destroy them. Many times he stopped his anger. He did not show all his anger.

**39** He remembered that they were only people. They were like a wind that goes away and does not come back.

**40** Many times they did not obey him in the desert. They made him sad in the desert.

**41** Again and again they tested God. They caused pain to the Holy One of Israel.

**42** They did not remember his power. They did not remember the day when he saved them from the enemy.

**43** They forgot his signs in Egypt. They forgot his wonderful acts in the area of Zoan.

**44** He changed the rivers of Egypt into blood. The people of Egypt could not drink from their streams.

**45** He sent swarms of flies that ate them. He sent frogs that destroyed them.

**46** He gave their crops to the caterpillars. He gave the results of their work to the locusts.

**47** He destroyed their vines with hail. He destroyed their fig trees with frost.

**48** He let the hail kill their cattle. He let lightning kill their flocks.

**49** He sent his hot anger on them. He sent his anger, his fury, and trouble. He sent a group of angels to destroy them.

**50** He did not stop his anger. He did not save them from death. He let a plague kill them.

**51** He killed all the firstborn sons in Egypt. He killed the oldest sons in the tents of Ham.

**52** But he led his own people out like sheep. He guided them like a flock in the desert.

**53** He led them safely, and they were not afraid. But the sea covered their enemies.

**54** He brought them to the border of his holy land. He brought them to the mountain that his right hand took.

**55** He pushed the nations out in front of them. He divided the land among them as their property. He let the tribes of Israel live in the tents of the nations.

**56** But they tested the Most High God and did not obey him. They did not obey his laws.

**57** They turned away and were not faithful, as their ancestors were. They were like a bow that does not shoot straight.

**58** They made him angry with their places of worship on the hills. They made him jealous with their idols.

**59** God heard this and he was very angry. He refused Israel completely.

**60** He left the tabernacle at Shiloh, the tent where he lived among people.

**61** He let the enemy take the ark, the sign of his strength. He let the enemy take the sign of his glory.

**62** He let the enemy kill his people with the sword. He was very angry with his own people.

**63** Fire killed their young men. Their young women had no weddings.

**64** The enemy killed their priests with the sword. Their widows could not cry for them.

**65** Then the Lord woke up as from sleep. He was like a strong soldier who shouts after wine.

**66** He hit his enemies and pushed them back. He put them to shame always.

**67** He refused the tent of Joseph. He did not choose the tribe of Ephraim.

**68** But he chose the tribe of Judah. He chose Mount Zion, which he loves.

**69** He built his holy place as high as the heavens. He made it firm like the earth, which he made to stay always.

**70** He chose his servant David. He took him from the sheep pens.

**71** David took care of the sheep and their young. God took him from that work to be the shepherd of his people Jacob, of Israel, his own people.

**72** David was their shepherd with an honest heart. He led them with skillful hands.

## Chapter 79

**1** God, the nations came into your land. They made your holy temple unclean. They destroyed Jerusalem and left only piles of stones.

**2** They gave the bodies of your servants as food to the birds. They gave the bodies of your holy people to the wild animals.

**3** They poured out the blood of your people like water all around Jerusalem. No person was there to bury the dead.

**4** Our neighbors insult us. The people around us laugh at us and mock us.

**5** LORD, how long will you be angry? Will you be angry always? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

**6** Pour your anger on the nations that do not know you. Pour your anger on the kingdoms that do not pray to you.

**7** They destroyed the people of Jacob. They destroyed his land.

**8** Do not punish us for the sins of our ancestors. Let your mercy come to us quickly, because we are very weak.

**9** God, you are our Savior. Help us for the glory of your name. Save us and forgive our sins because of your name.

**10** Why must the nations say, "Where is their God?" Let us see you punish the nations for the blood of your servants. Let the nations know it.

**11** Hear the sad sounds of the prisoners. Use your great power to keep alive the people who must die.

**12** Lord, our neighbors insulted you. Punish them 7 times more than they insulted you.

**13** Then we, your people and the sheep of your field, will thank you always. We will praise you through all generations.

## Chapter 80

**1** Shepherd of Israel, listen to us. You lead the people of Joseph like a flock. You sit on your throne between the cherubim. Shine on us.

**2** Show your strength to Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Come and save us.

**3** God, bring us back to you. Let your face shine on us, and then we will be safe.

**4** LORD God of armies, how long will you be angry when your people pray?

**5** You gave them tears as their food. You gave them many tears to drink.

**6** You let our neighbors fight about us. Our enemies laugh at us.

**7** God of armies, bring us back to you. Let your face shine on us, and then we will be safe.

**8** You brought a vine out of Egypt. You pushed out the nations and you planted the vine.

**9** You made the ground ready for the vine. Its roots went deep, and it filled the land.

**10** Its shadow covered the mountains. Its branches covered the large cedar trees.

**11** Its branches went out to the Mediterranean Sea. Its shoots went to the River Euphrates.

**12** Why did you break down its walls? Now all the people who go past take its fruit.

**13** The wild pigs from the forest destroy it. The wild animals of the field eat it.

**14** God of armies, please come back to us. Look down from heaven and see. Take care of this vine.

**15** Take care of the plant that your right hand planted. Take care of the son that you made strong for you.

**16** Enemies cut down your vine and burned it with fire. Your people die when you show your anger.

**17** Put your hand on the man at your right hand. Put your hand on the son of man whom you made strong for you.

**18** Then we will not turn away from you. Give us life again, and we will pray to you.

**19** LORD God of armies, bring us back to you. Let your face shine on us, and then we will be safe.

## Chapter 81

**1** Sing loudly to God, who is our strength. Shout with joy to the God of Jacob.

**2** Start a song (psalm). Bring the tambourine. Bring the pleasant harp and the lyre.

**3** Blow the trumpet at the new moon. Blow the trumpet at the full moon, on the day of our holy feast.

**4** This is a rule for Israel. It is a law from the God of Jacob.

**5** God gave this rule to Joseph as a testimony when he went out against the land of Egypt. There I heard a language that I did not know.

**6** God says, "I removed the heavy load from his shoulder. His hands became free from the baskets.

**7** You called to me when you had trouble, and I saved you. I answered you from the dark storm cloud. I tested you at the waters of Meribah." Selah.

**8** "Hear, my people, and I will warn you. Israel, I want you to listen to me!

**9** You must not have a foreign god among you. Do not worship a foreign god.

**10** I am the LORD your God. I brought you out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

**11** But my people did not listen to my voice. Israel did not want me.

**12** Thus I let them follow the strong wishes of their own hearts. They lived by their own plans.

**13** I want my people to listen to me! I want Israel to live in my ways!

**14** Then I will quickly defeat their enemies. I will turn my hand against their attackers.

**15** The people who hate the LORD will bow down to him in fear. Their punishment will continue for all time.

**16** I will feed Israel with the best wheat. I will give you honey from the rock until you are full."

## Chapter 82

**1** God stands in the assembly of the mighty. He judges among the gods.

**2** "How long will you judge without justice? How long will you show favor to the wicked?" Selah.

**3** "Defend the poor and the children with no father. Give justice to the people who suffer and to the people in need.

**4** Save the poor and the people in need. Free them from the power of the wicked."

**5** The judges do not know and they do not understand. They walk in darkness. All the foundations of the earth shake.

**6** "I said, 'You are gods. All of you are sons of the Most High.'

**7** But you will die like men. You will fall like any other ruler."

**8** God, get up and judge the earth! All the nations belong to you.

## Chapter 83

**1** God, do not be silent! God, do not be quiet and do not stay still.

**2** Look, your enemies make a loud noise. The people who hate you lift up their heads with pride.

**3** They make clever plans against your people. They plan together against the people that you protect.

**4** They say, "Come, let us destroy them as a nation. Then no person will remember the name of Israel."

**5** They plan together with one mind. They make an agreement against you.

**6** These are the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,

**7** Gebal, Ammon and Amalek, and Philistia with the people of Tyre.

**8** Assyria also joins them. They help the descendants of Lot. Selah.

**9** Do to them what you did to Midian. Do to them what you did to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon.

**10** Those enemies died at Endor. They became like manure on the ground.

**11** Make their leaders like Oreb and Zeeb. Make all their rulers like Zebah and Zalmunna.

**12** Those men said, "Let us take for ourselves the land where God lives."

**13** My God, make them like dust that turns in the wind. Make them like dry straw that the wind blows away.

**14** A fire burns a forest. A flame sets the mountains on fire.

**15** In the same way, chase them with your strong wind. Make them afraid with your storm.

**16** Fill their faces with shame, LORD. Then they will look for your name.

**17** Let them feel shame and fear for all time. Let them feel disgrace and let them die.

**18** Then the people will know that you alone have the name "the LORD." They will know that you are the Most High over all the earth.

## Chapter 84

**1** LORD of armies, the place where you live is very beautiful!

**2** My soul wants to be in the courtyards of the LORD. My soul becomes weak with this wish. My heart and my body shout with joy to the God who lives.

**3** The sparrow finds a home there. The swallow makes a nest for her young near your altars. LORD of armies, you are my King and my God.

**4** The people who live in your house are happy. They will always praise you. Selah.

**5** The man whose strength is in you is happy. His heart wants to travel to Zion.

**6** These people go through the dry valley of Baca. They make it a place of springs. The rain also fills it with pools.

**7** They become stronger and stronger as they go. Each of them comes before God in Zion.

**8** LORD God of armies, hear my prayer. God of Jacob, listen to me. Selah.

**9** God, you are our shield. Look at the face of the king that you chose (anointed).

**10** 1 day in your courtyards is better than 1,000 days in another place. I prefer to stand at the door of the house of my God. I do not want to live in the tents of wicked people.

**11** The LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD gives grace and honor. He does not keep any good thing from the people who live with honesty.

**12** LORD of armies, the man who trusts in you is happy.

## Chapter 85

**1** LORD, you showed kindness to your land. You brought back the prisoners of Jacob.

**2** You forgave the wrong acts of your people. You covered all their sin. Selah.

**3** You took away all your anger. You turned away from your strong anger.

**4** God, who saves us, bring us back to you. Stop your anger against us.

**5** Will you be angry with us for all time? Will your anger continue to all future generations?

**6** Will you not give us new life again? Then your people will be happy in you.

**7** LORD, show us your mercy. Give us your salvation.

**8** I will listen to what God, the LORD, says. He will speak peace to his people and to his loyal people. But they must not go back to foolish acts.

**9** His salvation is near to the people who fear him. Then his glory will live in our land.

**10** Mercy and truth meet together. Justice and peace kiss each other.

**11** Truth grows up from the earth. Justice looks down from heaven.

**12** The LORD will give what is good. Our land will give its crops.

**13** Justice will go in front of him. Justice will make a path for his steps.

## Chapter 86

**1** LORD, listen to me and answer me. I am poor and in need.

**2** Keep my life safe, because I am loyal to you. You are my God. Save me, your servant, because I trust in you.

**3** Lord, be merciful to me. I call to you all day.

**4** Make me, your servant, happy. Lord, I give my soul to you.

**5** Lord, you are good and you are ready to forgive. You give much mercy to all the people who call to you.

**6** LORD, listen to my prayer. Hear my voice when I ask you for help.

**7** On the day of my trouble I will call to you, because you will answer me.

**8** Lord, no god is the same as you. No works are the same as your works.

**9** Lord, you made all the nations. They will all come and worship you. They will give honor to your name.

**10** You are great and you do wonderful things. You alone are God.

**11** LORD, teach me your way. I will live by your truth. Give me a heart that has one purpose: to fear your name.

**12** Lord my God, I will praise you with all my heart. I will give honor to your name for all time.

**13** Your mercy to me is great. You saved my soul from the deepest part of the grave.

**14** God, proud men attack me. A group of violent men tries to kill me. They do not think about you.

**15** But Lord, you are a God of compassion and grace. You are slow to become angry. You have much mercy and truth.

**16** Turn to me and be merciful to me. Give your strength to your servant. Save me, the son of your female servant.

**17** Show me a sign of your goodness. Then the people who hate me will see it and feel shame. They will see that you, LORD, helped me and gave me comfort.

## Chapter 87

**1** The LORD built his city on the holy mountains.

**2** The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the other homes of Jacob.

**3** City of God, people say glorious things about you. Selah.

**4** "I will name Egypt (Rahab) and Babylon among the people who know me. Look at Philistia, Tyre and Ethiopia. People will say, 'This man came from Zion.'"

**5** People will say about Zion, "This man and that man came from Zion." The Most High himself will make Zion strong.

**6** The LORD will write a list of the peoples. He will write, "This man came from Zion." Selah.

**7** The singers and the musicians will say, "All my springs of joy are in you."

## Chapter 88

**1** LORD, you are the God who saves me. I cry to you day and night.

**2** Let my prayer come to you. Listen to my cry.

**3** My soul is full of trouble. My life comes near to the grave.

**4** People count me with those who go down into the pit. I am like a man with no strength.

**5** People leave me among the dead. I am like the dead bodies that lie in the grave. You do not remember them. Your help does not come to them.

**6** You put me in the deepest pit. You put me in dark and deep places.

**7** Your anger is heavy on me. You hit me with all your waves. Selah.

**8** You took my friends far from me. You made them hate me. I am in a prison and I cannot go out.

**9** My eyes become weak because of my pain. LORD, I call to you every day. I lift up my hands to you.

**10** Do you show your wonders to the dead? Do the dead get up and praise you? Selah.

**11** Do people tell about your love in the grave? Do they tell about your faithfulness in the place of destruction?

**12** Do people know your wonders in the darkness? Do they know your justice in the land where people forget?

**13** But I cry to you, LORD. In the morning my prayer comes to you.

**14** LORD, why do you push my soul away? Why do you hide your face from me?

**15** Since I was young, I suffered and I was near death. I suffer your terrors, and I do not know what to do.

**16** Your strong anger goes over me. Your terrors destroy me.

**17** They come around me all day like water. They come around me on all sides.

**18** You took my friends and neighbors far from me. Darkness is my only friend.

## Chapter 89

**1** I will always sing about the mercies of the LORD. With my mouth I will tell all generations about your faithfulness.

**2** I said, "Your mercy will continue for all time. You will make your faithfulness strong in the heavens."

**3** You said, "I made an agreement (covenant) with the man that I chose. I made a promise to my servant David.

**4** I will make your descendants continue for all time. I will make your throne strong for all generations." Selah.

**5** LORD, the heavens will praise your wonders. The group of holy ones will praise your faithfulness.

**6** No person in the skies is equal to the LORD. No person among the heavenly beings is the same as the LORD.

**7** In the assembly of the holy ones, people fear God very much. He is more terrible than all the beings around him.

**8** LORD God of armies, no person is as strong as you, LORD. Your faithfulness is all around you.

**9** You rule the angry sea. When its waves rise, you make them calm.

**10** You crushed Rahab like a dead body. With your strong arm you sent your enemies in all directions.

**11** The heavens belong to you. The earth also belongs to you. You made the world and all things in it.

**12** You made the north and the south. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon sing with joy to your name.

**13** Your arm is powerful. Your hand is strong. Your right hand is high.

**14** Justice and fair judgment are the foundation of your throne. Mercy and truth go in front of you.

**15** The people who know the shout of joy are happy. LORD, they walk in the light of your face.

**16** They are happy in your name all day. Your justice lifts them up.

**17** You are the glory of their strength. Because of your kindness, you make our strength greater.

**18** Our shield belongs to the LORD. Our king belongs to the Holy One of Israel.

**19** Then you spoke in a vision to your loyal people. You said, "I gave help to a strong man. I lifted up a man that I chose from the people.

**20** I found David, my servant. I poured my holy oil on him (anointed him).

**21** My hand will support him. My arm will make him strong.

**22** The enemy will not trick him. The wicked will not cause him to suffer.

**23** I will crush his enemies in front of him. I will hit the people who hate him.

**24** My faithfulness and my mercy will be with him. Because of my name, his power will become great.

**25** I will put his hand over the sea. I will put his right hand over the rivers.

**26** He will call to me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the rock that saves me.'

**27** I will make him my firstborn son. I will make him higher than all the kings of the earth.

**28** I will keep my mercy for him for all time. My agreement with him will not fail.

**29** I will make his descendants continue for all time. His throne will continue as long as the heavens.

**30** His children possibly will leave my law and not obey my rules.

**31** They possibly will break my laws and not keep my commands.

**32** If they do these things, then I will punish their sin with a rod. I will punish their wrong acts with blows.

**33** But I will not take my love away from him. I will not let my faithfulness fail.

**34** I will not break my agreement. I will not change the words that I spoke.

**35** I made a promise 1 time by my holiness. I will not lie to David.

**36** His descendants will continue for all time. His throne will continue in front of me as long as the sun.

**37** It will be strong for all time, like the moon. The moon is a faithful witness in the sky." Selah.

**38** But you pushed away and refused your chosen king (anointed). You are angry with him.

**39** You broke the agreement with your servant. You threw his crown on the ground and made it unclean.

**40** You broke down all his walls. You destroyed his strong places.

**41** All the people who go past him steal from him. His neighbors insult him.

**42** You made his enemies strong. You made all his enemies happy.

**43** You made his sword useless. You did not help him in the battle.

**44** You stopped his glory. You threw his throne down to the ground.

**45** You made the days of his youth short. You covered him with shame. Selah.

**46** How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself for all time? Will your anger burn like fire for all time?

**47** Remember how short my life is. You made all people, and their lives are very short!

**48** No man can live and not see death. No man can save his life from the power of the grave. Selah.

**49** Lord, where is your love from the past? You made a promise to David in your faithfulness.

**50** Lord, remember how people insult your servants. I carry in my heart the insults of many nations.

**51** LORD, your enemies insult us. They insult each step of your chosen king.

**52** Praise the LORD for all time! Amen and Amen.

## Chapter 90

**1** Lord, you were our home for all generations.

**2** You were God before the mountains came into existence. You were God before you made the earth and the world. You are God from all time past to all time in the future.

**3** You turn people back to dust. You say, "Go back, children of men."

**4** In your view, 1,000 years are like 1 day that is in the past. They are like a few hours in the night.

**5** You sweep people away like a flood. They are like a dream. They are like grass that grows in the morning.

**6** In the morning the grass grows and it is green. In the evening it becomes dry and it dies.

**7** Your anger destroys us. Your strong anger fills us with fear.

**8** You put our sins in front of you. You put our secret sins in the light of your face.

**9** All our days go past under your anger. Our years end like a sigh.

**10** We live 70 years. If we are strong, we live 80 years. But even our best years are full of work and sorrow. They go quickly, and then we die.

**11** No person knows the power of your anger. Your anger is as great as the fear that you deserve.

**12** Teach us to count our days. Then our hearts will become wise.

**13** LORD, come back to us! How long will we wait? Have compassion on your servants.

**14** In the morning fill us with your mercy. Then we will sing and be happy all our days.

**15** Make us happy for as many days as you made us suffer. Make us happy for as many years as we saw trouble.

**16** Show your work to your servants. Show your glory to their children.

**17** Let the kindness of the Lord our God be on us. Make the work of our hands strong. Yes, make the work of our hands strong.

## Chapter 91

**1** The person who lives in the shelter of the Most High will stay in the shadow of the Almighty.

**2** I will say about the LORD, "He is my safe place and my fortress. He is my God, and I trust in him."

**3** He will save you from the trap of the hunter. He will save you from the deadly disease.

**4** He will cover you with his feathers. You will find safety under his wings. His faithfulness will be your shield and your wall.

**5** You will not be afraid of the terror in the night. You will not be afraid of the arrow that flies in the day.

**6** You will not be afraid of the disease that moves in the darkness. You will not be afraid of the destruction at noon.

**7** 1,000 people will fall at your side. 10,000 people will fall at your right hand. But the danger will not come near you.

**8** You will only look with your eyes. You will see the punishment of the wicked.

**9** You made the LORD your home. He is my safe place, the Most High.

**10** Thus no evil will come to you. No disease will come near your tent.

**11** He will give orders to his angels about you. They will keep you safe in all your ways.

**12** They will lift you up in their hands. Then you will not hit your foot against a stone.

**13** You will walk on the lion and the snake. You will put your feet on the young lion and the serpent.

**14** The LORD says, "He loves me, thus I will save him. I will protect him because he knows my name.

**15** He will call to me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will save him and give him honor.

**16** I will give him a long and full life. I will show him my salvation."

## Chapter 92

**1** It is good to give thanks to the LORD. It is good to sing praises to your name, Most High.

**2** It is good to tell about your love in the morning. It is good to tell about your faithfulness every night.

**3** We sing with a 10-string instrument and with the lyre. We sing with the quiet sound of the harp.

**4** LORD, your work makes me happy. I sing with joy about the works of your hands.

**5** LORD, your works are very great! Your thoughts are very deep.

**6** A stupid man does not know this. A fool does not understand this.

**7** The wicked grow like grass. All the people who do evil become rich. But God will destroy them for all time.

**8** But you, LORD, are high above all for all time.

**9** Look, LORD, your enemies will die. All the people who do evil will go away in all directions.

**10** You made me strong like a wild ox. You poured fresh oil on me.

**11** My eyes saw the defeat of my enemies. My ears heard the fall of the wicked men who attack me.

**12** Good people will grow like a palm tree. They will grow tall like a cedar tree in Lebanon.

**13** They are like trees in the house of the LORD. They will grow well in the courtyards of our God.

**14** They will continue to make fruit when they are old. They will stay healthy and green.

**15** They will show that the LORD is honest. He is my rock. He does no wrong.

## Chapter 93

**1** The LORD rules as king. He wears majesty like clothes. The LORD wears strength like a belt. The world is firm, and nothing can move it.

**2** Your throne was firm a long time ago. You are from all time past.

**3** LORD, the seas rise up. The seas lift up their voice. The seas lift up their loud waves.

**4** The LORD on high is more powerful than the noise of much water. He is more powerful than the strong waves of the sea.

**5** LORD, your laws are very sure. Holiness is correct for your house for all time.

## Chapter 94

**1** LORD, you are the God who punishes. God who punishes, show yourself.

**2** Get up, judge of the earth! Give the proud people what they deserve.

**3** LORD, how long will the wicked people be happy about their success? How long?

**4** They speak proud words. All the people who do evil speak with pride.

**5** LORD, they crush your people. They cause pain to the people who belong to you.

**6** They kill the widow and the foreigner. They murder the children with no father.

**7** They say, "The LORD does not see. The God of Jacob does not pay attention."

**8** You stupid people, understand! You fools, when will you become wise?

**9** God made the ear. Can he not hear? God made the eye. Can he not see?

**10** God punishes the nations. Can he not correct you? He teaches knowledge to people. Does he not know?

**11** The LORD knows the thoughts of people. He knows that their thoughts are useless.

**12** LORD, the man that you correct is happy. The man that you teach from your law is happy.

**13** You give him rest from days of trouble, until the wicked fall into a pit.

**14** The LORD will not push away his people. He will not leave the people who belong to him.

**15** Judgment will become fair again. All the people with honest hearts will follow it.

**16** Who will stand up for me against the wicked? Who will help me against the people who do evil?

**17** The LORD helped me. Because of this, I did not go down to the silent grave.

**18** I said, "My foot slips." But LORD, your mercy held me up.

**19** When I have many worries, your comfort makes my soul happy.

**20** Corrupt rulers make evil plans by their laws. Those rulers cannot be your partners.

**21** They meet together against good people. They condemn innocent people to death.

**22** But the LORD is my fortress. My God is the rock where I find safety.

**23** He will punish the wicked for their sins. He will destroy them for their evil acts. The LORD our God will destroy them.

## Chapter 95

**1** Come, let us sing to the LORD. Let us shout with joy to the rock that saves us.

**2** Let us come to him with thanks. Let us shout to him with joy and with songs (psalms).

**3** The LORD is a great God. He is a great King above all gods.

**4** The deep places of the earth are in his hand. The tops of the mountains also belong to him.

**5** The sea belongs to him, because he made it. His hands made the dry land.

**6** Come, let us worship and bow down. Let us kneel in front of the LORD who made us.

**7** He is our God. We are the people that he takes care of. We are his sheep. Today, if you hear his voice,

**8** do not make your hearts hard. Your fathers did this at Meribah. They did this on the day at Massah in the desert.

**9** Your fathers tested me there. They tested me, but they saw my work.

**10** For 40 years I was angry with that generation. I said, "They are a people whose hearts go away from me. They do not know my ways."

**11** Thus in my anger I made a promise. I said, "They will not come into my place of rest."

## Chapter 96

**1** Sing a new song to the LORD! All the earth, sing to the LORD!

**2** Sing to the LORD and praise his name. Every day tell about his salvation.

**3** Tell the nations about his glory. Tell all peoples about his wonders.

**4** The LORD is great, and he deserves much praise. People must fear him more than all gods.

**5** All the gods of the nations are idols. But the LORD made the heavens.

**6** Honor and majesty are in front of him. Strength and beauty are in his holy place.

**7** Families of the peoples, give praise to the LORD! Give glory and strength to the LORD!

**8** Give the LORD the glory that his name deserves. Bring an offering and come into his courtyards.

**9** Worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness. All the earth, shake with fear in front of him.

**10** Tell the nations, "The LORD rules as king." The world is firm, and nothing can move it. He will judge the peoples fairly.

**11** Let the heavens be happy. Let the earth be glad. Let the sea and all things in it make a loud noise.

**12** Let the fields and all things in them be happy. Then all the trees of the forest will sing with joy

**13** in front of the LORD. He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with justice and the peoples with his truth.

## Chapter 97

**1** The LORD rules as king! Let the earth be happy. Let the many islands be glad.

**2** Clouds and darkness are around him. Justice and fair judgment are the foundation of his throne.

**3** A fire goes in front of him. The fire burns his enemies on all sides.

**4** His lightning gives light to the world. The earth sees it and shakes.

**5** The mountains melt like wax in front of the LORD. They melt in front of the Lord of all the earth.

**6** The heavens tell about his justice. All the peoples see his glory.

**7** Let all the people who serve carved idols feel shame. They are proud of their idols. All gods, worship the LORD!

**8** Zion hears and is glad. The towns of Judah are happy because of your judgments, LORD.

**9** LORD, you are the Most High over all the earth. You are much higher than all gods.

**10** You who love the LORD, hate evil! He keeps the lives of his loyal people safe. He saves them from the power of the wicked.

**11** Light shines on good people. Joy comes to the people with honest hearts.

**12** Good people, be happy in the LORD. Give thanks to his holy name.

## Chapter 98

**1** Sing a new song to the LORD, because he did wonderful things. His right hand and his holy arm got the victory for him.

**2** The LORD made his salvation known. He showed his justice to the nations.

**3** He remembered his love and his faithfulness to the people of Israel. All the ends of the earth saw the salvation of our God.

**4** All the earth, shout with joy to the LORD! Shout loudly, be happy and sing praises.

**5** Sing to the LORD with the harp. Sing with the harp and the sound of a song.

**6** Shout with joy in front of the LORD, the King. Use trumpets and the sound of the horn.

**7** Let the sea and all things in it make a loud noise. Let the world and all the people in it make a loud noise.

**8** Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing together with joy

**9** in front of the LORD. He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with justice and the peoples fairly.

## Chapter 99

**1** The LORD rules as king. Let the peoples shake with fear. He sits on his throne above the cherubim. Let the earth shake.

**2** The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

**3** Let them praise your great and terrible name. He is holy.

**4** The King is strong and he loves justice. You made fairness firm. You did what is just and right in Jacob.

**5** Praise the LORD our God! Worship at his footstool. He is holy.

**6** Moses and Aaron were among his priests. Samuel was among the people who called to his name. They called to the LORD, and he answered them.

**7** He spoke to them from the column of cloud. They obeyed his laws and the rules that he gave them.

**8** LORD our God, you answered them. You were a God who forgave them. But you punished them for their wrong acts.

**9** Praise the LORD our God! Worship at his holy mountain. The LORD our God is holy.

## Chapter 100

**1** All the earth, shout with joy to the LORD!

**2** Serve the LORD with joy. Come in front of him with songs.

**3** Know that the LORD is God. He made us, and we belong to him. We are his people and the sheep that he takes care of.

**4** Go into his gates with thanks. Go into his courtyards with praise. Give thanks to him and praise his name.

**5** The LORD is good. His mercy continues for all time. His faithfulness continues to all generations.

## Chapter 101

**1** I will sing about mercy and justice. LORD, I will sing praises to you.

**2** I will be careful to live a life with no fault. When will you come to me? I will live in my house with an honest heart.

**3** I will not look at any evil thing. I hate the acts of the people who turn away from you. Their acts will not hold on to me.

**4** I will keep a dishonest heart far from me. I will have no part in evil.

**5** Possibly a person secretly says bad things about his neighbor. I will destroy that person. I will not permit a person with proud eyes and a proud heart.

**6** I will look with favor on the faithful people of the land. They will live with me. The person who lives with no fault will serve me.

**7** The person who tricks others will not live in my house. The person who tells lies will not stay in front of me.

**8** Every morning I will destroy all the wicked people in the land. I will remove all the people who do evil from the city of the LORD.

## Chapter 102

**1** LORD, hear my prayer. Let my cry come to you.

**2** Do not hide your face from me on the day of my trouble. Listen to me. When I call, answer me quickly.

**3** My days go away like smoke. My bones burn like coals in a fire.

**4** My heart is hurt and dry like grass. I forget to eat my food.

**5** Because I cry so loudly, I am only skin and bones.

**6** I am like a bird in the desert. I am like an owl in a place of ruins.

**7** I lie awake. I am like a lonely bird on a roof.

**8** My enemies insult me all day. The people who are angry with me use my name as a curse.

**9** I eat ashes as my food. I mix my drink with tears.

**10** This is because of your strong anger. You lifted me up, and then you threw me away.

**11** My days are like a shadow at the end of the day. I become dry like grass.

**12** But you, LORD, sit on your throne for all time. All generations will remember your name.

**13** You will get up and show mercy to Zion. It is time to show kindness to her. The correct time came.

**14** Your servants love the stones of Zion. They feel pity for her dust.

**15** The nations will fear the name of the LORD. All the kings of the earth will fear your glory.

**16** The LORD will build Zion again. He will appear in his glory.

**17** He will listen to the prayer of the poor people. He will not refuse their prayer.

**18** Write this for the future generation. Then the people who are not yet born will praise the LORD.

**19** The LORD looked down from his high and holy place. From heaven the LORD looked at the earth.

**20** He heard the cries of the prisoners. He set free the people who were to die.

**21** Thus people will tell about the name of the LORD in Zion. They will praise him in Jerusalem.

**22** The peoples and the kingdoms will meet together to serve the LORD.

**23** He made me weak in the middle of my life. He made my days short.

**24** I said, "My God, do not take me away in the middle of my life. Your years continue through all generations.

**25** A long time ago you made the foundation of the earth. Your hands made the heavens.

**26** The earth and the heavens will end, but you will continue. They will all become old like clothes. You will change them like clothes, and they will go away.

**27** But you do not change. Your years will never end.

**28** The children of your servants will live safely. Their descendants will stay in front of you."

## Chapter 103

**1** My soul, praise the LORD! All that is in me, praise his holy name!

**2** My soul, praise the LORD. Do not forget all the good things that he does.

**3** He forgives all your sins. He heals all your diseases.

**4** He saves your life from the grave. He gives you love and compassion like a crown.

**5** He satisfies you with good things. He makes you young and strong again, like the eagle.

**6** The LORD does what is just. He gives justice to all the people who suffer.

**7** He showed his ways to Moses. He showed his acts to the people of Israel.

**8** The LORD gives mercy and grace. He is slow to become angry. He has much love.

**9** He will not always accuse us. He will not stay angry for all time.

**10** He does not punish us as our sins deserve. He does not pay us back for our wrong acts.

**11** The heavens are very high above the earth. His love for the people who fear him is as great as that.

**12** The east is very far from the west. He took our sins that far away from us.

**13** A father has compassion on his children. In the same way, the LORD has compassion on the people who fear him.

**14** He knows how he made us. He remembers that we are dust.

**15** The days of a man are like grass. A man grows like a flower in the field.

**16** The wind blows over the flower, and the flower goes away. No person sees it in its place again.

**17** But the love of the LORD is with the people who fear him for all time. His justice continues to their grandchildren.

**18** His love is with the people who keep his agreement (covenant). It is with the people who remember to obey his commands.

**19** The LORD put his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

**20** Praise the LORD, you his angels! You are very strong. You do what he says, and you obey his word.

**21** Praise the LORD, all his armies in heaven! You are his servants, and you do what he wants.

**22** All the things that he made, praise the LORD in all the places that he rules! My soul, praise the LORD!

## Chapter 104

**1** My soul, praise the LORD! LORD my God, you are very great. You wear honor and majesty like clothes.

**2** You cover yourself with light like a coat. You spread out the heavens like a tent.

**3** You put the beams of your rooms on the waters above. You make the clouds your chariot. You move on the wings of the wind.

**4** You make the winds your messengers. You make flames of fire your servants.

**5** You put the earth on its foundations. Nothing will ever move it.

**6** You covered the earth with the deep sea like a coat. The waters stood above the mountains.

**7** When you shouted, the waters ran away. At the sound of your thunder, they ran quickly.

**8** The waters went over the mountains. They went down into the valleys, to the place that you made for them.

**9** You put a limit for the waters. They cannot go across it. They will not cover the earth again.

**10** He sends springs into the valleys. The water flows between the mountains.

**11** The springs give water to all the animals of the field. The wild donkeys drink and are not thirsty.

**12** The birds of the sky live near the water. They sing among the branches.

**13** He gives water to the mountains from his rooms above. The earth is full of the fruit of your work.

**14** He makes grass grow for the cattle. He makes plants grow for people to use. Thus people get food from the earth.

**15** He gives wine that makes people happy. He gives oil that makes their faces shine. He gives bread that makes them strong.

**16** The trees of the LORD get much water. These are the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.

**17** The birds make their nests there. The stork has her home in the pine trees.

**18** The high mountains are a safe place for the wild goats. The rocks are a safe place for the rock badgers.

**19** He made the moon to show the seasons. The sun knows when to go down.

**20** You make darkness, and it is night. Then all the animals of the forest come out.

**21** The young lions roar for their food. They ask God for their food.

**22** When the sun comes up, the animals go away. They lie down in their caves.

**23** Then people go out to their work. They work until the evening.

**24** LORD, you made very many things! You made all of them with wisdom. The earth is full of the things that you made.

**25** Look at the sea. It is very large and wide. It is full of animals. They are too many to count, small and large.

**26** The ships move on the sea. The Leviathan that you made plays in the sea.

**27** All these animals wait for you. They wait for you to give them their food at the correct time.

**28** When you give food to them, they collect it. When you open your hand, they eat good food until they are full.

**29** When you hide your face, they are afraid. When you take away their breath, they die. They go back to dust.

**30** When you send your Spirit, they come to life. You make the ground new again.

**31** The glory of the LORD will continue for all time. The LORD will be happy with the things that he made.

**32** He looks at the earth, and it shakes. He touches the mountains, and they make smoke.

**33** I will sing to the LORD all my life. I will sing praise to my God while I live.

**34** I hope that my thoughts make him happy. I will be happy in the LORD.

**35** Let the sinners go away from the earth. Let the wicked be no more. My soul, praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!

## Chapter 105

**1** Give thanks to the LORD. Call to his name. Tell the peoples about what he did.

**2** Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell about all his wonderful works.

**3** Be proud of his holy name. Let the hearts of the people who look for the LORD be happy.

**4** Look to the LORD and his strength. Always look for him.

**5** Remember the wonderful works that he did. Remember his wonders and the judgments that he spoke.

**6** You are the descendants of Abraham, his servant. You are the sons of Jacob, the people that he chose.

**7** He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

**8** He always remembers his agreement (covenant). He remembers his promise for 1,000 generations.

**9** He made that agreement with Abraham. He made a promise to Isaac.

**10** He made it a law for Jacob. He made it an agreement for all time for Israel.

**11** He said, "I will give you the land of Canaan. It will be the land that you own."

**12** At that time they were few in number. They were very few and they were foreigners in the land.

**13** They went from one nation to another nation. They went from one kingdom to another people.

**14** He did not let any person hurt them. Because of them, he warned kings.

**15** He said, "Do not touch the people that I chose (anointed). Do not hurt my prophets."

**16** He caused a famine in the land. He destroyed all their supply of food.

**17** He sent a man in front of them. That man was Joseph, whom people sold as a slave.

**18** They hurt his feet with chains. They put an iron collar on his neck.

**19** This continued until the time when his words came true. The word of the LORD tested Joseph.

**20** The king sent a message and set him free. The ruler of the peoples let him go.

**21** The king made him the master of his house. He made Joseph the ruler of all that he had.

**22** Joseph could order the king's officials as he wanted. He could teach the king's leaders wisdom.

**23** Then Israel came into Egypt. Jacob lived as a foreigner in the land of Ham.

**24** The LORD made his people increase very much. He made them stronger than their enemies.

**25** He caused the Egyptians to hate his people. They made plans against his servants.

**26** He sent his servant Moses. He sent Aaron, whom he chose.

**27** They did his signs among the Egyptians. They did his wonders in the land of Ham.

**28** He sent darkness and made the land dark. Moses and Aaron did not go against his word.

**29** He changed the waters of Egypt into blood. He killed their fish.

**30** Their land became full of frogs. The frogs came into the rooms of their kings.

**31** He spoke, and swarms of flies came. Small insects came into all their land.

**32** He gave them hail in place of rain. He sent lightning into their land.

**33** He destroyed their grape vines and their fig trees. He broke the trees in their land.

**34** He spoke, and the locusts came. Very many young locusts came.

**35** They ate all the plants in their land. They ate all the crops of their ground.

**36** He killed all the firstborn sons in their land. These were the first sons of their strength.

**37** He brought Israel out with silver and gold. No person in their tribes was weak.

**38** Egypt was glad when they went away, because the Egyptians were afraid of Israel.

**39** He spread out a cloud to cover them. He gave a fire to give light in the night.

**40** The people asked for food, and he brought quails. He satisfied them with bread from heaven.

**41** He opened the rock, and water came out. The water flowed like a river in the desert.

**42** He remembered his holy promise to his servant Abraham.

**43** He brought out his people with joy. He brought out the people that he chose with shouts of joy.

**44** He gave them the lands of the nations. They got the things that other peoples worked for.

**45** He did this so that they will obey his rules and keep his laws. Praise the LORD!

## Chapter 106

**1** Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, because he is good. His love continues for all time.

**2** No person can tell all the powerful acts of the LORD. No person can give him all the praise that he deserves.

**3** The people who do what is just are happy. The person who always does what is right is happy.

**4** LORD, remember me when you show kindness to your people. Help me when you save them.

**5** Then I will see the good things that you give to the people that you chose. I will be happy with your nation. I will praise you with the people who belong to you.

**6** We sinned, the same as our fathers did. We did wrong. We did evil things.

**7** In Egypt our fathers did not understand your wonders. They did not remember your many acts of love. They went against you at the sea, the Red Sea.

**8** But he saved them because of his name. He did this to show his great power.

**9** He gave a command to the Red Sea, and it became dry. He took them through the deep water as through a desert.

**10** He saved them from the power of the people who hated them. He freed them from the power of the enemy.

**11** The waters covered their enemies. Not one of the enemies lived.

**12** Then our fathers believed his words. They sang praise to him.

**13** But they quickly forgot what he did. They did not wait for his advice.

**14** In the desert they had very strong wishes. They tested God in the desert.

**15** He gave them what they asked for. But he sent a disease that made them weak.

**16** In the camp they were jealous of Moses. They were jealous of Aaron, the holy man of the LORD.

**17** The ground opened and swallowed Dathan. It covered the group of Abiram.

**18** A fire started among their group. The flame burned the wicked people.

**19** At Horeb they made a calf. They worshipped a metal idol.

**20** They changed their glorious God for the image of a bull that eats grass.

**21** They forgot God, who saved them. He did great things in Egypt.

**22** He did wonderful works in the land of Ham. He did terrible things at the Red Sea.

**23** Thus he said that he will destroy them. But Moses, the man that he chose, stood in front of him. Moses stopped God's anger, so that God did not destroy them.

**24** Then they refused the pleasant land. They did not believe his promise.

**25** They complained in their tents. They did not obey the voice of the LORD.

**26** Thus he lifted his hand and made a promise against them. He said that he will make them die in the desert.

**27** He said that he will make their descendants die among the nations. He said that he will send them into many lands.

**28** They joined in the worship of Baal at Peor. They ate sacrifices that people gave to dead gods.

**29** They made the LORD angry with their evil acts. Thus a disease attacked them.

**30** Then Phinehas stood up and stopped the evil. Then the disease stopped.

**31** God accepted this act as right. People will remember it for all generations.
