**32** At the waters of Meribah they made the LORD angry. Because of them, trouble came to Moses.

**33** They made Moses bitter. Thus he spoke without care.

**34** They did not destroy the peoples of the land. But the LORD told them to do this.

**35** They mixed with the nations. They learned the customs of the nations.

**36** They served the idols of the nations. These idols became a trap for them.

**37** They gave their sons and their daughters as sacrifices to demons.

**38** They killed innocent people. They killed their sons and their daughters as sacrifices to the idols of Canaan. Thus the blood made the land unclean.

**39** Their acts made them unclean. They were not loyal to God, because of the things that they did.

**40** Thus the LORD became angry with his people. He hated the people who belonged to him.

**41** He gave them into the power of the nations. The people who hated them ruled over them.

**42** Their enemies caused them to suffer. Their enemies controlled them.

**43** Many times he saved them. But they went against him with their plans. They became weak because of their sin.

**44** But he saw their pain when he heard their cry.

**45** He remembered his agreement with them. Because of his great love, he did not punish them.

**46** He caused all their captors to show pity to them.

**47** LORD our God, save us. Bring us back from the nations. Then we will give thanks to your holy name. We will be proud to praise you.

**48** Praise the LORD, the God of Israel, from all time past to all time in the future. Let all the people say, "Amen." Praise the LORD!

## Chapter 107

**1** Give thanks to the LORD, because he is good. His love continues for all time.

**2** Let the people that the LORD saved say this. He saved them from the power of the enemy.

**3** He brought them back from the lands. He brought them from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

**4** Some people walked in the desert with no road. They did not find a city to live in.

**5** They were hungry and thirsty. Their lives became weak.

**6** Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble. He saved them from their problems.

**7** He took them on a straight road to a city where they could live.

**8** People must praise the LORD for his love. They must praise him for his wonderful works for people.

**9** He satisfies the thirsty person. He fills the hungry person with good things.

**10** Some people sat in darkness and in deep shadow. They were prisoners in pain and in iron chains.

**11** They went against the words of God. They refused the advice of the Most High.

**12** Thus he made them humble with hard work. They fell down, and no person helped them.

**13** Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble. He saved them from their problems.

**14** He brought them out of the darkness and the deep shadow. He broke their chains.

**15** People must praise the LORD for his love. They must praise him for his wonderful works for people.

**16** He breaks the bronze gates. He cuts the iron bars.

**17** Some people were fools because of their sinful ways. They suffered because of their sins.

**18** They did not want to eat any food. They came near to death.

**19** Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble. He saved them from their problems.

**20** He sent his word and healed them. He saved them from the grave.

**21** People must praise the LORD for his love. They must praise him for his wonderful works for people.

**22** Let them give sacrifices of thanks. Let them sing with joy and tell about his works.

**23** Some people went on the sea in ships. They did business on the large waters.

**24** They saw the works of the LORD. They saw his wonders in the deep sea.

**25** He gave a command, and a storm wind came. The wind lifted up the waves of the sea.

**26** The sailors went up to the sky and went down to the deep water. They lost their courage because of the danger.

**27** They moved from side to side like drunk men. They did not know what to do.

**28** Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble. He brought them out of their problems.

**29** He made the storm calm. The waves became quiet.

**30** The sailors were glad because the sea was quiet. He took them to the port that they wanted.

**31** People must praise the LORD for his love. They must praise him for his wonderful works for people.

**32** Let them praise him in the assembly of the people. Let them praise him in the council of the leaders.

**33** He changes rivers into a desert. He changes springs of water into dry ground.

**34** He changes good land into salt land, because the people in it are wicked.

**35** He changes the desert into pools of water. He changes dry ground into springs of water.

**36** He lets the hungry people live there. They build a city where they can live.

**37** They plant seeds in the fields and plant vineyards. The fields give a good harvest.

**38** He blesses them, and their number increases very much. He does not let their cattle decrease.

**39** Then their number decreases. Their enemies make them weak with cruelty, trouble and sorrow.

**40** He shows contempt for rulers. He makes them walk in a desert with no road.

**41** But he lifts the poor people up out of their pain. He makes their families increase like a flock of sheep.

**42** Honest people see this and are happy. All wicked people become silent.

**43** Wise people must think about these things. They will understand the love of the LORD.

## Chapter 108

**1** God, my heart is firm. I will sing and give praise with all my soul.

**2** Wake up, lyre and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

**3** LORD, I will praise you among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

**4** Your love is greater than the heavens. Your faithfulness goes up to the clouds.

**5** God, show your greatness above the heavens. Show your glory over all the earth.

**6** Save us with your right hand and answer me. Then the people that you love will be safe.

**7** God spoke from his holy place. He said, "I will be happy. I will divide the land of Shechem. I will measure the valley of Succoth.

**8** Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim is my helmet. Judah is my ruler's scepter.

**9** Moab is my wash bowl. I will throw my shoe on Edom. I will shout in victory over Philistia."

**10** Who will take me into the strong city? Who will lead me into Edom?

**11** God, you are the one who did this. But you pushed us away. God, you do not go out with our armies.

**12** Help us against the enemy, because the help of people is useless.

**13** With the help of God we will win. He will crush our enemies.

## Chapter 109

**1** God, I praise you. Do not be silent.

**2** Wicked and dishonest men open their mouths against me. They speak lies about me.

**3** They are all around me with words of hate. They attack me without a reason.

**4** I give them love, but they accuse me. But I pray for them.

**5** They pay me back with evil for good. They give me hate for my love.

**6** Put a wicked man against my enemy. Let an accuser (Satan) stand at his right hand.

**7** When the judges judge him, let them find him guilty. Let his prayer become sin.

**8** Let his life be short. Let another person take his position.

**9** Let his children have no father. Let his wife become a widow.

**10** Let his children always travel and ask for food. Let them look for food far from their ruined homes.

**11** Let the person to whom he owes money take all that he has. Let foreigners take all the things that he worked for.

**12** Let no person show him kindness. Let no person feel pity for his children who have no father.

**13** Let his descendants die. Let the next generation forget their name.

**14** Let the LORD remember the sins of his fathers. Let the LORD not forget the sin of his mother.

**15** Let the LORD always remember their sins. Let the LORD remove the memory of them from the earth.

**16** That man never thought to show kindness. He attacked the poor and the people in need. He wanted to kill the people with sad hearts.

**17** He loved to curse. Let curses come to him. He did not like to bless. Let blessings stay far from him.

**18** He put on curses as his clothes. Let curses go into his body like water. Let curses go into his bones like oil.

**19** Let curses cover him like his clothes. Let curses always be around him like a belt.

**20** Let the LORD pay back my accusers in this way. Let the LORD pay back the people who speak evil against me.

**21** But you, LORD God, help me because of your name. Your love is good. Save me!

**22** I am poor and in need. My heart is hurt inside me.

**23** I go away like a shadow at the end of the day. People shake me off like a locust.

**24** My knees are weak because I do not eat. My body is thin.

**25** People insult me. When they see me, they shake their heads.

**26** LORD my God, help me! Save me because of your love.

**27** Then they will know that your hand did this. They will know that you, LORD, did it.

**28** They can curse, but you will bless. When they attack, they will feel shame. But your servant will be happy.

**29** Let shame cover my accusers like clothes. Let their disgrace cover them like a coat.

**30** With my mouth I will give much thanks to the LORD. I will praise him among many people.

**31** He stands at the right hand of the poor man. He saves him from the people who condemn him.

## Chapter 110

**1** The LORD said to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet."

**2** The LORD will make your power go out from Zion. You will rule over your enemies.

**3** On the day of your battle, your people will come to you freely. They will wear holy clothes. Your young men will come to you like dew in the early morning.

**4** The LORD made a promise, and he will not change his mind. "You are a priest for all time, like Melchizedek."

**5** The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings on the day of his anger.

**6** He will judge the nations. He will fill the places with dead bodies. He will crush the rulers of many lands.

**7** He will drink from the stream next to the road. Thus he will lift up his head in victory.

## Chapter 111

**1** Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart. I will do this in the assembly of honest people and in the group of his people.

**2** The works of the LORD are great. All the people who like his works think about them.

**3** His work is full of honor and glory. His justice continues for all time.

**4** He makes people remember his wonderful works. The LORD has grace and compassion.

**5** He gives food to the people who fear him. He always remembers his agreement (covenant).

**6** He showed his people the power of his works. He gave them the lands of other nations.

**7** The works of his hands are true and just. All his laws are sure.

**8** His laws are firm for all time. He made them with truth and honesty.

**9** He set his people free. He made his agreement with them for all time. His name is holy and terrible.

**10** The fear of the LORD is the start of wisdom. All the people who obey his laws have good sense. His praise continues for all time.

## Chapter 112

**1** Praise the LORD! The man who fears the LORD is happy. He is very happy to obey the LORD's commands.

**2** His children will be powerful on the earth. God will bless the generation of honest people.

**3** His house will be full of riches. His justice continues for all time.

**4** For honest people, light shines in the darkness. Such a person has grace and compassion and is just.

**5** Good things come to the man who is kind and lends money. He does his business fairly.

**6** He will never fall. People will remember the good man for all time.

**7** He will not be afraid of bad news. His heart is firm, and he trusts in the LORD.

**8** His heart is safe, and he is not afraid. In the end he will see the defeat of his enemies.

**9** He gives freely to the poor. His justice continues for all time. He will become powerful and have honor.

**10** The wicked man will see this and become angry. He will grind his teeth and go away. The hopes of the wicked will fail.

## Chapter 113

**1** Praise the LORD! Servants of the LORD, praise him! Praise the name of the LORD!

**2** Let people praise the name of the LORD now and for all time.

**3** From the place where the sun comes up to the place where it goes down, people must praise the name of the LORD.

**4** The LORD is high above all the nations. His glory is above the heavens.

**5** No person is the same as the LORD our God. He sits on his throne on high.

**6** He bends down to look at the heavens and the earth.

**7** He lifts the poor up from the dust. He lifts the people in need up from the pile of ashes.

**8** He puts them with princes. He puts them with the princes of his people.

**9** He gives a home to the woman who has no children. He makes her a happy mother of children. Praise the LORD!

## Chapter 114

**1** Israel went out of Egypt. The family of Jacob went away from a people with a foreign language.

**2** Then Judah became God's holy place. Israel became the land that he rules.

**3** The sea saw this and ran away. The river Jordan turned back.

**4** The mountains jumped like rams. The hills jumped like lambs.

**5** Sea, why did you run away? Jordan, why did you turn back?

**6** Mountains, why did you jump like rams? Hills, why did you jump like lambs?

**7** Earth, shake in front of the Lord. Shake in front of the God of Jacob.

**8** He changed the rock into a pool of water. He changed the hard rock into a spring of water.

## Chapter 115

**1** LORD, do not give glory to us. Give glory to your name, because of your love and your faithfulness.

**2** Why do the nations say, "Where is their God?"

**3** Our God is in the heavens. He does all that he wants.

**4** Their idols are silver and gold. Human hands made them.

**5** The idols have mouths, but they cannot speak. They have eyes, but they cannot see.

**6** They have ears, but they cannot hear. They have noses, but they cannot smell.

**7** They have hands, but they cannot feel. They have feet, but they cannot walk. They cannot make a sound with their throats.

**8** The people who make idols will become like the idols. All the people who trust in idols will become like them.

**9** Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

**10** Family of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

**11** You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

**12** The LORD remembers us, and he will bless us. He will bless the family of Israel. He will bless the family of Aaron.

**13** He will bless the people who fear the LORD, the small and the great.

**14** Let the LORD make your number increase. Let him make you and your children increase.

**15** The LORD, who made heaven and earth, blesses you.

**16** The highest heavens belong to the LORD. But he gave the earth to people.

**17** The dead do not praise the LORD. The people who go down into the silent grave do not praise him.

**18** But we will praise the LORD now and for all time. Praise the LORD!

## Chapter 116

**1** I love the LORD, because he heard my voice. He heard me when I asked for mercy.

**2** He listened to me. Thus I will call to him all my life.

**3** The ropes of death were around me. The pains of the grave held me. I found trouble and sorrow.

**4** Then I called to the name of the LORD. I said, "LORD, please save my life!"

**5** The LORD gives grace and he is just. Our God is merciful.

**6** The LORD protects simple people. I was in great trouble, and he saved me.

**7** My soul, be calm again, because the LORD was good to you.

**8** LORD, you saved my life from death. You stopped the tears from my eyes. You kept my feet from a fall.

**9** I will live in front of the LORD in the land of the people who live.

**10** I believed, thus I spoke. I said, "I suffer very much."

**11** When I was afraid, I said, "All people are liars."

**12** What can I give to the LORD for all the good things that he did for me?

**13** I will lift up the cup of salvation. I will call to the name of the LORD.

**14** I will give the LORD what I promised to him. I will do this now in front of all his people.

**15** The death of his loyal people is very important to the LORD.

**16** LORD, I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your female servant. You freed me from my chains.

**17** I will give you a sacrifice of thanks. I will call to the name of the LORD.

**18** I will give the LORD what I promised to him. I will do this now in front of all his people.

**19** I will do this in the courtyards of the house of the LORD, in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

## Chapter 117

**1** All nations, praise the LORD! All peoples, praise him!

**2** His love for us is great. The faithfulness of the LORD continues for all time. Praise the LORD!

## Chapter 118

**1** Give thanks to the LORD, because he is good. His love continues for all time.

**2** Let Israel say, "His love continues for all time."

**3** Let the family of Aaron say, "His love continues for all time."

**4** Let the people who fear the LORD say, "His love continues for all time."

**5** In my trouble I called to the LORD. The LORD answered me and made me free.

**6** The LORD is with me, thus I will not be afraid. People cannot hurt me.

**7** The LORD is with me. He helps me. I will see the defeat of the people who hate me.

**8** It is better to trust in the LORD than to trust in people.

**9** It is better to trust in the LORD than to trust in rulers.

**10** All the nations were around me. But with the name of the LORD I destroyed them.

**11** They were around me on all sides. But with the name of the LORD I destroyed them.

**12** They were around me like bees. But they stopped quickly, like a fire in thorn bushes. With the name of the LORD I destroyed them.

**13** My enemy pushed me hard to make me fall. But the LORD helped me.

**14** The LORD is my strength and my song. He saved me.

**15** Shouts of joy and victory are in the tents of good people. The right hand of the LORD does powerful things.

**16** The right hand of the LORD is high. The right hand of the LORD does powerful things.

**17** I will not die. I will live, and I will tell about the works of the LORD.

**18** The LORD punished me hard. But he did not let me die.

**19** Open the gates of justice for me. I will go through them, and I will give thanks to the LORD.

**20** This is the gate of the LORD. Good people will go through this gate.

**21** I will give thanks to you, because you answered me. You saved me.

**22** The builders refused a stone. That stone became the most important stone of the building.

**23** The LORD did this. It is wonderful to us.

**24** The LORD made this day. We will be happy and glad today.

**25** LORD, please save us! LORD, please give us success!

**26** God blesses the person who comes in the name of the LORD. We bless you from the house of the LORD.

**27** The LORD is God. He gave us light. Tie the sacrifice with ropes to the horns of the altar.

**28** You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, and I will praise you.

**29** Give thanks to the LORD, because he is good. His love continues for all time.

## Chapter 119

**1** The people who live with no fault are happy. They obey the law of the LORD.

**2** The people who keep his laws are happy. They look for him with all their heart.

**3** They do no wrong. They live in his ways.

**4** You gave us your rules. You told us to obey them carefully.

**5** I want my life to be firm, so that I will obey your laws!

**6** Then I will not feel shame when I look at all your commands.

**7** I will praise you with an honest heart when I learn your just laws.

**8** I will obey your laws. Do not leave me completely!

**9** How can a young man keep his life clean? He must obey your word.

**10** I look for you with all my heart. Do not let me go away from your commands.

**11** I keep your word in my heart, so that I will not sin against you.

**12** LORD, I praise you! Teach me your laws.

**13** With my lips I tell all the laws that you spoke.

**14** Your laws make me as happy as great riches make a man happy.

**15** I will think about your rules. I will look carefully at your ways.

**16** I will be happy with your laws. I will not forget your word.

**17** Be good to me, your servant. Then I will live and obey your word.

**18** Open my eyes. Then I will see wonderful things in your law.

**19** I am a foreigner on the earth. Do not hide your commands from me.

**20** My soul is always weak because I want your laws so much.

**21** You warn the proud people. A curse is on them, because they go away from your commands.

**22** Take away the insults and the contempt from me, because I keep your laws.

**23** Rulers sit together and speak against me. But I, your servant, think about your laws.

**24** Your laws make me happy. They give me good advice.

**25** I lie in the dust. Give me new life, as you promised in your word.

**26** I told you about my life, and you answered me. Teach me your laws.

**27** Help me understand your rules. Then I will think about your wonderful works.

**28** My soul is weak because of sorrow. Make me strong, as you promised in your word.

**29** Keep me away from lies. Be kind to me and teach me your law.

**30** I chose the way of truth. I keep your laws in front of me.

**31** I hold on to your laws. LORD, do not let me feel shame.

**32** I will quickly obey your commands, because you make my heart free.

**33** LORD, teach me the way of your laws. Then I will obey them until the end.

**34** Help me understand. Then I will keep your law. I will obey it with all my heart.

**35** Lead me in the path of your commands, because they make me happy.

**36** Turn my heart to your laws. Do not let my heart want riches that are not mine.

**37** Turn my eyes away from useless things. Give me new life in your way.

**38** Keep your promise to me, your servant. Then people will fear you.

**39** Take away the shame that I fear, because your laws are good.

**40** Look, I want your rules very much. Give me new life because of your justice.

**41** LORD, let your love come to me. Save me, as you promised.

**42** Then I will have an answer for the people who insult me, because I trust in your word.

**43** Do not take the word of truth away from my mouth. I put my hope in your laws.

**44** I will always obey your law for all time.

**45** I will live in freedom, because I look for your rules.

**46** I will speak about your laws in front of kings. I will not feel shame.

**47** I am happy with your commands, because I love them.

**48** I lift up my hands to your commands, because I love them. I will think about your laws.

**49** Remember your promise to me, your servant. You gave me hope with your promise.

**50** This is my comfort when I suffer: your promise gives me life.

**51** Proud people laugh at me very much. But I do not turn away from your law.

**52** LORD, I remember your laws from the past. They give me comfort.

**53** I become very angry because of the wicked people who leave your law.

**54** Your laws are my songs in the place where I live as a foreigner.

**55** LORD, in the night I remember your name. I obey your law.

**56** This is my way of life: I obey your rules.

**57** LORD, you are all that I need. I promised to obey your words.

**58** I asked for your kindness with all my heart. Be merciful to me, as you promised.

**59** I thought about my life. Then I turned my feet to follow your laws.

**60** I obeyed your commands quickly. I did not wait.

**61** Wicked people tied me with ropes. But I did not forget your law.

**62** At midnight I get up to give thanks to you because of your just laws.

**63** I am a friend to all the people who fear you. I am a friend to the people who obey your rules.

**64** LORD, the earth is full of your love. Teach me your laws.

**65** LORD, you were good to me, your servant, as you promised.

**66** Teach me good judgment and knowledge, because I believe your commands.

**67** Before you made me suffer, I went the wrong way. But now I obey your word.

**68** You are good, and you do good things. Teach me your laws.

**69** Proud people tell lies about me. But I obey your rules with all my heart.

**70** Their hearts are hard and they have no feeling. But I am happy with your law.

**71** It was good for me to suffer, because then I learned your laws.

**72** The law that you spoke is better for me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.

**73** Your hands made me and gave me shape. Help me understand, so that I will learn your commands.

**74** The people who fear you will see me and be glad, because I hope in your word.

**75** LORD, I know that your laws are right. You made me suffer because you are faithful.

**76** Please let your love give me comfort, as you promised to me, your servant.

**77** Show me your compassion, so that I will live. Your law makes me happy.

**78** Let the proud people feel shame, because they hurt me with lies. But I will think about your rules.

**79** Let the people who fear you come back to me. Let the people who know your laws come back to me.

**80** Let my heart obey your laws with no fault. Then I will not feel shame.

**81** My soul becomes weak because I want you to save me. But I hope in your word.

**82** My eyes become tired while I look for your promise. I ask, "When will you comfort me?"

**83** I am like a dry wineskin in the smoke. But I do not forget your laws.

**84** How long must I, your servant, wait? When will you punish the people who attack me?

**85** Proud people dig pits to catch me. They do not obey your law.

**86** All your commands are true. People attack me with lies. Help me!

**87** They almost killed me on the earth. But I did not leave your rules.

**88** Give me new life because of your love. Then I will obey the laws that you spoke.

**89** LORD, your word continues for all time. It stays firm in heaven.

**90** Your faithfulness continues to all generations. You made the earth firm, and it stays in its place.

**91** All things continue today because of your laws. All things are your servants.

**92** Your law made me happy. Because of this, I did not die in my pain.

**93** I will never forget your rules, because you give me life with them.

**94** I belong to you. Save me, because I look for your rules.

**95** Wicked people wait to destroy me. But I will think about your laws.

**96** I see that all perfect things have a limit. But your command has no limit.

**97** I love your law very much! I think about it all day.

**98** Your commands make me wiser than my enemies, because your commands are always with me.

**99** I have more wisdom than all my teachers, because I think about your laws.

**100** I understand more than the old men, because I obey your rules.

**101** I keep my feet away from all evil paths, so that I will obey your word.

**102** I do not turn away from your laws, because you teach me.

**103** Your words are very sweet to me. They are sweeter than honey in my mouth!

**104** I get wisdom from your rules. Thus I hate all false ways.

**105** Your word is a lamp for my feet. It is a light on my path.

**106** I made a promise, and I will keep it. I will obey your just laws.

**107** I suffer very much. LORD, give me new life, as you promised.

**108** LORD, please accept my prayers of praise as an offering. Teach me your laws.

**109** My life is always in danger. But I do not forget your law.

**110** Wicked people put a trap for me. But I do not go away from your rules.

**111** Your laws are mine for all time. They make my heart happy.

**112** I decide in my heart to obey your laws for all time, to the end.

**113** I hate people who are not loyal. But I love your law.

**114** You are my safe place and my shield. I hope in your word.

**115** Go away from me, you evil people! I will obey the commands of my God.

**116** Support me, as you promised, so that I will live. Do not let my hope fail.

**117** Hold me up, and I will be safe. I will always look carefully at your laws.

**118** You refuse all the people who go away from your laws. Their lies are useless.

**119** You throw away all the wicked people of the earth like waste. Thus I love your laws.

**120** My body shakes because I fear you. I am afraid of your judgments.

**121** I did what is just and right. Do not leave me to the people who hurt me.

**122** Promise to help me, your servant. Do not let the proud people hurt me.

**123** My eyes become tired while I wait for you to save me. I wait for your just promise.

**124** Treat me, your servant, with your love. Teach me your laws.

**125** I am your servant. Help me understand, so that I will know your laws.

**126** LORD, it is time for you to act. People break your law.

**127** Thus I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold.

**128** Thus I follow all your rules carefully. I hate all false ways.

**129** Your laws are wonderful. Thus I obey them.

**130** When your words come into the mind, they give light. They give wisdom to simple people.

**131** I open my mouth and breathe quickly, because I want your commands.

**132** Turn to me and be merciful to me. Do as you always do for the people who love your name.

**133** Guide my steps by your word. Do not let any sin control me.

**134** Save me from the people who hurt me. Then I will obey your rules.

**135** Show me your kindness, your servant. Teach me your laws.

**136** Tears flow from my eyes like rivers, because people do not obey your law.

**137** LORD, you are just. Your laws are right.

**138** The laws that you gave are just and very true.

**139** My strong love for you destroys me, because my enemies forget your words.

**140** Your word is very pure. Thus I, your servant, love it.

**141** I am small and people hate me. But I do not forget your rules.

**142** Your justice continues for all time. Your law is true.

**143** Trouble and pain come to me. But your commands make me happy.

**144** Your laws are just for all time. Help me understand, and I will live.

**145** I call to you with all my heart. LORD, answer me! I will obey your laws.

**146** I call to you. Save me, and I will obey your laws.

**147** I get up before the sun and cry for help. I hope in your word.

**148** I stay awake in the night, so that I can think about your word.

**149** LORD, hear my voice because of your love. Give me new life because of your laws.

**150** The people who make evil plans come near. They are far from your law.

**151** But you are near, LORD. All your commands are true.

**152** A long time ago I learned from your laws. I know that you made them firm for all time.

**153** Look at my pain and save me, because I do not forget your law.

**154** Defend me and save me. Give me new life, as you promised.

**155** The wicked people are far from salvation, because they do not look for your laws.

**156** LORD, your compassion is great. Give me new life because of your laws.

**157** Many enemies attack me. But I do not turn away from your laws.

**158** I saw the people who are not loyal to you, and I hated them. They do not obey your word.

**159** Look, I love your rules! LORD, give me new life because of your love.

**160** All your words are true. All your just laws continue for all time.

**161** Rulers attack me without a reason. But my heart fears your word.

**162** I am happy with your promise. I am like a man who finds great riches.

**163** I hate lies very much. But I love your law.

**164** 7 times a day I praise you because of your just laws.

**165** The people who love your law have great peace. Nothing makes them fall.

**166** LORD, I hope for your salvation. I obey your commands.

**167** I obey your laws. I love them very much.

**168** I obey your rules and your laws, because you know all that I do.

**169** LORD, let my cry come to you. Help me understand, as you promised.

**170** Let my prayer come to you. Save me, as you promised.

**171** My lips will praise you, because you teach me your laws.

**172** My tongue will sing about your word, because all your commands are just.

**173** Let your hand help me, because I chose your rules.

**174** LORD, I want you to save me. Your law makes me happy.

**175** Let me live so that I can praise you. Let your laws help me.

**176** I went away like a lost sheep. Look for me, your servant, because I do not forget your commands.

## Chapter 120

**1** In my trouble I cried to the LORD, and he answered me.

**2** LORD, save me from lying lips. Save me from dishonest tongues.

**3** You dishonest tongue, what will God do to you? How will he punish you?

**4** He will punish you with the sharp arrows of a soldier. He will punish you with hot coals of a broom tree.

**5** I am very sad, because I live as a foreigner in Meshech. I live among the tents of Kedar.

**6** I lived too long among people who hate peace.

**7** I want peace. But when I speak, they want war.

## Chapter 121

**1** I look up to the mountains. Where does my help come from?

**2** My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

**3** He will not let your foot slip. He who protects you will not sleep.

**4** Look, he who protects Israel will not become tired and he will not sleep.

**5** The LORD protects you. The LORD is your shade at your right hand.

**6** The sun will not hurt you in the day. The moon will not hurt you in the night.

**7** The LORD will keep you safe from all evil. He will keep your life safe.

**8** The LORD will keep you safe when you go and when you come. He will do this now and for all time.

## Chapter 122

**1** I was glad when people said to me, "Let us go to the house of the LORD."

**2** Jerusalem, our feet stand inside your gates.

**3** Jerusalem is a city that people built well. All its parts join closely together.

**4** The tribes go up to Jerusalem, the tribes of the LORD. They give thanks to the name of the LORD, as the law of Israel tells them.

**5** The thrones of judgment are there. They are the thrones of the family of David.

**6** Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. "Let the people who love you have success.

**7** Let there be peace inside your walls. Let there be safety inside your palaces."

**8** Because of my brothers and my friends, I will say, "Let there be peace in you."

**9** Because of the house of the LORD our God, I will look for good things for you.

## Chapter 123

**1** I look up to you. You sit on your throne in heaven.

**2** Servants look to the hand of their master. A female servant looks to the hand of her mistress. In the same way, our eyes look to the LORD our God until he shows us mercy.

**3** LORD, be merciful to us. Be merciful to us, because people show us much contempt.

**4** Proud people laugh at us very much. Arrogant people show us much contempt.

## Chapter 124

**1** Let Israel say, "The LORD was on our side. If he was not on our side,

**2** if the LORD was not on our side when men attacked us,

**3** then they will swallow us alive. Their anger burned against us.

**4** Then the flood will cover us. The river will go over us.

**5** Then the angry waters will go over us."

**6** Praise the LORD! He did not let their teeth tear us apart.

**7** We escaped like a bird from the trap of a hunter. The trap broke, and we escaped.

**8** Our help comes from the name of the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

## Chapter 125

**1** The people who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. Nothing can move Mount Zion. It stays for all time.

**2** The mountains are around Jerusalem. In the same way, the LORD is around his people now and for all time.

**3** The wicked will not rule the land of good people. If the wicked rule, good people possibly will do wrong things.

**4** LORD, do good to good people. Do good to the people with honest hearts.

**5** But the LORD will send away the people who turn to dishonest ways. He will send them away with the people who do evil. Let there be peace on Israel.

## Chapter 126

**1** The LORD brought the prisoners back to Zion. Then we were like people in a dream.

**2** Our mouths were full of laughter. Our tongues sang with joy. Then the nations said, "The LORD did great things for them."

**3** The LORD did great things for us. Thus we are glad.

**4** LORD, give us back our good fortune, as streams fill the dry land in the south.

**5** The people who plant seed with tears will collect the harvest with songs of joy.

**6** A person goes out and cries while he carries his seed to plant. He will come back with songs of joy and carry his harvest.

## Chapter 127

**1** If the LORD does not build the house, the builders work for no purpose. If the LORD does not protect the city, the guard stays awake for no purpose.

**2** It is useless for you to get up early and go to bed late. It is useless to work hard for your food. The LORD gives sleep to the people that he loves.

**3** Children are a gift from the LORD. Children are his reward.

**4** Children of a young man are like arrows in the hand of a soldier.

**5** The man who has many of these arrows is happy. He will not feel shame when he argues with his enemies at the city gate.

## Chapter 128

**1** All the people who fear the LORD are happy. They live in his ways.

**2** You will eat the food that you work for. You will be happy and you will have success.

**3** Your wife will be like a vine with much fruit in your house. Your children will be like young olive trees around your table.

**4** This is how God will bless the man who fears the LORD.

**5** The LORD will bless you from Zion. You will see the good things of Jerusalem all your life.

**6** You will see your grandchildren. Let there be peace on Israel.

## Chapter 129

**1** Let Israel say, "Many times my enemies attacked me since I was young.

**2** Many times they attacked me since I was young. But they did not defeat me.

**3** They hurt my back badly. They made long cuts on it, like a farmer who plows a field.

**4** But the LORD is just. He cut the ropes of the wicked people."

**5** Let all the people who hate Zion feel shame and turn back.

**6** Let them be like grass on the roof. The grass becomes dry before it grows.

**7** The worker cannot fill his hand with that grass. The person who ties the grain cannot fill his arms with it.

**8** The people who go past do not say, "We wish the blessing of the LORD on you. We bless you in the name of the LORD."

## Chapter 130

**1** LORD, I cry to you from deep trouble.

**2** Lord, hear my voice. Listen to me when I ask for mercy.

**3** LORD, if you kept a record of sins, Lord, no person could stand.

**4** But you forgive. Thus people fear you.

**5** I wait for the LORD. My soul waits for him. I hope in his word.

**6** My soul waits for the Lord more than guards wait for the morning. Yes, more than guards wait for the morning.

**7** Israel, put your hope in the LORD! The LORD has love. He has great power to save.

**8** He will save Israel from all their sins.

## Chapter 131

**1** LORD, my heart is not proud. My eyes are not proud. I do not try to do great things. I do not try to do things that are too difficult for me.

**2** I made my soul calm and quiet. I am like a young child with his mother. My soul is calm like that child.

**3** Israel, put your hope in the LORD now and for all time.

## Chapter 132

**1** LORD, remember David and all his troubles.

**2** He made a promise to the LORD. He made a promise to the Mighty One of Jacob.

**3** David said, "I will not go into my house. I will not go to my bed.

**4** I will not let my eyes sleep. I will not let my eyes close.

**5** I will not rest until I find a place for the LORD. I will find a home for the Mighty One of Jacob."

**6** We heard about the box of the agreement (ark) in Ephrathah. We found it in the fields of Jaar.

**7** Let us go to his home. Let us worship at his footstool.

**8** LORD, get up and go to your place of rest. Go with the ark that shows your strength.

**9** Let your priests wear justice like clothes. Let your loyal people shout with joy.

**10** Because of your servant David, do not refuse the king that you chose (anointed).

**11** The LORD made a true promise to David. He will not change it. He said, "I will put one of your sons on your throne.

**12** Your sons possibly will obey my agreement (covenant) and the laws that I teach them. If they do, then their sons will sit on your throne for all time."

**13** The LORD chose Zion. He wanted Zion as his home.

**14** He said, "This is my place of rest for all time. I will live here, because I want this place.

**15** I will bless Zion with much food. I will give enough bread to her poor people.

**16** I will make her priests wear salvation like clothes. Her loyal people will shout with joy.

**17** There I will make a strong king grow from the family of David. I will keep a lamp lit for the king that I chose.

**18** I will cover his enemies with shame. But his crown will shine on his head."

## Chapter 133

**1** Look, it is good and pleasant when brothers live together as one!

**2** It is like expensive oil on the head. The oil flows down on the beard of Aaron. It flows down onto the collar of his clothes.

**3** It is like the dew of Mount Hermon that falls on the mountains of Zion. There the LORD gives his blessing, which is life for all time.

## Chapter 134

**1** All servants of the LORD, praise the LORD! You serve in the house of the LORD in the night.

**2** Lift up your hands in the holy place, and praise the LORD.

**3** The LORD, who made heaven and earth, will bless you from Zion.

## Chapter 135

**1** Praise the LORD. Praise the name of the LORD. Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD.

**2** You stand in the house of the LORD. You stand in the yards of the house of our God.

**3** Praise the LORD, because the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, because his name gives pleasure.

**4** The LORD chose Jacob for himself. He chose Israel as his special treasure.

**5** I know that the LORD is great. I know that our Lord is above all gods.

**6** The LORD does all the things that he wants. He does them in heaven and on the earth. He does them in the seas and in all the deep places.

**7** He causes the clouds to go up from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain. He brings the wind out of his storehouses.

**8** He killed the firstborn of Egypt, the firstborn of people and of animals.

**9** He sent signs and wonders into the middle of Egypt. He sent them against Pharaoh and against all his servants.

**10** He attacked great nations. He killed strong kings.

**11** He killed Sihon, the king of the Amorites, and Og, the king of Bashan. He defeated all the kingdoms of Canaan.

**12** He gave their land as a possession. He gave it as a possession to Israel, his people.

**13** LORD, your name will continue for all time. LORD, all generations will remember you.

**14** The LORD will judge his people. He will show pity to his servants.

**15** The idols of the nations are silver and gold. Human hands made these idols.

**16** The idols have mouths, but they cannot speak. The idols have eyes, but they cannot see.

**17** The idols have ears, but they cannot hear. The idols have no breath in their mouths.

**18** The people who make idols will become like the idols. All the people who trust in idols will become like them.

**19** People of Israel, praise the LORD. Family of Aaron, praise the LORD.

**20** Family of Levi, praise the LORD. All you who fear the LORD, praise the LORD.

**21** Praise the LORD from Zion. The LORD lives in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD.

**1** Give thanks to the LORD, because he is good. His love continues for all time.

**2** Give thanks to the God of gods. His love continues for all time.

**3** Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His love continues for all time.

**4** Only he does great wonders. His love continues for all time.

**5** He used his wisdom to make the heavens. His love continues for all time.

**6** He spread out the earth above the waters. His love continues for all time.

**7** He made the great lights. His love continues for all time.

**8** He made the sun to rule the day. His love continues for all time.

**9** He made the moon and the stars to rule the night. His love continues for all time.

**10** He killed the firstborn of Egypt. His love continues for all time.

**11** He brought Israel out from among the Egyptians. His love continues for all time.

**12** He did this with a strong hand and with a powerful arm. His love continues for all time.

**13** He divided the Red Sea into 2 parts. His love continues for all time.

**14** He caused Israel to go through the middle of the sea. His love continues for all time.

**15** But he threw Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His love continues for all time.

**17** He attacked great kings. His love continues for all time.

**19** He killed Sihon, the king of the Amorites. His love continues for all time.

**20** He killed Og, the king of Bashan. His love continues for all time.

**21** He gave their land as a possession. His love continues for all time.

**22** He gave the land as a possession to Israel, his servant. His love continues for all time.

**24** He made us free from our enemies. His love continues for all time.

**25** He gives food to all creatures. His love continues for all time.

## Chapter 137

**1** We sat down by the rivers of Babylon. We cried when we remembered Zion.

**2** We hung our harps on the trees in that country.

**3** The people who took us away as prisoners told us to sing songs. The people who hurt us told us to be happy. They said, "Sing one of the songs of Zion for us."

**4** How can we sing the song of the LORD in a foreign land?

**5** Jerusalem, if I forget you, then let my right hand forget its skill.

**6** If I do not remember you, then let my tongue stick to the top of my mouth. Let this occur if Jerusalem is not my greatest joy.

**7** LORD, remember what the people of Edom did on the day that Jerusalem fell. They said, "Destroy the city. Destroy it to its foundations."

**8** People of Babylon, someone will destroy you. The man who pays you back for what you did to us will be happy.

**9** The man who takes your children and throws them against the rocks will be happy.

## Chapter 138

**1** I will praise you with all my heart. I will sing praise to you in front of the gods.

**2** I will bow down toward your holy temple. I will praise your name for your love and your truth. You made your word greater than all your name.

**3** On the day that I called to you, you answered me. You made my soul strong.

**4** LORD, all the kings of the earth will praise you when they hear your words.

**5** They will sing about the ways of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD is great.

**6** The LORD is high, but he takes care of humble people. But he knows proud people from far away.

**7** When I walk in the middle of trouble, you keep me alive. You put out your hand against the anger of my enemies. Your right hand saves me.

**8** The LORD will complete his plan for me. LORD, your love continues for all time. Do not leave the work of your own hands.

## Chapter 139

**1** LORD, you examined me and you know me.

**2** You know when I sit down and when I stand up. You know my thoughts from far away.

**3** You see where I go and where I lie down. You know all the things that I do.

**4** Before I say a word, LORD, you know all of it.

**5** You are all around me, behind me and in front of me. You put your hand on me.

**6** This knowledge is too wonderful for me. It is too high, and I cannot understand it.

**7** Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I run from you?

**8** If I go up to heaven, you are there. If I lie down in the place of the dead, you are there.

**9** I can fly on the wings of the morning. I can live at the farthest part of the sea.

**10** Even there your hand will lead me. Your right hand will hold me.

**11** I can say, "The darkness will hide me." But the night around me will become light.

**12** The darkness is not dark to you. The night is bright like the day. Darkness and light are the same to you.

**13** You made all the parts of my body. You made me inside my mother.

**14** I will praise you, because you made me in a wonderful way. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows this very well.

**15** You saw my body when you made me in a secret place. You made me with skill, as if in the deep parts of the earth.

**16** Your eyes saw my body before it was complete. You wrote all my days in your book. You wrote them before one of them started.

**17** God, your thoughts are very valuable to me. The number of your thoughts is very large.

**18** If I count your thoughts, they are more than the grains of sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

**19** God, you will surely kill the wicked people. Murderers, go away from me!

**20** These people speak against you with evil plans. Your enemies use your name falsely.

**21** LORD, I hate the people who hate you. I feel sad about the people who fight against you.

**22** I hate them completely. I think of them as my enemies.

**23** God, examine me and know my heart. Test me and know my thoughts.

**24** See if there is a wicked way in me. Lead me in the way that continues for all time.

## Chapter 140

**1** LORD, save me from evil men. Keep me safe from violent men.

**2** These men make evil plans in their hearts. They always cause wars.

**3** Their tongues are sharp like the tongue of a snake. Their words are like the poison of a snake. Selah.

**4** LORD, keep me safe from the hands of wicked people. Keep me safe from violent men. These men plan to make me fall.

**5** Proud men hid a trap for me. They put out ropes and a net along the road. They set traps for me. Selah.

**6** I said to the LORD, "You are my God. LORD, hear my calls for help."

**7** GOD the Lord, you are my strong savior. You protected my head on the day of battle.

**8** LORD, do not give wicked people what they want. Do not let their evil plans succeed. If their plans succeed, they will become proud. Selah.

**9** My enemies are all around me. Let the evil that they speak fall back on their own heads.

**10** Let hot coals fall on them. Throw them into the fire. Throw them into deep holes, so that they cannot get out again.

**11** Do not let liars become strong in the land. Let evil hunt the violent man and destroy him.

**12** I know that the LORD will help the poor people. He will give fair judgment to people who are in need.

**13** Good people will surely give thanks to your name. Honest people will live with you.

## Chapter 141

**1** LORD, I call to you. Come to me quickly. Listen to me when I call to you.

**2** Let my prayer come to you like incense. Let my raised hands be like the evening sacrifice.

**3** LORD, put a guard on my mouth. Watch the door of my lips.

**4** Do not let my heart want an evil thing. Do not let me do wicked things with evil men. Do not let me eat their good food.

**5** If a good man hits me, it is a kindness. If he corrects me, it is like good oil on my head. My head will not refuse it. I will always pray against the evil things that wicked people do.

**6** People will throw their leaders down from the rocks. Then the people will hear my words and know that my words are pleasant.

**7** Our bones lie in all directions at the mouth of the grave. They are like wood that a man cuts and breaks on the ground.

**8** But GOD the Lord, I look to you. I trust in you. Do not leave me without help.

**9** Keep me safe from the traps that the evil people set for me. Keep me safe from their traps.

**10** Let the wicked people fall into their own nets. But let me go free.

## Chapter 142

**1** I called to the LORD with my voice. I asked the LORD for help with my voice.

**2** I told him all my complaints. I told him about my trouble.

**3** When my spirit was weak, you knew my way. My enemies hid a trap for me on the road where I walk.

**4** I looked to my right side, but no person knew me. I had no safe place. No person cared about me.

**5** LORD, I called to you. I said, "You are my safe place. You are all that I have in the land of the people who live."

**6** Listen to my call, because I am very weak. Save me from the people who attack me, because they are stronger than I am.

**7** Bring me out of the prison, so that I can praise your name. Then good people will come around me, because you will be kind to me.

## Chapter 143

**1** LORD, hear my prayer. Listen to my calls for help. Answer me, because you are faithful and good.

**2** Do not judge your servant, because no person who lives is good in your eyes.

**3** The enemy attacked me. He pushed my life down to the ground. He made me live in darkness, like people who died a long time ago.

**4** Thus my spirit is weak. My heart is full of fear.

**5** I remember the days of the past. I think about all the things that you did. I think about the work of your hands.

**6** I hold out my hands to you. My soul is thirsty for you, like a dry land. Selah.

**7** LORD, answer me quickly. My spirit is weak. Do not hide your face from me. If you hide your face, I will be like the people who go down into the grave.

**8** Let me hear about your love in the morning, because I trust you. Show me the way that I must go, because I give my life to you.

**9** LORD, save me from my enemies. I go to you for protection.

**10** Teach me to do the things that you want, because you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me on level ground.

**11** LORD, keep me alive for the honor of your name. Because you are good, bring me out of trouble.

**12** Because of your love, destroy my enemies. Destroy all the people who attack me, because I am your servant.

## Chapter 144

**1** Praise the LORD, my strength. He teaches my hands to make war. He teaches my fingers to fight.

**2** He is my love and my strong place. He is my high tower and my savior. He is my shield, and I trust in him. He puts my people under my control.

**3** LORD, what is a human, that you think about him? What is a son of man, that you care about him?

**4** A human is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that goes away.

**5** LORD, open your heavens and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will make smoke.

**6** Send lightning and scatter the enemies. Shoot your arrows and destroy them.

**7** Put out your hand from above. Save me from the deep waters. Save me from the hands of foreigners.

**8** These foreigners speak lies. When they make a promise, they lie.

**9** God, I will sing a new song to you. I will play a harp with 10 strings and sing praises to you.

**10** God gives victory to kings. He saves David, his servant, from the dangerous sword.

**11** Save me from the hands of foreigners. These foreigners speak lies. When they make a promise, they lie.

**12** Then our sons will be like strong young plants. Our daughters will be like beautiful corner stones in a palace.

**13** Our storehouses will be full of all types of food. Our sheep will give birth to thousands and tens of thousands in our fields.

**14** Our cattle will be strong and do much work. No enemy will break through our walls. No people will go away as prisoners. No people will cry in our streets.

**15** The people who have these things are happy. The people whose God is the LORD are happy.

## Chapter 145

**1** My God and King, I will praise you. I will praise your name for all time.

**2** I will praise you every day. I will praise your name for all time.

**3** The LORD is great, and people must praise him very much. No person can measure his greatness.

**4** Each generation will praise your works to the next generation. They will tell about your powerful acts.

**5** I will speak about your glory and your honor. I will speak about your wonderful works.

**6** People will speak about the power of your terrible acts. I will tell about your greatness.

**7** People will tell again and again about your great goodness. They will sing about your justice.

**8** The LORD is kind and full of pity. He is slow to become angry, and his love is great.

**9** The LORD is good to all. He shows pity to all the things that he made.

**10** LORD, all the things that you made will praise you. Your holy people will praise you.

**11** They will speak about the glory of your kingdom. They will talk about your power.

**12** They will tell all people about the powerful acts of God. They will tell about the glory of his kingdom.

**13** Your kingdom will continue for all time. Your rule will continue through all generations.

**14** The LORD helps all the people who fall. He lifts up all the people who are bent down.

**15** The eyes of all creatures look to you. You give them their food at the correct time.

**16** You open your hand. You give every creature what it wants.

**17** The LORD is fair in all his ways. He is holy in all his works.

**18** The LORD is near to all the people who call to him. He is near to all the people who call to him honestly.

**19** He will give the people who fear him what they want. He will hear their call and save them.

**20** The LORD keeps safe all the people who love him. But he will destroy all wicked people.

**21** My mouth will speak praise to the LORD. Let all people praise his holy name for all time.

## Chapter 146

**1** Praise the LORD. My soul, praise the LORD.

**2** I will praise the LORD all my life. I will sing praises to my God while I live.

**3** Do not trust in princes. Do not trust in a human. A human cannot save you.

**4** When his breath goes out, he goes back to the ground. On that day his plans stop.

**5** The person whose help is the God of Jacob is happy. The person whose hope is in the LORD his God is happy.

**6** God made heaven and earth and the sea. He made all the things in them. He is always faithful.

**7** He gives justice to people whom others treat badly. He gives food to hungry people. The LORD makes prisoners free.

**8** The LORD opens the eyes of blind people. The LORD lifts up the people who are bent down. The LORD loves good people.

**9** The LORD keeps foreigners safe. He helps orphans and widows. But he stops the plans of wicked people.

**10** The LORD will rule for all time. Zion, your God will rule through all generations. Praise the LORD.

## Chapter 147

**1** Praise the LORD. It is good to sing praises to our God. It gives pleasure, and praise is correct.

**2** The LORD builds Jerusalem again. He brings back the people of Israel whom their enemies sent away.

**3** He heals the people with broken hearts. He puts bandages on their wounds.

**4** He knows the number of the stars. He gives a name to each star.

**5** Our Lord is great and very powerful. His knowledge has no limit.

**6** The LORD lifts up humble people. He throws wicked people down to the ground.

**7** Sing to the LORD with thanks. Play the harp and sing praise to our God.

**8** He covers the sky with clouds. He makes rain for the earth. He makes grass grow on the mountains.

**9** He gives food to the animals. He gives food to the young ravens when they call.

**10** The strength of a horse does not give him pleasure. The strong legs of a man do not give him pleasure.

**11** The LORD gets pleasure from the people who fear him. He gets pleasure from the people who hope in his love.

**12** Jerusalem, praise the LORD. Zion, praise your God.

**13** He makes the bars of your gates strong. He blesses your children in you.

**14** He gives peace to your country. He gives you the best wheat.

**15** He sends his command to the earth. His word goes very quickly.

**16** He sends snow that is like wool. He scatters frost like ashes.

**17** He throws down hail like small stones. No person can stand in his cold.

**18** He sends his word, and the ice melts. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

**19** He tells his word to Jacob. He tells his laws and his rules to Israel.

**20** He did not do this for any other nation. The other nations do not know his rules. Praise the LORD.

## Chapter 148

**1** Praise the LORD. Praise the LORD from the heavens. Praise him in the high places.

**2** Praise him, all his angels. Praise him, all his armies in heaven.

**3** Sun and moon, praise him. All you bright stars, praise him.

**4** Highest heavens, praise him. Waters above the sky, praise him.

**5** Let them praise the name of the LORD, because he gave the command and they came into existence.

**6** He put them in their places for all time. He made a law that will not change.

**7** Praise the LORD from the earth, you sea monsters and all the deep seas.

**8** Praise him, fire and hail, snow and clouds. Praise him, strong winds that obey his word.

**9** Praise him, mountains and all hills. Praise him, fruit trees and all cedars.

**10** Praise him, wild animals and all cattle. Praise him, small animals and birds.

**11** Praise him, kings of the earth and all nations. Praise him, princes and all rulers of the earth.

**12** Praise him, young men and young women. Praise him, old men and children.

**13** Let them praise the name of the LORD, because only his name is great. His glory is above the earth and heaven.

**14** He made his people strong. All his holy people praise him. The people of Israel are near to him. Praise the LORD.

## Chapter 149

**1** Praise the LORD. Sing a new song to the LORD. Praise him in the group of his holy people.

**2** Let Israel be glad in their Maker. Let the people of Zion be happy in their King.

**3** Let them praise his name with dances. Let them sing praises to him with the tambourine and the harp.

**4** The LORD gets pleasure from his people. He gives honor to humble people, because he saves them.

**5** Let the holy people be happy in their glory. Let them sing loudly on their beds.

**6** Let the praises of God be in their mouths. Let them hold a sword with 2 sharp edges in their hands.

**7** They will punish the nations. They will punish the peoples.

**8** They will put chains on their kings. They will put iron chains on their nobles.

**9** They will do the judgment that God wrote against them. This is the honor of all his holy people. Praise the LORD.

## Chapter 150

**1** Praise the LORD. Praise God in his holy place. Praise him in his powerful sky.

**2** Praise him for his powerful acts. Praise him for his very great power.

**3** Praise him with the sound of the trumpet. Praise him with the lyre and the harp.

**4** Praise him with the tambourine and dances. Praise him with strings and flutes.

**5** Praise him with loud cymbals. Praise him with very loud cymbals.

**6** Let all things that have breath praise the LORD. Praise the LORD.

# Proverbs

## Chapter 1

**1** These are the wise sayings (proverbs) of Solomon. Solomon was the son of David and the king of Israel.

**2** These proverbs help you to know wisdom and to accept correction. They help you to understand wise words.

**3** They help you to learn how to live wisely. They teach you to do what is right, fair and honest.

**4** They give good sense to simple people. They give knowledge and good judgment to young men.

**5** A wise man will listen and learn more. A man with good sense will get good advice.

**6** Then he will understand proverbs and their meanings. He will understand the words of wise people and their difficult sayings.

**7** Fear of the LORD is the start of knowledge. But fools hate wisdom and correction.

**8** My son, listen to the instruction of your father. Do not forget the law of your mother.

**9** Their words will be like a beautiful crown on your head. They will be like a chain of honor around your neck.

**10** My son, sinners will try to make you do wrong. Do not agree with them.

**11** They will say, "Come with us. We will hide and wait to kill someone. We will attack innocent people for no reason.

**12** We will destroy them completely, as the grave takes the dead. We will kill them as the dead go down into the pit.

**13** We will find all types of valuable things. We will fill our houses with the things that we steal.

**14** Join our group. We will share all the money."

**15** My son, do not go with them. Keep your feet away from their path.

**16** Their feet run to do evil. They go quickly to kill people.

**17** A bird can see a net. Then the net does not catch the bird.

**18** But these men wait to kill, and they kill themselves. They hide and wait for their own death.

**19** This is what occurs to all people who are greedy for money. Greed takes away the lives of the greedy people.

**20** Wisdom calls aloud outside. She raises her voice in the streets.

**21** She calls in the busy places. She speaks at the city gates. She says,

**22** "Simple people, how long will you love your foolish ways? How long will mockers enjoy their mockery? How long will fools hate knowledge?

**23** Listen when I correct you. I will give you my spirit. I will tell you my words.

**24** I called to you, but you refused to listen. I held out my hand to you, but no person paid attention.

**25** You ignored all my advice. You did not accept my correction.

**26** So I will laugh when disaster comes to you. I will mock you when fear comes to you.

**27** Fear will come on you like a storm. Destruction will come on you like a strong wind. Trouble and pain will come on you.

**28** Then they will call to me, but I will not answer. They will look for me, but they will not find me.

**29** They hated knowledge. They did not choose to fear the LORD.

**30** They did not accept my advice. They hated all my correction.

**31** Thus they will get the results of their own way. Their own plans will cause them much trouble.

**32** Simple people turn away from wisdom, and this kills them. Fools are too comfortable, and this destroys them.

**33** But the person who listens to me will live safely. He will be calm and he will not fear evil."

## Chapter 2

**1** My son, accept my words. Keep my commands in your memory.

**2** Listen carefully to wisdom. Use all your mind to get good sense.

**3** Call out for knowledge. Ask loudly for good sense.

**4** Look for wisdom as you look for silver. Search for it as you search for hidden treasure.

**5** If you do these things, then you will understand the fear of the LORD. You will find the knowledge of God.

**6** The LORD gives wisdom. Knowledge and good sense come from his mouth.

**7** He keeps good wisdom for honest people. He is a shield to the people who live correctly.

**8** He protects the paths of fair people. He keeps his faithful people safe.

**9** Then you will understand what is right, fair and honest. You will understand every good path.

**10** Wisdom will come into your heart. Knowledge will give pleasure to your soul.

**11** Then good judgment will protect you. Understanding will keep you safe.

**12** Wisdom will save you from the way of evil men. It will save you from men who speak lies.

**13** These men leave the correct paths. They walk in the ways of darkness.

**14** They are happy when they do evil. They enjoy the bad things that wicked people do.

**15** Their ways are not straight. Their paths are dishonest.

**16** Wisdom will also save you from the adulterous woman. It will save you from the foreign woman who speaks false sweet words.

**17** She left the husband of her youth. She forgot the agreement (covenant) that she made in front of her God.

**18** Her house leads down to death. Her paths lead to the dead.

**19** No man who goes to her comes back. No man finds the paths of life again.

**20** Thus you will walk in the way of good men. You will stay on the paths of honest people.

**21** Honest people will live in the land. People who do right will stay in the land.

**22** But God will remove wicked people from the land. He will pull out dishonest people from the land.

## Chapter 3

**1** My son, do not forget my law. Keep my commands in your heart.

**2** My commands will give you a long life. They will give you many years and peace.

**3** Do not let love and truth leave you. Tie them around your neck. Write them on your heart.

**4** Then God and people will like you. They will think well of you.

**5** Trust in the LORD with all your heart. Do not depend on your own knowledge.

**6** Remember the LORD in all that you do. He will make your paths straight.

**7** Do not think that you are wise. Fear the LORD and turn away from evil.

**8** This will make your body healthy. It will make your bones strong.

**9** Honor the LORD with your wealth. Give him the first and best part of all your crops.

**10** Then your storehouses will be very full. Your wine containers will overflow with new wine.

**11** My son, do not hate the discipline of the LORD. Do not become angry when he corrects you.

**12** The LORD corrects the people that he loves. A father corrects the son that gives him pleasure.

**13** The man who finds wisdom is happy. The man who gets good sense is happy.

**14** Wisdom is better than silver. Its profit is better than gold.

**15** Wisdom is more valuable than rubies. All the things that you want are not equal to her.

**16** Wisdom holds a long life in her right hand. She holds wealth and honor in her left hand.

**17** Her ways give pleasure. All her paths give peace.

**18** Wisdom is a tree of life to the people who hold her. The people who keep her are happy.

**19** The LORD used wisdom to make the earth. He used his knowledge to put the heavens in their place.

**20** His knowledge caused the deep waters to break out. His knowledge causes the clouds to drop dew.

**21** My son, keep good wisdom and good judgment. Do not let them go away from your eyes.

**22** They will give life to your soul. They will be like a beautiful chain around your neck.

**23** Then you will walk on your path safely. Your foot will not trip.

**24** When you lie down, you will not be afraid. You will lie down and sleep well.

**25** Do not be afraid of sudden disaster. Do not be afraid when destruction comes on the wicked people.

**26** The LORD will be your hope. He will keep your foot from a trap.

**27** Do not keep good things from the people who must get them. Give good things when you can.

**28** Your neighbor can ask you for something that you have now. Then do not say, "Go away and come back. I will give it to you tomorrow."

**29** Do not plan evil against your neighbor. He lives near you and trusts you.

**30** Do not argue with a man for no reason. Do not argue with him if he did not hurt you.

**31** Do not envy a violent man. Do not do the things that he does.

**32** The LORD hates dishonest people. But he is a friend to honest people.

**33** The LORD curses the house of wicked people. But he blesses the home of good people.

**34** The LORD mocks proud mockers. But he is kind to humble people.

**35** Wise people will get honor. But fools will get shame.

## Chapter 4

**1** Children, listen to the instruction of your father. Pay attention so that you get good sense.

**2** I give you good instruction. Do not leave my law.

**3** I was a son to my father. I was young and the only child that my mother loved.

**4** My father taught me. He said, "Keep my words in your heart. Obey my commands and you will live.

**5** Get wisdom. Get good sense. Do not forget my words. Do not turn away from them.

**6** Do not leave wisdom, and she will protect you. Love her, and she will keep you safe.

**7** Wisdom is the most important thing. Thus, get wisdom. Use all that you have to get good sense.

**8** Think highly of wisdom, and she will make you great. Hold her close, and she will give you honor.

**9** She will put a beautiful crown on your head. She will give you a crown of glory."

**10** My son, listen and accept my words. Then you will live for many years.

**11** I taught you the way of wisdom. I led you on straight paths.

**12** When you walk, nothing will stop you. When you run, you will not trip.

**13** Hold on to correction. Do not let it go. Keep it, because it is your life.

**14** Do not go on the path of wicked people. Do not walk in the way of evil men.

**15** Stay away from their path. Do not go on it. Turn away from it and go past it.

**16** Wicked people cannot sleep until they do evil. They cannot sleep until they cause a person to fall.

**17** They eat food that they get by wicked acts. They drink wine that they get by violence.

**18** The path of good people is like the light of the sunrise. The light becomes brighter until it is full day.

**19** The way of wicked people is like deep darkness. They do not know what causes them to fall.

**20** My son, pay attention to my words. Listen carefully to what I say.

**21** Do not let my words go away from your eyes. Keep them deep in your heart.

**22** My words give life to the people who find them. They give health to the whole body.

**23** Guard your heart carefully, because your life comes from your heart.

**24** Do not let your mouth speak lies. Keep your lips away from dishonest words.

**25** Let your eyes look straight ahead. Look directly in front of you.

**26** Think carefully about the path for your feet. Then all your ways will be safe.

**27** Do not turn to the right or to the left. Keep your foot away from evil.

## Chapter 5

**1** My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Listen carefully to my words of knowledge.

**2** Then you will keep good judgment. Your lips will keep knowledge.

**3** The lips of an adulterous woman are sweet like honey. Her words are smoother than oil.

**4** But at the end she is bitter like poison. She is as sharp as a sword with 2 edges.

**5** Her feet go down to death. Her steps go to the grave.

**6** She does not think about the path of life. Her ways go in different directions, and she does not know it.

**7** Thus, children, listen to me now. Do not turn away from my words.

**8** Stay far away from that woman. Do not go near the door of her house.

**9** If you go to her, you will give your honor to other people. You will give your years to cruel people.

**10** Strangers will take your wealth. Your work will make strangers rich.

**11** At the end of your life you will cry. Your body will be weak and sick.

**12** You will say, "I hated correction. My heart did not accept words of correction.

**13** I did not obey my teachers. I did not listen to the people who taught me.

**14** I almost destroyed myself in front of all the people."

**15** Drink water from your own well. Drink the water that flows from your own spring. Be faithful to your wife.

**16** Do not let your springs flow into the streets. Do not let your water flow into public places.

**17** Your water is only for you. Do not share it with strangers.

**18** Let your spring be blessed. Be happy with the wife that you married when you were young.

**19** She is beautiful and graceful like a deer. Let her breasts satisfy you always. Let her love fill you with joy always.

**20** My son, do not let an adulterous woman fill you with desire. Do not hold the body of another man's wife.

**21** The LORD sees all that a person does. He examines all his paths.

**22** The sins of a wicked man will catch him. His sins will hold him like ropes.

**23** He will die because he did not accept correction. His great foolishness will cause him to go the wrong way.

## Chapter 6

**1** My son, maybe you promised to pay the debt of your friend. Maybe you made an agreement for a stranger.

**2** Then the words of your mouth caught you like a trap. Your own words caught you.

**3** My son, do this now to make yourself free. Your friend has power over you. Go to him and be humble. Ask him again and again to release you.

**4** Do not sleep. Do not rest your eyes.

**5** Make yourself free, as a deer escapes from the hunter. Make yourself free, as a bird escapes from a trap.

**6** Lazy person, go to the ant. Look at what it does and become wise.

**7** The ant has no leader, no supervisor and no ruler.

**8** But it gets its food ready in the summer. It collects its food at the harvest.

**9** Lazy person, how long will you sleep? When will you get up from your sleep?

**10** You say, "I will sleep a little more. I will rest a little more. I will fold my hands and rest a little more."

**11** Then poverty will come on you like a thief. Need will come on you like an armed man.

**12** A bad and wicked man always tells lies.

**13** He winks his eyes. He makes signs with his feet. He points with his fingers.

**14** His heart is dishonest. He always plans evil. He causes arguments.

**15** Thus disaster will come on him suddenly. Suddenly he will break, and nothing will help him.

**16** The LORD hates 6 things. There are 7 things that he hates very much:

**17** proud eyes, a tongue that lies, hands that kill innocent people,

**18** a heart that plans wicked things, feet that run quickly to do evil,

**19** a false witness who tells lies, and a person who causes arguments among brothers.

**20** My son, obey the commands of your father. Do not forget the law of your mother.

**21** Always keep their words in your heart. Tie them around your neck.

**22** When you walk, their words will lead you. When you sleep, they will protect you. When you wake up, they will speak to you.

**23** The command is a lamp. The law is a light. Correction and discipline show you the way of life.

**24** They will keep you away from the evil woman. They will keep you from the sweet words of the adulterous woman.

**25** Do not let her beauty fill your heart with desire. Do not let her eyes catch you.

**26** A prostitute can make a man poor, so that he has only a piece of bread. Another man's wife hunts for your life.

**27** Can a man carry fire against his chest and not burn his clothes?

**28** Can a man walk on hot coals and not burn his feet?

**29** The same is true for the man who sleeps with his neighbor's wife. Every man who touches her will receive punishment.

**30** People do not hate a thief if he steals food when he is hungry.

**31** But if people catch the thief, he must pay back 7 times the value. He must give all the things in his house.

**32** But the man who commits adultery has no sense. The man who does this destroys himself.

**33** He will get wounds and shame. His shame will never go away.

**34** Jealousy makes a husband very angry. When the husband punishes him, he will show no pity.

**35** The husband will not accept payment. He will refuse all gifts, even many gifts.

## Chapter 7

**1** My son, obey my words. Keep my commands in your heart.

**2** Obey my commands and you will live. Protect my law as you protect your eyes.

**3** Tie my commands on your fingers. Write them on your heart.

**4** Say to wisdom, "You are my sister." Call good sense your close relative.

**5** They will keep you away from the adulterous woman. They will keep you away from the foreign woman who speaks false sweet words.

**6** I looked out through the window of my house.

**7** I saw a group of simple young men. Among them I saw a young man who had no sense.

**8** He went along the street near the corner where the woman lived. He walked toward her house.

**9** It was the evening, at sunset. Then the night became dark.
