**6** Each person helped his neighbor. Each said to his brother, 'Be strong!'

**7** The carpenter encourages the goldsmith. The worker who makes the metal smooth with a hammer encourages the worker who hits the anvil. He says, 'The joint is good.' He uses nails to make the idol firm, so that it will not fall over.

**8** But you, Israel, are my servant. People of Jacob, I chose you. You are the descendants of my friend Abraham.

**9** I took you from the ends of the earth. I called you from its far corners. I said, 'You are my servant. I chose you and I did not refuse you.'

**10** Do not be afraid, because I am with you. Do not have fear, because I am your God. I will make you strong and help you. I will hold you up with my right hand of righteousness.

**11** Look! All the people who are angry with you will feel shame and confusion. The people who fight against you will become as nothing. They will die.

**12** You will look for your enemies, but you will not find them. The people who make war against you will become as nothing.

**13** I am the LORD your God. I hold your right hand. I tell you, 'Do not be afraid. I will help you.'

**14** Do not be afraid, people of Jacob, although you are small as a worm. People of Israel, I will help you," says the LORD. The Holy One of Israel is your Redeemer.

**15** "Look! I will make you as a new sledge with many sharp teeth. Farmers use it to separate grain. You will crush the mountains into small pieces. You will make the hills as straw.

**16** You will throw them into the air. The wind will carry them away. The storm will scatter them. But you will be happy in the LORD. You will praise the Holy One of Israel.

**17** The poor and needy people look for water, but they find none. Their tongues are dry with thirst. But I, the LORD, will answer them. I, the God of Israel, will not leave them.

**18** I will make rivers flow on the bare hills. I will make springs flow in the valleys. I will make the desert a pool of water. I will make the dry land into springs of water.

**19** I will plant cedar, acacia, myrtle, and olive trees in the desert. I will put juniper, fir, and cypress trees together in the dry land.

**20** I will do this so that people will see and know. They will think about it and understand. The hand of the LORD did this. The Holy One of Israel made it."

**21** "Bring your case," says the LORD. "Show your best arguments," says the King of Jacob.

**22** "Let your idols come and tell us what will happen. Let them tell us about the things that happened before. Then we can think about them and know their result. Or let them tell us about the things to come.

**23** Tell us what will happen in the future. Then we will know that you are gods. Do something, good or bad. Then we will be afraid and amazed.

**24** Look! You are less than nothing. Your work has no value. The person who chooses you is a thing that God hates.

**25** I caused a man to come from the north, and he comes. He comes from the east, and he calls on my name. He walks on rulers as on mud. He walks on them as a potter walks on clay.

**26** Who told us about this from the beginning, so that we could know? Who told us before, so that we could say, 'He was right'? None of your idols told us. None of them said anything. Nobody heard your words.

**27** I was the first to tell Zion, 'Look, they come!' I sent a messenger with good news to Jerusalem.

**28** I look, but there is nobody. None of the idols can give advice. When I ask them a question, they cannot answer.

**29** Look! All of them are false. Their actions are nothing. Their metal idols are only wind and confusion."

## Chapter 42

**1** "Look at my servant. I support him. I chose him, and I am happy with him. I put my Spirit on him. He will bring justice to the nations.

**2** He will not shout or speak loudly. He will not make his voice heard in the streets.

**3** He will not break a damaged reed. He will not put out a weak flame. He will faithfully bring justice.

**4** He will not become weak or lose courage until he puts justice on the earth. The islands will wait for his law."

**5** God the LORD made the sky and spread it out. He spread out the earth and all the things that grow on it. He gives breath to the people on the earth. He gives life to all who live on it. He says,

**6** "I, the LORD, called you for a righteous purpose. I will hold your hand and keep you safe. I will make you a covenant for the people. You will be a light for the nations.

**7** You will open the eyes of blind people. You will free the prisoners from jail. You will bring out the people who sit in darkness in prison.

**8** I am the LORD. That is my name. I will not give my glory to another. I will not give my praise to idols.

**9** Look! The things that I told you before happened. Now I tell you new things. I tell you about them before they occur."

**10** Sing a new song to the LORD! Sing his praise from the ends of the earth! Sing, you who sail on the sea, and all the animals in it! Sing, islands, and all the people who live on them!

**11** Let the desert and its towns shout. Let the villages where the people of Kedar live shout. Let the people of Sela sing for joy. Let them shout from the tops of the mountains.

**12** Let them give glory to the LORD. Let them praise him in the islands.

**13** The LORD will go out as a strong soldier. He will be ready for battle as a warrior. He will shout a war cry. He will defeat his enemies.

**14** "I was silent for a long time. I was quiet and I did not act. But now I will cry out as a woman who gives birth. I will breathe hard.

**15** I will destroy the mountains and hills. I will dry up all their plants. I will make the rivers into dry land. I will dry up the pools.

**16** I will lead blind people on a road that they did not know. I will guide them on paths that they did not know. I will change the darkness into light in front of them. I will make the rough places level. I will do these things. I will not leave them.

**17** But the people who trust in idols will turn back in shame. They say to their metal idols, 'You are our gods.' They will be very ashamed.

**18** Hear, you deaf people! Look, you blind people, so that you can see!

**19** Nobody is as blind as my servant! Nobody is as deaf as the messenger that I send! Nobody is as blind as the person who has my covenant! Nobody is as blind as the servant of the LORD!

**20** You see many things, but you do not pay attention. Your ears are open, but you do not listen."

**21** The LORD wanted to show that he is righteous. So he made his law great and glorious.

**22** But enemies rob these people and take their goods. Enemies catch all of them in holes. Enemies hide them in prisons. Enemies take them, and nobody saves them. Enemies rob them, and nobody says, "Give them back!"

**23** Which of you will listen to this? Who will pay attention in the future?

**24** Who let the enemies rob the people of Jacob? Who gave Israel to the thieves? The LORD did it, because we sinned against him. The people did not live as he told them. They did not obey his law.

**25** Thus the LORD poured his strong anger on them. He sent war against them. His anger burned all around them, but they did not understand. It burned them, but they did not learn.

## Chapter 43

**1** But now the LORD made you, people of Jacob. He formed you, people of Israel. He says, "Do not be afraid, because I saved you. I called you by your name. You are mine.

**2** When you go through deep water, I will be with you. When you go through rivers, they will not cover you. When you walk through fire, it will not burn you. The flames will not hurt you.

**3** I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I gave Egypt as the price to free you. I gave Cush and Seba in your place.

**4** You are valuable to me. I honor you and I love you. So I will give other people in your place. I will give other nations in exchange for your life.

**5** Do not be afraid, because I am with you. I will bring your children from the east. I will collect you from the west.

**6** I will tell the north, 'Let them go!' I will tell the south, 'Do not keep them!' Bring my sons from far away. Bring my daughters from the ends of the earth.

**7** Bring all the people who carry my name. I made them for my glory. I formed them and made them."

**8** Bring out the people who have eyes but are blind. Bring out the people who have ears but are deaf.

**9** All the nations come together. The peoples meet together. Which of their gods told us about this in the past? Which of them told us the things that happened before? Let them bring their witnesses to prove that they are right. Let the witnesses hear and say, "It is true."

**10** "You are my witnesses," says the LORD. "You are the servant that I chose. I chose you so that you will know and believe me. I chose you to understand that I am God. No god existed before me. No god will exist after me.

**11** I, only I, am the LORD. There is no savior except me.

**12** I told you what will happen. I saved you and I showed you my power. No foreign god among you did this. You are my witnesses that I am God," says the LORD.

**13** "I am God from all time. Nobody can take anything out of my hand. When I do something, nobody can stop it."

**14** The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says, "For you I will send an army against Babylon. I will make all the Babylonians run away as refugees. The Chaldeans will cry in the ships that they were proud of.

**15** I am the LORD, your Holy One. I made Israel. I am your King."

**16** The LORD made a road through the sea. He made a path through the strong water.

**17** He brought out the chariots and horses of Egypt. He brought out the whole army. They fell down together and did not get up again. They went out as a flame goes out. The LORD says,

**18** "Do not remember the things of the past. Do not think about what happened long ago.

**19** Look! I will do a new thing. It starts now. Do you not see it? I will make a road in the wilderness. I will make rivers in the desert.

**20** The wild animals will honor me. The jackals and the ostriches will honor me. I give water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. I give water to my people, whom I chose.

**21** I made these people for myself. They will tell about my praise.

**22** But you did not call to me, people of Jacob. You became tired of me, people of Israel.

**23** You did not bring me your sheep as burnt offerings. You did not honor me with your sacrifices. I did not make you work hard to bring offerings. I did not make you tired with requests for incense.

**24** You did not buy sweet cane for me. You did not give me the fat of your sacrifices. But you made me work hard because of your sins. You made me tired with your evil actions.

**25** I, only I, remove your sins for my own honor. I will not remember your sins again.

**26** Remind me of the past. We will argue this case together. Tell me why you are innocent.

**27** Your first ancestor sinned. Your leaders turned against me.

**28** Thus I removed the honor of the leaders of the temple. I let enemies destroy Jacob. I let people insult Israel."

## Chapter 44

**1** "But now listen, people of Jacob, my servant. Listen, people of Israel, whom I chose."

**2** The LORD made you. He formed you before your birth. He will help you. He says, "Do not be afraid, people of Jacob, my servant. Do not be afraid, Jeshurun, whom I chose.

**3** I will pour water on the thirsty land. I will make streams flow on the dry ground. I will pour my Spirit on your children. I will pour my blessing on your descendants.

**4** They will grow as grass in a field with water. They will grow as willow trees along streams.

**5** One person will say, 'I belong to the LORD.' Another will call himself by the name of Jacob. Another will write on his hand, 'I belong to the LORD.' He will take the name of Israel."

**6** The LORD is the King of Israel and its Redeemer. He is the LORD of armies. He says, "I am the first and I am the last. There is no God except me.

**7** Who is the same as me? Let him speak and tell what happened since I made my people long ago. Let him explain it to me. Let him tell what will happen in the future.

**8** Do not be afraid. Do not shake with fear. I told you these things long ago. I told you what will happen. You are my witnesses. Is there any God except me? No, there is no other Rock. I know of none."

**9** All the people who make idols are nothing. The things that they love have no value. Their worshippers are their witnesses. But these witnesses are blind and know nothing. Thus they will feel shame.

**10** Who makes a god or shapes an idol that cannot help him?

**11** Look! All the people who worship that idol will feel shame. The workers who make idols are only humans. Let them all come together and stand up. They will have much fear and shame together.

**12** The blacksmith uses a tool and works over the hot coals. He shapes the idol with hammers. He uses the strength of his arms. Then he becomes hungry and loses his strength. He drinks no water and becomes tired.

**13** The carpenter measures the wood with a line. He marks it with a pen. He shapes it with tools and he measures it. He makes it into the shape of a man. He makes a beautiful human shape to put in a shrine.

**14** He cuts down cedar trees. He chooses a cypress tree or an oak tree. He lets it grow strong among the trees of the forest. Or he plants a pine tree, and the rain makes it grow.

**15** A man uses the wood as fuel. He takes some of it and makes a fire to warm himself. He makes a fire and bakes bread. Then he makes a god from the same wood and worships it. He makes an idol and bows down to it.

**16** He burns half of the wood in the fire. On it he cooks meat and eats until he is full. He warms himself and says, "Good! I am warm. I see the fire."

**17** From the wood that remains, he makes a god, his idol. He bows down to it and worships it. He prays to it and says, "Save me, because you are my god!"

**18** These people do not know or understand anything. God closed their eyes, so that they cannot see. He closed their minds, so that they cannot understand.

**19** Nobody stops to think. Nobody has the knowledge or wisdom to say, "I burned half of the wood in the fire. I baked bread on its coals. I cooked meat and ate it. Must I make a thing that God hates from the wood that remains? Must I bow down to a block of wood?"

**20** He is as a person who eats ashes. His foolish mind leads him the wrong way. He cannot save himself. He cannot say, "The idol in my right hand is a lie."

**21** "People of Jacob, remember these things. People of Israel, you are my servant. I made you. You are my servant. Israel, I will not forget you.

**22** I removed your sins as the wind removes a thick cloud. I removed your sins as the sun removes the morning mist. Come back to me, because I saved you."

**23** Sing for joy, you heavens, because the LORD did this! Shout, you deep places of the earth! Sing, you mountains, forests, and all the trees! The LORD saved the people of Jacob. He shows his glory in Israel.

**24** The LORD, your Redeemer, formed you before your birth. He says, "I am the LORD. I made all things. I alone spread out the sky. I spread out the earth by myself.

**25** I show that the signs of false prophets are lies. I make fools of the people who tell the future. I make wise men confused. I make their knowledge foolish.

**26** I make the words of my servant come true. I make the plans of my messengers happen. I say about Jerusalem, 'People will live in it again.' I say about the cities of Judah, 'People will build them again. I will rebuild their ruins.'

**27** I tell the deep water, 'Become dry! I will dry up your rivers.'

**28** I say about Cyrus, 'He is my shepherd. He will do everything that I want.' He will say about Jerusalem, 'Build it again.' He will say about the temple, 'Put its foundation in place.'"

## Chapter 45

**1** The LORD speaks to Cyrus, his anointed king. "I hold your right hand. I give you power to defeat nations. I take away the power of kings. I open doors in front of you. City gates will not close.

**2** I will go in front of you. I will make the mountains level. I will break down the bronze gates. I will cut through the iron bars.

**3** I will give you treasures from dark places. I will give you riches from secret places. Then you will know that I am the LORD, the God of Israel. I call you by your name.

**4** I call you by your name because of my servant Jacob, Israel, whom I chose. I give you a title of honor, although you do not know me.

**5** I am the LORD, and there is no other God. There is no God except me. I make you strong, although you do not know me.

**6** I do this so that all people from the east to the west will know that there is no God except me. I am the LORD, and there is no other God.

**7** I make the light and I make the darkness. I bring peace and I bring disaster. I, the LORD, do all these things.

**8** Sky above, rain down righteousness! Let the clouds pour it down! Let the earth open, and let salvation grow. Let righteousness grow with it. I, the LORD, made it."

**9** The person who argues with God, who made him, is in very bad trouble! He is only a piece of broken pot among other pieces on the ground. The clay does not say to the potter, "What do you make?" The pot does not say, "He has no hands!"

**10** The person who says to his father, "Why did you become my father?" is in very bad trouble! The person who says to his mother, "Why did you give birth to me?" is in very bad trouble!

**11** The LORD, the Holy One of Israel, who made Israel, says, "Do you ask me about things to come? Do you question me about my children? Do you give me orders about the work of my hands?

**12** I made the earth. I made humans to live on it. My hands spread out the sky. I command all the stars.

**13** I will make Cyrus come for a righteous purpose. I will make all his roads straight. He will build my city again. He will free my people who are prisoners. He will not do this for money or for a reward," says the LORD of armies.

**14** The LORD says, "The riches of Egypt and the goods of Cush will come to you. The tall people of Seba will come to you. They will belong to you. They will follow you in chains. They will bow down to you. They will pray to you and say, 'Truly God is with you. There is no other God.'"

**15** Truly you are a God who hides himself, God of Israel, the Savior.

**16** All the people who make idols will feel shame and confusion. They will all go away in shame together.

**17** But the LORD will save Israel with a salvation that will last always. You will never feel shame or confusion again.

**18** The LORD made the heavens. He is God. He formed the earth and made it. He made it firm. He did not make it empty. He made it for people to live on. He says, "I am the LORD, and there is no other God.

**19** I did not speak in secret, in a dark place of the earth. I did not tell the people of Jacob, 'Look for me, but you will not find me.' I, the LORD, speak the truth. I say what is right.

**20** Come together, you people who escaped from the nations! Come near! The people who carry wooden idols know nothing. They pray to a god that cannot save them.

**21** Speak and tell your case. Let them talk to each other. Who told about these things long ago? Who said them in the past? I, the LORD, did it! There is no other God except me. I am a righteous God and a Savior. There is no other God except me.

**22** All the people at the ends of the earth, turn to me and receive salvation! I am God, and there is no other God.

**23** I made a promise by my own name. I spoke a true word, and I will not change it: All people will bow down to me. All people will promise to be loyal to me.

**24** They will say about me, 'Only the LORD gives righteousness and strength.'" All the people who were angry with him will come to him. They will feel shame.

**25** The LORD will make all the descendants of Israel righteous. They will praise him.

## Chapter 46

**1** Bel bows down. Nebo bends low. Animals carry their idols. The idols that people carried before are now a heavy load. They are a heavy load for tired animals.

**2** The gods bend low and bow down together. They cannot save the load. They themselves go away as prisoners.

**3** "Listen to me, people of Jacob. Listen, all you people of Israel who stay alive. I carried you since your birth. I took care of you since the time you came from the womb.

**4** Even when you are old, I will be the same. When your hair is gray, I will carry you. I made you, and I will carry you. I will carry you and save you.

**5** To whom will you compare me? Who is equal to me? To whom will you say that I am the same?

**6** People pour out gold from their bags. They weigh silver on scales. They hire a goldsmith to make it into a god. Then they bow down and worship it.

**7** They lift it on their shoulders and carry it. They put it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move from its place. People cry to it, but it does not answer. It cannot save them from their trouble.

**8** Remember this and be brave! Think about it, you people who sin!

**9** Remember the things that happened long ago. I am God, and there is no other God. I am God, and nobody is the same as me.

**10** From the start I tell what will happen at the end. Long ago I told what will happen in the future. I say, 'My plan will stay. I will do all that I want.'

**11** I call a bird of prey from the east. I call a man from a far country to do my plan. I said it, and I will make it happen. I planned it, and I will do it.

**12** Listen to me, you stubborn people! You are far from righteousness.

**13** I bring my righteousness near. It is not far away. My salvation will not be late. I will give salvation to Zion. I will give my glory to Israel."

## Chapter 47

**1** "Come down and sit in the dust, young woman Babylon! Sit on the ground with no throne, city of the Chaldeans! People will not call you gentle and delicate again.

**2** Take millstones and make flour. Take off your veil. Lift up your skirt. Show your legs, and walk through the rivers.

**3** People will see your bare body. They will see your shame. I will take revenge. I will not show mercy to anybody."

**4** Our Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel. His name is the LORD of armies.

**5** "Sit in silence, city of the Chaldeans! Go into the darkness! People will not call you 'The Queen of Kingdoms' again.

**6** I was angry with my people. I let my own people become unclean. I gave them to you. But you showed them no mercy. You put a very heavy load even on old people.

**7** You said, 'I will always be the queen!' You did not think about these things. You did not think about what will happen at the end.

**8** Now listen, you who love pleasure! You feel safe. You say to yourself, 'I am the only one. Nobody is the same as me. I will never be a widow. I will never lose my children.'

**9** But both these things will happen to you suddenly, on 1 day. You will lose your children and you will become a widow. These things will happen to you completely. Your many magic spells and your strong charms will not stop them.

**10** You trusted in your evil. You said, 'Nobody sees me.' Your wisdom and your knowledge led you the wrong way. You said to yourself, 'I am the only one. Nobody is the same as me.'

**11** Thus disaster will come on you. You will not know how to stop it with magic. Trouble will fall on you. You will not be able to pay to stop it. Destruction that you do not expect will come on you suddenly.

**12** Continue to use your magic spells and your many charms! You used them since you were young. Maybe they will help you. Maybe you will make your enemies afraid.

**13** All the advice that you get makes you weary. Let your astrologers come and save you. Let the people who look at the stars and tell the future each month save you from what will happen.

**14** Look! They are as straw. The fire will burn them. They cannot save themselves from the power of the flames. This fire is not a coal to warm a person. It is not a fire to sit near.

**15** The people that you worked with will be the same for you. You traded with them since you were young. Each of them will go his own way. Nobody will save you."

## Chapter 48

**1** Hear this, people of the family of Jacob. You have the name Israel, and you come from the family line of Judah. You make promises in the name of the LORD, and you speak about the God of Israel. But you do not do this with truth or with honesty.

**2** You say that you are citizens of the holy city. You say that you put your trust in the God of Israel. His name is the LORD of armies.

**3** "A long time ago I told you about the past events. I spoke about them and I made them known. Then I suddenly did them, and they occurred.

**4** I knew that you were stubborn. Your neck was as hard as iron, and your forehead was as hard as bronze.

**5** Thus I told you about these events a long time ago. I told you before they occurred. I did this so that you could not say, 'My idol did these things. My carved statue and my metal statue caused them.'

**6** You heard about these things. Now look at all of them. Will you not say that they are true? From now on I tell you about new things. I hid these things, and you did not know them.

**7** I make them now. I did not make them a long time ago. You did not hear about them before today. Thus you cannot say, 'I knew about them.'

**8** You did not hear about them and you did not know about them. Your ears did not open from the start. I knew that you will be very disloyal. People called you a rebel from the time of your birth.

**9** For the honor of my name, I will wait to show my anger. For my praise, I will control my anger toward you. Thus I will not destroy you.

**10** Look, I made you pure, but not as a worker makes silver pure. I tested you in the hot fire of trouble.

**11** I will do this for my own sake. I will not let people treat my name as unholy. I will not give my glory to another god.

**12** Listen to me, Jacob, and Israel, the people that I called. I am the one God. I am the first and I am the last.

**13** My hand made the foundation of the earth. My right hand spread out the heavens. When I call the earth and the heavens, they stand up together.

**14** All of you, come together and listen. Which of the idols told you about these things? The LORD loves the man that he chose. That man will do what the LORD wants against Babylon. He will use his power against the Chaldeans.

**15** I am the one who spoke. I called that man. I brought him, and he will have success in what he does.

**16** Come near to me and hear this. From the start I did not speak in secret. When these things occurred, I was there." Now the Lord GOD and his Spirit sent me.

**17** The LORD, who saves you, the Holy One of Israel, says this: "I am the LORD your God. I teach you what is good for you. I lead you on the road that you must go.

**18** I wish that you obeyed my commands! Then you could have peace like a river that flows always. You could have goodness like the waves of the sea.

**19** Then you could have descendants as many as the grains of sand. You could have children as many as the small stones on the shore. Their name could stay in front of me always."

**20** Go out of Babylon! Run away from the Chaldeans! Shout with joy and tell this news. Send the news to all parts of the earth. Say, "The LORD paid the price to free his servant Jacob."

**21** The people were not thirsty when the LORD led them through the deserts. He caused water to flow out of a rock for them. He split the rock, and the water flowed out.

**22** The LORD says, "Wicked people have no peace."

## Chapter 49

**1** Listen to me, people on the coasts and islands. Hear me, nations that are far away. The LORD called me before my birth. He spoke my name when I was in the body of my mother.

**2** He made my words as sharp as a sword. He hid me in the shadow of his hand. He made me like a smooth arrow. He hid me in his bag of arrows.

**3** He said to me, "You are my servant, Israel. I will show my glory through you."

**4** But I said, "My work has no result. I used all my strength for nothing. But the LORD will judge me fairly. My God will give me my reward."

**5** The LORD made me before my birth to be his servant. He made me to bring the people of Jacob back to him, and to gather Israel to him. The LORD honors me, and my God is my strength. Now the LORD says this:

**6** He says, "It is too small a task for you only to be my servant and bring back the tribes of Jacob. It is too small a task only to bring back the survivors of Israel. I will also make you a light for the Gentiles (the nations that are not Jewish). Thus you will bring my salvation to all parts of the earth."

**7** The LORD, who saves Israel, the Holy One of Israel, speaks to the man that people hate. He speaks to the man that the nations do not like. He speaks to the servant of rulers. He says, "Kings will see you and they will stand up. Princes will bow down to you. They will do this because the LORD is faithful. The Holy One of Israel chose you."

**8** The LORD says this: "At the correct time, I answered you. On the day of salvation, I helped you. I will protect you. I will make you the agreement (covenant) between me and the people. You will make the land strong again. You will give the empty land back to the people who own it.

**9** You will say to the prisoners, 'Come out.' You will say to the people in darkness, 'Come into the light.' They will be like sheep that find food along the roads. They will find grass on all the bare hills.

**10** They will not be hungry or thirsty. The hot wind and the sun will not hurt them. The God who has mercy on them will lead them. He will guide them to springs of water.

**11** I will make all my mountains into roads. I will build up my main roads.

**12** Look, my people will come from far away. Some will come from the north and from the west. Some will come from the land of Sinim."

**13** Sing, heavens! Be happy, earth! Mountains, start to sing! The LORD gives comfort to his people. He will have mercy on his people who suffer.

**14** But Zion said, "The LORD left me. The Lord forgot me."

**15** The LORD says, "Can a woman forget the baby that she feeds? Can she have no love for the son that she gave birth to? Possibly she can forget. But I will not forget you.

**16** Look, I wrote your name on the palms of my hands. I always think about your walls.

**17** Your children will come back quickly. The people who destroyed you will go away from you.

**18** Look around you and see. All your children come together and come to you. As surely as I live, you will wear them like jewelry. You will put them on as a bride puts on her jewelry," says the LORD.

**19** "Your land is now empty and destroyed. But soon it will be too small for all your people. The enemies who destroyed you will be far away.

**20** You lost some of your children. But the children that you will have will say to you, 'This place is too small for us. Give us more space to live.'

**21** Then you will think, 'Who gave me these children? I lost my children and I could not have more. I was a prisoner in a foreign land. Who raised these children? I was alone. Where did they come from?'"

**22** The Lord GOD says this: "Look, I will lift my hand to signal to the Gentiles. I will raise my flag for the nations. They will carry your sons in their arms. They will carry your daughters on their shoulders.

**23** Kings will take care of your children like fathers. Queens will take care of them like mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces to the ground. They will show you complete respect. Then you will know that I am the LORD. The people who wait for me will not feel shame."

**24** Can a person take the stolen goods from a strong warrior? Can a prisoner escape from a cruel ruler?

**25** But the LORD says this: "Yes, people will take the prisoners away from the strong warrior. The cruel ruler will lose his stolen goods. I will fight the people who fight you. I will save your children.

**26** I will cause your enemies to fight and kill each other. They will be like drunk men. Then all people will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior. They will know that I, the Mighty One of Jacob, pay the price to free you."

## Chapter 50

**1** The LORD says this: "Where is the document that shows that I divorced your mother? To which of my creditors did I sell you? Look, I sold you because of your sins. I sent your mother away because of your rebellion.

**2** When I came, why was no person there? When I called, why did no person answer? Is my arm too short to save you? Do I not have the power to rescue you? Look, I speak a command and the sea becomes dry. I make the rivers into a desert. The fish die because there is no water, and they smell bad.

**3** I make the sky dark. I cover the sky as with black cloth."

**4** The Lord GOD taught me how to speak. Thus I know how to say the correct words to a tired person. Each morning he wakes me up. He wakes me up to listen like a student.

**5** The Lord GOD opened my ears. I did not refuse to obey him. I did not turn away from him.

**6** I let people hit my back. I let them pull out the hair of my beard. I did not hide my face when they insulted me and spat on me.

**7** The Lord GOD helps me, thus I will not feel shame. I made my face firm like a hard stone. I know that nobody will put me to shame.

**8** The God who says that I am innocent is near. Who will accuse me? Let us stand together in court. Who is my enemy? Let him come near to me.

**9** Look, the Lord GOD helps me. Who will say that I am guilty? All my enemies will become old like a piece of clothing. Insects will eat them.

**10** Who among you respects the LORD and obeys the words of his servant? You can walk in darkness and have no light. But you must trust in the name of the LORD and depend on your God.

**11** But some of you light your own fires and make your own light. Then walk in the light of your fires and of the sparks that you light. The LORD says, "This is what you will get from me. You will lie down in pain."

## Chapter 51

**1** "Listen to me, you who want to do what is right. Listen, you who look for the LORD. Think about the rock from which I cut you. Think about the hole in the ground from which I dug you.

**2** Think about Abraham, your ancestor, and about Sarah, who gave birth to you. When I called Abraham, he was only 1 man. Then I blessed him and I gave him many descendants.

**3** The LORD will comfort Zion. He will comfort all her destroyed places. He will make her desert like Eden. He will make her dry land like the garden of the LORD. People will be happy and glad there. They will thank God and they will sing songs.

**4** Listen to me, my people. Hear me, my nation. I will give my law. My justice will be a light for the nations.

**5** I will soon show that I do what is right. I will soon save my people. I will use my power to judge the nations. The people on the coasts and islands will wait for me. They will trust in my power.

**6** Look up at the sky and look down at the earth. The sky will go away like smoke. The earth will become old like a piece of clothing. The people on the earth will die like insects. But my salvation will continue always. My goodness will not stop.

**7** Listen to me, you who know what is right. You have my law in your hearts. Do not be afraid when men insult you. Do not be afraid of their cruel words.

**8** Insects will eat those men as they eat clothing and wool. But my goodness will continue always. My salvation will continue for all generations."

**9** Wake up, wake up! Arm of the LORD, become strong! Wake up as in the days of long ago. You cut Rahab into pieces. You wounded the sea monster.

**10** You made the sea dry. You dried the water of the deep sea. You made a road through the deepest part of the sea. Thus the people that you saved could go across.

**11** The people that the LORD freed will come back. They will come to Zion and sing. They will be happy always. Joy and happiness will fill them. Sorrow and sadness will go away.

**12** The LORD says, "I am the one who comforts you. Why are you afraid of men? They will die. They are like grass.

**13** Why do you forget the LORD, who made you? I spread out the sky and made the foundations of the earth. But every day you are afraid of the anger of the cruel ruler. You think that he is ready to destroy you. But where is his anger now?

**14** The prisoners who bend down in chains will soon be free. They will not die in the prison. They will have enough food.

**15** I am the LORD your God. I stir up the sea, and its waves make a loud noise. My name is the LORD of armies.

**16** I put my words in your mouth. I covered you and kept you safe with my hand. I put the sky in its place and made the foundations of the earth. I say to Zion, 'You are my people.'"

**17** Wake up, wake up! Stand up, Jerusalem! The LORD punished you in his anger. It was as if you drank from his cup of anger. You drank all of it, and it caused you to fall down.

**18** You gave birth to many sons and raised them. But not 1 of them can guide you. Not 1 of them can hold your hand.

**19** These 2 disasters came to you. Who will feel sorry for you? Enemies destroyed your land, and your people are hungry and dead in war. Who will comfort you?

**20** Your sons are weak and fall down. They lie at the corners of all the streets. They are like an animal caught in a net. The anger of the LORD fills them. Your God punished them.

**21** Thus hear this, you who suffer. You stagger like a drunk person, but not from wine.

**22** Your Lord, the LORD, your God who defends his people, says this: "Look, I took from your hand the cup that made you fall. That is the cup of my anger. You will not drink from it again.

**23** I will give it to the people who cause you pain. They said to you, 'Lie down on the ground so that we can walk on you.' You made your back like the ground. You made it like a street for them to walk on."

## Chapter 52

**1** Wake up, wake up, Zion! Be strong again! Put on your beautiful clothes, Jerusalem, the holy city! People who did not receive circumcision and people who are unclean will not come into you again.

**2** Shake off the dust and stand up, Jerusalem. Sit on your throne. Remove the chains from your neck, captive people of Zion.

**3** The LORD says this: "People took you for no payment. Thus I will free you without money."

**4** The Lord GOD says this: "Long ago my people went to Egypt to live there as foreigners. Then the Assyrians did cruel things to them without a reason.

**5** And now, what do I see here?" says the LORD. "People took my people away for no payment. The rulers of my people laugh at them," says the LORD. "Every day people insult my name.

**6** Thus my people will know my name. On that day they will know that I am the one who speaks. Look, I am here."

**7** It is beautiful to see the messenger come across the mountains! He brings good news. He announces peace. He brings good news and announces salvation. He says to Zion, "Your God is king!"

**8** Your guards shout. They sing together with joy. They will see with their own eyes the LORD come back to Zion.

**9** Destroyed places of Jerusalem, start to shout and sing together with joy! The LORD comforts his people. He freed Jerusalem.

**10** The LORD shows his holy power to all the nations. All the people on the earth will see that our God saves his people.

**11** Leave, leave! Go out of Babylon! Do not touch anything that is unclean. Come out of that city. You who carry the containers of the LORD, make yourselves clean.

**12** You will not leave quickly. You will not need to run away. The LORD will go in front of you. The God of Israel will protect you from behind.

**13** Look, my servant will act wisely. People will honor him and lift him up. He will be very great.

**14** Many people felt shock when they saw him. His face had so much damage that he did not look like a man. His body did not look like a human body.

**15** But now he will surprise many nations. Kings will be silent because of him. They will see things that no person told them. They will understand things that they did not hear.

## Chapter 53

**1** Who believed the message that we heard? To whom did the LORD show his power?

**2** The servant grew up in front of the LORD like a young plant. He was like a root in dry ground. He had no beauty and no royal appearance to attract us. He did not look special, and we did not want him.

**3** People hated him and refused him. He knew much sorrow and pain. People turned their faces away from him. They hated him, and we did not think that he was important.

**4** But he took our pain and he carried our sorrow. We thought that God punished him and struck him. We thought that God caused him to suffer.

**5** But other people wounded him because of our sins. They crushed him because of our evil acts. He accepted the punishment that gives us peace. His wounds healed us.

**6** All of us went away from God, as sheep go away from the shepherd. Each of us went his own way. But the LORD put the sin of all of us on him.

**7** People did cruel things to him and caused him pain. But he did not say a word. People led him away like a lamb to its death. A sheep is silent when men cut its wool. Thus he did not say a word.

**8** People arrested him, judged him unfairly and took him away. No person of his generation thought about him. People killed him. God punished him because of the sins of my people.

**9** People made his grave with the graves of wicked men. People put him in the grave of a rich man. But he did no violent act, and he told no lies.

**10** But the LORD wanted to crush him and to cause him to suffer. His life was an offering to remove sin. Thus he will see his descendants and he will live a long time. Through him, the LORD will do what he wants.

**11** After the pain of his soul, he will see the light of life and be content. My servant does what is right. By his knowledge he will make many people right with God. He will carry the punishment for their sins.

**12** Thus I will give him a place among the great people. He will share the rewards of victory with the strong. He gave his life and he died. People counted him with the sinners. He carried the sins of many people. He asked God to forgive the sinners.

## Chapter 54

**1** "Sing, woman who has no children! You never gave birth. Start to sing and shout with joy, you who never felt the pain of birth. The woman whom her husband left alone will have more children than the woman with a husband," says the LORD.

**2** "Make your tent larger. Spread out the curtains of your home. Do not stop. Make your ropes longer and make your tent posts stronger.

**3** You will spread out to the right and to the left. Your descendants will take the land of the nations. They will make people live in the empty cities again.

**4** Do not be afraid, because you will not feel shame. Do not have confusion, because people will not disgrace you. You will forget the shame of your youth. You will not remember the disgrace of the time when you were a widow.

**5** The God who made you is your husband. His name is the LORD of armies. The Holy One of Israel saves you. People call him the God of all the earth.

**6** The LORD calls you back. You were like a wife whose husband left her. You were sad in your spirit. You were like a young wife whose husband refused her," says your God.

**7** "I left you for a short time. But with great mercy I will bring you back.

**8** I was angry and I hid my face from you for a short time. But I will love you always and I will have mercy on you," says the LORD, who saves you.

**9** "For me, this is like the time of Noah. I promised that a flood will not cover the earth again. Now I promise that I will not be angry with you. I will not punish you again.

**10** Possibly the mountains will move and the hills will shake. But my love for you will not end. My agreement (covenant) of peace will not change," says the LORD, who has mercy on you.

**11** "You suffered much, city of Jerusalem. Storms hit you, and no person comforted you. Look, I will build you with beautiful stones. I will make your foundations with sapphires.

**12** I will make your towers of rubies. I will make your gates of bright jewels. I will make all your walls of valuable stones.

**13** The LORD will teach all your children. Your children will have much peace.

**14** You will be strong because you do what is right. Cruel people will be far from you. You will not be afraid. Terror will not come near you.

**15** Enemies will possibly attack you, but I will not send them. Any army that attacks you will fail.

**16** Look, I made the metal worker who blows on the hot coals. He makes weapons for his work. I also made the destroyer who destroys.

**17** No weapon that enemies make against you will have success. You will prove false each person who accuses you. This is what the servants of the LORD will get. I will show that they are right," says the LORD.

## Chapter 55

**1** "Come, all of you who are thirsty. Come to the water. You who have no money, come, buy food and eat. Come, buy wine and milk without money. You pay nothing.

**2** Why do you spend money on things that are not food? Why do you work for things that do not satisfy you? Listen carefully to me, and eat what is good. Enjoy the best food.

**3** Listen and come to me. Hear me, and you will live. I will make an agreement (covenant) with you that continues always. I will give you the love that I promised to David.

**4** Look, I made David a witness to the nations. I made him a leader and a commander for the nations.

**5** Look, you will call nations that you do not know. Nations that do not know you will run to you. They will do this because of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel. He gives you honor."

**6** Look for the LORD while you can find him. Call to him while he is near.

**7** Wicked people must stop their evil ways. Bad people must stop their evil thoughts. They must come back to the LORD, and he will have mercy on them. They must come back to our God, because he will forgive them completely.

**8** The LORD says, "My thoughts are not like your thoughts. Your ways are not like my ways.

**9** The sky is higher than the earth. Thus my ways are higher than your ways, and my thoughts are higher than your thoughts.

**10** The rain and the snow fall from the sky. They do not go back to the sky. They give water to the earth and cause plants to grow. Thus the plants give seed to the farmer and food to the people.

**11** My word that comes from my mouth is the same. It will not come back to me with no result. It will do what I want. It will have success in the task for which I sent it.

**12** You will go out of Babylon with joy. I will lead you in peace. The mountains and the hills will sing in front of you. All the trees in the fields will clap their hands.

**13** Fir trees will grow where thorn plants grew. Myrtle trees will grow where weeds grew. This will bring honor to the LORD. It will be a sign that continues always. Nothing will destroy it."

## Chapter 56

**1** The LORD says this: "Be fair and do what is right. I will soon come to save you. I will soon show my goodness.

**2** The man who does these things will be happy. The person who holds on to these things will be happy. He keeps the Sabbath and does not make it unholy. He does not do evil things."

**3** A foreigner who joins himself to the LORD must not say, "The LORD will surely separate me from his people." A man who cannot have children (a eunuch) must not say, "Look, I am only a dry tree."

**4** The LORD says this: "Some eunuchs keep my Sabbaths. They choose to do the things that please me. They obey my agreement (covenant).

**5** I will give them a place in my temple and inside my walls. I will give them a name that is better than sons and daughters. I will give them a name that continues always. Nothing will destroy it.

**6** Some foreigners join themselves to the LORD. They serve him and love his name. They become his servants. They keep the Sabbath and do not make it unholy. They obey my agreement.

**7** I will bring these foreigners to my holy mountain. I will make them happy in my house of prayer. I will accept their burnt offerings and their sacrifices on my altar. People will call my temple a house of prayer for all nations."

**8** The Lord GOD, who gathers the people of Israel whom enemies sent away, says this: "I will gather more people to them. I will add these to the people that I already gathered."

**9** Come, all you wild animals in the fields and in the forest. Come and eat!

**10** The leaders of Israel are like guards who are blind. They know nothing. They are like dogs that cannot bark. They lie down and dream. They love to sleep.

**11** They are like hungry dogs that never get enough food. They are shepherds who do not understand. Each of them goes his own way. Each wants to get things for himself.

**12** Each says, "Come, I will get wine. We will drink much strong drink. Tomorrow will be like today, or even better."

## Chapter 57

**1** Good people die, and no person thinks about it. Death takes faithful people away, and no person understands. God takes good people away to protect them from the evil that will come.

**2** They go into peace. People who live honest lives find rest in death.

**3** "But come here, you children of witches! You are the children of men who are not loyal to their wives and of women who sell their bodies.

**4** Who do you laugh at? Who do you insult with your mouth and your tongue? You are children of sinners. You are a family of liars.

**5** You have strong sexual desire for idols under every large green tree. You kill your children as sacrifices in the valleys, under the edges of the rocks.

**6** You worship the smooth stones of the valley. You chose those stones. You pour out drink offerings to them. You give grain offerings to them. Must I feel content with these things?

**7** You made your bed on a high mountain. You went up there to give sacrifices.

**8** You put the signs of your idols behind your doors and doorposts. You left me and uncovered your bed. You made your bed larger. You made an agreement with the people that you love. You loved to see their beds.

**9** You went to the god Molech with olive oil. You used much perfume. You sent your messengers far away. You even sent them down to the place of the dead.

**10** Your many journeys made you tired. But you did not say, 'There is no hope.' You found new strength. Thus you did not become weak.

**11** Of whom were you so afraid that you told lies to me? You did not remember me. You did not think about me. I was silent for a long time. Is that why you are not afraid of me?

**12** I will tell people about your 'good' acts and about your works. They will not help you.

**13** When you call for help, let your idols save you! The wind will carry all of them away. A breath will take them away. But the person who trusts in me will live in the land. He will own my holy mountain."

**14** God will say, "Build up the road, build up the road! Make the road ready! Remove all obstacles from the road of my people."

**15** God is high and great. He lives always, and his name is Holy. He says this: "I live in a high and holy place. But I also live with people who are sorry for their sins and humble. I give new life to the spirit of humble people. I give new life to the heart of people who are sorry for their sins.

**16** I will not accuse people always. I will not be angry always. If I did, the spirit of people will become weak in front of me. The people that I made will become weak.

**17** I was angry because of the greed and sin of my people. Thus I punished them. I hid my face and I was angry. But they continued to do what they wanted.

**18** I saw what they did, but I will heal them. I will lead them and I will comfort them again. I will comfort the people who are sad among them.

**19** I will give them words of praise. I will give peace to the people who are far away and to the people who are near," says the LORD. "I will heal them."

**20** But wicked people are like the sea in a storm. The sea cannot be calm. Its waves bring up mud and dirt.

**21** My God says, "Wicked people have no peace."

## Chapter 58

**1** "Shout loudly. Do not stop. Make your voice loud like a trumpet. Tell my people about their rebellion. Tell the family of Jacob about their sins.

**2** Every day they look for me. They seem to want to know my ways. They act like a nation that does what is right. They act like a nation that obeys the laws of its God. They ask me for fair decisions. They seem to want to come near to God.

**3** They say, 'Why did we fast (stop to eat food) when you did not see? Why did we make ourselves humble when you did not notice?' Look, on your fast days you do what you want. You force your workers to work hard.

**4** Look, when you fast, you argue and you fight. You hit people with your fists. If you fast like this, I will not hear your prayers.

**5** Is this the type of fast that I want? Is it only a day when a person makes himself humble? Is it only to bow down the head like a plant? Is it only to lie on rough cloth and ashes? Do you call this a fast? Do you think that this pleases the LORD?

**6** This is the type of fast that I want. Stop the unfair actions that hold people like chains. Remove the heavy loads from people. Let people who suffer go free. Break every yoke that controls them.

**7** Share your food with hungry people. Bring poor people without a home into your house. Give clothes to people who have none. Do not refuse to help your own family.

**8** Then your light will shine like the sun in the morning. You will quickly become healthy. Your goodness will go in front of you. The glory of the LORD will protect you from behind.

**9** Then you will call, and the LORD will answer. You will call for help, and he will say, 'I am here.' Stop the cruel acts against other people. Do not point your finger at people. Do not speak evil.

**10** Give food to hungry people. Help people who suffer. Then your light will shine in the darkness. Your darkness will become as bright as noon.

**11** The LORD will always guide you. He will give you what you need in a dry land. He will make your body strong. You will be like a garden that has much water. You will be like a spring that always has water.

**12** Your people will build again the old cities that are in ruins. You will build on the old foundations. People will call you 'The one who repairs broken walls.' They will call you 'The one who repairs the streets where people live.'

**13** Do not do what you want on the Sabbath, my holy day. Call the Sabbath a day of joy. Honor the holy day of the LORD. Honor it. Do not do your own work on that day. Do not look for your own pleasure or speak empty words.

**14** Then you will find joy in the LORD. I will make you ride on the high places of the earth. I will give you the land that I gave to your ancestor Jacob." The LORD spoke these words.

## Chapter 59

**1** Look, the arm of the LORD is not too short to save you. His ear is not too dull to hear you.

**2** But your sins separate you from your God. Your sins caused him to hide his face from you. Thus he does not hear you.

**3** Your hands are dirty with blood. Your fingers are dirty with sin. Your lips speak lies. Your tongue says evil things.

**4** No person asks for justice. No person is honest in court. People trust in empty words and tell lies. They plan trouble and do evil things.

**5** Their evil plans are like the eggs of poisonous snakes. If a person eats those eggs, he dies. If a person breaks 1 of the eggs, a snake comes out. Their plans are also like the web of a spider.

**6** But people cannot make clothes from a spider web. They cannot cover themselves with what they make. Their acts are evil. They do violent things with their hands.

**7** They run quickly to do evil. They hurry to kill innocent people. They think evil thoughts. They leave ruin and destruction where they go.

**8** They do not know the way of peace. They are not fair in what they do. They make their roads crooked. Any person who goes on those roads will not know peace.

**9** Thus justice is far from us. Goodness does not come to us. We look for light, but we see only darkness. We look for a bright light, but we walk in darkness.

**10** We feel along the wall like blind people. We feel our way like people who have no eyes. At noon we fall as if it is night. Among strong people we are like dead men.

**11** All of us make sounds like angry bears. We cry sadly like doves. We look for justice, but there is none. We look for salvation, but it is far from us.

**12** We did many wrong things against you. Our sins show that we are guilty. We know our sins. We know the wrong things that we did.

**13** We rebelled against the LORD and we were not loyal to him. We turned away from our God. We spoke about cruel acts and rebellion. We planned lies in our hearts and spoke them.

**14** Thus there is no justice. Goodness stays far away. Truth falls down in the street. Honesty cannot come in.

**15** There is no truth. People attack the person who stops his evil acts. The LORD saw that there was no justice, and he was not happy.

**16** He saw that there was no person to help. He wondered why no person came to help. Thus he used his own power to save his people. His goodness gave him strength.

**17** He put on goodness like a breastplate. He put salvation on his head like a helmet. He put on the clothes of punishment. He covered himself with strong zeal like a coat.

**18** He will pay back his enemies for what they did. He will punish them with his anger. He will pay back the people on the coasts and islands.

**19** Then the people in the west will fear the name of the LORD. The people in the east will respect his glory. The LORD will come like a fast river that the wind of the LORD pushes.

**20** "The Redeemer (the one who frees his people) will come to Zion. He will come to the people of Jacob who turn away from their sins," says the LORD.

**21** "This is my agreement (covenant) with them," says the LORD. "My Spirit is on you. My words are in your mouth. They will always be in your mouth. They will be in the mouths of your children and their descendants, from now on and always," says the LORD.

## Chapter 60

**1** Stand up and shine, Jerusalem! Your light comes. The glory of the LORD shines on you.

**2** Look, darkness will cover the earth. Deep darkness will cover the nations. But the LORD will shine on you. People will see his glory on you.

**3** The nations will come to your light. Kings will come to your bright light.

**4** Look around you and see. All your people come together and come to you. Your sons come from far away. People carry your daughters in their arms.

**5** Then you will see this and your face will shine with joy. Your heart will beat fast and be full of joy. The wealth of the sea will come to you. The riches of the nations will come to you.

**6** Many camels will fill your land. Young camels will come from Midian and Ephah. All the people from Sheba will come. They will bring gold and incense. They will praise the LORD.

**7** People will bring all the flocks of Kedar to you. The rams of Nebaioth will be for you. I will accept them as offerings on my altar. I will make my glorious temple more glorious.

**8** Who are these people that fly like clouds? They are like doves that fly to their homes.

**9** The people on the coasts and islands wait for me. The ships of Tarshish come first. They bring your sons from far away. They bring their silver and gold with them. They bring it to honor the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel. He gives you honor.

**10** Foreigners will build your walls again. Their kings will serve you. I was angry and I punished you. But now I am kind to you and I have mercy on you.

**11** Your gates will always be open. People will not close them in the day or in the night. Thus people can bring you the riches of the nations. Their kings will come in a procession.

**12** The nation or kingdom that does not serve you will die. Those nations will become complete ruins.

**13** The best trees of Lebanon will come to you. The fir tree, the pine tree and the cypress tree will come together. They will make my temple beautiful. I will make the place of my feet glorious.

**14** The sons of the people who hurt you will come and bow down to you. All the people who hated you will bow down at your feet. They will call you the City of the LORD. They will call you Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

**15** People left you and hated you. No person went through your land. But I will make you great always. You will be a joy for all generations.

**16** The nations will give you what you need, as a mother gives milk to her baby. Kings will feed you. Then you will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior. You will know that I, the Mighty One of Jacob, pay the price to free you.

**17** I will bring you gold instead of bronze. I will bring you silver instead of iron. I will bring you bronze instead of wood, and iron instead of stones. Peace will be your ruler. Goodness will be your leader.

**18** People will not hear about violence in your land again. There will be no ruin or destruction inside your borders. You will call your walls Salvation. You will call your gates Praise.

**19** You will not need the sun for light in the day. You will not need the moon for light in the night. The LORD will be your light always. Your God will be your glory.

**20** Your sun will not go down again. Your moon will not go away. The LORD will be your light always. Your days of sadness will end.

**21** All your people will be good. They will own the land always. They are like a young plant that I planted. They are the work of my hands. They will show my glory.

**22** The smallest family will become 1000 people. The smallest group will become a strong nation. I am the LORD. When the time is correct, I will do this quickly.

## Chapter 61

**1** The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on me. The LORD anointed me (chose me with oil) to tell good news to poor people. He sent me to heal people with broken hearts. He sent me to tell the captives that they are free. He sent me to tell the prisoners that I will release them.

**2** He sent me to announce the year when the LORD will show his kindness. He sent me to announce the day when our God will punish his enemies. He sent me to comfort all sad people.

**3** He sent me to help the sad people in Zion. I will give them a crown of beauty instead of ashes. I will give them the oil of joy instead of sadness. I will give them clothes of praise instead of a weak spirit. People will call them strong trees of goodness. The LORD planted them to show his glory.

**4** They will build again the old ruins. They will repair the places that enemies destroyed long ago. They will repair the cities that were empty for many generations.

**5** Foreigners will stand and take care of your flocks. Foreigners will work in your fields and in your vineyards.

**6** People will call you the priests of the LORD. They will call you the servants of our God. You will eat the riches of the nations. You will be proud of their wealth.

**7** You had shame, but now you will get 2 times more than before. You had disgrace, but now you will be happy with your share. You will get 2 times more land. Your joy will continue always.

**8** "I, the LORD, love justice. I hate robbery and wrong acts. I will be faithful and give my people their reward. I will make an agreement (covenant) with them that continues always.

**9** Their descendants will be famous among the nations. The peoples will know their children. All people who see them will know that the LORD blessed them."

**10** I am very happy in the LORD. My soul is full of joy in my God. He put on me the clothes of salvation. He covered me with a coat of goodness. I am like a bridegroom who puts on a decorated hat. I am like a bride who puts on her jewels.

**11** The earth causes plants to grow. A garden causes seeds to grow. Thus the Lord GOD will cause goodness and praise to grow in front of all the nations.

## Chapter 62

**1** I will not be silent because I love Zion. I will not stop because I love Jerusalem. I will continue until her goodness shines like a bright light. I will continue until her salvation burns like a lamp.

**2** The nations will see your goodness. All kings will see your glory. The LORD will give you a new name.

**3** You will be like a beautiful crown in the hand of the LORD. You will be like the crown of a king in the hand of your God.

**4** People will not call you "Left Alone" again. They will not call your land "Empty" again. Your new name will be "Hephzibah", which means "I am happy with her." People will call your land "Beulah", which means "Married." The LORD is happy with you, and your land will have a husband.

**5** A young man marries a young woman. Thus your sons will marry you. A bridegroom is happy with his bride. Thus your God will be happy with you.

**6** Jerusalem, I put guards on your walls. They will not be silent, day or night. You who pray to the LORD, do not be silent.

**7** Do not let the LORD rest until he makes Jerusalem strong again. Do not let him rest until all the earth praises Jerusalem.

**8** The LORD made a promise with his right hand and his strong arm. He said, "I will not give your grain to your enemies as food again. Foreigners will not drink the new wine that you worked for.

**9** The people who gather the grain will eat it and praise the LORD. The people who gather the grapes will drink the wine in the courtyards of my temple."

**10** Go through, go through the gates! Make the road ready for the people. Build up the main road. Remove the stones. Raise a flag for the nations.

**11** Look, the LORD speaks to all parts of the earth. "Tell the people of Zion, 'Look, your Savior comes! He brings his reward with him. He brings his payment with him.'"

**12** People will call them "The Holy People" and "The People that the LORD Freed." They will call you "The City that God Wants" and "The City that God Did Not Leave."

## Chapter 63

**1** Who is this man who comes from Edom? He comes from the city of Bozrah. His clothes are red. He wears beautiful clothes. He walks forward with great strength. "It is I, the LORD. I speak what is right. I have the power to save."

**2** Why are your clothes red? They look like the clothes of a man who crushes grapes to make wine.

**3** "I crushed the grapes alone. No person from the nations helped me. In my anger I walked on my enemies. I crushed them in my anger. Their blood fell on my clothes. It made all my clothes dirty.

**4** I decided that the time to punish my enemies was here. The year to free my people came.

**5** I looked, but there was no person to help me. I wondered why no person gave me support. Thus I used my own power to save my people. My anger gave me strength.

**6** In my anger I walked on the nations. I caused them to stagger with my anger. I poured their blood on the ground."

**7** I will tell about the kind acts of the LORD. I will praise the LORD for all the things that he did for us. He did many good things for the family of Israel. He did them because of his mercy and his great love.

**8** He said, "They are surely my people. They are children who will not lie to me." Thus he became their Savior.

**9** When they suffered, he also suffered. The angel from his presence saved them. In his love and his mercy he freed them. He lifted them up and carried them for many years.

**10** But they rebelled against him. They caused sorrow to his Holy Spirit. Thus he became their enemy and he fought against them.

**11** Then his people remembered the days long ago, the days of Moses. They asked, "Where is the LORD, who brought the people through the sea? Where is he who brought the shepherd of his flock? Where is he who put his Holy Spirit among them?

**12** Where is he who sent his glorious power with Moses? He divided the water in front of them. He made his name famous always.

**13** He led them through the deep water. They did not fall. They were like a horse that runs in the desert.

**14** Cattle go down to a valley to rest. Thus the Spirit of the LORD gave them rest. LORD, you led your people in this way. You made your name glorious."

**15** Look down from heaven and see us. Look down from your holy and glorious home. Where is your zeal and your power? Where is your kindness and your mercy? Do you keep them from us?

**16** You are our father. Abraham does not know us. Israel does not recognize us. But you, LORD, are our father. Your name is "Our Redeemer from Long Ago."

**17** LORD, why do you let us go away from your ways? Why do you let our hearts become hard so that we do not respect you? Come back to help your servants. Come back to help the tribes that are yours.

**18** Your holy people owned your land for only a short time. Now our enemies walk on your temple and destroy it.

**19** We are like people that you never ruled. We are like people who do not carry your name.

## Chapter 64

**1** We want you to tear open the sky and come down! Then the mountains will shake in front of you.

**2** Come like a fire that burns sticks. Come like a fire that causes water to boil. Show your name to your enemies. Then the nations will shake with fear in front of you.

**3** Long ago you did terrible things that we did not expect. You came down, and the mountains shook in front of you.

**4** From the start of the world no person heard of a God like you. No ear heard about one and no eye saw one. Only you act for the people who wait for you.

**5** You help people who are happy to do what is right. You help people who remember your ways. But you were angry because we sinned. We continued to sin for a long time. How can you save us?

**6** All of us became like a person who is unclean. All our good acts are like dirty cloth. All of us are like dead leaves. Our sins carry us away like the wind.

**7** No person calls to you. No person tries to hold on to you. You hid your face from us. Our sins caused us to become weak.

**8** But LORD, you are our father. We are the clay, and you are the potter. You made all of us with your hands.

**9** LORD, do not be too angry with us. Do not remember our sins always. Please look at us. We are all your people.

**10** Your holy cities are now a desert. Zion is a desert. Jerusalem is empty and destroyed.

**11** Fire burned our holy and beautiful temple. Our ancestors praised you there. Enemies destroyed all the things that we loved.

**12** LORD, after all these things, will you not do something? Will you be silent and punish us very much?

## Chapter 65

**1** The LORD says, "I was ready to answer people who did not ask for me. I was ready for people who did not look for me to find me. I said, 'I am here, I am here,' to a nation that did not pray to me.

**2** All day I held out my hands to a people who rebel. They do things that are not good. They do what they want.

**3** These people always make me angry in front of me. They give sacrifices in gardens to their idols. They burn incense on altars of bricks.

**4** They sit among the graves. They spend the night in secret places. They eat pork. Their pots contain soup made of unclean meat.

**5** They say to other people, 'Stay away. Do not come near me. I am more holy than you.' These people are like smoke in my nose. They make me angry all day, like a fire that burns all day.

**6** Look, I wrote down my decision. I will not be silent. I will punish them completely.

**7** I will punish them for their sins and for the sins of their ancestors," says the LORD. "They burned incense on the mountains. They insulted me on the hills. Thus I will punish them for all their past acts."

**8** The LORD says this: "When a person finds juice in a bunch of grapes, other people say, 'Do not destroy it. There is something good in it.' Thus I will not destroy all my people. I will do this for my servants.

**9** I will bring descendants from Jacob. I will bring people from Judah who will own my mountains. My chosen people will own the land. My servants will live there.

**10** The plain of Sharon will be a field for sheep. The Valley of Achor will be a place for cattle to rest. These places will be for my people who look for me.

**11** But some of you left the LORD and forgot my holy mountain. You prepare food for the god Fortune. You pour out mixed wine for the god Fate.

**12** Thus I will decide that you will die in war. All of you will bow down to your killers. When I called, you did not answer. When I spoke, you did not listen. You did evil things in front of me. You chose to do things that I do not like."

**13** Thus the Lord GOD says this: "Look, my servants will eat, but you will be hungry. My servants will drink, but you will be thirsty. My servants will be happy, but you will feel shame.

**14** My servants will sing with happy hearts. But you will cry with sad hearts. You will cry loudly because you have a broken spirit.

**15** My chosen people will use your name as a curse. The Lord GOD will kill you. But he will give his servants another name.

**16** People in the land who ask for a blessing will ask the God of truth. People in the land who make a promise will promise by the God of truth. I will forget the past troubles. I will not see them again.

**17** Look, I will make new heavens and a new earth. People will not remember the past things. They will not think about them.

**18** Be happy and full of joy always because of the things that I make. Look, I will make Jerusalem a city of joy. I will make her people happy.

**19** I will be happy with Jerusalem. I will be glad about my people. People will not hear the sound of tears and sadness in the city again.

**20** In that city no baby will die after only a few days. All old people will live a long life. A person who dies at 100 years old will seem young. A person who does not live 100 years will seem cursed.

**21** My people will build houses and live in them. They will plant vineyards and eat the grapes.

**22** They will not build houses for other people to live in. They will not plant food for other people to eat. My people will live as long as trees. My chosen people will enjoy the things that they make for a long time.

**23** They will not work for nothing. Their children will not have a life of trouble. The LORD will bless them and their descendants.

**24** I will answer them before they call to me. I will hear them while they still speak to me.

**25** The wolf and the lamb will eat together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. The snake will eat only dust. Nothing will hurt or destroy on all my holy mountain," says the LORD.

## Chapter 66

**1** The LORD says this: "Heaven is my throne. The earth is the place where I put my feet. Thus where is the house that you will build for me? Where is the place where I will rest?

**2** My hand made all these things. Thus all these things came into existence," says the LORD. "But I look with favor on the person who is humble and sorry for his sins. I look with favor on the person who respects my word with fear.

**3** But some people kill an ox as a sacrifice, and they also kill a man. Some people sacrifice a lamb, and they also break the neck of a dog. Some people give a grain offering, and they also give the blood of a pig. Some people burn incense, and they also worship an idol. These people chose their own ways. They love the things that I hate.

**4** Thus I will choose to punish them. I will bring on them the things that they fear. When I called, no person answered. When I spoke, they did not listen. They did evil things in front of me. They chose to do things that I do not like."

**5** Hear the word of the LORD, you who respect his word with fear. "Your brothers hate you. They send you away because you are loyal to me. They say, 'Let the LORD show his glory. Then we will see your joy.' But they will feel shame.

**6** Hear the loud noise from the city! Hear the sound from the temple! It is the sound of the LORD. He punishes his enemies for what they did.

**7** Zion gave birth before she felt the pain of birth. Before the pain came, she gave birth to a son.

**8** Who ever heard of a thing like this? Who ever saw things like these? Can a country start in 1 day? Can a nation come to life in 1 moment? But when Zion felt the pain of birth, she gave birth to her children at once.

**9** I start the birth of a child. Thus I will not stop the birth," says the LORD. "I cause the birth of a child. Thus I will not close the womb," says your God.

**10** "Be happy with Jerusalem, all you who love her. Be glad with her. Be very happy with her, all you who were sad for her.

**11** Then you will get comfort from her, as a baby gets milk from its mother. You will be content. You will enjoy her great riches.

**12** The LORD says this: "Look, I will give Jerusalem peace that flows like a river. The riches of the nations will come to her like a stream that flows over its banks. You will be like a baby that its mother feeds. She will carry you in her arms. She will play with you on her knees.

**13** As a mother comforts her child, I will comfort you. You will get comfort in Jerusalem."

**14** When you see this, your heart will be happy. Your body will become strong like new grass. The LORD will show his power to help his servants. He will show his anger against his enemies.

**15** Look, the LORD will come with fire. His chariots will come like a storm. He will show his anger and punish his enemies with flames of fire.

**16** The LORD will judge all people with fire and with his sword. The LORD will kill many people.

**17** "Some people make themselves holy and clean to worship in the gardens. They follow a leader who stands in the center. They eat pork, rats and other unclean things. All these people will die together," says the LORD.

**18** "I know what they do and what they think. The time will come when I will gather all nations and all languages. They will come and they will see my glory.

**19** I will put a sign among them. I will send some of the survivors to the nations. I will send them to Tarshish, to Pul and to Lud, where people use bows and arrows. I will send them to Tubal, to Greece and to the islands far away. Those people did not hear about me or see my glory. My messengers will tell the nations about my glory.

**20** They will bring all your brothers from all the nations to my holy mountain, Jerusalem. They will bring them as an offering to the LORD. They will bring them on horses, in chariots and in wagons, and on mules and camels," says the LORD. "The people of Israel bring offerings to the temple of the LORD in clean containers. Thus your brothers will be like an offering in a clean container.

**21** I will also choose some of them to be priests and Levites," says the LORD.
