**7** In you, the people do not respect their fathers and mothers. They are cruel to the foreigners. They cause injury to the orphans and the widows.

**8** You do not respect my holy things. You make my Sabbaths unholy.

**9** In you are men who tell lies to cause the death of other people. In you are people who eat at the shrines on the mountains. In you the people commit sexual sins.

**10** In you are men who have sex with the wives of their fathers. In you are men who have sex with women during their monthly period.

**11** One man does a hateful thing with the wife of his neighbor. Another man has sex with his daughter-in-law. Another man has sex with his sister, the daughter of his father.

**12** In you people take payments to kill other people. You lend money for interest and take profit. You take money from your neighbors by force. And you forget me, says the Lord GOD.

**13** "'Thus I hit my hands together against the money that you got dishonestly. I hit my hands together against the blood that flows in you.

**14** When I punish you, will your heart stay brave? Will your hands stay strong? I, the LORD, spoke, and I will do it.

**15** I will send you away among the nations. I will scatter you through the countries. I will remove your unclean actions from you.

**16** The nations will see your shame. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'"

**17** The word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**18** "Son of man, the people of Israel became like waste metal to me. All of them are like copper, tin, iron and lead in a furnace. They are like the waste metal that stays after a person refines silver.

**19** Thus the Lord GOD says this: 'All of you became like waste metal. Thus I will gather you into Jerusalem.

**20** People gather silver, copper, iron, lead and tin into a furnace. They blow on the fire to melt the metal. In the same way, I will gather you in my anger. I will put you in the city and melt you.

**21** I will gather you and blow on you with the fire of my anger. You will melt in the city.

**22** Silver melts in a furnace. In the same way, you will melt in the city. Then you will know that I, the LORD, poured out my anger on you.'"

**23** The word of the LORD came to me again. He said,

**24** "Son of man, say to the land, 'You are a land that is not clean. You got no rain on the day of my anger.'

**25** The prophets in the land make secret plans together. They are like a lion that roars and tears its prey. They kill people. They take money and valuable things. They cause many women in the land to become widows.

**26** The priests of the land do not obey my law. They dishonor my holy things. They do not teach the difference between holy things and common things. They do not show the difference between unclean things and clean things. They do not keep my Sabbaths. Thus the people dishonor me.

**27** The officials in the land are like wolves that tear their prey. They kill people and destroy lives to get money dishonestly.

**28** The prophets hide these sins, as people cover a wall with whitewash. They see false visions and tell lies with magic. They say, 'The Lord GOD says this.' But the LORD did not speak.

**29** The people of the land are cruel and they steal. They cause injury to the poor and the needy. They are not fair to the foreigners, and they are cruel to them.

**30** I looked for a man among them who could repair the wall. I looked for a man who could stand in the hole in the wall in front of me to protect the land. Then I will not destroy the land. But I did not find one.

**31** Thus I poured out my anger on them. I destroyed them with the fire of my anger. I punished them for what they did, says the Lord GOD."

## Chapter 23

**1** The word of the LORD came to me again. He said,

**2** "Son of man, there were 2 women. They were the daughters of the same mother.

**3** They became prostitutes in Egypt when they were young. There men touched their breasts and took away their virginity.

**4** The older sister was Oholah, and the younger sister was Oholibah. They became mine, and they gave birth to sons and daughters. Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.

**5** "Oholah acted as a prostitute while she was mine. She had strong sexual desire for her lovers, the Assyrians, who were her neighbors.

**6** They wore blue clothes. They were commanders and officials. All of them were attractive young men who rode horses.

**7** She became a prostitute for all the best men of Assyria. She made herself unclean with all the idols of the men that she desired.

**8** She did not stop the prostitution that she started in Egypt. When she was young, the Egyptians had sex with her. They took away her virginity and used her as a prostitute.

**9** Thus I gave her to her lovers, the Assyrians, whom she desired.

**10** They took off her clothes. They took her sons and her daughters. They killed her with the sword. The punishment of Oholah became a lesson to other women.

**11** "Her sister Oholibah saw this. But Oholibah was worse than her sister in her lust and her prostitution.

**12** She desired the Assyrians, her neighbors. They were commanders and officials in fine clothes. They were attractive young men who rode horses.

**13** I saw that she also made herself unclean. The 2 sisters followed the same way.

**14** But Oholibah did more acts of prostitution. She saw pictures of men on a wall. They were pictures of Babylonians, painted in red.

**15** The men in the pictures wore belts around their waists and long cloths on their heads. All of them looked like officers from Babylon, from the land of the Chaldeans.

**16** When she saw the pictures, she desired the men. She sent messengers to them in Babylonia.

**17** The Babylonians came to her bed of love. They made her unclean with their lust. After they made her unclean, she started to hate them.

**18** She did her prostitution openly and she showed her naked body. Then I turned away from her in disgust, as I turned away from her sister.

**19** But she did more acts of prostitution. She remembered the days when she was young, when she acted as a prostitute in the land of Egypt.

**20** She desired her lovers there, who had very strong sexual desire.

**21** Thus, Oholibah, you wanted the sexual sins of your youth again. You remembered when the Egyptians touched your young breasts.

**22** "Thus, Oholibah, the Lord GOD says this: 'I will cause your lovers to attack you. You hate them now. I will bring them against you from all directions.

**23** I will bring the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, and the men from Pekod, Shoa and Koa. I will bring all the Assyrians with them. All of them are attractive young men, commanders and officials, officers and important men. All of them ride horses.

**24** They will attack you with weapons, chariots and wagons, and with a large army. They will surround you with shields and helmets. I will give them the authority to punish you. They will punish you as their laws tell them.

**25** I will show my jealous anger against you, and they will be very cruel to you. They will cut off your nose and your ears. They will kill the people who stay alive with the sword. They will take your sons and your daughters. Fire will burn the people who stay alive.

**26** They will take off your clothes and take your beautiful jewelry.

**27** Thus I will stop your sexual sins and the prostitution that you started in Egypt. You will not look at the Egyptians with desire. You will not remember Egypt again.

**28** "'The Lord GOD says this: I will give you to the people whom you hate. I will give you to the people who disgust you.

**29** They will show their hate to you. They will take all that you worked for. They will leave you naked, with no clothes. All people will see the shame of your prostitution, your sexual sins and your lust.

**30** I will do these things to you because you acted as a prostitute with the nations. You made yourself unclean with their idols.

**31** You followed the way of your sister. Thus I will put her cup of punishment in your hand.

**32** "'The Lord GOD says this: You will drink the cup of your sister. The cup is deep and wide. People will laugh at you and insult you. The cup holds much punishment.

**33** You will be drunk and full of sadness. It is a cup of horror and destruction. It is the cup of your sister Samaria.

**34** You will drink all of it. You will break the cup into pieces. Then you will tear your breasts. I spoke, says the Lord GOD.

**35** "'Thus the Lord GOD says this: You forgot me and you turned your back on me. Thus you will get the punishment for your sexual sins and your prostitution.'"

**36** The LORD said to me, "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then tell them about their hateful actions.

**37** They committed adultery and they killed people. They committed adultery with their idols. They burned their sons, whom they gave birth to for me, as food for the idols.

**38** They also did this to me: On that same day, they made my sanctuary unclean and they made my Sabbaths unholy.

**39** They killed their children as sacrifices to their idols. Then, on the same day, they came into my sanctuary and made it unclean. They did this in my house.

**40** "They sent messengers to bring men from far away. The men came. For them, Oholibah washed herself, painted her eyes and put on her jewelry.

**41** She sat on a beautiful couch. A table was ready in front of it. On the table she put my incense and my oil.

**42** The noise of a careless crowd was around her. Common men and drunk men from the desert came. They put bracelets on the arms of the 2 sisters and beautiful crowns on their heads.

**43** Then I said about the woman who was weak from adultery, 'Now let them use her as a prostitute, because that is what she is.'

**44** The men went to her as men go to a prostitute. Thus they went to Oholah and Oholibah, the women with no shame.

**45** But righteous men will judge them. They will punish them as judges punish women who commit adultery and kill people. The sisters committed adultery and they killed people.

**46** "The Lord GOD says this: 'Bring a crowd against them. Give them to the crowd to cause terror and to steal from them.

**47** The crowd will throw stones at them and kill them with swords. The crowd will kill their sons and their daughters and burn their houses.

**48** Thus I will stop the sexual sin in the land. Then all women will learn a lesson. They will not commit sexual sins as you did.

**49** You will get the punishment for your sexual sins and for your idols. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD.'"

## Chapter 24

**1** In the 9th year, in the 10th month, on the 10th day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**2** "Son of man, write down the date of this day. On this day the king of Babylon started to attack Jerusalem.

**3** Tell a story with a meaning to the people who rebel against me. Tell them, 'The Lord GOD says this: Put a pot on the fire. Put it on the fire and pour water into it.

**4** Put pieces of meat into it, all the good pieces, the thigh and the shoulder. Fill it with the best bones.

**5** Take the best animal of the flock. Put wood under the pot to cook the bones. Boil the meat well and cook the bones in it.

**6** "'Thus the Lord GOD says this: Trouble will come to the city that kills people! The city is like a pot with rust in it. The rust does not come out of it. Take out the meat, piece by piece, and do not choose any piece.

**7** The blood that the city caused to flow is still in it. She poured the blood on a bare rock. She did not pour it on the ground, where dust could cover it.

**8** I put her blood on the bare rock so that no person can cover it. Thus my anger will come, and I will punish her.

**9** "'Thus the Lord GOD says this: Trouble will come to the city that kills people! I will also make a large pile of wood for the fire.

**10** Put much wood on it and start the fire. Cook the meat well and mix in the spices. Let the bones burn.

**11** Then put the empty pot on the hot coals. Make the copper hot until it glows. Then the dirt in the pot will melt and the rust will burn away.

**12** But all the work is useless. The thick rust does not come out of the pot. Even the fire does not remove the rust.

**13** "'Your dirt is your sexual sin. I tried to make you clean, but you did not become clean. You will not become clean again until my anger against you stops.

**14** I, the LORD, spoke. The time comes, and I will do it. I will not stop. I will not feel pity, and I will not change my decision. I will judge you by your ways and your actions, says the Lord GOD.'"

**15** The word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**16** "Son of man, I will suddenly take away from you the woman that you love. But you must not show sadness or cry. Do not let tears come from your eyes.

**17** Groan quietly. Do not show sadness for the dead. Put on your turban and your shoes. Do not cover your mouth. Do not eat the food that people bring to a person who is sad."

**18** I spoke to the people in the morning, and in the evening my wife died. The next morning I did as the LORD told me.

**19** The people asked me, "Tell us. What is the meaning of these things that you do?"

**20** I said to them, "The word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**21** 'Speak to the people of Israel. Tell them, "The Lord GOD says this: I will make my sanctuary unholy. You are proud of its strength. You love to look at it, and you love it with all your heart. The enemy will kill with the sword the sons and the daughters that you left behind.

**22** Then you will do as Ezekiel did. You will not cover your mouth. You will not eat the food that people bring to a person who is sad.

**23** You will keep your turbans on your heads and your shoes on your feet. You will not show sadness or cry. But you will become weak because of your sins, and you will groan with each other.

**24** Ezekiel will be a sign to you. You will do all the things that he did. When this occurs, you will know that I am the Lord GOD."'

**25** "Son of man, I will take away their strong place, their joy and their pride. They love to look at it, and they love it with all their heart. I will also take away their sons and their daughters.

**26** On that day a person who escapes will come to you and tell you the news.

**27** On that day you will speak to the person who escaped. You will speak and you will not be silent again. Thus you will be a sign to them, and they will know that I am the LORD."

## Chapter 25

**1** The word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**2** "Son of man, turn your face toward the Ammonites and prophesy against them.

**3** Tell the Ammonites, 'Hear the word of the Lord GOD. The Lord GOD says this: You laughed at my sanctuary when people made it unholy. You laughed at the land of Israel when the enemy destroyed it. You laughed at the people of Judah when the enemy took them away as prisoners.

**4** Thus I will give you to the people of the east. They will own your land. They will put their camps and their tents in your land. They will eat your fruit and drink your milk.

**5** I will make the city of Rabbah a field for camels. I will make the land of the Ammonites a place where sheep rest. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

**6** "'The Lord GOD says this: You clapped your hands and hit the ground with your feet. You were happy in your heart, and you insulted the land of Israel.

**7** Thus I will put out my hand against you. I will give you to the nations as stolen goods. I will remove you from among the nations. I will destroy you from among the countries. I will destroy you. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'

**8** "The Lord GOD says this: 'Moab and Seir say, "The people of Judah are the same as all the other nations."

**9** Thus I will open the side of Moab to attack. I will start with the cities on its border, the beautiful cities of Beth Jeshimoth, Baal Meon and Kiriathaim.

**10** I will give Moab and the land of the Ammonites to the people of the east. They will own these lands. Then the nations will not remember the Ammonites.

**11** I will punish Moab. Then the people will know that I am the LORD.'

**12** "The Lord GOD says this: 'Edom took revenge on the people of Judah. Edom became very guilty when it took revenge on them.

**13** Thus the Lord GOD says this: I will put out my hand against Edom. I will kill the people and the animals in it. I will destroy the land from Teman to Dedan. The enemy will kill the people with the sword.

**14** I will use my people Israel to take revenge on Edom. They will do to Edom what my anger demands. Then the people of Edom will know my revenge, says the Lord GOD.'

**15** "The Lord GOD says this: 'The Philistines took revenge. They took revenge with hate in their hearts. They hated Judah for a long time and they tried to destroy it.

**16** Thus the Lord GOD says this: I will put out my hand against the Philistines. I will kill the Cherethites. I will destroy the people who stay alive on the coast.

**17** I will take terrible revenge on them and punish them in my anger. When I take my revenge on them, they will know that I am the LORD.'"

## Chapter 26

**1** In the 11th year, on the 1st day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**2** "Son of man, Tyre said this about Jerusalem: 'Aha! Someone broke the gate to the nations. Jerusalem is open to me now. She is a ruin, and now I will become rich.'

**3** Thus the Lord GOD says this: 'I am against you, Tyre. I will bring many nations against you, as the sea brings its waves.

**4** They will destroy the walls of Tyre and break down her towers. I will remove her soil and make her a bare rock.

**5** Tyre will be a place in the sea where people spread their nets to catch fish. I spoke, says the Lord GOD. The nations will take everything from Tyre.

**6** The enemy will kill with the sword the people in her villages on the mainland. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'

**7** "The Lord GOD says this: 'I will bring Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, against Tyre from the north. He is the most powerful of all kings. He will come with horses, chariots and horsemen, and with a large army.

**8** He will kill with the sword the people in your villages on the mainland. He will build ramps and walls against you. He will put up shields against you.

**9** He will hit your walls with heavy rams. He will break down your towers with his axes.

**10** He will have so many horses that their dust will cover you. He will come in through your gates as men come into a city with broken walls. Your walls will shake at the noise of his horsemen, wagons and chariots.

**11** The hoofs of his horses will walk through all your streets. He will kill your people with the sword. Your strong columns will fall to the ground.

**12** They will take your wealth and your goods. They will break down your walls and destroy your beautiful houses. They will throw your stones, your wood and your soil into the sea.

**13** I will stop the noise of your songs. People will not hear the music of your harps again.

**14** I will make you a bare rock. You will be a place where people spread their nets to catch fish. People will not build you again. I, the LORD, spoke, says the Lord GOD.'

**15** "The Lord GOD says this to Tyre: 'The coasts will shake at the noise of your fall. They will shake when wounded people groan and when the enemy kills people in you.

**16** Then all the princes of the coast will come down from their thrones. They will take off their robes and their beautiful clothes. They will sit on the ground and shake with fear. They will shake all the time, and they will feel horror at you.

**17** They will sing a sad song about you. They will say to you, "You were a famous city. Sailors lived in you. You were powerful on the sea. You and your people caused terror to all the people who lived near you. Now you are a ruin!

**18** Now the coasts shake on the day of your fall. The islands in the sea are afraid because of your end."

**19** "'The Lord GOD says this: I will make you an empty city, like other cities where no people live. I will bring the deep ocean over you, and much water will cover you.

**20** Then I will bring you down to the pit, to the people who died long ago. I will make you live in the world of the dead, in places that are empty since ancient times. You will be with the people who go down to the pit. Then no people will live in you, and you will have no place in the land of the people who are alive.

**21** I will bring you to a terrible end, and you will not exist again. People will look for you, but they will never find you again, says the Lord GOD.'"

## Chapter 27

**1** The word of the LORD came to me again. He said,

**2** "Son of man, sing a sad song about Tyre.

**3** Say to Tyre, the city at the entrance to the sea, 'The Lord GOD says this.' Tyre trades with the people of many coasts. Say, 'Tyre, you said, "My beauty is perfect."

**4** Your borders are in the middle of the seas. Your builders made your beauty perfect.

**5** They made all your planks from pine trees from Senir. They took cedars from Lebanon to make masts for you.

**6** They made your oars from the oaks of Bashan. They made your deck from cypress wood from the coasts of Cyprus, with ivory in it.

**7** Your sail was fine linen with decorations from Egypt. It was a flag for you. Your sunshade was of blue and purple cloth from the coasts of Elishah.

**8** The people of Sidon and Arvad were your sailors. Your skilled men, Tyre, were your captains.

**9** The old and skilled men of Gebal were in you. They repaired the holes in your ships. All the ships of the sea and their sailors came to you to trade for your goods.

**10** "'Men from Persia, Lud and Put were soldiers in your army. They hung their shields and helmets on your walls. They made you look splendid.

**11** Men from Arvad and from your army were on all your walls. Men from Gammad were in your towers. They hung their shields on all your walls. They made your beauty perfect.

**12** "'Tarshish traded with you because of your great wealth. They gave silver, iron, tin and lead for your goods.

**13** Greece, Tubal and Meshech traded with you. They gave slaves and copper items for your goods.

**14** The people of Beth Togarmah gave horses, war horses and mules for your goods.

**15** The men of Dedan traded with you. Many coasts were your markets. They paid you with ivory tusks and ebony.

**16** Syria traded with you because you made many goods. They gave emeralds, purple cloth, cloth with decorations, fine linen, coral and rubies for your goods.

**17** Judah and the land of Israel traded with you. They gave wheat from Minnith, cakes, honey, oil and balm for your goods.

**18** Damascus traded with you because you made many goods and had great wealth. They gave wine from Helbon and white wool.

**19** Dan and Greece from Uzal gave worked iron, cassia and sweet cane for your goods.

**20** Dedan traded saddle blankets with you.

**21** Arabia and all the princes of Kedar traded with you. They gave lambs, rams and goats.

**22** The merchants of Sheba and Raamah traded with you. They gave the best spices, all types of valuable stones, and gold for your goods.

**23** Haran, Canneh and Eden traded with you. The merchants of Sheba, Asshur and Chilmad traded with you.

**24** They traded beautiful clothes with you. They gave blue cloth, cloth with decorations, and carpets of many colors, with strong ropes.

**25** The ships of Tarshish carried your goods. You were full of goods and very rich in the middle of the seas.

**26** "'Your men rowed you into deep water. But the east wind broke you in the middle of the seas.

**27** On the day of your destruction, all will go down into the sea. Your wealth, your goods, your sailors and your captains will sink into the sea. The men who repair your ships, your merchants, all your soldiers and all your people will sink too.

**28** The coasts will shake when your captains cry out.

**29** All the men who use oars will leave their ships. The sailors and all the captains of the sea will stand on the land.

**30** They will cry loudly about you. They will cry with much sadness. They will throw dust on their heads and roll in ashes.

**31** They will shave their heads because of you. They will put on sackcloth. They will cry for you with much sadness in their hearts.

**32** In their sadness they will sing a sad song about you. They will say, "Which city was like Tyre? Now Tyre is silent in the middle of the sea!"

**33** When your goods went out across the seas, you satisfied many nations. You made the kings of the earth rich with your great wealth and your goods.

**34** Now the sea breaks you in the deep water. Your goods and all your people sink with you.

**35** All the people who live on the coasts feel horror at you. Their kings are very afraid, and their faces show fear.

**36** The merchants among the nations whistle at you in surprise. You came to a terrible end, and you will not exist again.'"

## Chapter 28

**1** The word of the LORD came to me again. He said,

**2** "Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, 'The Lord GOD says this: Your heart is proud. You say, "I am a god. I sit on the throne of a god in the middle of the seas." But you are a man and not a god, although you think that you are as wise as a god.

**3** You think that you are wiser than Daniel. You think that no person can hide a secret from you.

**4** With your wisdom and your knowledge you got wealth for yourself. You put gold and silver in your treasuries.

**5** With your great skill in trade you increased your wealth. Your heart became proud because of your wealth.

**6** "'Thus the Lord GOD says this: You think that you are as wise as a god.

**7** Thus I will bring foreigners against you. They are the most cruel of the nations. They will use their swords against your beautiful wisdom. They will make your splendor unholy.

**8** They will bring you down to the pit. You will die a violent death in the middle of the seas.

**9** Will you still say, "I am a god," in front of the people who kill you? You will be a man and not a god in the hands of the people who kill you.

**10** You will die like an uncircumcised person in the hands of foreigners. I spoke, says the Lord GOD.'"

**11** The word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**12** "Son of man, sing a sad song about the king of Tyre. Say to him, 'The Lord GOD says this: You were a perfect example. You were full of wisdom and your beauty was perfect.

**13** You were in Eden, the garden of God. All types of valuable stones covered you: ruby, topaz, diamond, beryl, onyx, jasper, sapphire, emerald and carbuncle. Their settings were of gold. On the day that I made you, these things were ready.

**14** I put you there as a guardian cherub (angel) with wings that covered. You were on the holy mountain of God. You walked among the stones of fire.

**15** You were perfect in your ways from the day that I made you. But then I found sin in you.

**16** You traded much, and thus you became full of violence and you sinned. Thus I threw you out from the mountain of God in shame. Guardian cherub, I removed you from among the stones of fire.

**17** Your heart became proud because of your beauty. Your splendor caused you to lose your wisdom. Thus I threw you to the ground. I made you an example in front of kings, so that they can look at you.

**18** You made your holy places unholy with your many sins and your dishonest trade. Thus I caused a fire to come out from you, and the fire burned you. I made you ashes on the ground in front of all the people who watched.

**19** All the nations who know you feel horror at you. You came to a terrible end, and you will not exist again.'"

**20** The word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**21** "Son of man, turn your face toward Sidon and prophesy against it.

**22** Say, 'The Lord GOD says this: I am against you, Sidon. I will show my glory in you. The people will know that I am the LORD when I punish Sidon and show that I am holy in her.

**23** I will send disease and blood into her streets. The enemy will attack her from all directions with the sword, and many people in her will die. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

**24** The nations around Israel insulted the people of Israel. But they will not cause pain to Israel again, as sharp thorns cause pain. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.

**25** "'The Lord GOD says this: I will gather the people of Israel from the nations where they are. Then I will show that I am holy through them, while the nations watch. Then the people of Israel will live in their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob.

**26** They will live safely there. They will build houses and plant vineyards. They will live safely when I punish all their neighbors who insulted them. Then they will know that I am the LORD their God.'"

## Chapter 29

**1** In the 10th year, in the 10th month, on the 12th day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**2** "Son of man, turn your face toward Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. Prophesy against him and against all Egypt.

**3** Speak and say, 'The Lord GOD says this: I am against you, Pharaoh, king of Egypt. You are like a large crocodile that lies in the middle of its rivers. You say, "The Nile is mine. I made it for myself."

**4** But I will put hooks in your jaws. I will make the fish of your rivers hold on to your scales. I will pull you up out of your rivers, with all the fish that hold on to your scales.

**5** I will throw you into the desert, you and all the fish of your rivers. You will fall on the open field. No person will pick you up or bury you. I will give you as food to the wild animals and to the birds.

**6** Then all the people who live in Egypt will know that I am the LORD. Egypt was a weak support to the people of Israel, like a stick made of reed.

**7** When the people of Israel held you in their hand, you broke and tore their shoulders. When they leaned on you, you broke and caused their backs to shake.

**8** "'Thus the Lord GOD says this: I will bring a sword against you. I will kill your people and your animals.

**9** The land of Egypt will become empty and destroyed. Then they will know that I am the LORD. Pharaoh said, "The Nile is mine. I made it."

**10** Thus I am against you and against your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt completely empty and destroyed, from Migdol to Syene and to the border of Ethiopia.

**11** No person or animal will go through it. No person will live there for 40 years.

**12** I will make the land of Egypt empty among the empty countries. Her cities will be empty among the destroyed cities for 40 years. I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and through the countries.

**13** "'But the Lord GOD says this: At the end of 40 years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they are.

**14** I will make Egypt wealthy again. I will bring the Egyptians back to Pathros, the land where they started. There they will be a weak kingdom.

**15** Egypt will be the weakest of the kingdoms. It will not make itself higher than the other nations again. I will make it so small that it will not rule over the nations again.

**16** The people of Israel will not trust Egypt again. Egypt will remind them of their sin when they went to Egypt for help. Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD.'"

**17** In the 27th year, in the 1st month, on the 1st day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**18** "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, made his army work hard against Tyre. Each head became bald and each shoulder became sore. But he and his army got no payment from Tyre for their work against Tyre.

**19** Thus the Lord GOD says this: 'I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon. He will take away the wealth of Egypt and its goods. That will be the payment for his army.

**20** I will give him the land of Egypt as payment for his work against Tyre, because his army worked for me, says the Lord GOD.'

**21** "On that day I will make the people of Israel strong again. I will let you, Ezekiel, speak openly among them. Then they will know that I am the LORD."

## Chapter 30

**1** The word of the LORD came to me again. He said,

**2** "Son of man, prophesy and say, 'The Lord GOD says this: Cry out, "That day will be terrible!"

**3** The day is near. The day of the LORD is near. It will be a day of dark clouds. It will be a time of punishment for the nations.

**4** A sword will come against Egypt. Ethiopia will feel much pain when many people die in Egypt. The enemy will take away the wealth of Egypt and break down her foundations.

**5** Ethiopia, Put, Lud, all the foreign people, Libya and the people of the allied land will die by the sword with Egypt.

**6** "'The LORD says this: The allies of Egypt will fall. The proud power of Egypt will come down. The enemy will kill her people with the sword from Migdol to Syene, says the Lord GOD.

**7** Egypt will be empty among the empty countries. Her cities will be among the destroyed cities.

**8** I will start a fire in Egypt and destroy all her allies. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

**9** "'On that day messengers will go out from me in ships. They will cause fear to the people of Ethiopia, who feel safe now. Pain will come to them on the day of the destruction of Egypt. That day will surely come!

**10** "'The Lord GOD says this: I will use Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, to destroy the wealth of Egypt.

**11** He and his army are the most cruel of the nations. I will bring them to destroy the land. They will use their swords against Egypt. They will fill the land with dead bodies.

**12** I will make the rivers of the Nile dry. I will sell the land to wicked people. I will use foreigners to destroy the land and all that is in it. I, the LORD, spoke.

**13** "'The Lord GOD says this: I will destroy the idols. I will remove the false gods from Memphis. There will not be a prince in Egypt again. I will put fear in the land of Egypt.

**14** I will destroy Pathros. I will start a fire in Zoan. I will punish Thebes.

**15** I will pour out my anger on Pelusium, the strong city of Egypt. I will kill the crowds of Thebes.

**16** I will start a fire in Egypt. Pelusium will feel much pain. The enemy will break into Thebes. Memphis will have troubles each day.

**17** The enemy will kill the young men of On and Pi Beseth with the sword. The enemy will take the people of these cities away as prisoners.

**18** At Tahpanhes the day will become dark when I break the power of Egypt. Her proud strength will come to an end. A dark cloud will cover Tahpanhes. The enemy will take her villages away as prisoners.

**19** Thus I will punish Egypt. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"

**20** In the 11th year, in the 1st month, on the 7th day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**21** "Son of man, I broke the arm of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. No person put a bandage on it to make it well. Thus the arm is not strong, and it cannot hold a sword.

**22** Thus the Lord GOD says this: 'I am against Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. I will break his 2 arms, the strong arm and the broken arm. I will make the sword fall from his hand.

**23** I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and through the countries.

**24** I will make the arms of the king of Babylon strong. I will put my sword in his hand. But I will break the arms of Pharaoh. Pharaoh will groan in front of the king of Babylon like a man who has a fatal wound.

**25** I will make the arms of the king of Babylon strong, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall. I will put my sword in the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will use it against the land of Egypt. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

**26** I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and through the countries. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"

## Chapter 31

**1** In the 11th year, in the 3rd month, on the 1st day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**2** "Son of man, speak to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and to his crowd of people. Say, 'Who is as great as you?

**3** Think about Assyria. It was like a cedar in Lebanon. It had beautiful branches that gave much shade. It was very tall, and its top was above the thick branches.

**4** Water caused it to grow. Deep springs made it tall. Rivers flowed around the place where it grew. Streams went out to all the trees of the field.

**5** Thus the cedar was taller than all the other trees of the field. It had many branches, and they became long because of the much water.

**6** All the birds made their nests in its branches. All the wild animals gave birth to their young under its branches. All the large nations lived in its shade.

**7** The tree was beautiful and great, with long branches, because its roots went down to much water.

**8** The cedars in the garden of God were not equal to it. The pine trees did not have branches like its branches. The plane trees did not have branches like it. No tree in the garden of God was as beautiful as it.

**9** I made it beautiful with many branches. All the trees of Eden in the garden of God were jealous of it.

**10** "'Thus the Lord GOD says this: The cedar became very tall. Its top went above the thick branches. It became proud because of its height.

**11** Thus I gave it to the ruler of the nations. He will punish it as its wickedness deserves. I threw it away.

**12** Foreigners, the most cruel of the nations, cut it down and left it. Its branches fell on the mountains and in all the valleys. Its broken branches lay in all the streams of the land. All the nations of the earth left its shade.

**13** All the birds live on the fallen tree. All the wild animals live among its branches.

**14** Thus no other tree near water will become so tall again. No other tree will put its top above the thick branches. No tree that gets much water will become so tall. All of them will die and go down to the world of the dead. They will go with the people who go down to the pit.

**15** "'The Lord GOD says this: On the day that the cedar went down to the grave, I caused the deep springs to show sadness. I stopped its rivers and held back its much water. I caused Lebanon to show sadness for it. All the trees of the field became weak because of it.

**16** I made the nations shake at the noise of its fall, when I sent it down to the world of the dead. All the trees of Eden, the best trees of Lebanon that get much water, felt comfort in the world of the dead.

**17** They also went down with the cedar to the world of the dead. They went to the people whom the enemy killed with the sword. They were the allies of the cedar who lived in its shade among the nations.

**18** "'Pharaoh, which of the trees of Eden was equal to you in glory and greatness? But you will go down with the trees of Eden to the world of the dead. You will lie among the uncircumcised people whom the enemy killed with the sword. This is what will occur to Pharaoh and all his crowd of people, says the Lord GOD.'"

## Chapter 32

**1** In the 12th year, in the 12th month, on the 1st day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**2** "Son of man, sing a sad song about Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. Say to him, 'You think that you are like a young lion among the nations. But you are like a monster in the seas. You splash in your rivers. You stir the water with your feet and make the rivers dirty.

**3** "'The Lord GOD says this: I will spread my net over you with a large crowd of people. They will pull you up in my net.

**4** I will throw you on the land. I will throw you on the open field. All the birds will stay on you. All the wild animals of the earth will eat you until they are full.

**5** I will put your flesh on the mountains. I will fill the valleys with your dead body.

**6** I will pour your blood on the land, up to the mountains. Your blood will fill the streams.

**7** When I destroy you, I will cover the sky and make the stars dark. I will cover the sun with a cloud. The moon will not give its light.

**8** I will make all the bright lights in the sky dark over you. I will send darkness on your land, says the Lord GOD.

**9** "'I will trouble the hearts of many nations when I bring news of your destruction to the nations. I will bring it to countries that you did not know.

**10** I will make many nations shocked at you. Their kings will be very afraid of you when I move my sword in front of them. On the day of your fall, each of them will shake all the time with fear for his life.

**11** "'The Lord GOD says this: The sword of the king of Babylon will attack you.

**12** I will use the swords of strong soldiers to kill your crowds of people. All of them are the most cruel of the nations. They will destroy the pride of Egypt and kill all her crowds of people.

**13** I will kill all her animals beside the large rivers. The feet of people and the hoofs of animals will not stir the water again.

**14** Then I will make her water clear. I will make her rivers flow smoothly like oil, says the Lord GOD.

**15** I will make the land of Egypt empty. I will remove all that is in it. I will kill all the people who live there. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'

**16** This is the sad song that people will sing about her. The women of the nations will sing it. They will sing it about Egypt and all her crowds of people, says the Lord GOD."

**17** In the 12th year, on the 15th day of the month, the word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**18** "Son of man, cry for the crowds of Egypt. Send them and the women of strong nations down to the world of the dead, with the people who go down to the pit.

**19** Say to them, 'Do you think that you are more beautiful than other people? Go down and lie among the uncircumcised people.'

**20** The Egyptians will fall among the people whom the enemy killed with the sword. The sword is ready. Pull Egypt and all her crowds away.

**21** In the world of the dead, the strong leaders will speak to Pharaoh and his allies. They will say, 'They came down. They lie with the uncircumcised people whom the enemy killed with the sword.'

**22** "Assyria is there with all her army. Their graves are around their king. All of them died. The enemy killed them with the sword.

**23** Their graves are in the deepest part of the pit. Her army is around her grave. All of them died by the sword. They caused terror in the land of the people who are alive.

**24** "Elam is there with all her crowds of people around her grave. All of them died by the sword. They went down uncircumcised to the world of the dead. They caused terror in the land of the people who are alive. Now they feel their shame with the people who go down to the pit.

**25** They made a bed for Elam among the dead people, with all her crowds of people. Their graves are around her king. None of them received circumcision. The enemy killed them with the sword. They caused terror in the land of the people who are alive. Now they feel their shame with the people who go down to the pit. They lie among the dead people.

**26** "Meshech and Tubal are there with all their crowds of people. Their graves are around their king. None of them received circumcision. The enemy killed them with the sword. They caused terror in the land of the people who are alive.

**27** They do not lie with the famous soldiers of ancient times who died. Those soldiers went down to the world of the dead with their weapons. People put their swords under their heads and their shields over their bones. Those soldiers caused terror in the land of the people who are alive.

**28** "Pharaoh, I will also break you among the uncircumcised people. You will lie with the people whom the enemy killed with the sword.

**29** "Edom is there with her kings and all her princes. They were powerful, but now they lie with the people whom the enemy killed with the sword. They lie with the uncircumcised people and with the people who go down to the pit.

**30** "All the princes of the north and all the people of Sidon are there. They went down with the dead people. They caused terror with their power, but now they feel shame. They lie uncircumcised with the people whom the enemy killed with the sword. They feel their shame with the people who go down to the pit.

**31** "Pharaoh will see them. He will feel comfort because his crowds of people are not alone. Pharaoh and all his army will die by the sword, says the Lord GOD.

**32** I let Pharaoh cause terror in the land of the people who are alive. But Pharaoh and all his crowds of people will lie among the uncircumcised people. They will lie with the people whom the enemy killed with the sword, says the Lord GOD."

## Chapter 33

**1** The word of the LORD came to me again. He said,

**2** "Son of man, speak to your people. Tell them, 'Possibly I will bring a sword against a land. The people of the land choose one of their men and make him their guard.

**3** The guard sees the sword come against the land. He blows the trumpet to warn the people.

**4** Then a person hears the sound of the trumpet but does not obey the alarm. The sword comes and kills him. He is responsible for his death.

**5** He heard the sound of the trumpet, but he did not obey the alarm. Thus he is responsible for his death. If he obeys the alarm, then he will save his life.

**6** But possibly the guard sees the sword come and he does not blow the trumpet. Thus the people get no alarm. Then the sword comes and kills one of them. That person dies because of his sin. But I will make the guard responsible for his death.'

**7** "Son of man, I made you a guard for the people of Israel. When you hear a word from my mouth, tell them about the danger from me.

**8** Possibly I say to a wicked person, 'Wicked person, you will surely die.' But you do not speak to warn him to stop his wicked ways. Then that wicked person will die because of his sin. But I will make you responsible for his death.

**9** But possibly you warn the wicked person to stop his wicked ways, and he does not stop. Then he will die because of his sin. But you will save your life.

**10** "Son of man, speak to the people of Israel. Tell them, 'You say this: "Our sins and our wrong actions are heavy on us. We become weak because of them. How can we live?"'

**11** Tell them, 'As surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, I do not like to see the death of a wicked person. I want the wicked person to stop his bad ways and live. Stop! Stop your bad ways! People of Israel, why do you want to die?'

**12** "Son of man, tell your people, 'If a righteous person sins, his righteous actions will not save him. If a wicked person stops his wicked actions, his wicked actions will not cause his death. If a righteous person sins, he will not live because of his righteous actions.'

**13** I can tell a righteous person that he will surely live. But possibly he trusts in his righteous actions and starts to sin. Then I will not remember any of his righteous actions. He will die because of the sin that he did.

**14** I can tell a wicked person, 'You will surely die.' But possibly he stops his sin and does what is fair and correct.

**15** He gives back what a borrower gave him as a guarantee. He gives back what he stole. He obeys the laws that give life, and he does not sin. Then he will surely live. He will not die.

**16** I will not remember any of the sins that he did. He does what is fair and correct. He will surely live.

**17** "But your people say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' But it is their way that is not fair.

**18** If a righteous person stops his righteous actions and starts to sin, then he will die because of his sin.

**19** If a wicked person stops his wicked actions and does what is fair and correct, then he will live because of that.

**20** But you say, 'The way of the Lord is not fair.' People of Israel, I will judge each of you by your ways."

**21** In the 12th year of our exile, in the 10th month, on the 5th day of the month, a man came to me. He escaped from Jerusalem. He said, "The enemy captured the city!"

**22** On the evening before the man came, the power of the LORD was on me. The LORD opened my mouth before the man came to me in the morning. Thus my mouth was open, and I was not silent again.

**23** Then the word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**24** "Son of man, the people who live in the destroyed towns in the land of Israel say this. 'Abraham was only one man, but he got the land as his property. We are many people. Surely the land is ours as our property.'

**25** Thus tell them, 'The Lord GOD says this: You eat meat that still has blood in it. You worship your idols. You kill people. Will you get the land as your property?

**26** You trust in your swords. You do hateful things. Each of you has sex with the wife of his neighbor. Will you get the land as your property?'

**27** "Tell them, 'The Lord GOD says this: As surely as I live, the people who live in the destroyed towns will die by the sword. I will give the people in the open field to the wild animals as food. The people in the strong places and in the caves will die of disease.

**28** I will make the land completely empty. Its proud strength will come to an end. The mountains of Israel will be empty, and no person will go through them.

**29** I will make the land completely empty because of all the hateful things that they did. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'

**30** "Son of man, your people talk about you near the walls and at the doors of their houses. They say to each other, 'Come and hear the message that comes from the LORD.'

**31** They come to you as people usually come. They sit in front of you as my people. They hear your words, but they do not obey them. They speak words of love, but their hearts want only money.

**32** To them you are only a singer who sings love songs with a beautiful voice. You are like a person who plays an instrument well. They hear your words, but they do not obey them.

**33** But the things that you say will surely occur. When they occur, the people will know that a prophet was among them."

## Chapter 34

**1** The word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**2** "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and tell them, 'The Lord GOD says this to the shepherds: Trouble will come to the shepherds of Israel! They only feed themselves. Shepherds must feed the sheep!

**3** You eat the fat and you wear clothes of wool. You kill the best sheep. But you do not feed the sheep.

**4** You do not make the weak sheep strong. You do not heal the sick sheep. You do not put bandages on the injured sheep. You do not bring back the sheep that went away. You do not look for the lost sheep. You rule the sheep with force and cruelty.

**5** The sheep went away in all directions because they had no shepherd. When they went away, the wild animals ate them.

**6** My sheep went across all the mountains and on each high hill. My sheep went away across all the earth. No person looked for them.

**7** "'Thus, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD.

**8** As surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, my sheep had no shepherd. Thus the wild animals caught them and ate them. My shepherds did not look for my sheep. The shepherds fed themselves, but they did not feed my sheep.

**9** Thus, you shepherds, hear the word of the LORD.

**10** The Lord GOD says this: I am against the shepherds. I will make them responsible for my sheep. I will stop them as shepherds of my sheep. The shepherds will not feed themselves again. I will save my sheep from their mouths. My sheep will not be their food again.

**11** "'The Lord GOD says this: I myself will look for my sheep and find them.

**12** A shepherd looks for his sheep when they go away in all directions. In the same way, I will look for my sheep. I will save them from all the places where they went on the dark day of clouds.

**13** I will bring them out from the nations and gather them from the countries. I will bring them into their own land. I will feed them on the mountains of Israel, near the streams, and in all the places where people live in the land.

**14** I will feed them in good fields. They will have the place where they rest on the high mountains of Israel. There they will lie down in good places. They will eat in rich fields on the mountains of Israel.

**15** I myself will feed my sheep and let them rest, says the Lord GOD.

**16** I will look for the lost sheep. I will bring back the sheep that went away. I will put bandages on the injured sheep. I will make the sick sheep strong. But I will destroy the fat and strong sheep. I will feed them with justice.

**17** "'My sheep, the Lord GOD says this to you: I will judge between one sheep and another sheep, between the rams and the male goats.

**18** You eat the good grass. Is that not sufficient for you? Why do you also walk on the other grass? You drink the clear water. Is that not sufficient for you? Why do you also make the other water dirty with your feet?

**19** My other sheep must eat the grass that you walked on. They must drink the water that you made dirty with your feet.

**20** "'Thus the Lord GOD says this to them: I myself will judge between the fat sheep and the thin sheep.

**21** You push with your sides and your shoulders. You push all the weak sheep with your horns until you push them away.

**22** Thus I will save my sheep. Other animals will not catch them again. I will judge between one sheep and another sheep.

**23** I will put one shepherd over them, my servant David. He will feed them. He will be their shepherd.

**24** I, the LORD, will be their God, and my servant David will be a prince among them. I, the LORD, spoke.

**25** "'I will make an agreement (covenant) of peace with them. I will remove the dangerous wild animals from the land. Then my sheep can live safely in the desert and sleep in the forests.

**26** I will bless them and the places around my hill. I will send rain at the correct time. The rain will be a blessing.

**27** The trees in the field will give their fruit. The ground will give its crops. The people will be safe in their land. I will break the chains on their necks. I will save them from the people who made them slaves. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

**28** The nations will not take them away again. The wild animals will not eat them. They will live safely, and no person will cause them fear.

**29** I will give them a land that is famous for its crops. They will not be hungry in the land again. The nations will not insult them again.

**30** Then they will know that I, the LORD their God, am with them. They will know that they, the people of Israel, are my people, says the Lord GOD.

**31** You are my sheep, the sheep in my fields. You are people, and I am your God, says the Lord GOD.'"

## Chapter 35

**1** The word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**2** "Son of man, turn your face toward Mount Seir and prophesy against it.

**3** Tell it, 'The Lord GOD says this: I am against you, Mount Seir. I will put out my hand against you. I will make you completely empty.

**4** I will destroy your cities, and you will become empty. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

**5** "'You always hated the people of Israel. When they had trouble, you let the sword kill them. That was the time of their final punishment.

**6** Thus, as surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, I will cause you to die. Death will follow you. You did not hate murder. Thus death will follow you.

**7** I will make Mount Seir completely empty. I will kill all the people who go out and come back.

**8** I will fill its mountains with dead bodies. People will die by the sword on your hills, in your valleys and in all your streams.

**9** I will make you empty for all time. No people will live in your cities again. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

**10** "'You said, "These 2 nations, Israel and Judah, and their lands will be ours. We will take them as our property." But the LORD was there.

**11** Thus, as surely as I live, says the Lord GOD, I will punish you as your anger and your jealousy deserve. You showed your anger and jealousy because you hated my people. I will show who I am to my people when I judge you.

**12** Then you will know that I, the LORD, heard all your insults against the mountains of Israel. You said, "The mountains are ruins. They are ours to eat."

**13** You said proud words against me. You said many words against me. I heard them.

**14** The Lord GOD says this: All the earth will be happy when I make you empty.

**15** You were happy when the land of the people of Israel became empty. I will do the same to you. Mount Seir and all Edom, you will become empty. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"

## Chapter 36

**1** "Son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel. Say, 'Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.

**2** The Lord GOD says this: The enemy said about you, "Aha! The ancient high places are now ours."

**3** Thus prophesy and say, 'The Lord GOD says this: The enemy destroyed you and attacked you from all directions. The other nations took you as their property. People talk about you and insult you.

**4** Thus, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD. The Lord GOD says this to the mountains and the hills, to the streams and the valleys. He speaks to the destroyed places and to the empty cities. The other nations around you stole from you and laughed at you.

**5** Thus the Lord GOD says this: In my jealous anger I spoke against the other nations and against all Edom. They were very happy to take my land as their property. They had hate in their hearts. They took the fields of my land for themselves.

**6** "'Thus prophesy about the land of Israel. Tell the mountains and the hills, the streams and the valleys, "The Lord GOD says this. I speak in my jealous anger because the nations insulted you.

**7** Thus the Lord GOD says this: I lifted my hand and made a promise. The nations around you will also feel shame.

**8** "'"But you, mountains of Israel, will grow branches and give fruit for my people Israel. They will come home soon.

**9** I will help you. I will turn to you. People will plow you and plant seeds in you.

**10** I will cause the number of people in you to increase, all the people of Israel. People will live in the cities again. They will build the destroyed places again.

**11** I will cause the number of people and animals in you to increase. They will increase and have many children. I will let people live in you as in the past. I will make you more wealthy than before. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

**12** I will cause people, my people Israel, to walk on you. They will own you, and you will be their property. You will not take away their children again.

**13** "'"The Lord GOD says this: People say to you, 'You are a land that eats people. You take away the children of your nation.'

**14** But you will not eat people again. You will not take away the children of your nation again, says the Lord GOD.

**15** I will not let the nations insult you again. The people will not shame you again. You will not cause your nation to fall again, says the Lord GOD."'"

**16** The word of the LORD came to me again. He said,

**17** "Son of man, when the people of Israel lived in their own land, they made it unclean with their ways and their actions. In my view, their ways were like the uncleanness of a woman during her monthly period.

**18** Thus I poured out my anger on them. They killed people in the land and they made the land unclean with their idols.

**19** I scattered them among the nations, and they went through the countries. I judged them by their ways and their actions.

**20** But in each nation where they went, they dishonored my holy name. People said about them, 'These are the people of the LORD, but they had to leave his land.'

**21** I wanted to protect my holy name. The people of Israel dishonored my name among the nations where they went.

**22** "Thus tell the people of Israel, 'The Lord GOD says this: People of Israel, I do not do these things for you. I do them for my holy name, which you dishonored among the nations where you went.

**23** I will show that my great name is holy. You dishonored my name among the nations. When I show that I am holy through you, the nations will see it. Then they will know that I am the LORD, says the Lord GOD.

**24** "'I will take you from the nations. I will gather you from all the countries. I will bring you into your own land.

**25** I will put clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will make you clean from all your uncleanness and from all your idols.

**26** I will give you a new heart. I will put a new spirit in you. I will remove your hard heart, which is like stone. I will give you a soft heart that obeys.

**27** I will put my Spirit in you. I will cause you to obey my laws and carefully keep my rules.

**28** You will live in the land that I gave to your ancestors. You will be my people, and I will be your God.

**29** I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will make the grain grow well. I will not send famine on you.

**30** I will cause the trees to give more fruit and the fields to give more crops. Then the nations will not insult you again because of famine.

**31** Then you will remember your bad ways and your actions that were not good. You will hate yourselves because of your sins and your hateful actions.

**32** Know this: I do not do these things for you, says the Lord GOD. People of Israel, feel shame and confusion because of your ways!

**33** "'The Lord GOD says this: I will make you clean from all your sins. On that day I will let you live in your cities again. People will build the destroyed places again.

**34** People will plow the empty land again. In the past, all the people who went past saw that the land was empty.

**35** They will say, "This land was empty, but now it is like the garden of Eden. The cities were in ruins and empty, but now they have strong walls and people live in them."

**36** Then the nations around you that stay alive will know that I, the LORD, built the destroyed places again. They will know that I planted the empty land. I, the LORD, spoke, and I will do it.'

**37** "The Lord GOD says this: 'I will let the people of Israel ask me again to help them. I will make their people as many as the sheep of a flock.

**38** At the holy festivals, Jerusalem is full of flocks of sheep for sacrifices. In the same way, the destroyed cities will be full of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"

## Chapter 37

**1** The power of the LORD was on me. The Spirit of the LORD took me out and put me down in the middle of a valley. The valley was full of bones.

**2** He made me walk around among the bones. There were very many bones on the floor of the valley, and they were very dry.

**3** He asked me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" I said, "Lord GOD, only you know."

**4** Then he said to me, "Prophesy to these bones. Tell them, 'Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.

**5** The Lord GOD says this to these bones: I will put breath into you, and you will live.

**6** I will put tendons on you. I will cause flesh to grow on you and cover you with skin. I will put breath in you, and you will live. Then you will know that I am the LORD.'"

**7** Thus I prophesied as he told me. While I prophesied, there was a noise, a sound like a rattle. The bones came together, each bone to its bone.

**8** I looked, and I saw tendons and flesh on the bones. Skin covered them. But there was no breath in them.

**9** Then he said to me, "Prophesy to the breath. Prophesy, son of man, and tell the breath, 'The Lord GOD says this: Breath, come from the 4 winds. Blow into these dead people, so that they live.'"

**10** Thus I prophesied as he told me. The breath came into them, and they became alive. They stood up on their feet. They were a very large army.

**11** Then he said to me, "Son of man, these bones are all the people of Israel. They say, 'Our bones are dry. We have no hope. Our end is here.'

**12** Thus prophesy and tell them, 'The Lord GOD says this: My people, I will open your graves. I will bring you up out of your graves. I will bring you into the land of Israel.

**13** My people, I will open your graves and bring you up out of them. Then you will know that I am the LORD.

**14** I will put my Spirit in you, and you will live. I will put you in your own land. Then you will know that I, the LORD, spoke, and I did it, says the LORD.'"

**15** The word of the LORD came to me again. He said,

**16** "Son of man, take a stick and write on it, 'For Judah and the people of Israel who are with him.' Then take another stick and write on it, 'For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and all the people of Israel who are with him.'

**17** Hold the 2 sticks together in your hand so that they become one stick.

**18** Your people will ask you, 'Tell us the meaning of these things.'

**19** Then tell them, 'The Lord GOD says this: I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim. I will take the tribes of Israel who are with him. I will put them together with the stick of Judah. I will make them one stick. They will be one in my hand.'

**20** Hold the sticks that you wrote on in your hand, where the people can see them.

**21** Tell them, 'The Lord GOD says this: I will take the people of Israel from the nations where they went. I will gather them from all directions. I will bring them into their own land.

**22** I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel. One king will rule all of them. They will not be 2 nations again. They will not separate into 2 kingdoms again.

**23** They will not make themselves unclean again with their idols, their filthy things or their sins. I will save them from all the places where they sinned. I will make them clean. They will be my people, and I will be their God.

**24** "'My servant David will be king over them. They will all have one shepherd. They will obey my rules and carefully keep my laws.

**25** They will live in the land that I gave to my servant Jacob, where your ancestors lived. They, their children and their grandchildren will live there for all time. My servant David will be their prince for all time.

**26** I will make an agreement (covenant) of peace with them. It will be a covenant that continues for all time. I will put them in their land and cause their number to increase. I will put my sanctuary among them for all time.

**27** My home will be with them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

**28** My sanctuary will be among them for all time. Then the nations will know that I, the LORD, make Israel holy.'"

## Chapter 38

**1** The word of the LORD came to me. He said,

**2** "Son of man, turn your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog. He is the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal. Prophesy against him.

**3** Say, 'The Lord GOD says this: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.

**4** I will turn you around. I will put hooks in your jaws. I will bring you out with all your army, your horses and your horsemen. All of them wear full armor. It is a large army with large shields and small shields. All of them hold swords.

**5** Persia, Ethiopia and Put are with them. All of them have shields and helmets.

**6** Gomer and all its soldiers are with them. Beth Togarmah from the far north and all its soldiers are with them. Many nations are with you.

**7** "'Be ready! Make yourself ready, you and all the armies that are with you. Be their commander.

**8** After many days I will call you. In the last years you will attack a land that recovered from war. Its people came back from many nations to the mountains of Israel. Those mountains were empty for a long time. The people came out of the nations, and now all of them live safely.

**9** You will come like a storm. You will cover the land like a cloud. You, all your soldiers and many nations with you will come.

**10** "'The Lord GOD says this: On that day, thoughts will come into your mind. You will make a wicked plan.

**11** You will say, "I will attack a land of villages with no walls. I will attack people who are calm and live safely. All of them live in villages with no walls, gates or bars.

**12** I will take their goods and steal their wealth. I will attack the places that were empty but now have people in them. I will attack the people who came back from the nations. They have animals and goods. They live at the center of the world."

**13** Sheba, Dedan, the merchants of Tarshish and all its towns will say to you, "Did you come to take goods? Did you gather your army to steal? Do you want to carry away silver and gold, animals and goods? Do you want to take much wealth?"'

**14** "Thus, son of man, prophesy and tell Gog, 'The Lord GOD says this: On that day my people Israel will live safely. You will know that.

**15** You will come from your place in the far north. Many nations will come with you. All of them will ride horses. You will be a large group and a strong army.

**16** You will attack my people Israel like a cloud that covers the land. In the last days I will bring you against my land. Gog, I will show that I am holy through you while the nations watch. Then the nations will know me.

**17** "'The Lord GOD says this: You are the person that I spoke about in the past. I spoke through my servants, the prophets of Israel. For many years they prophesied that I will bring you against Israel.

**18** On the day that Gog attacks the land of Israel, I will become very angry, says the Lord GOD.

**19** In my jealousy and my hot anger I say this: On that day there will be a large earthquake in the land of Israel.

**20** The fish in the sea, the birds in the sky and the wild animals will shake in my presence. All the small animals that move on the ground will shake. All the people on the earth will shake in my presence. The mountains will fall. The cliffs will fall. Each wall will fall to the ground.

**21** I will bring a sword against Gog on all my mountains, says the Lord GOD. Each man will use his sword against his brother.

**22** I will punish Gog with disease and with blood. I will send heavy rain, large hailstones, fire and sulfur on him. They will fall on his soldiers and on the many nations with him.

**23** Thus I will show that I am great and holy. I will make myself known to many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"

## Chapter 39

**1** "Son of man, prophesy against Gog. Say, 'The Lord GOD says this: I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.

**2** I will turn you around and lead you. I will bring you from the far north. I will bring you against the mountains of Israel.

**3** Then I will hit your bow out of your left hand. I will make your arrows fall from your right hand.

**4** You will die on the mountains of Israel, you, all your soldiers and the nations with you. I will give you as food to all types of birds that eat meat and to the wild animals.

**5** You will die in the open field. I spoke, says the Lord GOD.

**6** I will send fire on Magog and on the people who live safely on the coasts. Then they will know that I am the LORD.

**7** "'I will make my holy name known among my people Israel. I will not let people dishonor my holy name again. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.

**8** It comes! It will surely occur, says the Lord GOD. This is the day that I spoke about.

**9** "'Then the people who live in the cities of Israel will go out. They will start fires with the weapons and burn them. They will burn the small shields and the large shields, the bows and the arrows, the clubs and the spears. They will use them as fuel for 7 years.

**10** They will not need to get wood from the fields or cut down trees in the forests. They will burn the weapons as fuel. They will take goods from the people who took their goods. They will steal from the people who stole from them, says the Lord GOD.

**11** "'On that day I will give Gog a place for graves in Israel. It is the valley of the travelers, east of the sea. The graves will block the road of the travelers. There the people will bury Gog and all his army. They will call it the Valley of Hamon Gog (the army of Gog).

**12** The people of Israel will bury them for 7 months to make the land clean.

**13** All the people of the land will bury them. On the day that I show my glory, the people of Israel will become famous because of this, says the Lord GOD.

**14** "'The people will choose men who will work all the time to make the land clean. Some men will go through the land. Others will bury the bodies that stay on the ground. After 7 months they will start to search.

**15** The men will go through the land. When one of them sees a human bone, he will put a marker near it. Then the men who bury the dead will bury the bone in the Valley of Hamon Gog.

**16** There will also be a city with the name Hamonah. Thus they will make the land clean.'

**17** "Son of man, the Lord GOD says this: 'Speak to all types of birds and to all the wild animals. Tell them, "Gather and come! Come from all directions to my sacrifice. I will make a large sacrifice for you on the mountains of Israel. There you will eat flesh and drink blood.

**18** You will eat the flesh of strong soldiers and drink the blood of the rulers of the earth. They will be like rams, lambs, goats and bulls, all of them fat animals from Bashan.

**19** You will eat fat until you are full. You will drink blood until you are drunk. It will be at the sacrifice that I make for you.

**20** At my table you will eat until you are full. You will eat horses and riders, strong soldiers and all types of fighters, says the Lord GOD."'

**21** "I will show my glory among the nations. All the nations will see how I punish them with my power.

**22** From that day, the people of Israel will know that I am the LORD their God.

**23** The nations will know that the people of Israel went into exile because of their sins. They were not loyal to me. Thus I turned away from them. I gave them to their enemies, and all of them died by the sword.

**24** I punished them as their uncleanness and their sins deserved. I turned away from them.

**25** "Thus the Lord GOD says this: 'Now I will make the people of Jacob wealthy again. I will show mercy to all the people of Israel. I will protect my holy name.

**26** They will forget their shame and all the times when they were not loyal to me. They will live safely in their land, and no person will cause them fear.

**27** I will bring them back from the nations. I will gather them from the lands of their enemies. Many nations will see that I am holy through them.

**28** Then they will know that I am the LORD their God. I sent them into exile among the nations. But I will gather them into their own land. I will not leave any of them among the nations.

**29** I will not turn away from them again. I will pour out my Spirit on the people of Israel, says the Lord GOD.'"

## Chapter 40

**1** It was the 25th year of our exile and the 14th year after the enemy captured Jerusalem. It was at the start of the year, on the 10th day of the month. On that same day the power of the LORD was on me, and he brought me to Jerusalem.

**2** In visions from God he brought me into the land of Israel. He put me on a very high mountain. On the south side of the mountain there were buildings that looked like a city.

**3** He brought me there, and I saw a man. He looked like bronze. He had a rope of linen and a rod for measurement in his hand. He stood in the gate.

**4** The man said to me, "Son of man, look carefully and listen carefully. Pay attention to all that I will show you. That is why God brought you here. Tell the people of Israel all that you see."

**5** I saw a wall around the outside of the temple area. The man had a rod for measurement in his hand. The rod was 6 long cubits (each cubit was a normal cubit plus the width of a hand). He measured the wall. It was 1 rod thick and 1 rod high.

**6** Then he went to the gate that faced east. He went up its steps. He measured the threshold of the gate. It was 1 rod deep.

**7** Each guard room was 1 rod long and 1 rod wide. The walls between the guard rooms were 5 cubits thick. The threshold of the gate next to the porch, on the inner side, was 1 rod deep.

**8** He measured the porch of the gate on the inner side. It was 1 rod deep.

**9** He measured the porch of the gate. It was 8 cubits deep. Its posts were 2 cubits thick. The porch of the gate faced the temple.

**10** There were 3 guard rooms on each side of the east gate. All 3 had the same measurements. The posts on each side also had the same measurements.

**11** He measured the width of the entrance of the gate. It was 10 cubits. The length of the gate was 13 cubits.

**12** In front of each guard room there was a low wall 1 cubit high. The guard rooms were 6 cubits on each side.

**13** He measured the gate from the back wall of one guard room to the back wall of the opposite guard room. The distance was 25 cubits from one door to the opposite door.

**14** He measured the posts. They were 60 cubits. The courtyard was around the gate, up to the posts.

**15** The distance from the front of the entrance gate to the front of the inner porch of the gate was 50 cubits.

**16** The guard rooms and their posts had narrow windows on all sides of the gate. The porches also had windows on all sides. There were decorations of palm trees on each post.

**17** Then he brought me into the outer courtyard. I saw rooms and a stone floor around the courtyard. There were 30 rooms next to the stone floor.

**18** The stone floor was next to the gates. It was as long as the gates were deep. This was the lower stone floor.

**19** He measured the distance from the inner front of the lower gate to the outer front of the inner courtyard. It was 100 cubits on the east side and on the north side.

**20** Then he measured the length and the width of the gate of the outer courtyard that faced north.

**21** It had 3 guard rooms on each side. Its posts and its porch had the same measurements as the first gate. It was 50 cubits long and 25 cubits wide.

**22** Its windows, its porch and its palm trees had the same measurements as the gate that faced east. People went up to it on 7 steps. Its porch was at the top of the steps.

**23** There was a gate to the inner courtyard opposite the north gate, as at the east gate. He measured the distance from gate to gate. It was 100 cubits.

**24** Then he brought me to the south side. I saw a gate that faced south. He measured its posts and its porch. They had the same measurements as the other gates.

**25** The gate and its porch had windows on all sides, like the other windows. The gate was 50 cubits long and 25 cubits wide.

**26** It had 7 steps up to it. Its porch was at the top of the steps. There were decorations of palm trees on its posts, one on each side.

**27** The inner courtyard also had a gate that faced south. He measured from this gate to the outer gate on the south side. The distance was 100 cubits.
