**28** Then he brought me into the inner courtyard through the south gate. He measured the south gate. It had the same measurements as the other gates.

**29** Its guard rooms, its posts and its porch had the same measurements as the other gates. The gate and its porch had windows on all sides. The gate was 50 cubits long and 25 cubits wide.

**30** The porches around the inner courtyard were 25 cubits long and 5 cubits wide.

**31** Its porch faced the outer courtyard. There were decorations of palm trees on its posts. It had 8 steps up to it.

**32** Then he brought me into the inner courtyard on the east side. He measured the gate. It had the same measurements as the other gates.

**33** Its guard rooms, its posts and its porch had the same measurements as the other gates. The gate and its porch had windows on all sides. The gate was 50 cubits long and 25 cubits wide.

**34** Its porch faced the outer courtyard. There were decorations of palm trees on its posts on each side. It had 8 steps up to it.

**35** Then he brought me to the north gate. He measured it. It had the same measurements as the other gates.

**36** It had guard rooms, posts, a porch and windows on all sides. The gate was 50 cubits long and 25 cubits wide.

**37** Its posts faced the outer courtyard. There were decorations of palm trees on its posts on each side. It had 8 steps up to it.

**38** There was a room with a door near the posts of the gates. In that room the priests washed the burnt offerings.

**39** In the porch of the gate there were 2 tables on each side. On these tables the priests killed the animals for the burnt offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings.

**40** Outside the porch, near the entrance of the north gate, there were 2 tables. On the other side of the porch of the gate there were 2 tables.

**41** Thus there were 4 tables on each side of the gate, a total of 8 tables. On these tables the priests killed the animals for the sacrifices.

**42** There were also 4 tables of cut stone for the burnt offerings. Each table was 1.5 cubits long, 1.5 cubits wide and 1 cubit high. On these tables the priests put the tools that they used to kill the animals for the burnt offerings and the sacrifices.

**43** There were hooks around the walls. Each hook was the width of a hand. The meat of the offerings went on the tables.

**44** Outside the inner gate, in the inner courtyard, there were rooms for the singers. One room was at the side of the north gate and faced south. Another room was at the side of the east gate and faced north.

**45** The man said to me, "The room that faces south is for the priests who take care of the temple.

**46** The room that faces north is for the priests who take care of the altar. These priests are the sons of Zadok. They are the only Levites who can come near to the LORD to serve him."

**47** Then he measured the inner courtyard. It was square, 100 cubits long and 100 cubits wide. The altar was in front of the temple.

**48** He brought me to the porch of the temple. He measured the posts of the porch. They were 5 cubits thick on each side. The side walls of the gate were 3 cubits wide on each side.

**49** The porch was 20 cubits long and 11 cubits wide. People went up to it on steps. There were pillars beside the posts, one on each side.

## Chapter 41

**1** Then the man brought me to the main hall of the temple. He measured the posts. They were 6 cubits wide on each side. That was the width of the tent (tabernacle).

**2** The entrance was 10 cubits wide. The walls on each side of the entrance were 5 cubits wide. He measured the main hall. It was 40 cubits long and 20 cubits wide.

**3** Then he went into the inner room. He measured the posts of the entrance. Each post was 2 cubits thick. The entrance was 6 cubits wide. The walls on each side of the entrance were 7 cubits wide.

**4** He measured the inner room. It was 20 cubits long and 20 cubits wide. It was at the end of the main hall. He said to me, "This is the Most Holy Place."

**5** Then he measured the wall of the temple. It was 6 cubits thick. Each side room around the temple was 4 cubits wide.

**6** The side rooms were on 3 levels, one above the other. There were 30 rooms on each level. The wall of the temple had ledges for the side rooms. Thus the beams of the side rooms did not go into the wall of the temple.

**7** The side rooms around the temple became wider on each higher level. A stairway went up from the lowest level to the highest level through the middle level.

**8** I saw that the temple had a raised base around it. This base was the foundation of the side rooms. It was 1 full rod high, 6 long cubits.

**9** The outer wall of the side rooms was 5 cubits thick. The area inside this wall was the open area next to the side rooms.

**10** Between the side rooms and the rooms of the priests there was an open area. It was 20 cubits wide on all sides of the temple.

**11** The side rooms had doors to the open area. One door faced north and another door faced south. The open area was 5 cubits wide on all sides.

**12** There was a building on the west side, in front of the temple courtyard. It was 70 cubits wide. Its wall was 5 cubits thick on all sides. The building was 90 cubits long.

**13** Then he measured the temple. It was 100 cubits long. The courtyard, the building and its walls were also 100 cubits long.

**14** The east front of the temple and the courtyard was 100 cubits wide.

**15** He measured the length of the building behind the temple courtyard on the west side, with its galleries on each side. It was 100 cubits. He also measured the main hall, the inner room and the porches of the courtyard.

**16** These had door posts, narrow windows and galleries on 3 levels. Wood covered the walls around the doors, from the floor up to the windows. The windows had covers.

**17** The walls above the door, the walls of the inner room and the walls outside had decorations with exact measurements.

**18** There were decorations of cherubim (angels) and palm trees. There was a palm tree between each 2 cherubim. Each cherub had 2 faces.

**19** The face of a man looked at the palm tree on one side. The face of a young lion looked at the palm tree on the other side. These decorations were on all the walls of the temple.

**20** The cherubim and palm trees were on the wall of the main hall, from the floor to above the door.

**21** The door posts of the main hall were square. The front of the Most Holy Place looked the same.

**22** There was an altar of wood. It was 3 cubits high and 2 cubits long. Its corners, its base and its sides were of wood. The man said to me, "This is the table that is in front of the LORD."

**23** The main hall and the Most Holy Place each had a double door.

**24** Each door had 2 parts that turned. Each of the 2 doors had 2 parts.

**25** There were cherubim and palm trees on the doors of the main hall, like the decorations on the walls. There was a wood roof over the front of the porch outside.

**26** There were narrow windows and palm trees on each side of the porch. The side rooms of the temple also had wood roofs.

## Chapter 42

**1** Then the man brought me out into the outer courtyard, toward the north. He brought me to the rooms opposite the temple courtyard and opposite the building on the north side.

**2** The building with the north door was 100 cubits long and 50 cubits wide.

**3** The building was between the 20 cubits of the inner courtyard and the stone floor of the outer courtyard. It had galleries on 3 levels, one opposite the other.

**4** In front of the rooms there was a path on the inner side. It was 10 cubits wide and 100 cubits long. The doors of the rooms faced north.

**5** The rooms on the top level were narrower than the rooms on the lower and middle levels. The galleries took more space from the top rooms.

**6** The rooms were on 3 levels, but they had no pillars as the courtyards had. Thus the top rooms were smaller than the rooms on the lower and middle levels.

**7** There was an outer wall parallel to the rooms, next to the outer courtyard. It was 50 cubits long.

**8** The row of rooms next to the outer courtyard was 50 cubits long. The row of rooms that faced the temple was 100 cubits long.

**9** Below these rooms there was an entrance on the east side. People came into the rooms from the outer courtyard through this entrance.

**10** There were also rooms on the south side, along the wall of the courtyard. They were opposite the temple courtyard and opposite the building.

**11** There was a path in front of them. These rooms looked the same as the rooms on the north side. They had the same length and width. Their exits and their doors were the same.

**12** The doors of the rooms on the south side were the same. There was a door at the start of the path, next to the wall on the east side. People went into the rooms through it.

**13** Then the man said to me, "The north rooms and the south rooms in front of the temple courtyard are holy rooms. In these rooms the priests who come near to the LORD will eat the most holy offerings. There they will put the most holy offerings: the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings. The place is holy.

**14** When the priests go into the holy place, they must not go out into the outer courtyard in the clothes that they wear to serve. They must leave those clothes in these rooms, because the clothes are holy. They must put on other clothes before they go near the areas for the people."

**15** The man finished the measurement of the inner temple area. Then he brought me out through the gate that faced east. He measured the area around the temple.

**16** He measured the east side with the rod for measurement. It was 500 rods.

**17** He measured the north side. It was 500 rods.

**18** He measured the south side. It was 500 rods.

**19** He turned to the west side and measured it. It was 500 rods.

**20** Thus he measured the area on all 4 sides. A wall went around it. The wall was 500 rods long and 500 rods wide. The wall separated the holy area from the common area.

## Chapter 43

**1** Then the man brought me to the gate that faced east.

**2** I saw the glory of the God of Israel. It came from the east. His voice was like the noise of much water. The land was bright with his glory.

**3** This vision was the same as the vision that I saw when he came to destroy the city. It was also the same as the vision that I saw near the Kebar River. I fell down with my face to the ground.

**4** The glory of the LORD came into the temple through the gate that faced east.

**5** Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the inner courtyard. I saw that the glory of the LORD filled the temple.

**6** The man stood next to me. Then I heard a voice that spoke to me from the temple.

**7** The voice said, "Son of man, this is the place of my throne and the place where I put my feet. I will live here among the people of Israel for all time. The people of Israel and their kings will not dishonor my holy name again. They will not do it with their prostitution or with the dead bodies of their kings at their high places.

**8** They put their thresholds next to my threshold. They put their door posts next to my door posts. Only a wall was between me and them. They dishonored my holy name with their filthy actions. Thus I destroyed them in my anger.

**9** Now they must remove their prostitution and the dead bodies of their kings far from me. Then I will live among them for all time.

**10** "Son of man, describe the temple to the people of Israel. Then they will feel shame because of their sins. Let them examine the plan of the temple.

**11** If they feel shame for all that they did, then show them the design of the temple. Show them its plan, its exits and its entrances. Show them all its designs, its rules and its laws. Write these things down while they watch. Then they can obey all its design and all its rules.

**12** "This is the law of the temple: All the area around the top of the mountain will be most holy. This is the law of the temple.

**13** "These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits. Each long cubit is a normal cubit plus the width of a hand. The gutter around the base is 1 cubit deep and 1 cubit wide. The edge around it is 1 span (half a cubit) high. This is the base of the altar.

**14** From the gutter on the ground up to the lower ledge, the altar is 2 cubits high. The lower ledge is 1 cubit wide. From the lower ledge up to the upper ledge, the altar is 4 cubits high. The upper ledge is 1 cubit wide.

**15** The hearth of the altar is 4 cubits high. 4 horns go up from the hearth.

**16** The hearth of the altar is square. It is 12 cubits long and 12 cubits wide.

**17** The upper ledge is also square. It is 14 cubits long and 14 cubits wide. The edge around it is half a cubit. The gutter around it is 1 cubit. The steps of the altar face east."

**18** Then he said to me, "Son of man, the Lord GOD says this: 'These are the rules for the altar. Obey them on the day that you build it. Then the priests can offer burnt offerings and put blood on it.

**19** Give a young bull as a sin offering to the priests who are Levites from the family of Zadok. They come near to me to serve me, says the Lord GOD.

**20** Take some of the blood of the bull. Put it on the 4 horns of the altar, on the 4 corners of the upper ledge and on the edge around it. Thus you will make the altar clean and make it ready for use.

**21** Take the bull for the sin offering. Burn it in the correct place in the temple area, outside the sanctuary.

**22** On the 2nd day, offer a male goat with no defects as a sin offering. The priests will make the altar clean with the goat, as they made it clean with the bull.

**23** When you finish this, offer a young bull with no defects and a ram with no defects from the flock.

**24** Offer them to the LORD. The priests will put salt on them. They will offer them as a burnt offering to the LORD.

**25** For 7 days you must give a goat as a sin offering each day. You must also give a young bull and a ram from the flock. All of them must have no defects.

**26** For 7 days the priests will make the altar clean and make it pure. Thus they will make it holy for use.

**27** After these 7 days, from the 8th day and after, the priests will offer your burnt offerings and your peace offerings on the altar. Then I will accept you, says the Lord GOD.'"

## Chapter 44

**1** Then the man brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary that faced east. The gate was not open.

**2** The LORD said to me, "This gate must stay closed. No person must open it. No person must go in through it, because the LORD, the God of Israel, went in through it. Thus it must stay closed.

**3** Only the prince can sit in the gate to eat food in front of the LORD. He must come in through the porch of the gate and go out the same way."

**4** Then the man brought me through the north gate to the front of the temple. I looked, and I saw that the glory of the LORD filled the temple of the LORD. I fell down with my face to the ground.

**5** The LORD said to me, "Son of man, pay careful attention. Look with your eyes and listen with your ears to all that I tell you. I will tell you all the rules and laws of the temple of the LORD. Pay careful attention to the people who can come into the temple and the people who must stay out of the sanctuary.

**6** Speak to the people of Israel, who rebel against me. Tell them, 'The Lord GOD says this: People of Israel, stop all your filthy actions!

**7** You brought foreigners into my sanctuary. They did not receive circumcision in their hearts or in their bodies. They made my temple unholy when you offered me food, fat and blood. Thus you broke my covenant with all your filthy actions.

**8** You did not do your duty with my holy things. You let foreigners do the duty in my sanctuary in your place.

**9** "'The Lord GOD says this: No foreigner who did not receive circumcision in his heart and in his body can come into my sanctuary. This includes the foreigners who live among the people of Israel.

**10** "'Some of the Levites went far away from me when Israel left me. They left me to follow their idols. They will get the punishment for their sins.

**11** But they can serve in my sanctuary. They can guard the gates of the temple and do work in the temple. They can kill the animals for the burnt offerings and the sacrifices for the people. They can stand in front of the people to serve them.

**12** But they served the people in front of their idols. They caused the people of Israel to sin. Thus I lifted my hand and made a promise against them, says the Lord GOD. They will get the punishment for their sins.

**13** They must not come near to me to serve me as priests. They must not come near to any of my holy things or my most holy things. They must feel their shame because of the filthy things that they did.

**14** But I will make them responsible for the work of the temple. They will do all its work and all the tasks in it.

**15** "'But the priests who are Levites and sons of Zadok did their duty in my sanctuary when the people of Israel left me. They will come near to me to serve me. They will stand in front of me to offer me the fat and the blood, says the Lord GOD.

**16** They will come into my sanctuary. They will come near to my table to serve me. They will do the duty that I give them.

**17** "'When they come in through the gates of the inner courtyard, they must wear linen clothes. They must not wear wool when they serve at the gates of the inner courtyard or in the temple.

**18** They must wear linen turbans on their heads and linen underwear. They must not wear clothes that cause sweat.

**19** When they go out into the outer courtyard where the people are, they must take off the clothes that they wore to serve. They must leave those clothes in the holy rooms. They must put on other clothes. Thus they will not make the people holy with their holy clothes.

**20** "'They must not shave their heads or let their hair grow long. They must keep their hair cut short.

**21** No priest must drink wine before he goes into the inner courtyard.

**22** They must not marry a widow or a divorced woman. They can marry only a virgin from the people of Israel, or the widow of a priest.

**23** They must teach my people the difference between holy things and common things. They must show them the difference between unclean things and clean things.

**24** When people disagree, the priests must judge the case. They must judge it by my rules. They must obey my laws and my rules at all my festivals. They must keep my Sabbaths holy.

**25** "'A priest must not make himself unclean when he goes near a dead person. But he can make himself unclean for his father, his mother, his son, his daughter, his brother or his unmarried sister.

**26** After the priest becomes clean again, he must wait 7 days.

**27** On the day that he goes into the inner courtyard of the sanctuary to serve there, he must offer a sin offering for himself. The Lord GOD says this.

**28** "'The priests will have no property. I am their property. Do not give them land in Israel. I am their land.

**29** They will eat the grain offerings, the sin offerings and the guilt offerings. All the things that the people of Israel give completely to the LORD will be theirs.

**30** The best of all the first crops and all the special gifts will be for the priests. You must also give the priests the first part of your dough. Then I will bless your homes.

**31** The priests must not eat any bird or animal that died naturally or that wild animals killed.'"

## Chapter 45

**1** "'When you divide the land by lot among the tribes, you must give a holy part of the land to the LORD. It is a special gift. It must be 25,000 rods long and 10,000 rods wide. All this area will be holy.

**2** From this area, a square of 500 rods by 500 rods will be for the sanctuary. An open area 50 cubits wide will go around it.

**3** In the holy area, measure a part 25,000 rods long and 10,000 rods wide. The sanctuary, the Most Holy Place, will be in it.

**4** This holy part of the land will be for the priests who serve in the sanctuary. They come near to the LORD to serve him. It will be a place for their houses and a holy place for the sanctuary.

**5** Another area, 25,000 rods long and 10,000 rods wide, will be for the Levites who serve in the temple. It will be their property, with 20 rooms.

**6** "'Next to the holy area, give the city an area 5,000 rods wide and 25,000 rods long. It will be for all the people of Israel.

**7** "'The prince will have land on each side of the holy area and the city area. His land will go west from the west side and east from the east side. It will be as long as one of the areas of the tribes, from the west border to the east border.

**8** This land will be the property of the prince in Israel. Then my princes will not be cruel to my people again. They will give the other land to the people of Israel by their tribes.

**9** "'The Lord GOD says this: Princes of Israel, you did enough wrong! Stop your violence and your theft. Do what is fair and correct. Do not take land from my people by force again, says the Lord GOD.

**10** You must use honest scales. You must use an honest ephah (a unit of dry measure) and an honest bath (a unit of liquid measure).

**11** The ephah and the bath must be the same size. The bath must hold one tenth of a homer. The ephah must also hold one tenth of a homer. The homer is the standard measure for the 2 units.

**12** The shekel must be 20 gerahs. 60 shekels will be 1 mina.

**13** "'This is the offering that you must give: one sixtieth of your wheat and one sixtieth of your barley.

**14** This is the rule for the oil: give one hundredth of your oil. Measure it by the bath. 10 baths are 1 homer, and 1 homer is 1 cor.

**15** Give 1 sheep from each 200 sheep from the rich fields of Israel. Use these gifts for the grain offerings, the burnt offerings and the peace offerings. These offerings will make atonement for the people, says the Lord GOD.

**16** All the people of the land must give this offering to the prince of Israel.

**17** The prince must give the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the drink offerings at the festivals, the new moons and the Sabbaths. He must give them at all the special festivals of the people of Israel. He must give the sin offerings, the grain offerings, the burnt offerings and the peace offerings. These offerings will make atonement for the people of Israel.

**18** "'The Lord GOD says this: On the 1st day of the 1st month, take a young bull with no defects. Use it to make the sanctuary clean.

**19** The priest must take some of the blood of the sin offering. He must put it on the door posts of the temple. He must put it on the 4 corners of the ledge of the altar and on the posts of the gate of the inner courtyard.

**20** Do the same on the 7th day of the month for each person who sins by mistake or because he does not know. Thus you will make the temple clean.

**21** "'On the 14th day of the 1st month, you must celebrate the Passover. It is a festival of 7 days. During that time you must eat bread with no yeast.

**22** On that day the prince must give a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land.

**23** During the 7 days of the festival, he must give a burnt offering to the LORD each day. He must give 7 bulls and 7 rams with no defects. He must also give a male goat each day as a sin offering.

**24** He must give a grain offering of 1 ephah with each bull and 1 ephah with each ram. He must give 1 hin (a unit of liquid measure) of oil with each ephah.

**25** "'On the 15th day of the 7th month, at the festival of 7 days, he must give the same offerings. He must give the same sin offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings and oil.'"

## Chapter 46

**1** "'The Lord GOD says this: The gate of the inner courtyard that faces east must stay closed on the 6 work days. But on the Sabbath and on the day of the new moon, it must be open.

**2** The prince must come in from outside through the porch of that gate. He must stand by the post of the gate. The priests must offer his burnt offering and his peace offerings. He must worship at the threshold of the gate. Then he must go out. But no person must close the gate until the evening.

**3** The people of the land must also worship the LORD at the entrance of that gate on the Sabbaths and the new moons.

**4** On the Sabbath day the prince must give a burnt offering to the LORD. It must be 6 lambs with no defects and a ram with no defects.

**5** The grain offering must be 1 ephah with the ram. With the lambs, he can give as much grain as he wants. He must give 1 hin of oil with each ephah.

**6** On the day of the new moon he must give a young bull, 6 lambs and a ram. All of them must have no defects.

**7** He must give a grain offering of 1 ephah with the bull and 1 ephah with the ram. With the lambs, he can give as much grain as he can. He must give 1 hin of oil with each ephah.

**8** When the prince comes in, he must come in through the porch of the gate. He must go out the same way.

**9** "'When the people of the land come to worship the LORD at the special festivals, they must obey this rule. A person who comes in through the north gate must go out through the south gate. A person who comes in through the south gate must go out through the north gate. No person must go back through the gate where he came in. Each person must go out through the opposite gate.

**10** The prince must be among the people. He must come in when they come in, and he must go out when they go out.

**11** "'At the festivals and the special feasts, the grain offering must be 1 ephah with each bull and 1 ephah with each ram. With the lambs, he can give as much grain as he wants. He must give 1 hin of oil with each ephah.

**12** The prince can give a burnt offering or peace offerings to the LORD as a free gift. Then a person must open the gate that faces east for him. He must give his burnt offering and his peace offerings as he does on the Sabbath day. Then he must go out. After he goes out, a person must close the gate.

**13** "'Each day you must give a lamb as a burnt offering to the LORD. The lamb must be 1 year old and have no defects. Give it each morning.

**14** Each morning you must also give a grain offering with it. Give one sixth of an ephah of fine flour and one third of a hin of oil to mix with the flour. This grain offering to the LORD is a permanent rule.

**15** Thus you must give the lamb, the grain offering and the oil each morning as a regular burnt offering.

**16** "'The Lord GOD says this: The prince can give a gift of land to one of his sons. Then the land will belong to his sons. It will be their property for all time.

**17** But the prince can give a gift of land to one of his servants. Then the servant can keep it until the year of freedom. After that, the land must go back to the prince. Only his sons can keep his land for all time.

**18** The prince must not take the property of the people by force. He must not push them off their land. He must give his sons land only from his own property. Then none of my people will lose their property.'"

**19** Then the man brought me through the entrance at the side of the gate. He brought me into the holy rooms of the priests that faced north. I saw a place at the west end of the rooms.

**20** He said to me, "This is the place where the priests must cook the guilt offerings and the sin offerings. Here they must bake the grain offerings. Thus they will not take these offerings into the outer courtyard and make the people holy."

**21** Then he brought me out into the outer courtyard. He took me to each of the 4 corners of the courtyard. In each corner there was a small courtyard.

**22** In the 4 corners of the courtyard there were smaller courtyards with walls. Each was 40 cubits long and 30 cubits wide. All 4 had the same size.

**23** Around the inside of each of the 4 courtyards there was a stone wall. There were places for fires below the wall around each courtyard.

**24** He said to me, "These are the kitchens. Here the people who serve in the temple will cook the sacrifices of the people."

## Chapter 47

**1** Then the man brought me back to the entrance of the temple. I saw water that came out from under the threshold of the temple. The water flowed east, because the temple faced east. The water flowed down from under the south side of the temple, south of the altar.

**2** Then he brought me out through the north gate. He took me around the outside to the outer gate that faced east. I saw water that flowed from the south side of the gate.

**3** The man had a rope for measurement in his hand. He went east and measured 1,000 cubits. Then he took me through the water. The water came up to my ankles.

**4** He measured another 1,000 cubits and took me through the water. The water came up to my knees. He measured another 1,000 cubits and took me through the water. The water came up to my waist.

**5** He measured another 1,000 cubits. Now the water was a river that I could not cross. The water was deep. A person had to swim in it. No person could walk across the river.

**6** He asked me, "Son of man, do you see this?" Then he took me back to the bank of the river.

**7** When I came back, I saw very many trees on each side of the river.

**8** He said to me, "This water flows toward the east country. It goes down into the Arabah valley. When it goes into the Dead Sea, it makes the salt water fresh.

**9** All types of animals will live where the river goes. There will be very many fish, because this water goes there. The water makes the salt water fresh. Thus all things will live where the river goes.

**10** Fishermen will stand on the shore of the sea from En Gedi to En Eglaim. There they will spread their nets. There will be very many types of fish, like the fish of the Mediterranean Sea.

**11** But the swamps and the marshes will not become fresh. They will stay salty, to give salt.

**12** All types of fruit trees will grow on each bank of the river. Their leaves will not become dry, and their fruit will not stop. Each month they will give new fruit, because the water comes from the sanctuary. Their fruit will be food, and their leaves will be medicine."

**13** The Lord GOD says this: "These are the borders of the land. You will divide the land among the 12 tribes of Israel. Joseph will get 2 parts.

**14** Divide it equally among the tribes. I lifted my hand and promised to give the land to your ancestors. Thus this land will be your property.

**15** "This is the border of the land on the north side. It goes from the Mediterranean Sea along the road to Hethlon. Then it goes to the entrance of Zedad.

**16** It continues to Hamath, Berothah and Sibraim, which are between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath. It continues to Hazer Hatticon, on the border of Hauran.

**17** Thus the border goes from the sea to Hazar Enan, on the border of Damascus. The border of Hamath is to the north. This is the north side.

**18** "On the east side, the border goes between Hauran and Damascus. It goes along the Jordan River between Gilead and the land of Israel. It goes to the Dead Sea and to Tamar. This is the east side.

**19** "On the south side, the border goes from Tamar to the water of Meribah Kadesh. Then it goes along the Brook of Egypt to the Mediterranean Sea. This is the south side.

**20** "On the west side, the Mediterranean Sea is the border. It goes to a point opposite the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.

**21** "Divide this land among you by the tribes of Israel.

**22** Divide it by lot as property for yourselves and for the foreigners who live among you and have children among you. You must think of them as people whose mothers gave birth to them in Israel. They will get property with you among the tribes of Israel.

**23** In each tribe where a foreigner lives, give him his property, says the Lord GOD."

## Chapter 48

**1** These are the names of the tribes. The tribe of Dan will get 1 part of the land. The part of Dan is at the north end. Its border goes along the road to Hethlon, to Lebo Hamath, and to Hazar Enan. The border of Damascus is to the north, near Hamath. The part of Dan goes from the east side to the west side.

**2** The tribe of Asher will get 1 part. It is next to the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side.

**3** The tribe of Naphtali will get 1 part. It is next to the border of Asher, from the east side to the west side.

**4** The tribe of Manasseh will get 1 part. It is next to the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side.

**5** The tribe of Ephraim will get 1 part. It is next to the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side.

**6** The tribe of Reuben will get 1 part. It is next to the border of Ephraim, from the east side to the west side.

**7** The tribe of Judah will get 1 part. It is next to the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side.

**8** Next to the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side, is the special part. You will give this special part to the LORD. It will be 25,000 reeds wide. Its length from east to west will be the same as the length of the other parts. The holy place (sanctuary) will be in the middle of the special part.

**9** The special part that you give to the LORD will be 25,000 reeds long and 10,000 reeds wide.

**10** This holy part will be for the priests. On the north side it will be 25,000 reeds long. On the west side it will be 10,000 reeds wide. On the east side it will be 10,000 reeds wide. On the south side it will be 25,000 reeds long. The sanctuary of the LORD will be in the middle of the holy part.

**11** This land will be for the priests from the family of Zadok. I made these priests holy. They obeyed my orders. When the people of Israel went away from me, these priests did not go away. But the Levites went away from me.

**12** The priests will have this special part of the land as a very holy part. It will be next to the land of the Levites.

**13** Next to the land of the priests, the Levites will have a part. It will be 25,000 reeds long and 10,000 reeds wide. All the length will be 25,000 reeds, and the width will be 10,000 reeds.

**14** The Levites must not sell this land. They must not exchange it. They must not give this best part of the land to other people. The land is holy to the LORD.

**15** 5,000 reeds of width will stay, next to the 25,000 reeds. This land will be for common use by the city. The people will build houses and open land there. The city will be in the middle of this land.

**16** These will be the measurements of the city. The north side will be 4,500 reeds. The south side will be 4,500 reeds. The east side will be 4,500 reeds. The west side will be 4,500 reeds.

**17** The open land around the city will be 250 reeds to the north and 250 reeds to the south. It will be 250 reeds to the east and 250 reeds to the west.

**18** Some land will stay along the length, next to the holy part. It will be 10,000 reeds to the east and 10,000 reeds to the west. The crops from this land will be food for the workers of the city.

**19** The workers of the city will come from all the tribes of Israel.

**20** All the special part will be 25,000 reeds by 25,000 reeds. You will give the holy part as a square, together with the land of the city.

**21** The land on the 2 sides of the holy part and of the city land will be for the prince. This land goes from the 25,000 reeds of the holy part to the east border. It also goes from the 25,000 reeds to the west border. These parts are next to the parts of the tribes, and they will be for the prince. The holy part and the sanctuary of the temple will be in the middle.

**22** The land of the Levites and the land of the city are in the middle of the land of the prince. The land of the prince will be between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin.

**23** These are the parts for the other tribes. The tribe of Benjamin will get 1 part, from the east side to the west side.

**24** The tribe of Simeon will get 1 part. It is next to the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side.

**25** The tribe of Issachar will get 1 part. It is next to the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side.

**26** The tribe of Zebulun will get 1 part. It is next to the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side.

**27** The tribe of Gad will get 1 part. It is next to the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side.

**28** The south border of Gad will go from Tamar to the waters of Meribah Kadesh. Then it will go along the stream of Egypt to the Great Sea.

**29** This is the land that you will divide by lot among the tribes of Israel. These are their parts. The Lord GOD says this.

**30** These are the exits of the city. The north side will be 4,500 reeds long.

**31** The gates of the city will have the names of the tribes of Israel. There will be 3 gates on the north side. There will be 1 gate for Reuben, 1 gate for Judah, and 1 gate for Levi.

**32** The east side will be 4,500 reeds long, with 3 gates. There will be 1 gate for Joseph, 1 gate for Benjamin, and 1 gate for Dan.

**33** The south side will be 4,500 reeds long, with 3 gates. There will be 1 gate for Simeon, 1 gate for Issachar, and 1 gate for Zebulun.

**34** The west side will be 4,500 reeds long, with 3 gates. There will be 1 gate for Gad, 1 gate for Asher, and 1 gate for Naphtali.

**35** The distance around the city will be 18,000 reeds. From that day, the name of the city will be "The LORD Is There."
