**29** Some people receive baptism for the dead. If the dead do not rise, what will those people do? Why do they receive baptism for the dead?

**30** And why are we in danger each hour?

**31** Brothers, I am proud of you in Christ Jesus our Lord. Because of this, I tell you that I am near death each day.

**32** At Ephesus I fought with wild animals, for human reasons only. If the dead do not rise, what did I get from that fight? Then "Let us eat and drink, because tomorrow we will die."

**33** Do not let people trick you. "Bad friends cause good habits to become bad."

**34** Think correctly, as righteous people must. Stop your sins. Some of you do not know God. I say this to make you ashamed.

**35** But a person will possibly ask, "How do the dead rise? What type of body will they have when they come?"

**36** You are foolish! When you put a seed in the ground, the seed must die before it becomes alive.

**37** The thing that you put in the ground is not the plant that will grow. It is only a seed, possibly of wheat or of a different grain.

**38** But God gives the seed a body, as he wants. He gives each type of seed its own body.

**39** All bodies are not the same. People have one type of body. Animals have a different type. Fish have a different type, and birds have a different type.

**40** There are bodies in the sky, and there are bodies on the earth. The glory of the bodies in the sky is of one type. The glory of the bodies on the earth is of a different type.

**41** The sun has one type of glory. The moon has a different glory, and the stars have a different glory. Also, each star has a glory that is different from the other stars.

**42** It is the same with the resurrection of the dead. The body that people bury will decay. The body that God raises will never decay.

**43** The body that people bury has no honor. The body that God raises has glory. The body that people bury is weak. The body that God raises has power.

**44** People bury a natural body. God raises a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is also a spiritual body.

**45** The scripture says, "The first man, Adam, became a person with life." The last Adam became a spirit that gives life.

**46** The spiritual body did not come first. The natural body came first. Then the spiritual body came.

**47** The first man came from the dust of the earth. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

**48** The people of the earth are like the man who came from the earth. The people of heaven are like the man who came from heaven.

**49** We are like the man from the earth. In the same way, we will be like the man from heaven.

**50** Brothers, I tell you this: Bodies of flesh and blood cannot receive the kingdom of God. A thing that decays cannot receive a thing that never decays.

**51** Listen, I tell you a secret. Not all of us will die. But God will change all of us.

**52** God will change us very quickly, as fast as the blink of an eye. This will occur when the last trumpet sounds. The trumpet will sound, and God will raise the dead. They will never decay, and God will change us.

**53** Our bodies that can decay must become bodies that never decay. Our bodies that can die must become bodies that never die.

**54** This will occur. Then the words of the scripture will become true: "Victory destroyed death completely."

**55** "Death, where is your victory? Death, where is your power to hurt?"

**56** Sin gives death its power to hurt. And the law gives sin its power.

**57** But we thank God! He gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

**58** Thus, my dear brothers, stand firmly. Do not let anything move you. Always do much work for the Lord. You know that your work for the Lord has value.

## Chapter 16

**1** Now I will write about the money for the saints. Do the same things that I told the churches in Galatia to do.

**2** On the first day of each week, each of you must put some money aside. Put aside an amount that agrees with your income. Then you will not have to collect money when I come.

**3** When I come, I will send the people whom you choose. I will give them letters. They will take your gift to Jerusalem.

**4** If it is good for me to go also, then those people will go with me.

**5** I will go through Macedonia. After that, I will come to you.

**6** Possibly I will stay with you for some time, or for the whole winter. Then you can help me continue my journey to the place where I will go.

**7** I do not want to see you now only for a short time as I go past. I hope to stay with you for some time, if the Lord permits.

**8** But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost.

**9** God gave me a large opportunity for good work here. But many people are against me.

**10** If Timothy comes, make sure that he has no fear when he is with you. He does the work of the Lord, as I do.

**11** Thus, no person must think that Timothy is not important. Help him to continue his journey in peace, so that he can come back to me. I wait for him with the brothers.

**12** Now about our brother Apollos. I asked him many times to go to you with the brothers. But he did not want to go now. He will go when he has an opportunity.

**13** Be alert. Stand firmly in the faith. Be brave. Be strong.

**14** Do all your work with love.

**15** You know the family of Stephanas. They were the first believers in Achaia. They give their lives to serve the saints. Brothers, I ask you this:

**16** Obey such people. Also obey each person who works with us and works hard.

**17** I am happy that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus came to me. They gave me the help that you could not give me.

**18** They gave new strength to my spirit and to your spirit. Thus, give honor to such people.

**19** The churches in Asia send you their greetings. Aquila and Priscilla send you many greetings in the Lord. The church that meets in their house also sends greetings.

**20** All the brothers here send you their greetings. Greet each other with a holy kiss.

**21** I, Paul, write these words to greet you with my own hand.

**22** If a person does not love the Lord, let God curse that person. Our Lord, come!

**23** I pray that the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ will be with you.

**24** I give my love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

---

# 2 Corinthians

## Chapter 1

**1** This letter is from Paul and from our brother Timothy. God chose Paul to be an apostle of Jesus Christ. We write to the church of God in Corinth and to all the saints in all of Achaia.

**2** We pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give you grace and peace.

**3** Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! He is the Father who gives mercy. He is the God who gives all comfort.

**4** God gives us comfort in all our troubles. Thus, we can give comfort to other people in their troubles. We give them the same comfort that God gives us.

**5** We suffer much for Christ. In the same way, we also get much comfort through Christ.

**6** If we have troubles, our troubles give you comfort and salvation. If we get comfort, our comfort gives you comfort. Then you can patiently endure the same sufferings that we endure.

**7** Our hope for you is firm. We know that you share in our sufferings. Thus, you will also share in our comfort.

**8** Brothers, we want you to know about the troubles that we had in the province of Asia. The troubles were too heavy for our strength. We thought that we will die.

**9** In our hearts, we felt that we had a sentence of death. This occurred so that we did not trust ourselves. We trusted God, who raises the dead.

**10** God saved us from very great danger of death, and he will save us again. We trust that he will continue to save us.

**11** You also help us when you pray for us. Many people will pray for us. Then many people will thank God for the good things that he gives us.

**12** We are proud of this: Our conscience tells us that we lived honestly and sincerely in the world. We did not use human wisdom. We used the grace of God. We lived like this especially with you.

**13** We write to you only things that you can read and understand. I hope that you will understand completely.

**14** You understand us now only partly. But I hope that on the day of the Lord Jesus, you will be proud of us. And we will be proud of you.

**15** I was sure of this. Thus, I made a plan to visit you first. Then you could get a benefit 2 times.

**16** I planned to visit you on my way to Macedonia. Then I planned to come back to you from Macedonia. After that, you could help me to go to Judea.

**17** When I made this plan, did I make it carelessly? Do I make my plans as worldly people do? Do I say "yes" and "no" at the same time?

**18** God is faithful. Thus, our message to you is not "yes" and "no" at the same time.

**19** Silvanus, Timothy, and I preached to you about Jesus Christ, the Son of God. Jesus Christ is not "yes" and "no." In him, the answer is always "yes."

**20** All the promises of God are "yes" in Christ. Thus, through Christ we say "Amen" to give glory to God.

**21** God makes us and you strong in Christ. God anointed us.

**22** God put his seal on us to show that we belong to him. He put his Spirit in our hearts as a guarantee of the things that he will give us.

**23** I call on God as my witness. I tell you the truth: I did not come back to Corinth because I did not want to hurt you.

**24** We do not try to control your faith. We work with you for your joy, because you stand firmly by faith.

## Chapter 2

**1** I decided that I will not visit you again to cause you sorrow.

**2** If I cause you sorrow, no person can make me happy. Only the people whom I made sad can make me happy.

**3** I wrote that letter to you for this reason. I did not want to come and get sorrow from the people who must make me happy. I am sure that my joy is also the joy of all of you.

**4** I wrote to you with much trouble and pain in my heart. I wrote with many tears. I did not want to make you sad. I wanted you to know how much I love you.

**5** A person caused sorrow. He did not cause sorrow only to me. Partly, he caused sorrow to all of you. I do not want to say too much.

**6** Most of you punished that man. That punishment is sufficient for him.

**7** Thus, now you must forgive him and give him comfort. If you do not, he will possibly have too much sorrow.

**8** So I ask you to show him again that you love him.

**9** I also wrote to you to test you. I wanted to know if you obey in all things.

**10** If you forgive a person, I also forgive that person. If I forgave something, I forgave it for you in the presence of Christ.

**11** We do this so that Satan cannot trick us. We know his plans.

**12** I went to Troas to preach the gospel of Christ. There, the Lord gave me an opportunity for work.

**13** But my spirit had no rest, because I did not find my brother Titus there. Thus, I said goodbye to the people there and went to Macedonia.

**14** But we thank God! In Christ, God always leads us as in a victory parade. Through us, God spreads the knowledge of Christ to all places, like a sweet smell.

**15** For God, we are the sweet smell of Christ among the people whom God saves. We are also that smell among the people who die in their sins.

**16** To the people who die, we are a smell of death that causes death. To the people whom God saves, we are a smell of life that gives life. Which person is sufficient for this work?

**17** We are not like many people who sell the word of God for money. We speak sincerely, as people whom God sent. We speak in Christ, and God sees us.

## Chapter 3

**1** Do we start to praise ourselves again? Some people need letters of recommendation to you or from you. Do we need such letters?

**2** You are our letter. God wrote this letter in our hearts. All people know this letter and read it.

**3** You show clearly that you are a letter from Christ. We delivered this letter. People did not write it with ink. The Spirit of the God who lives wrote it. The Spirit did not write it on pieces of stone. The Spirit wrote it on human hearts.

**4** We are sure of this before God because of Christ.

**5** We cannot do anything good by our own ability. Our ability comes from God.

**6** God made us able to serve the new covenant (agreement). This covenant is not a written law. It is from the Spirit. The written law causes death, but the Spirit gives life.

**7** God wrote the old law with letters on stone. That law caused death, but it came with glory. The face of Moses shone with glory. Thus, the people of Israel could not look at his face. But that glory went away.

**8** Thus, the work of the Spirit has a much greater glory.

**9** The old law caused people to receive punishment, and it had glory. Thus, the work that makes people righteous has much more glory.

**10** The old law had glory. But now its glory is like nothing, because the new glory is much greater.

**11** The old law that went away had glory. Thus, the new covenant that stays has much more glory.

**12** We have this hope. Thus, we speak very clearly.

**13** We are not like Moses. He put a cover over his face. Thus, the people of Israel did not see the end of the glory that went away.

**14** But the minds of the people became closed. Even now, when they read the old covenant, the same cover stays on their minds. Only Christ removes that cover.

**15** Even now, when the people read the law of Moses, a cover is on their hearts.

**16** But when a person turns to the Lord, the Lord removes the cover.

**17** The Lord is the Spirit. Where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.

**18** None of us has a cover on our faces. We see the glory of the Lord, as in a mirror. The Spirit of the Lord changes us to be like the Lord. Our glory becomes greater and greater.

## Chapter 4

**1** God gave us this work because of his mercy. Thus, we do not lose courage.

**2** We stopped all shameful and secret things. We do not trick people. We do not change the word of God. We tell the truth clearly. Thus, before God, we show all people that we are honest.

**3** If something hides our gospel, it hides it only from the people who go to destruction.

**4** The god of this world closed the minds of unbelievers. Thus, they do not see the light of the gospel. The gospel tells about the glory of Christ, who is the image of God.

**5** We do not preach about ourselves. We preach that Christ Jesus is the Lord. We are your servants for Jesus.

**6** God said, "Let light shine out of darkness." That same God put his light in our hearts. That light gives us the knowledge of the glory of God. We see that glory in the face of Jesus Christ.

**7** We have this treasure, but we are like pots of clay. This shows that the great power comes from God, not from us.

**8** We have troubles on all sides, but these troubles do not defeat us. We do not always understand, but we do not lose hope.

**9** People attack us, but God does not leave us. People knock us down, but they do not destroy us.

**10** In our bodies we always share the death of Jesus. Thus, the life of Jesus also shows in our bodies.

**11** While we live, we are always in danger of death for Jesus. Thus, the life of Jesus also shows in our bodies that will die.

**12** So, death works in us, but life works in you.

**13** The scripture says, "I believed, thus I spoke." We have the same spirit of faith. We also believe, thus we speak.

**14** We know that God raised the Lord Jesus from the dead. God will also raise us with Jesus. And God will bring us with you into his presence.

**15** All these things are for you. Grace comes to more and more people. Thus, more people give thanks, and God gets more glory.

**16** Thus, we do not lose courage. Our bodies become weaker. But each day God makes our spirits new.

**17** Our troubles are small and they last only for a short time. These troubles get for us an eternal glory. That glory is much greater than the troubles.

**18** We do not look at the things that we can see. We look at the things that we cannot see. The things that we can see last only for a short time. But the things that we cannot see are eternal.

## Chapter 5

**1** Our body on earth is like a tent. We know that possibly this tent will go to pieces. But God will give us a building in heaven. Human hands did not make that house. It is eternal.

**2** In this tent we make sad sounds. We have a strong wish to put on our home from heaven, as we put on clothes.

**3** When we put on that home, we will not be naked.

**4** While we live in this tent, we make sad sounds, because we have a heavy load. We do not want to remove this body. We want to put on the new body. Then life will take the place of the body that dies.

**5** God made us for this purpose. He gave us his Spirit as a guarantee of the things that he will give us.

**6** Thus, we are always confident. We know that while we live in this body, we are away from the Lord.

**7** We live by faith, not by sight.

**8** We are confident. We prefer to leave this body and to be at home with the Lord.

**9** Thus, our goal is to please the Lord. We want to please him while we are in this body or away from it.

**10** We must all stand before Christ, and he will judge us. Each person will get what he must get for the things that he did in his body. He will get it for the good things or the bad things.

**11** We know what it means to fear the Lord. Thus, we try to persuade people. God knows us completely. I hope that you also know us in your conscience.

**12** We do not praise ourselves again to you. We give you a reason to be proud of us. Then you can answer the people who are proud of things that they see. Those people are not proud of what is in the heart.

**13** If we seem crazy, it is for God. If we have a clear mind, it is for you.

**14** The love of Christ controls us. We are sure of this: 1 person died for all people. Thus, all people died.

**15** Christ died for all people. Thus, the people who live must not live for themselves. They must live for Christ, who died for them and rose again.

**16** Thus, from now on, we do not think about any person from a human point of view. Before, we thought about Christ from a human point of view. But now we do not think that way.

**17** If a person is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things went away. All things are new.

**18** All this comes from God. Through Christ, God made peace between himself and us. And God gave us the work to make peace between people and God.

**19** In Christ, God made peace between himself and the world. He did not count the sins of people against them. And he gave us the message of peace with God.

**20** Thus, we speak for Christ. God speaks to you through us. We ask you, for Christ, "Make peace with God."

**21** Christ had no sin. But God made Christ to be sin for us. Thus, in Christ we become righteous before God.

## Chapter 6

**1** We work with God. Thus, we ask you not to receive the grace of God without a result.

**2** God says, "At the correct time I heard you. On the day of salvation I helped you." Now is the correct time. Now is the day of salvation!

**3** We do not cause problems for any person. Thus, no person can find a fault in our work.

**4** In all things we show that we are servants of God. We are very patient in troubles, in difficulties, and in pain.

**5** People beat us and put us in prison. Crowds attacked us. We worked hard, and we did not sleep. We did not eat.

**6** We show that we are servants of God by pure lives and by knowledge. We show it by patience and kindness, by the Holy Spirit, and by true love.

**7** We speak the truth with the power of God. We use righteousness as weapons in our right hand and in our left hand.

**8** Some people honor us, and some people do not honor us. Some people say bad things about us, and some say good things. People think that we are liars, but we speak the truth.

**9** People do not know us, but many people know us well. We seem near death, but we live. People punish us, but they do not kill us.

**10** We have sorrow, but we always have joy. We are poor, but we make many people rich. We have nothing, but we have all things.

**11** People of Corinth, we spoke openly to you. Our hearts are open to you.

**12** We do not hold back our love from you. But you hold back your love from us.

**13** I speak to you as to my children. Open your hearts to us, as we opened our hearts to you.

**14** Do not join with unbelievers. Righteousness and evil cannot be partners. Light and darkness cannot be together.

**15** Christ and Belial (Satan) cannot agree. A believer and an unbeliever cannot share their lives.

**16** The temple of God and idols cannot agree. We are the temple of the God who lives. God said, "I will live with them and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people."

**17** Thus, the Lord says, "Come out from among them, and be separate. Do not touch any unclean thing. Then I will accept you.

**18** I will be your Father, and you will be my sons and daughters," says the Lord Almighty.

## Chapter 7

**1** Dear friends, God gave us these promises. Thus, we must make ourselves clean from all things that make the body and spirit unclean. We must respect God and become completely holy.

**2** Open your hearts to us. We did not do wrong to any person. We did not cause any person to become bad. We did not cheat any person.

**3** I do not say this to accuse you. I told you before that you are in our hearts. We will die with you or live with you.

**4** I speak very boldly to you. I am very proud of you. You give me much comfort. In all our troubles, I have very much joy.

**5** When we came into Macedonia, our bodies had no rest. We had troubles on all sides. Outside there were fights, and inside there were fears.

**6** But God gives comfort to sad people. God gave us comfort when Titus came.

**7** Titus gave us comfort, and also you gave comfort to Titus. Titus told us that you want to see me. He told us about your sorrow and your strong love for me. Thus, my joy became greater.

**8** My letter made you sad, but I am not sorry that I wrote it. For a short time I was sorry, because I saw that the letter made you sad. But you were sad only for a short time.

**9** Now I am happy. I am not happy because you became sad. I am happy because your sorrow caused you to repent. God used your sorrow. Thus, we did not hurt you.

**10** Sorrow that comes from God causes a person to repent. Then God saves that person, and the person has no regret. But the sorrow of the world causes death.

**11** Look at what this sorrow from God did for you! You became very serious. You wanted to show that you were not guilty. You became angry and afraid. You wanted to see me. You were eager to make the problem correct. In all things you showed that you are not guilty in this problem.

**12** I wrote that letter to you. But I did not write it because of the man who did the wrong. And I did not write it because of the man who suffered the wrong. I wrote it so that you can see before God how much you care about us.

**13** Because of all this, we have comfort. Also, the joy of Titus made us very happy. All of you gave new strength to his spirit.

**14** I told Titus that I was proud of you. And you did not make me ashamed. All the things that we told you were true. In the same way, the good things that we told Titus about you were true.

**15** Titus loves you more and more. He remembers that all of you obeyed. You received him with fear and respect.

**16** I am happy because I can trust you completely.

## Chapter 8

**1** Brothers, now we want you to know about the grace that God gave to the churches in Macedonia.

**2** Those churches had many troubles that tested them. They were very poor. But they had much joy, and they gave very generously.

**3** I am a witness that they gave as much as they could. They gave even more than they could. They gave because they wanted to give.

**4** They asked us many times to let them share in this help for the saints.

**5** They did more than we hoped. First, they gave themselves to the Lord. Then they gave themselves to us, as God wanted.

**6** Thus, we asked Titus to help you complete this generous gift. He started this work with you before.

**7** You are rich in all things: in faith, in speech, in knowledge, in eagerness, and in your love for us. Thus, make sure that you are also rich in this act of grace.

**8** I do not give you a command. I tell you about the eagerness of other people. Thus, I test if your love is true.

**9** You know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ. He was rich, but he became poor for you. Thus, through his poverty you became rich.

**10** I give you my advice about this. It is good for you to complete this work. Last year you were the first people to start to give. You were also the first people who wanted to give.

**11** Now complete the work. You were eager to start it. In the same way, complete it with the things that you have.

**12** If a person is eager to give, God accepts the gift. God accepts the gift that the person can give. He does not ask for things that the person does not have.

**13** I do not want to make life easy for other people and difficult for you.

**14** I want things to be equal. Now you have much, and you can help them in their need. Then, at a different time, they will have much. Then they can help you in your need. Thus, things will be equal.

**15** The scripture says, "The person who collected much did not have too much. The person who collected little had sufficient."

**16** We thank God! He put in the heart of Titus the same care for you that I have.

**17** Titus agreed to our request. And he was very eager to visit you. He decided by himself to go to you.

**18** We send with Titus a brother whom all the churches praise for his work for the gospel.

**19** Also, the churches chose this brother to travel with us. He helps us take this gift to Jerusalem. We do this work to give glory to the Lord and to show that we are eager to help.

**20** We want to be careful about this large gift. We do not want any person to criticize us for how we use this gift.

**21** We try to do what is honest. We want the Lord to see it, and also people.

**22** Also, we send with them another of our brothers. We tested him many times, and he showed that he is eager in many things. Now he is even more eager, because he trusts you very much.

**23** Titus is my partner, and he works with me to help you. The other brothers are messengers from the churches. They give glory to Christ.

**24** Thus, show these men your love. Show the churches that our pride in you is correct.

## Chapter 9

**1** I do not need to write to you about the help for the saints.

**2** I know that you are eager to help. I told the people of Macedonia that I am proud of you. I said, "The people in Achaia were ready to give 1 year ago." Your eagerness caused many of them to act.

**3** But I send the brothers to you. I do not want our pride in you to be wrong in this matter. I want you to be ready, as I said.

**4** Possibly some people from Macedonia will come with me. If they find that you are not ready, we will feel shame. You will also feel shame. We were too sure of you.

**5** Thus, I thought that it was necessary to ask the brothers to go to you before me. They will prepare the gift that you promised. Then the gift will be ready. It will be a generous gift, not a gift that you give unwillingly.

**6** Remember this: A person who plants few seeds will get a small harvest. A person who plants many seeds will get a large harvest.

**7** Each person must give what he decided in his heart. He must not give unwillingly or because people force him. God loves a person who gives happily.

**8** God can give you much grace. Then you will always have sufficient of all things. And you will have much to give for each good work.

**9** The scripture says, "He gives freely to the poor. His righteousness continues forever."

**10** God gives seed to the farmer and bread for food. God will also give you seed and make it increase. He will make the harvest of your righteousness larger.

**11** God will make you rich in all things. Then you can always give generously. When we take your gifts to the people, they will thank God.

**12** This work of help gives the saints what they need. It also causes many people to thank God.

**13** This work proves who you are. The saints will praise God because you obey the gospel of Christ. They will praise God because you share generously with them and with all people.

**14** They will pray for you, and they will have a strong wish to see you. They will do this because God gave you very much grace.

**15** We thank God for his gift. The gift is too great for words!

## Chapter 10

**1** I, Paul, ask you, by the gentleness and kindness of Christ. Some people say that I am humble when I am with you, but bold when I am away.

**2** I ask you not to make me bold when I come. I think that I will be bold against some people. Those people think that we live as worldly people.

**3** We live in the world. But we do not fight as worldly people fight.

**4** The weapons that we use are not human weapons. God makes our weapons powerful to destroy strong forts.

**5** We destroy false arguments and all proud things that are against the knowledge of God. We take each thought prisoner and make it obey Christ.

**6** We are ready to punish all disobedience after you obey completely.

**7** You look only at the things in front of you. A person can be sure that he belongs to Christ. Then that person must think again. We belong to Christ as much as he does.

**8** The Lord gave us authority to make you stronger, not to destroy you. If I am proud of that authority, I do not feel shame.

**9** I do not want you to think that I try to frighten you with my letters.

**10** Some people say, "His letters are serious and strong. But when he is with us, he is weak. And his speech is bad."

**11** Such people must know this: When we are away, we write letters. When we are with you, we will do the things that we write.

**12** We do not compare ourselves with people who praise themselves. Those people measure themselves by themselves. They compare themselves with themselves. They are not wise.

**13** But we will not be proud of things outside the limits of our work. We will be proud only of the work that God gave us. That work includes our work with you.

**14** We do not go past our limits. If we did not come to you, we went past our limits. But we came to you with the gospel of Christ.

**15** We are not proud of the work that other people did. But we hope that your faith will become stronger. Then our work among you will become much larger.

**16** Then we can preach the gospel in places past your city. We do not want to be proud of work that another person did in his area.

**17** The scripture says, "A person who is proud must be proud of the Lord."

**18** The Lord does not accept a person who praises himself. He accepts the person whom the Lord praises.

## Chapter 11

**1** I want you to be patient with me while I speak a little foolishly. Please be patient with me.

**2** I am jealous for you, with a jealousy from God. I promised you to 1 husband, Christ. I want to give you to Christ as a pure virgin.

**3** But I am afraid. The snake tricked Eve with his cleverness. In the same way, a person can possibly cause your minds to leave your sincere and pure devotion to Christ.

**4** A person comes and preaches a different Jesus. That Jesus is not the Jesus whom we preached. Or you receive a different spirit or a different gospel. You accept these things very easily.

**5** I do not think that I am less important than those "great apostles."

**6** Possibly I am not a trained speaker, but I have knowledge. We showed you this clearly in all things.

**7** I preached the gospel of God to you without payment. I made myself humble to make you great. Was that a sin?

**8** Other churches paid me so that I could serve you. It was as if I robbed them.

**9** When I was with you and I needed something, I did not ask any person for money. The brothers who came from Macedonia gave me what I needed. I did not let myself be a load for you. And I will continue to do this.

**10** The truth of Christ is in me. Thus, no person in Achaia will stop me from my pride about this.

**11** Why do I do this? Is it because I do not love you? God knows that I love you!

**12** I will continue to do what I do now. Some people want an opportunity to say that they work as we work. I will not give them that opportunity.

**13** Such people are false apostles. They are dishonest workers. They change themselves to look like apostles of Christ.

**14** This does not surprise me. Satan himself changes his appearance to look like an angel of light.

**15** Thus, it is not a surprise if the servants of Satan also look like servants of righteousness. In the end, they will get the punishment that their actions deserve.

**16** I say again: No person must think that I am a fool. But if you think so, then accept me as a fool. Then I can be proud a little.

**17** What I say now does not come from the Lord. I speak as a fool who is proud.

**18** Many people are proud of worldly things. Thus, I will also be proud.

**19** You think that you are wise. Thus, you are happy to be patient with fools!

**20** You are patient when a person makes you his slaves. You are patient when a person takes all that you have, or uses you for his gain. You are patient when a person is proud, or hits you in the face.

**21** I feel shame to say that we were too weak to do such things! But if another person is bold, I am also bold. I speak as a fool.

**22** Are they Hebrews? I am also a Hebrew. Are they Israelites? I am also an Israelite. Are they descendants of Abraham? I am also a descendant of Abraham.

**23** Are they servants of Christ? I speak as a crazy person, but I am a better servant. I worked much harder. I was in prison more frequently. People beat me more times than I can count. Many times I was near death.

**24** 5 times the Jews hit me with a whip 39 times.

**25** 3 times people beat me with sticks. 1 time people threw stones at me. 3 times my ship broke and sank. 1 time I was in the sea for a night and a day.

**26** I traveled many times. I was in danger from rivers and from robbers. I was in danger from my own people and from people who are not Jews. I was in danger in cities, in the wilderness, and at sea. I was in danger from false brothers.

**27** I worked very hard, and I had much pain. Many times I did not sleep. I was hungry and thirsty. Many times I did not have food. I was cold, and I did not have sufficient clothes.

**28** Also, each day I have the care of all the churches.

**29** When a person is weak, I feel weak too. When a person causes another person to sin, I become very angry.

**30** If I must be proud, I will be proud of the things that show my weakness.

**31** God, the Father of the Lord Jesus, knows that I do not lie. People must praise him forever.

**32** In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas put guards around the city to catch me.

**33** But my friends put me in a basket. They let me down through a window in the wall. Thus, I escaped from the governor.

## Chapter 12

**1** I must be proud, but it does not help. Now I will speak about visions and revelations from the Lord.

**2** I know a man in Christ. 14 years ago, God took that man up to the third heaven. I do not know if the man was in his body or out of his body. God knows.

**3** I know that God took this man up. I do not know if he was in his body or out of his body. God knows.

**4** God took this man up into paradise. There, the man heard words that a person cannot say. No person has permission to say those words.

**5** I will be proud of that man. But I will not be proud of myself, except of my weaknesses.

**6** If I want to be proud, I will not be a fool, because I will tell the truth. But I will not be proud. I do not want people to think more of me than what they see and hear.

**7** God gave me very great revelations. Thus, God gave me a pain in my body, so that I will not become too proud. The pain was like a sharp thorn. It was a messenger from Satan to hurt me.

**8** I asked the Lord 3 times to remove this pain from me.

**9** But the Lord said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you. My power is strongest when you are weak." Thus, I am very happy to be proud of my weaknesses. Then the power of Christ will stay on me.

**10** Thus, I am happy in my weaknesses for Christ. I am happy when people insult me, when I have difficulties, when people attack me, and when I have troubles. When I am weak, then I am strong.

**11** I spoke like a fool, but you forced me to do it. You must praise me. I am nothing, but I am not less than those "great apostles."

**12** I showed you the signs of an apostle with much patience. I did signs, wonders, and miracles among you.

**13** You got all the things that other churches got. But I did not ask you for money. Please forgive me this wrong!

**14** Now I am ready to visit you for the third time. And I will not ask you for money. I do not want your things. I want you. Children must not save money for their parents. Parents must save money for their children.

**15** I will be very happy to spend all that I have for you. I will also give myself for you. If I love you more, will you love me less?

**16** You agree that I was not a load for you. But some people say that I was clever and tricked you.

**17** Did I cheat you through the men whom I sent to you?

**18** I asked Titus to visit you, and I sent our brother with him. Did Titus cheat you? No! Titus and I have the same spirit. We do the same things.

**19** Possibly you think that we try to defend ourselves to you. No, we speak before God in Christ. Dear friends, all that we do is to make you stronger.

**20** I am afraid that when I come, you will not be as I want. And possibly I will not be as you want. I am afraid that there will be arguments, jealousy, and anger. I am afraid of fights, evil talk, gossip, pride, and disorder.

**21** I am afraid that when I come again, my God will make me humble among you. I am afraid that I will be sad for many people who sinned before. They did not repent of their impurity, sexual sins, and shameful actions.

## Chapter 13

**1** This will be the third time that I visit you. The scripture says, "2 or 3 witnesses must confirm each accusation."

**2** On my second visit, I warned the people who sinned. Now I am away, but I warn them again, and all other people too. When I come again, I will not be gentle.

**3** You want proof that Christ speaks through me. Christ is not weak when he deals with you. He is powerful among you.

**4** Christ was weak when people crucified him. But he lives by the power of God. We are also weak in Christ. But by the power of God we will live with Christ to serve you.

**5** Examine yourselves to see if you live in the faith. Test yourselves. You know that Jesus Christ is in you, unless you fail the test.

**6** I hope that you will know that we did not fail the test.

**7** We pray to God that you do nothing wrong. We do not pray this to show that we passed the test. We pray that you will do what is correct, even if people think that we failed.

**8** We cannot do anything against the truth. We can only do things for the truth.

**9** We are happy when we are weak and you are strong. We pray that you will become complete.

**10** Thus, I write these things while I am away. Then, when I am with you, I will not need to be severe. The Lord gave me authority to make you stronger, not to destroy you.

**11** Finally, brothers, goodbye. Try to become complete. Encourage each other. Agree with each other. Live in peace. Then the God of love and peace will be with you.

**12** Greet each other with a holy kiss.

**13** All the saints here send you their greetings.

**14** I pray that the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ will be with all of you. I pray that the love of God and the friendship of the Holy Spirit will be with all of you. Amen.

# Galatians

## Chapter 1

**1** This letter is from Paul, an apostle. People did not send me, and no person made me an apostle. Jesus Christ and God the Father made me an apostle. God raised Jesus from the dead.

**2** All the brothers who are with me also send this letter. We write to the churches in Galatia.

**3** We pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will give you grace and peace.

**4** Christ gave himself for our sins. He did this to save us from this evil world. God our Father wanted Christ to do this.

**5** Give glory to God forever and ever. Amen.

**6** It is a surprise to me that you leave God so quickly. God called you through the grace of Christ. But now you turn to a different gospel.

**7** That gospel is not really a gospel. But some people cause you trouble. They want to change the gospel of Christ.

**8** We preached the gospel to you. Possibly we, or an angel from heaven, will preach a different gospel to you. Then let God curse that person.

**9** We said this before, and now I say it again. If a person preaches to you a gospel that is different from the gospel that you received, let God curse that person.

**10** Do I try to get the approval of people, or the approval of God? Do I try to please people? If I continue to please people, I am not a servant of Christ.

**11** Brothers, I want you to know this: The gospel that I preached does not come from people.

**12** I did not receive it from a person. No person taught it to me. Jesus Christ showed it to me in a revelation.

**13** You heard about my life in the past, when I followed the Jewish religion. I attacked the church of God very violently. I tried to destroy the church.

**14** In the Jewish religion I was better than many people of my age in my nation. I had a very strong devotion to the traditions of my ancestors.

**15** But God chose me before my mother gave birth to me. He called me through his grace. Then God decided

**16** to show his Son to me. God wanted me to preach about his Son among the Gentiles (people who are not Jews). At that time I did not ask any person for advice.

**17** I did not go to Jerusalem to see the people who were apostles before me. I went to Arabia. Then I went back to Damascus.

**18** After 3 years, I went to Jerusalem to meet Peter. I stayed with him for 15 days.

**19** I did not see any other apostle. I saw only James, the brother of the Lord.

**20** I tell you the truth. God knows that the things which I write to you are not lies.

**21** Then I went to the areas of Syria and Cilicia.

**22** The churches of Christ in Judea did not know me personally.

**23** They only heard this: "The man who attacked us in the past now preaches the faith. Before, he tried to destroy the faith."

**24** And they praised God because of me.

## Chapter 2

**1** 14 years later, I went to Jerusalem again with Barnabas. I also took Titus with me.

**2** I went because God showed me in a revelation that I must go. I met privately with the leaders of the church. I told them the gospel that I preach among the Gentiles. I wanted to make sure that my work, in the past and now, was not without a result.

**3** Titus was with me. He is a Greek. But the leaders did not force him to receive circumcision.

**4** Some false brothers came into our group secretly. They came to spy on the freedom that we have in Christ Jesus. They wanted to make us slaves again.

**5** We did not obey them, not even for 1 hour. We wanted the truth of the gospel to stay with you.

**6** Some men seemed to be important leaders. What they were before is not important to me, because God does not judge by appearance. These leaders added nothing to my message.

**7** But they saw that God gave me the work to preach the gospel to the Gentiles. In the same way, God gave Peter the work to preach to the Jews.

**8** God worked through Peter to make him an apostle to the Jews. God also worked through me to make me an apostle to the Gentiles.

**9** James, Cephas, and John seemed to be the most important leaders. They saw that God gave me his grace. Thus, they shook hands with Barnabas and me as partners. They agreed that we must go to the Gentiles. They agreed to go to the Jews.

**10** They asked us only to remember the poor. I was eager to do this.

**11** But when Peter came to Antioch, I spoke against him in front of the people. He was clearly wrong.

**12** Before some men came from James, Peter ate with the Gentiles. But when those men came, Peter stopped. He separated himself from the Gentiles. He was afraid of the Jews who said that all men must receive circumcision.

**13** The other Jewish believers also acted falsely with Peter. Even Barnabas followed their false actions.

**14** I saw that they did not obey the truth of the gospel. So I spoke to Peter in front of all the people. I said, "You are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile, not like a Jew. So why do you force the Gentiles to live like Jews?"

**15** We are Jews by birth. We are not Gentile sinners.

**16** But we know that a person does not become righteous before God when he obeys the law. He becomes righteous by faith in Jesus Christ. So we also believed in Christ Jesus. We wanted God to make us righteous by faith in Christ, not by the law. No person will become righteous because he obeys the law.

**17** We try to become righteous through Christ. But possibly people find that we are still sinners. Does that mean that Christ causes sin? No!

**18** If I build again the things that I destroyed, I show that I break the law.

**19** Through the law, I died to the law. Thus, I can live for God.

**20** I died with Christ on the cross. Now I do not live, but Christ lives in me. I live my life in this body by faith in the Son of God. He loved me and gave himself for me.

**21** I do not reject the grace of God. If people can become righteous through the law, then Christ died for no reason.

## Chapter 3

**1** You foolish people of Galatia! Who tricked you? We showed you clearly that Jesus Christ died on the cross.

**2** Tell me only this: Did you receive the Spirit because you obeyed the law? Or did you receive the Spirit because you heard the message and believed it?

**3** Are you so foolish? You started with the Spirit. Do you now try to become complete with your own human strength?

**4** You suffered many things. Did you suffer for no result? I hope not!

**5** God gives you the Spirit and does miracles among you. Does he do this because you obey the law? Or does he do it because you hear the message and believe it?

**6** Abraham believed God. Thus, God accepted Abraham as righteous.

**7** Thus, you know that the people who have faith are the children of Abraham.

**8** The scripture said before that God will make the Gentiles righteous through faith. So the scripture told the good news to Abraham before: "Through you, God will bless all nations."

**9** Thus, the people who have faith receive the blessing with Abraham, who had faith.

**10** All people who depend on the works of the law are under a curse. The scripture says, "God curses each person who does not obey all the things in the book of the law."

**11** It is clear that no person becomes righteous before God by the law. The scripture says, "The righteous person will live by faith."

**12** The law does not depend on faith. The scripture says, "The person who obeys these laws will live by them."

**13** Christ made us free from the curse of the law. He took the curse on himself for us. The scripture says, "God curses each person who hangs on a tree."

**14** Christ did this so that the blessing of Abraham can come to the Gentiles through Christ Jesus. Thus, we can receive the promised Spirit through faith.

**15** Brothers, I will use an example from daily life. When people agree to a covenant (agreement) and confirm it, no person can cancel it. And no person can add to it.

**16** God gave his promises to Abraham and to his descendant. The scripture does not say "descendants," as if it means many people. It says "your descendant," and this means 1 person. That person is Christ.

**17** This is what I mean: God made a covenant and confirmed it. The law came 430 years later. The law cannot cancel the covenant and stop the promise.

**18** If we get the inheritance through the law, then it does not come through the promise. But God gave the inheritance to Abraham through a promise.

**19** Then why did God give the law? God added the law because of sins. The law was to continue until the descendant came. God gave the promise to that descendant. God gave the law through angels and through a man who went between God and the people.

**20** A man who goes between 2 groups does not act for 1 group only. But God is one.

**21** Is the law against the promises of God? No! If God gave a law that could give life, then people became righteous by the law.

**22** But the scripture says that all people are prisoners of sin. Thus, God gives the promise to the people who believe in Jesus Christ.

**23** Before faith came, the law kept us like prisoners. We were prisoners until God showed us the way of faith.

**24** Thus, the law was our guardian until Christ came. Then God could make us righteous through faith.

**25** Now that faith came, we do not need the guardian.

**26** All of you are children of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

**27** All of you who received baptism into Christ put on Christ, as you put on clothes.

**28** In Christ there is no Jew or Greek, no slave or free person, no male or female. All of you are one in Christ Jesus.

**29** If you belong to Christ, then you are the descendants of Abraham. You will get the things that God promised.

## Chapter 4

**1** I tell you this: While the heir is a child, he is the same as a slave. This is true even when he owns all the property.

**2** He must obey guardians and managers until the time that his father decided.

**3** It is the same with us. When we were children, we were slaves to the basic rules of this world.

**4** But at the correct time, God sent his Son. A woman gave birth to his Son. His Son lived under the law.

**5** God sent him to make free the people who were under the law. Thus, God could adopt us as his sons.

**6** You are his sons. Thus, God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. The Spirit calls, "Abba, Father."

**7** Thus, you are not a slave now. You are a son. And because you are a son, God will make you his heir through Christ.

**8** Before, you did not know God. You were slaves to things that are not really gods.

**9** But now you know God. Or, it is better to say that God knows you. So why do you turn back to those weak and poor rules? Why do you want to be slaves to those rules again?

**10** You follow special days, months, seasons, and years.

**11** I am afraid for you. Possibly my work for you had no result.

**12** Brothers, I ask you to become as I am. I became as you are. You did not do wrong to me.

**13** You know that I first preached the gospel to you because I was sick.

**14** My sickness was a test for you. But you did not hate me or reject me. You received me as an angel of God. You received me as if I was Christ Jesus.

**15** You were very happy then. What happened to that joy? I am a witness of this: if you could, you were ready to take out your own eyes and give them to me.

**16** Did I become your enemy because I tell you the truth?

**17** Those people are very eager to get your support, but not for a good purpose. They want to separate you from us. Then you will be eager to support them.

**18** It is always good to be eager for a good purpose. Be eager all the time, not only when I am with you.

**19** My little children, I feel pain for you again, as a woman feels pain when she gives birth. I will feel this pain until Christ is completely formed in you.

**20** I want to be with you now and speak to you in a different way. I do not know what to do about you.

**21** You want to obey the law. Tell me, do you not listen to what the law says?

**22** The scripture says that Abraham had 2 sons. 1 son was from a slave woman. The other son was from a free woman.

**23** The son of the slave woman came into the world in the natural way. But the son of the free woman came because of the promise of God.

**24** These things are an example. The 2 women are like 2 covenants. One covenant is from Mount Sinai. Its children become slaves. This covenant is Hagar.

**25** Hagar is like Mount Sinai in Arabia. She is like the city of Jerusalem now. Jerusalem and her children are slaves.

**26** But the Jerusalem in heaven is free. She is our mother.

**27** The scripture says, "Be happy, woman who cannot have children! Shout with joy, woman who did not feel the pains of birth! The woman who is alone will have more children than the woman who has a husband."

**28** Brothers, you are children of the promise, as Isaac was.

**29** At that time, the son who came in the natural way attacked the son who came by the Spirit. It is the same now.

**30** But what does the scripture say? "Send away the slave woman and her son. The son of the slave woman will not share the inheritance with the son of the free woman."

**31** Thus, brothers, we are not children of the slave woman. We are children of the free woman.

## Chapter 5

**1** Christ made us free. Thus, stand firmly in this freedom. Do not become slaves of the law again.

**2** Listen! I, Paul, tell you this: If you receive circumcision, then Christ will not help you at all.

**3** Again I tell each man who receives circumcision that he must obey all of the law.

**4** You try to become righteous by the law. Then you separated yourselves from Christ. You went away from grace.

**5** But through the Spirit, we wait by faith for the righteousness that we hope for.

**6** In Christ Jesus, circumcision has no value. And no circumcision has no value. The important thing is faith that shows itself through love.

**7** You lived very well. Who stopped you? Who caused you to not obey the truth?

**8** That persuasion does not come from God, who calls you.

**9** "A small quantity of yeast causes the whole quantity of dough to rise."

**10** I trust in the Lord that you will not think differently. The person who causes you trouble will get punishment, whoever he is.

**11** Brothers, if I still preach circumcision, then why do people still attack me? If I preach circumcision, then the cross no longer offends people.

**12** I wish that the people who cause you trouble will cut themselves off completely!

**13** Brothers, God called you to be free. But do not use your freedom as an opportunity to sin. Serve each other with love.

**14** All the law is in 1 command: "Love other people as you love yourself."

**15** But if you continue to fight and hurt each other, be careful. You will destroy each other.

**16** Thus, I tell you this: Let the Spirit control your life. Then you will not do the bad things that your human nature wants.

**17** The human nature wants things that are against the Spirit. And the Spirit wants things that are against the human nature. These 2 are enemies. Thus, you do not do the things that you want to do.

**18** But if the Spirit leads you, then you are not under the law.

**19** The actions of the human nature are clear. They are adultery, sexual sins, impurity, and shameful actions.

**20** They are worship of idols, witchcraft, hate, arguments, jealousy, and anger. They are fights, divisions, and false groups.

**21** They are envy, murder, drunkenness, wild parties, and other such things. I warn you now, as I warned you before. The people who do such things will not receive the kingdom of God.

**22** But the Spirit causes love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, and faithfulness.

**23** The Spirit also causes gentleness and self-control. No law is against such things.

**24** The people who belong to Christ killed their human nature on the cross. They killed its emotions and bad wishes.

**25** We live by the Spirit. Thus, we must also let the Spirit lead us.

**26** We must not be proud. We must not make each other angry. We must not be jealous of each other.

## Chapter 6

**1** Brothers, possibly a person does a sin. Then you who are spiritual must help that person to come back. Help him gently. Be careful, because temptation can also come to you.

**2** Help each other with your difficulties. Thus, you will obey the law of Christ.

**3** If a person thinks that he is important when he is not, he tricks himself.

**4** Each person must examine his own work. Then he can be proud of his own work. He must not compare himself with other people.

**5** Each person must carry his own load.

**6** The person who learns the word of God must share all good things with his teacher.

**7** Do not let people trick you. No person can trick God. A person will harvest the things that he plants.

**8** A person who plants to please his human nature will harvest death from that nature. But a person who plants to please the Spirit will harvest eternal life from the Spirit.

**9** We must not become tired of doing good things. At the correct time we will harvest, if we do not stop.

**10** Thus, when we have the opportunity, we must do good things for all people. We must especially do good things for the family of believers.

**11** Look at the large letters that I use when I write to you with my own hand!

**12** Some people want to look good to other people. These people try to force you to receive circumcision. They do this only because they do not want people to attack them for the cross of Christ.

**13** The people who receive circumcision do not obey the law. But they want you to receive circumcision. Then they can be proud of your bodies.

**14** But I will be proud only of the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Through the cross, the world is dead to me, and I am dead to the world.

**15** In Christ Jesus, circumcision has no value. And no circumcision has no value. The important thing is to be a new creation.

**16** I pray for peace and mercy on all the people who follow this rule. I also pray for peace and mercy on the Israel of God.

**17** From now on, no person must cause me trouble. I have the marks of the Lord Jesus on my body.

**18** Brothers, I pray that the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ will be with your spirit. Amen.

# Ephesians

## Chapter 1

**1** I, Paul, am an apostle of Jesus Christ because God wants this. I write this letter to the saints in Ephesus. I write to the people who are faithful in Christ Jesus.

**2** I ask that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

**3** Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God gave us all spiritual blessings in the heavenly places in Christ.

**4** Before God made the world, he chose us in Christ. He chose us so that we will be holy and without fault in front of him. He did this because of his love.

**5** Before that time, God decided to make us his children through Jesus Christ. God did this because it was his good will and his pleasure.

**6** God did this so that people will praise his great grace. He gave this grace to us freely in the Son that he loves.

**7** In Christ, God bought us back to be free through the blood of Christ. God forgave our sins because his grace is very rich.

**8** God gave us much grace. He also gave us all wisdom and good judgment.

**9** God told us the secret of his will. He did this because of his good pleasure. He decided on this plan in himself.

**10** God has a plan for the correct time. At that time, he will bring together all things under Christ as head. He will bring together the things in heaven and the things on earth in Christ.

**11** In Christ, we also got an inheritance. God chose us for this before that time. God does all things as his will decides.

**12** God did this so that we, who first put our hope in Christ, will cause people to praise his glory.

**13** You also trusted in Christ after you heard the word of truth. This word is the gospel that saves you. After you believed, God put his seal on you. This seal is the Holy Spirit that he promised.

**14** The Holy Spirit is the first payment of our inheritance. He is the proof that God will make his people completely free. Then people will praise the glory of God.

**15** Thus, I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus. I also heard about your love for all the saints.

**16** Thus, I do not stop when I thank God for you. I speak about you in my prayers.

**17** I pray to the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory. I ask him to give you a spirit of wisdom and revelation. Then you will know God better.

**18** I pray that God will give light to the eyes of your heart. Then you will know the hope that he calls you to. You will know the rich glory of his inheritance in the saints.

**19** Also, you will know that God's power for us who believe is very great. This power is the same as the work of his strong power.

**20** God used this power in Christ when he raised Christ from the dead. God put Christ at his right side in the heavenly places.

**21** Christ is far above all rulers, authorities, powers and lords. He is above every name that people use, in this world and also in the world that will come.

**22** God put all things under the feet of Christ. God made Christ the head over all things for the church.

**23** The church is the body of Christ. The church is full of Christ, who fills all things in every way.

## Chapter 2

**1** You were dead because of your wrong actions and your sins. But God made you alive.

**2** Before, you lived in these sins. You followed the ways of this world. You obeyed the ruler of the power of the air. This ruler is the spirit that now works in the people who do not obey God.

**3** At one time, we all also lived among these people. We did the things that our sinful nature wanted. We obeyed the desires of our body and our mind. Like the other people, our nature caused God to be angry with us.

**4** But God has much mercy. He loved us with a great love.

**5** We were dead because of our sins. But God made us alive with Christ. God saved you because of his grace.

**6** God raised us up with Christ. God put us with Christ in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus.

**7** God did this so that, in the time that will come, he can show the very great riches of his grace. He shows his grace by his kindness to us in Christ Jesus.

**8** God saved you by grace, through faith. You did not save yourselves. Your salvation is a gift from God.

**9** Your salvation does not come from your good actions. Thus, no person can say that he is proud of his work.

**10** God made us. He made us in Christ Jesus so that we will do good works. Before that time, God prepared these good works for us to do.

**11** Remember that before, you were Gentiles by birth. The Jews call themselves "the circumcision." They called you "the uncircumcision." But their circumcision is only a thing that hands do to the body.

**12** At that time, you were without Christ. You were not citizens of Israel. You were strangers to the agreements (covenants) of the promise. You had no hope, and you did not know God in the world.

**13** Before, you were far from God. But now in Christ Jesus, the blood of Christ brings you near.

**14** Christ is our peace. He made the Jews and the Gentiles into one group. He broke down the wall of hate that kept them apart.

**15** Through his body, Christ stopped the hate. He stopped the law of commandments and rules. He did this to make one new people from the 2 groups. Thus, he made peace.

**16** Through the cross, Christ brought both groups back to God in one body. On the cross, Christ killed the hate.

**17** Christ came and told the good news of peace to you who were far away. He also told it to the people who were near.

**18** Through Christ, we both can come to the Father by one Spirit.

**19** Thus, you are not strangers and foreigners now. You are citizens together with the saints. You are members of the family of God.

**20** You are a building on the foundation of the apostles and prophets. Jesus Christ himself is the most important stone at the corner.

**21** In Christ, all the building joins together correctly. The building grows into a holy temple in the Lord.

**22** In Christ, God also builds you together with the others. You become a place where God lives through the Spirit.

## Chapter 3

**1** Because of this, I pray. I, Paul, am a prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles.

**2** You heard about the work that God gave me. God gave me his grace so that I can help you.

**3** God showed me the secret plan by revelation. I wrote a short letter to you about this before.

**4** When you read that letter, you can understand my knowledge of the secret plan of Christ.

**5** In past times, God did not show this secret to the people. But now the Spirit shows it to God's holy apostles and prophets.

**6** This is the secret: through the gospel, the Gentiles will get an inheritance together with the Jews. They are members of the same body. They share the promise of God in Christ Jesus.

**7** I became a servant of this gospel. God gave me this work as a gift of his grace. He did this through the work of his power.

**8** I am less important than all the saints. But God gave me this grace. He gave it so that I will tell the Gentiles about the riches of Christ. No person can know all these riches.

**9** God sent me to show all people how this secret plan works. From the start of the world, God kept this plan hidden in himself. God made all things through Jesus Christ.

**10** Now God shows his wisdom through the church to the rulers and authorities in the heavenly places. His wisdom has many parts.

**11** God did this because of his plan for all time. He did this plan through Christ Jesus our Lord.

**12** In Christ, we can come near to God with courage and confidence because of our faith in Christ.

**13** Thus, I ask you: do not lose courage because of my troubles for you. My troubles bring honor to you.

**14** Because of this, I go down on my knees in front of the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

**15** Every family in heaven and on earth gets its name from the Father.

**16** I pray that God will give you strength in your heart through his Spirit. His glory is very rich.

**17** I pray that Christ will live in your hearts through faith. I pray that your roots and your foundation will be in love.

**18** Then, with all the saints, you will understand how wide, long, high and deep the love of Christ is.

**19** I pray that you will know the love of Christ. This love is greater than all knowledge. Then God will fill you completely with all his fullness.

**20** God can do much more than all the things that we ask or think. He does this through his power that works in us.

**21** Give glory to God in the church and in Christ Jesus. Give him glory through all ages, for all time. Amen.

## Chapter 4

**1** Thus, I, a prisoner for the Lord, ask you to live as people that God called. Live in a way that is correct for that call.

**2** Always be humble and gentle. Be patient. Accept each other in love.

**3** Try hard to keep the unity that the Spirit gives. Peace keeps you together.

**4** There is one body and one Spirit. God called you to one hope.

**5** There is one Lord, one faith and one baptism.

**6** There is one God and Father of all people. He is over all, through all and in all.

**7** But Christ gave grace to each of us. He decided how much to give to each person.

**8** Thus, the scripture says, "When he went up to the highest place, he took many prisoners. He gave gifts to people."

**9** What does "he went up" mean? It means that he also went down first to the lower parts of the earth.

**10** The person who went down is the same person who went up far above all the heavens. He did this to fill all things.

**11** Christ gave some people to be apostles. He gave some to be prophets. He gave some to be evangelists. He gave some to be pastors and teachers.

**12** He did this to prepare the saints for the work of service. They will make the body of Christ strong.

**13** This work will continue until we all agree in the faith. We will all know the Son of God. We will become mature, and we will be as complete as Christ.

**14** Then we will not be like children. False teachings will not push us here and there like waves in the wind. Bad people will not trick us with their clever lies.

**15** But we will speak the truth in love. In all things, we will grow to be more like Christ. Christ is the head.

**16** Christ joins the whole body together. Each joint helps to keep the body together. When each part does its work, the body grows. The body makes itself strong in love.

**17** Thus, I tell you this in the name of the Lord: Do not live like the Gentiles live. Their thoughts have no value.

**18** Their minds are in darkness. They are far from the life of God because they do not know God. Their hearts are hard.

**19** They do not feel shame now. They give themselves to sexual sin. They want to do all types of bad things, and they always want more.

**20** But you did not learn this about Christ.

**21** You heard about Christ, and people taught you the truth that is in Jesus.

**22** They taught you to stop your old way of life. Your old self is bad because of its desires that trick you.

**23** Let God make the attitude of your minds new.

**24** Become the new person that God made. This new person is like God. He is good and truly holy.

**25** Thus, stop your lies. Each person must speak the truth to his neighbor, because we are all members of one body.

**26** When you are angry, do not sin. Stop your anger before the sun goes down.

**27** Do not give the devil a chance to work.

**28** The person who stole must not steal again. He must work hard with his hands and do good things. Then he will have something to give to people who need help.

**29** Do not speak bad words. Only say good things that help other people grow. Then your words will help the people who hear them.

**30** Do not make the Holy Spirit of God sad. God put the seal of the Spirit on you for the day when he will make you free.

**31** Stop all bitterness, rage and anger. Stop all shouts and bad words against other people. Stop all wishes to hurt other people.

**32** Be kind to each other and have pity on each other. Forgive each other, as God forgave you through Christ.

## Chapter 5

**1** Thus, copy God, because you are his children and he loves you.

**2** Live in love, as Christ loved us. Christ gave himself for us as an offering and a sacrifice to God. This sacrifice was like a sweet smell to God.

**3** Sexual sin, all bad actions and greed must not be among you. Not one person must even speak about these things. These things are not correct for saints.

**4** Do not say dirty or foolish things. Do not make bad jokes. These things are not correct. Instead, thank God.

**5** You know this: a person who does sexual sin will get no inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God. A person who does bad things or who is greedy will get no inheritance. A greedy person worships idols.

**6** Do not let any person trick you with empty words. Because of these sins, God is angry with the people who do not obey him.

**7** Thus, do not join these people.

**8** Before, you were in darkness. But now you are light in the Lord. Live as children of light.

**9** The light gives all goodness, righteousness and truth.

**10** Learn the things that make the Lord happy.

**11** Do not join in the bad works of darkness, because they give nothing good. Instead, show that they are bad.

**12** These people do things in secret. It is shameful even to speak about those things.

**13** But the light shows all things clearly. And the light makes all things visible.

**14** Thus, the scripture says, "Wake up, you who sleep. Rise from the dead. Christ will give you light."

**15** Thus, be careful how you live. Do not live as foolish people. Live as wise people.

**16** Use every chance well, because these days are bad.

**17** Thus, do not be foolish. Understand what the Lord wants.

**18** Do not become drunk with wine, because wine causes a bad way of life. Instead, let the Spirit fill you.

**19** Speak to each other with psalms, hymns and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your heart to the Lord.

**20** Always thank God the Father for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

**21** Obey each other because you respect Christ.

**22** Wives, obey your husbands as you obey the Lord.

**23** The husband is the head of the wife, as Christ is the head of the church. Christ is the Savior of the church, which is his body.

**24** The church obeys Christ. In the same way, wives must obey their husbands in all things.

**25** Husbands, love your wives as Christ loved the church. Christ gave himself for the church.

**26** He did this to make the church holy. He made the church clean with water through the word.

**27** He did this to put the church in front of himself as a glorious church. The church will have no spot and no wrinkle or other fault. The church will be holy and without fault.

**28** In the same way, husbands must love their wives as they love their own bodies. A man who loves his wife loves himself.

**29** No person hates his own body. Each person feeds his body and cares for it. Christ does the same for the church.

**30** We are members of the body of Christ.

**31** "Because of this, a man will leave his father and mother and join his wife. The 2 people will become one body."

**32** This secret is very important. But I speak about Christ and the church.

**33** But each of you must love his wife as he loves himself. And the wife must respect her husband.

## Chapter 6

**1** Children, obey your parents in the Lord, because this is correct.

**2** "Honor your father and mother." This is the first commandment that has a promise.

**3** The promise is this: "Then things will go well for you, and you will live a long time on the earth."

**4** Fathers, do not make your children angry. Teach and correct them in the way of the Lord.

**5** Slaves, obey your masters on earth. Respect them and fear them. Obey them with an honest heart, as you obey Christ.

**6** Do not obey them only when they watch you, to make them happy. Obey them as slaves of Christ. Do the will of God with all your heart.

**7** Serve your masters with a good attitude. Serve them as you serve the Lord, not as you serve people.

**8** You know that the Lord will reward each person for the good things that he does. He will reward a slave and a free person.

**9** Masters, act in the same way to your slaves. Do not threaten them. You know that the Master of the slaves and of you is in heaven. He treats all people the same.

**10** Last, my brothers, be strong in the Lord and in his great power.

**11** Put on all the armor of God. Then you can stand against the tricks of the devil.

**12** We do not fight against human people. We fight against the rulers, the authorities and the powers of the darkness in this world. We fight against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly places.

**13** Thus, take all the armor of God. Then you can fight against the enemy on the bad day. After you do all things, you will continue to stand.

**14** Thus, stand strong. Put on truth like a belt around your waist. Put on righteousness like armor on your chest.

**15** Put on the readiness of the gospel of peace like shoes on your feet.

**16** Also, take faith as a shield. With this shield, you can stop all the arrows of fire of the evil one.

**17** Take salvation as a helmet. Take the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

**18** Always pray in the Spirit with all types of prayers and requests. Watch carefully and do not stop. Pray for all the saints.

**19** Pray for me also. Pray that God will give me the correct words when I speak. Then I can tell the secret of the gospel with courage.

**20** I am a messenger for the gospel, and now I am in chains. Pray that I will speak the gospel with courage, as I must.

**21** Tychicus is a brother that we love. He is a faithful servant in the Lord. He will tell you all things about me. Then you will know about my life and what I do.

**22** I send Tychicus to you for this purpose. I want you to know about us. I want Tychicus to make your hearts strong.

**23** I ask that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give peace to the brothers. I ask them to give you love with faith.

**24** I ask God to give grace to all the people who love our Lord Jesus Christ with a love that does not stop. Amen.
