# Philippians

## Chapter 1

**1** Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, write this letter. We write to all the saints in Christ Jesus in Philippi. We also write to the leaders and the helpers (deacons) of the church.

**2** We ask that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

**3** Each time that I remember you, I thank my God.

**4** In all my prayers for all of you, I always pray with joy.

**5** I thank God because you helped me with the gospel from the first day until now.

**6** I am sure of this: God started a good work in you. He will continue this work until the day when Jesus Christ comes. Then the work will be complete.

**7** It is correct for me to think this about all of you, because you are in my heart. I am in chains now. Before, I defended the gospel and showed that it is true. At all these times, you shared God's grace with me.

**8** God knows that I want very much to see all of you. I love you with the love of Jesus Christ.

**9** This is my prayer: I pray that your love will grow more and more. I pray that it will grow in knowledge and in all good judgment.

**10** Then you will know which things are the best. You will be pure and without fault until the day of Christ.

**11** Jesus Christ will fill you with the good results of righteousness. Then people will give glory and praise to God.

**12** Brothers, I want you to know this: the things that happened to me helped the gospel to spread.

**13** All the palace guard and all the other people know that I am in chains because of Christ.

**14** Because I am in chains, most of the brothers in the Lord have more confidence. They speak the word of God with more courage and without fear.

**15** It is true that some people tell about Christ because they are jealous and want to fight. But other people tell about Christ because they have good will.

**16** The first group tells about Christ to compete with me. Their reasons are not honest. They think that they will give me more trouble while I am in chains.

**17** But the other group tells about Christ because of love. They know that God put me here to defend the gospel.

**18** What is the result? People tell about Christ in all ways, with false reasons or with true reasons. Because of this, I am happy. And I will continue to be happy.

**19** You pray for me, and the Spirit of Jesus Christ helps me. Thus, I know that these things will make me free.

**20** I hope very much that I will have no shame. I hope that I will have courage, now and always. Then, by my life or by my death, people will see that Christ is great.

**21** For me, life is Christ, and death is a gain.

**22** If I continue to live in my body, I can do useful work. But I do not know which thing to choose.

**23** I find it difficult to choose between the 2 things. I want to leave this life and be with Christ. That is much better.

**24** But it is more necessary for you that I stay in my body.

**25** I am sure of this. Thus, I know that I will stay and continue with all of you. I will help you to grow and to have joy in your faith.

**26** When I come to you again, you will have more reasons to be proud in Christ Jesus because of me.

**27** Only live in a way that is correct for the gospel of Christ. Maybe I will come and see you, or maybe I will be away. But I want to hear this about you: you stand strong in one spirit. You work together with one mind for the faith of the gospel.

**28** Do not let your enemies make you afraid in any way. This will show your enemies that God will destroy them. But it will show you that God will save you.

**29** God gave you the chance to believe in Christ. God also gave you the chance to suffer for Christ.

**30** You have the same fight that you saw me have. And now you hear that I still have this fight.

## Chapter 2

**1** Christ gives you encouragement. His love gives you comfort. You share in the Spirit. You have kindness and mercy.

**2** Thus, make my joy complete: think in the same way. Have the same love. Agree with each other and have one purpose.

**3** Do nothing because you want to compete or because you are proud. Be humble. Think that other people are more important than you.

**4** Each person must not think only about his own interests. Each person must also think about the interests of other people.

**5** Have the same attitude that Christ Jesus had.

**6** Christ was God by nature. But he did not think that he must hold on to his equality with God.

**7** Instead, he gave up all things. He took the nature of a servant. He became a human.

**8** He was a man, and he made himself humble. He obeyed God until his death. He died on a cross.

**9** Thus, God raised Christ to the highest place. God gave him the name that is above every name.

**10** God did this so that every person will go down on his knees at the name of Jesus. All in heaven, on earth and under the earth will do this.

**11** Every person will say that Jesus Christ is Lord. This will give glory to God the Father.

**12** My dear friends, you always obeyed me when I was with you. Now I am away from you, so you must obey more. With fear and respect, continue to work out your salvation.

**13** God works in you. He gives you the will and the power to do the things that make him happy.

**14** Do all things without complaints and arguments.

**15** Then you will be pure and without fault. You will be children of God without fault among bad and dishonest people. Among them, you shine like lights in the world.

**16** Hold on to the word of life. Then, on the day of Christ, I will be proud of you. I will know that my work for you was not useless.

**17** Your faith is a sacrifice and a service to God. Possibly I will pour out my blood like an offering on your sacrifice. If this occurs, I will be glad. I will share my joy with all of you.

**18** In the same way, you must also be glad and share your joy with me.

**19** I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon. Then I will know how you are, and this news will give me comfort.

**20** I have no other person like Timothy. He truly cares about you.

**21** All the other people think only about their own interests. They do not think about the interests of Jesus Christ.

**22** But you know that Timothy showed his value. Like a son with his father, he served with me in the work of the gospel.

**23** Thus, I hope to send Timothy to you immediately after I know what will occur to me.

**24** And I trust in the Lord that I myself will also come soon.

**25** But I think that it is necessary to send Epaphroditus back to you. He is my brother. He works with me and fights with me like a soldier. You sent him to help me with my needs.

**26** He wants very much to see all of you. He was very sad because you heard that he was sick.

**27** It is true that he was sick and almost died. But God had mercy on him. God also had mercy on me. Thus, I did not have sorrow added to my sorrow.

**28** Thus, I want very much to send him to you. When you see him again, you will be glad. And I will have less sorrow.

**29** Receive him in the Lord with much joy. Honor people like him.

**30** He almost died for the work of Christ. He put his life in danger to help me. He did the work that you could not do for me.

## Chapter 3

**1** Last, my brothers, be glad in the Lord. I am happy to write the same things to you again. These things will keep you safe.

**2** Be careful of the bad people. They are like dogs. They do evil work. They want to cut your body.

**3** We are the true circumcision. We worship God by the Spirit of God. We are proud of Christ Jesus. We do not trust in human actions.

**4** But I can also have trust in human actions. Some people think that they have reasons to trust in human actions. I have more reasons than they have.

**5** People circumcised me on the eighth day after my birth. I am from the people of Israel and from the tribe of Benjamin. I am a Hebrew, and my parents are Hebrews. About the law, I was a Pharisee.

**6** I had much zeal, so I attacked the church. About the righteousness in the law, I had no fault.

**7** But these things were a gain to me before. Now I think that they are a loss because of Christ.

**8** It is true that I think all things are a loss. To know Christ Jesus my Lord is much better than all things. Because of Christ, I lost all things. I think that these things are garbage. I want only to get Christ.

**9** I want to be in Christ. My righteousness does not come from the law. My righteousness comes through faith in Christ. This righteousness comes from God, and it is through faith.

**10** I want to know Christ and the power of his resurrection. I want to share in his sufferings. I want to become like him in his death.

**11** Then, in some way, I will rise from the dead.

**12** I do not say that I have all these things now. I do not say that I am perfect now. But I continue to try to get the prize. Christ Jesus took me for this purpose.

**13** Brothers, I do not think that I have this prize now. But I do one thing. I forget the things behind me. I reach for the things in front of me.

**14** I run to the finish to get the prize. God calls me to heaven in Christ Jesus to get this prize.

**15** All of us who are mature must think in this way. If you think differently about something, God will show you the truth about that thing.

**16** But we must continue to live by the truth that we have now.

**17** Brothers, all of you must copy me. Watch the people who live as we live. We are an example for you.

**18** Many people live as enemies of the cross of Christ. I told you about these people many times. Now I cry while I tell you again.

**19** In the end, God will destroy these people. Their god is their stomach. They are proud of their shameful actions. They think only about things on earth.

**20** But we are citizens of heaven. We wait for our Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ, to come from heaven.

**21** Christ will change our weak human bodies. He will make our bodies like his glorious body. He will do this by the power that lets him control all things.

## Chapter 4

**1** Thus, my dear brothers, I love you and I want to see you. You are my joy and my crown. Stand strong in the Lord, my dear friends.

**2** I ask Euodia and Syntyche to agree with each other in the Lord.

**3** And I also ask you, my true partner: help these women. They worked hard with me for the gospel. Clement and my other helpers also worked with me. Their names are in the book of life.

**4** Always be glad in the Lord. I tell you again: be glad.

**5** Let all people know that you are gentle. The Lord is near.

**6** Do not worry about anything. In all things, pray and ask God for what you need. Thank him and tell him your requests.

**7** Then the peace of God will keep your hearts and minds safe in Christ Jesus. This peace is greater than all that people can know.

**8** Last, brothers, think about the things that are true, honorable, correct, pure, lovely and good. Think about the things that are excellent and that deserve praise.

**9** Do the things that you learned, received, heard and saw in me. Then the God of peace will be with you.

**10** I am very glad in the Lord, because now again you show that you care about me. You cared about me before, but you did not have a chance to show it.

**11** I do not say this because I need something. I learned to be content in all conditions.

**12** I know how to live with little. I know how to live with much. I learned how to live in all conditions. I can be full or hungry. I can have much or have less than I need.

**13** I can do all things through Christ, who gives me strength.

**14** But you did a good thing when you shared my troubles.

**15** You Philippians know this: at the start of the gospel work, I left Macedonia. At that time, only your church shared with me. Only you gave to me and received from me.

**16** When I was in Thessalonica, you sent help for my needs more than one time.

**17** I do not want a gift for myself. I want a good result that will go into your account.

**18** I have all that I need, and more. I have much, because Epaphroditus brought me your gifts. Your gifts are like a sweet smell to God. They are a sacrifice that God accepts and that makes him happy.

**19** My God will give you all that you need. He will do this from his great riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

**20** Give glory to our God and Father for all time. Amen.

**21** Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you greetings.

**22** All the saints send you greetings. Most of all, the saints in the house of Caesar send you greetings.

**23** I ask that the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ will be with all of you. Amen.

# Colossians

## Chapter 1

**1** I, Paul, am an apostle of Jesus Christ because God wants this. Timothy, our brother, is with me.

**2** We write to the saints and the faithful brothers in Christ in Colossae. We ask that God our Father give you grace and peace.

**3** We always pray for you. We thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

**4** We heard about your faith in Christ Jesus. We also heard about your love for all the saints.

**5** You have faith and love because of the hope that God keeps for you in heaven. You heard about this hope before in the true word of the gospel.

**6** The gospel came to you. In all the world, the gospel gives good results and grows. The gospel also did this among you. It started on the day when you heard the gospel and truly understood the grace of God.

**7** You learned the gospel from Epaphras. We love him, and he serves with us. He is a faithful servant of Christ for us.

**8** Epaphras told us about your love in the Spirit.

**9** Thus, since the day we heard about you, we do not stop our prayers for you. We ask God to fill you with the knowledge of his will. We ask him to give you all wisdom and spiritual knowledge.

**10** Then you will live in a way that is correct for the Lord. You will make him happy in all things. You will do all types of good work. You will know God better and better.

**11** We pray that God will make you strong with all strength from his glorious power. Then you will be patient in all things, and you will have joy.

**12** We pray that you will thank the Father. He made you able to share the inheritance of the saints in the kingdom of light.

**13** God made us free from the power of darkness. He brought us into the kingdom of his Son, whom he loves.

**14** Through the Son, God bought us back to be free. God forgave our sins.

**15** The Son is the image of God, whom no person can see. The Son is first and highest over all things that God made.

**16** God made all things through the Son. He made all things in heaven and on earth, the things that people can see and the things that they cannot see. He made all thrones, powers, rulers and authorities. God made all things through the Son and for the Son.

**17** The Son was before all things. The Son keeps all things together.

**18** The Son is the head of the body, which is the church. He is the start. He is the first to rise from the dead. Thus, he is the most important in all things.

**19** God wanted all his fullness to live in the Son.

**20** Through the Son, God brought all things back to himself. He brought back the things on earth and the things in heaven. God made peace through the blood of the Son on the cross.

**21** Before, you were far from God. You were his enemies in your minds because of your evil actions.

**22** But now God brought you back to himself through the death of Christ in his human body. God did this to put you in front of himself as holy people. You will have no fault, and no person will accuse you.

**23** But you must continue in the faith. Stand strong on its foundation. Do not move away from the hope of the gospel. You heard this gospel. People told it to all people under heaven. I, Paul, became a servant of this gospel.

**24** Now I am glad when I suffer for you. In my body, I complete the sufferings of Christ that are not complete. I do this for his body, which is the church.

**25** I became a servant of the church because God gave me this work. God gave me the work for you. My work is to tell the word of God completely.

**26** This word is the secret that God kept hidden through all ages and generations. But now God shows this secret to his saints.

**27** God wanted to show to his saints the rich glory of this secret among the Gentiles. This is the secret: Christ is in you. Christ is your hope of glory.

**28** We tell all people about Christ. We warn every person, and we teach every person with all wisdom. We want to put every person in front of God as mature in Christ.

**29** For this purpose, I work and fight hard. I use the strength of Christ, which works powerfully in me.

## Chapter 2

**1** I want you to know how hard I work for you. I also work hard for the people in Laodicea. I work for all the people who did not meet me in person.

**2** I want them to have encouragement in their hearts. I want love to join them together. I want them to have the riches of complete and certain knowledge. Then they will know the secret of God, which is Christ.

**3** God put all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge in Christ, in a secret place.

**4** I tell you this so that no person will trick you with words that sound good.

**5** My body is not with you, but I am with you in my spirit. I am happy to see that you live in good order. I am happy that your faith in Christ is strong.

**6** You received Christ Jesus as Lord. Thus, continue to live in him.

**7** Let your roots grow deep into Christ, and build your lives on him. Become strong in the faith, as people taught you. Always give thanks.

**8** Be careful. Do not let any person take control of you through empty and false ideas. These ideas come from human traditions and from the spiritual powers of the world. They do not come from Christ.

**9** All the fullness of God lives in Christ in a human body.

**10** And you are complete in Christ. He is the head over all rulers and authorities.

**11** In Christ, you also received circumcision. Human hands did not do this circumcision. Christ did this circumcision. He removed your sinful nature.

**12** When you received baptism, God buried you with Christ. In baptism, God also raised you with Christ through your faith. You believed in the power of God, who raised Christ from the dead.

**13** You were dead because of your sins. You did not have circumcision in your sinful nature. But God made you alive with Christ. God forgave all your sins.

**14** There was a written record of our debts against us. The rules in this record were against us. God removed this record. He nailed it to the cross.

**15** God took the power from the rulers and authorities. He showed everyone that they had no power. He won against them through the cross.

**16** Thus, do not let any person judge you about food or drink. Do not let any person judge you about a holy day, a new moon or a Sabbath day.

**17** These things are only a shadow of the things that will come. The true thing is Christ.

**18** Some people like to show false humility. They worship angels. They speak about visions that they say they saw. Their human minds make them proud for no reason. Do not let these people take your prize from you.

**19** These people do not hold on to Christ, who is the head. The whole body gets food from the head through its joints and ligaments. The body joins together and grows as God makes it grow.

**20** You died with Christ, and you are free from the spiritual powers of the world. Thus, why do you live as if you are in the world? Why do you obey its rules?

**21** These rules say, "Do not hold this. Do not taste that. Do not touch that."

**22** All these things go to destruction when people use them. These rules are only human commandments and lessons.

**23** It is true that these rules seem wise. They cause people to worship in their own way, to show false humility and to treat the body badly. But these rules do not help people to stop the desires of the sinful nature.

## Chapter 3

**1** God raised you with Christ. Thus, try to get the things in heaven. In heaven, Christ sits at the right side of God.

**2** Think about the things in heaven. Do not think about the things on earth.

**3** You died, and God keeps your life in a secret place with Christ in God.

**4** Christ is your life. When Christ comes again, you will also come with him in glory.

**5** Thus, kill the earthly desires in you. Stop sexual sin, impure actions, bad passions, evil desires and greed. Greed is the same as the worship of idols.

**6** Because of these sins, God is angry with the people who do not obey him.

**7** You also did these sins before, when you lived in them.

**8** But now you must also stop all these things: anger, rage, wishes to hurt other people, insults and dirty words.

**9** Do not lie to each other. You stopped your old self and its actions.

**10** You started your new self. God makes this new self new again and again in knowledge. He makes it like himself, because he made it.

**11** In this new life, there is no difference between Greek and Jew. There is no difference between circumcised and uncircumcised people. There is no difference between foreigner, Scythian, slave or free person. Christ is all, and he is in all.

**12** God chose you. You are holy, and he loves you. Thus, have pity and kindness. Be humble, gentle and patient.

**13** Accept each other. If a person has a complaint against another person, forgive him. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.

**14** Most of all, have love. Love joins all these things together completely.

**15** Let the peace of Christ control your hearts. God called you to this peace as members of one body. And be thankful.

**16** Let the word of Christ live richly in you. Teach and warn each other with all wisdom. Sing psalms, hymns and spiritual songs. Thank God in your hearts when you sing.

**17** In all the things that you say or do, do them in the name of the Lord Jesus. Thank God the Father through him.

**18** Wives, obey your husbands, as is correct in the Lord.

**19** Husbands, love your wives. Do not be harsh with them.

**20** Children, obey your parents in all things, because this makes the Lord happy.

**21** Fathers, do not make your children angry. If you do, they will lose courage.

**22** Slaves, obey your masters on earth in all things. Do not obey them only when they watch you, to make them happy. Obey them with an honest heart, because you respect the Lord.

**23** In all the things that you do, work with all your heart. Work for the Lord, not for people.

**24** You know that the Lord will give you an inheritance as a reward. You serve the Lord Christ.

**25** A person who does wrong will get the result of his wrong. God treats all people the same.

## Chapter 4

**1** Masters, give your slaves what is correct and fair. You know that you also have a Master in heaven.

**2** Continue to pray. Be alert when you pray, and thank God.

**3** Also pray for us. Pray that God will give us a chance to speak the secret of Christ. Because of this secret, I am in chains.

**4** Pray that I will speak the secret clearly, as I must.

**5** Be wise in how you act with people who are not believers. Use every chance well.

**6** Always speak with grace and with good words. Then you will know how to answer each person.

**7** Tychicus will tell you all the news about me. He is a brother that we love. He is a faithful servant, and he serves with me in the Lord.

**8** I send Tychicus to you for this purpose. I want him to know about you. I want him to give encouragement to your hearts.

**9** Onesimus comes with Tychicus. Onesimus is a faithful brother that we love. He is one of your people. They will tell you all the things that occur here.

**10** Aristarchus, who is in prison with me, sends you greetings. Mark, the cousin of Barnabas, also sends greetings. You received instructions about Mark. If he comes to you, receive him.

**11** Jesus, who has the name Justus, also sends greetings. Of the Jews, only these men work with me for the kingdom of God. They give me comfort.

**12** Epaphras, who is one of your people, sends you greetings. He is a servant of Christ. He always prays hard for you. He prays that you will stand mature and completely sure in all the will of God.

**13** I tell you the truth: Epaphras works hard for you. He also works hard for the people in Laodicea and in Hierapolis.

**14** Luke, the doctor that we love, sends you greetings. Demas also sends you greetings.

**15** Greet the brothers in Laodicea. Also greet Nympha and the church that meets in her house.

**16** After you read this letter, send it to the church of the Laodiceans so that they read it. And you must also read the letter from Laodicea.

**17** Say to Archippus, "Make sure that you complete the work that you received in the Lord."

**18** I, Paul, write these words to greet you with my own hand. Remember that I am in chains. I ask that God give you grace. Amen.

---

# 1 Thessalonians

## Chapter 1

**1** Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy write this letter to the church of the Thessalonians. This church is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ. We ask that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

**2** We always thank God for all of you. We speak about you in our prayers.

**3** Before God our Father, we always remember your work that comes from faith. We remember your hard work that comes from love. We also remember your patience that comes from hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

**4** Brothers, God loves you. We know that God chose you.

**5** Our gospel did not come to you only in words. It also came with power, with the Holy Spirit, and with a strong certainty. You know how we lived among you for your good.

**6** You did as we did, and as the Lord did. You received the word with much trouble. But you also received it with the joy that the Holy Spirit gives.

**7** Thus you became an example to all the believers in Macedonia and in Achaia.

**8** The word of the Lord went out from you. It went out into Macedonia and Achaia. Also, the news of your faith in God went out to all places. Thus we do not need to say anything.

**9** The people in those places tell how you received us. They tell how you turned to God from idols. Now you serve the true God who lives.

**10** They tell how you wait for the Son of God to come from heaven. God made him alive again after his death. He is Jesus, who saves us from the anger of God that will come.

## Chapter 2

**1** Brothers, you know that our visit to you was not without a result.

**2** Before we came to you, we suffered in Philippi. The people there treated us badly. You know this. But our God gave us courage. Thus we told you the gospel of God, although many people opposed us.

**3** Our message did not come from a lie. It did not come from an unclean purpose. We did not try to trick you.

**4** God examined us and found us correct. He gave the gospel to us as a trust. Thus we speak. We do not speak to please men. We speak to please God, who examines our hearts.

**5** You know that we never used false praise. We never hid a wish to get money. God sees this, and he is our witness.

**6** We did not try to get honor from men, from you, or from other people. As apostles of Christ, we had the right to ask for your support.

**7** But we were gentle among you. We were like a mother who takes care of her own children.

**8** We loved you very much. Thus we were glad to give you the gospel of God. We were also glad to give you our own lives. We did this because you were very dear to us.

**9** Brothers, you remember our hard work. We worked night and day so that we did not cause expense to any of you. While we worked, we told you the gospel of God.

**10** You are witnesses, and God is also a witness. We lived among you believers in a holy, correct, and good way. No one could find a fault in us.

**11** You know how we spoke to each of you. We encouraged you, comforted you, and told you what to do. We did as a father does with his children.

**12** We told you to live in a way that is worthy of God. God calls you into his kingdom and his glory.

**13** For this reason, we also thank God all the time. You heard the word of God from us. You did not receive it as a word from men. You received it as the word of God, and it is truly his word. This word works in you who believe.

**14** Brothers, your experience is the same as the experience of the churches of God in Judea. Those churches are in Christ Jesus. Your own people made you suffer. In the same way, the Jews made those churches suffer.

**15** Those Jews killed the Lord Jesus and their own prophets. They also made us go away. They do not please God. They are enemies of all men.

**16** They try to stop us when we speak to the Gentiles, so that God cannot save the Gentiles. Thus they always make their sins bigger. But at last the anger of God came on them.

**17** Brothers, we were away from you for a short time. Our bodies were away, but our hearts were with you. We wanted very much to see you again. Thus we tried very hard to come to you.

**18** We wanted to come to you. I, Paul, tried to come to you again and again. But Satan stopped us.

**19** What is our hope, our joy, and our crown of honor? You are! You will be our joy before our Lord Jesus Christ when he comes.

**20** Truly, you are our glory and our joy.

## Chapter 3

**1** Thus we could not wait longer. We decided to stay alone in Athens.

**2** We sent Timothy to you. He is our brother and a servant of God. He works with us in the gospel of Christ. We sent him to make your faith strong and to encourage you.

**3** We did not want these troubles to make any of you weak. You know that God chose us for these troubles.

**4** When we were with you, we told you before that we will suffer troubles. And the troubles came, as you know.

**5** For this reason, I could not wait longer. I sent Timothy to learn about your faith. I was afraid that the tempter tempted you. I was afraid that our work among you was without a result.

**6** But now Timothy came back to us from you. He brought us good news about your faith and your love. He told us that you always remember us with kindness. He told us that you want to see us. We also want to see you.

**7** Thus, brothers, your faith comforted us in all our pain and trouble.

**8** Now we truly live, because you stand strong in the Lord.

**9** We cannot thank God enough for you. Before our God, we have much joy because of you.

**10** Night and day we pray very much that we can see you again. We want to give you the things that your faith does not have yet.

**11** We ask that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ open the way for us to come to you.

**12** We ask that the Lord make your love grow more and more. We ask that you love each other and all people. We love you in the same way.

**13** We ask that the Lord make your hearts strong. Then you will be holy and without fault before God our Father. This will be true when our Lord Jesus Christ comes with all his holy people.

## Chapter 4

**1** Finally, brothers, we ask you and encourage you in the Lord Jesus. You learned from us how to live and how to please God. You do these things now. Do them more and more.

**2** You know the instructions that we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.

**3** God wants you to be holy. Do not commit sexual sin.

**4** Each of you must learn to control his own body in a holy and honorable way.

**5** Do not control your body with strong sexual desire, as the Gentiles do. The Gentiles do not know God.

**6** In this matter, no man must do wrong to his brother or cheat him. The Lord will punish all people who do these things. We told you this before, and we strongly warned you.

**7** God did not call us to be unclean. He called us to be holy.

**8** Thus a person who refuses this instruction does not refuse a man. He refuses God. God gives his Holy Spirit to you.

**9** I do not need to write to you about love for the brothers. God taught you to love each other.

**10** Truly, you love all the brothers in all Macedonia. But, brothers, we ask you to love them more and more.

**11** Try hard to live a quiet life. Do your own work. Work with your own hands, as we told you.

**12** Then the people who are not believers will respect how you live. Also, you will not need help from other people.

**13** Brothers, we want you to know about the believers who died. We do not want you to be sad as the other people are sad. Those people have no hope.

**14** We believe that Jesus died and became alive again. Thus we also believe that God will bring back with Jesus the believers who died in Jesus.

**15** We tell you this from the word of the Lord. Some of us will be alive when the Lord comes. We will not go before the believers who died.

**16** The Lord himself will come down from heaven with a loud command. The chief angel will call out. The trumpet of God will sound. Then the dead people who are in Christ will rise first.

**17** After that, God will lift up us who are still alive. We will go up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. Then we will always be with the Lord.

**18** Thus comfort each other with these words.

## Chapter 5

**1** Brothers, I do not need to write to you about the times and the dates.

**2** You know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

**3** People will say, "We have peace and safety." Then sudden destruction will come on them. It will come as pain comes on a woman who will soon give birth. Those people will not escape.

**4** But, brothers, you do not live in darkness. Thus that day will not surprise you like a thief.

**5** All of you are children of light and children of the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

**6** Thus we must not sleep as other people do. We must stay alert and have self-control.

**7** People who sleep, sleep at night. People who become drunk, become drunk at night.

**8** But we belong to the day. Thus we must have self-control. We must put on faith and love as armor for the chest. We must put on the hope of salvation as a helmet.

**9** God did not choose us to receive his anger. He chose us to receive salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

**10** Jesus died for us. Thus we will live together with him, if we are alive or if we are dead.

**11** Thus encourage each other and make each other strong. You do this now.

**12** Brothers, we ask you to respect the people who work hard among you. They lead you in the Lord, and they give you instructions.

**13** Respect them very much and love them because of their work. Live in peace with each other.

**14** Brothers, we encourage you to do these things. Warn the people who are lazy. Encourage the people who are afraid. Help the weak people. Be patient with all people.

**15** Make sure that no one does wrong to a person who did wrong to him. Always try to do good to each other and to all people.

**16** Always be glad.

**17** Pray all the time.

**18** Thank God in all conditions. God wants you to do this in Christ Jesus.

**19** Do not stop the work of the Spirit.

**20** Do not think that prophecies have no value.

**21** Examine all things. Keep the things that are good.

**22** Stay away from all types of evil.

**23** We ask that the God of peace make you completely holy. We ask that God keep your whole spirit, soul, and body without fault until our Lord Jesus Christ comes.

**24** God, who calls you, is faithful. He will do this.

**25** Brothers, pray for us.

**26** Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

**27** By the authority of the Lord, I tell you to read this letter to all the holy brothers.

**28** We ask that the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

---

# 2 Thessalonians

## Chapter 1

**1** Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy write this letter to the church of the Thessalonians. This church is in God our Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ.

**2** We ask that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

**3** Brothers, we must always thank God for you, and this is correct. Your faith grows very much. The love of each of you for the others also grows.

**4** Thus we speak with pride about you to the churches of God. People attack you and give you troubles. But you continue to be patient, and you keep your faith.

**5** This shows that the judgment of God is correct. God will make you worthy of his kingdom. You suffer for his kingdom.

**6** God is just. He will give trouble to the people who give trouble to you.

**7** He will give rest to you who suffer, and to us also. He will do this when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven. Jesus will come with his powerful angels.

**8** He will come in a fire with flames. He will punish the people who do not know God. He will punish the people who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.

**9** God will punish those people with destruction that will not end. They will be away from the Lord and from the glory of his power.

**10** This will occur on the day when the Lord comes. On that day, his holy people will give him glory. All who believe will look at him with wonder. You will be with them, because you believed our message.

**11** For this reason, we always pray for you. We ask that our God make you worthy of the life that he calls you to. We ask that he use his power to complete all your good wishes. We ask that he complete each work that comes from your faith.

**12** Then you will give honor to the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. And he will give honor to you. This comes from the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

## Chapter 2

**1** Brothers, we have a request about the time when our Lord Jesus Christ comes. It is also about the time when God will bring us together to him.

**2** Do not let anything quickly confuse you or make you afraid. Someone can say that the day of the Lord came already. He can say that a spirit told him this. He can say that it came by a message or by a letter from us. Do not believe it.

**3** Do not let anyone trick you in any way. That day will not come until the great rebellion against God occurs first. Also, the man of sin must first appear. God will destroy that man.

**4** That man will oppose all things that people call god or worship. He will put himself above all of them. He will sit in the temple of God and say that he is God.

**5** I told you these things when I was still with you. Do you not remember?

**6** Now you know what stops that man. That man will appear only at the correct time.

**7** The secret power of sin works in the world now. But someone stops that power now. He will continue to stop it until God takes him away.

**8** Then the evil man will appear. The Lord Jesus will kill him with the breath of his mouth. When the Lord comes, he will destroy him with his bright light.

**9** The evil man will come with the power of Satan. He will do all types of powerful acts, signs, and false wonders.

**10** He will use all types of evil to trick the people who will die. Those people will die because they refused to love the truth. If they loved the truth, God will save them.

**11** For this reason, God will send them a strong power that will trick them. Then they will believe a lie.

**12** God will judge all the people who did not believe the truth. They liked evil things.

**13** But, brothers, the Lord loves you. We must always thank God for you. From the start, God chose you for salvation. The Spirit makes you holy, and you believe the truth.

**14** God called you to this through the gospel that we told you. He called you so that you will share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

**15** Thus, brothers, stand strong. Keep the teachings that we gave you, by our words or by our letter.

**16** Our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father love us. By his grace, God gave us comfort that will not end and a good hope.

**17** We ask that they comfort your hearts. We ask that they make you strong in all good words and in all good work.

## Chapter 3

**1** Finally, brothers, pray for us. Pray that the word of the Lord moves quickly to other people. Pray that people give honor to the word, as you do.

**2** Pray that God saves us from bad and evil men. Not all people have faith.

**3** But the Lord is faithful. He will make you strong. He will keep you safe from the evil one.

**4** The Lord makes us confident about you. We are sure that you do the things that we tell you. We are sure that you will continue to do them.

**5** We ask that the Lord guide your hearts to the love of God. We ask that he guide you to the patience of Christ.

**6** Brothers, we give you a command in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. Keep away from each brother who is lazy. Keep away from each brother who does not obey the lessons that you got from us.

**7** You know that you must do as we do. We were not lazy when we were with you.

**8** We did not eat food from any person without payment. We worked very hard night and day. We did this so that we did not cause expense to any of you.

**9** We had the right to get help from you. But we did not ask for it. We wanted to give you an example. We wanted you to do as we did.

**10** When we were with you, we gave you this command: "If a person does not want to work, he must not eat."

**11** We hear that some people among you are lazy. They do no work. But they put themselves into the business of other people.

**12** We command these people in the Lord Jesus Christ. We encourage them to work quietly and to earn their own food.

**13** But you, brothers, do not stop when you do good.

**14** Some people possibly will not obey the instructions in this letter. Identify those people. Do not associate with them. Then they will feel shame.

**15** But do not think that such a person is an enemy. Warn him as you warn a brother.

**16** We ask that the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in all ways. We ask that the Lord be with all of you.

**17** I, Paul, write these words to greet you with my own hand. This is the sign in all my letters. This is how I write.

**18** We ask that the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you. Amen.

---

# 1 Timothy

## Chapter 1

**1** I, Paul, write this letter. I am an apostle of Jesus Christ by the command of God our Savior and of the Lord Jesus Christ. Jesus Christ is our hope.

**2** I write to Timothy. You are my true son in the faith. I ask that God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord give you grace, mercy, and peace.

**3** When I went into Macedonia, I asked you to stay in Ephesus. Stay there now. Tell some people to stop their false lessons.

**4** Tell them not to give attention to stories and to long lists of ancestors. These things cause arguments. They do not help God's work, which comes through faith.

**5** The purpose of this command is love. This love comes from a pure heart, a good conscience, and a true faith.

**6** Some people went away from these things. Now they talk about things that have no value.

**7** They want to be teachers of the law. But they do not understand what they say. They do not understand the things that they say with confidence.

**8** We know that the law is good if a person uses it correctly.

**9** We know that God did not give the law for good people. He gave it for people who do not obey the law and who rebel. He gave it for people who do not respect God and for sinners. He gave it for people who are not holy and who insult holy things. He gave it for people who kill their fathers or mothers, and for all murderers.

**10** He gave the law for people who commit sexual sin and for men who have sex with men. He gave it for people who steal people and sell them as slaves. He gave it for liars and for people who lie under oath. He gave it for all other actions that are against the true lessons.

**11** This message agrees with the gospel about the glory of the blessed God. God gave this gospel to me as a trust.

**12** I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who gives me strength. He thought that I was faithful. Thus he put me into his service.

**13** Before, I spoke against God. I attacked his people and I was violent. But God gave me mercy, because I did not believe and I did not know what I did.

**14** The grace of our Lord came to me in very large quantity. With it came the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

**15** This statement is true, and all people must accept it. Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners. I am the worst sinner.

**16** But for this reason God gave me mercy. I was the worst sinner. Thus Jesus Christ used me to show all his patience. I am an example for the people who will believe in him and get life that does not end.

**17** Give honor and glory to the King who lives always. He cannot die, and no one can see him. He is the only God. Give him honor and glory always. Amen.

**18** Timothy, my son, I give you this command. It agrees with the prophecies that people spoke about you before. Use those prophecies to fight the good fight.

**19** Keep your faith and a good conscience. Some people did not keep a good conscience. Thus they destroyed their faith, as a ship breaks on the rocks.

**20** Hymenaeus and Alexander are 2 of these people. I gave them to Satan, so that they will learn not to speak against God.

## Chapter 2

**1** Thus, first of all, I tell you to pray for all people. Make requests to God for them, and thank God for them.

**2** Pray for kings and for all people who have authority. Then we can live quiet and peaceful lives. We can respect God and live in an honest way.

**3** This is good, and it pleases God our Savior.

**4** God wants to save all people. He wants them to know the truth.

**5** There is one God. There is also one person who brings God and men together. He is the man Christ Jesus.

**6** Christ Jesus gave his life as the price to make all people free. God showed this at the correct time.

**7** For this purpose, God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle. I tell the truth in Christ, and I do not lie. God chose me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.

**8** Thus I want the men in all places to pray. They must lift up holy hands. They must not be angry or argue.

**9** Also, I want women to wear modest clothes. They must be modest and have self-control. They must not make themselves beautiful with special hair styles, gold, pearls, or expensive clothes.

**10** Women who say that they worship God must make themselves beautiful with good works.

**11** A woman must learn quietly and obey completely.

**12** I do not let a woman teach a man or have authority over a man. She must be quiet.

**13** God made Adam first. Then he made Eve.

**14** The serpent did not trick Adam. The serpent tricked the woman, and she sinned.

**15** But God will save women through the birth of children. They must continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.

## Chapter 3

**1** This statement is true: If a man wants to be a church leader (bishop), he wants to do good work.

**2** Thus a bishop must have a good life that no one can find a fault in. He must have only 1 wife. He must have self-control and good judgment. He must behave well. He must welcome guests into his home. He must be able to teach.

**3** He must not drink too much wine. He must not be violent. He must be gentle. He must not argue. He must not love money.

**4** He must manage his own family well. His children must obey him and respect him.

**5** If a man does not know how to manage his own family, he cannot take care of the church of God.

**6** A bishop must not be a new believer. If he is a new believer, he can become proud. Then he will fall under the same judgment as the devil.

**7** Also, the people who are not believers must think well of him. If they do not, people will say bad things about him. Then he can fall into the trap of the devil.

**8** In the same way, the church helpers (deacons) must be serious and honest. They must not drink too much wine. They must not try to get money in a dishonest way.

**9** They must keep the secret truth of the faith with a clean conscience.

**10** First, the church must examine them. If no one finds a fault in them, then they can serve as deacons.

**11** In the same way, their wives must be serious. They must not say bad things about other people. They must have self-control and be faithful in all things.

**12** A deacon must have only 1 wife. He must manage his children and his family well.

**13** The deacons who serve well get a good position for themselves. They also get great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.

**14** I write these things to you. I hope to come to you soon.

**15** But possibly I will be late. Then you will know how people must behave in the family of God. This family is the church of the God who lives. The church supports the truth and makes it strong.

**16** All people agree that the secret truth about God is great: Christ appeared in a human body. The Spirit showed that he was right. The angels saw him. People told the Gentiles about him. People in the world believed in him. God took him up into glory.

## Chapter 4

**1** The Spirit says clearly that, in the last times, some people will leave the faith. They will obey spirits that trick them. They will obey the teachings of demons.

**2** These teachings come from liars who say false things. Their consciences are dead, as if a hot iron burned them.

**3** These liars tell people not to marry. They tell people not to eat some foods. But God made these foods. He wants the people who believe and know the truth to eat them and thank him.

**4** All things that God made are good. Do not refuse anything if you thank God for it.

**5** The word of God and prayer make it holy.

**6** Tell these things to the brothers. Then you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. The words of the faith and the good lessons that you followed will make you strong.

**7** Do not listen to foolish stories that are not holy. Train yourself to obey God.

**8** Training of the body gives a small advantage. But a life that obeys God gives an advantage in all things. It gives a promise for the life now and for the life that will come.

**9** This statement is true, and all people must accept it.

**10** For this reason, we work hard and struggle. We trust in the God who lives. He is the Savior of all people, and especially of the people who believe.

**11** Command and teach these things.

**12** Do not let anyone think that you are not important because you are young. Be an example to the believers in how you speak and how you live. Be an example in love, faith, and purity.

**13** Until I come, read the Scriptures to the people. Encourage them and teach them.

**14** Do not forget the gift that is in you. God gave it to you through prophecy, when the elders put their hands on you.

**15** Think about these things. Give all your attention to them. Then all people will see your progress.

**16** Be careful about how you live and what you teach. Continue to do these things. Then you will save yourself and the people who hear you.

## Chapter 5

**1** Do not speak angrily to an older man. Speak to him with respect, as to a father. Speak to younger men as to brothers.

**2** Speak to older women as to mothers. Speak to younger women as to sisters, with all purity.

**3** Give respect and help to widows who have no family to help them.

**4** If a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to obey God in their own family. They must give help to their parents and grandparents. This pleases God.

**5** A true widow is alone. She trusts in God. She continues to pray to God night and day.

**6** But a widow who lives only for pleasure is spiritually dead, although she is alive.

**7** Give these instructions to the people. Then no one can find a fault in them.

**8** A person must take care of his relatives, and especially of his own family. If he does not, he refuses the faith. He is worse than a person who does not believe.

**9** Do not put a widow on the list of widows if she is less than 60 years old. She must be faithful to her husband.

**10** People must know about her good works. Did she take care of her children? Did she welcome strangers into her home? Did she wash the feet of God's people? Did she help people who had troubles? Did she do all types of good work?

**11** But do not put younger widows on the list. Their physical desires can take them away from Christ. Then they will want to marry.

**12** Thus they will be guilty, because they did not keep their first promise.

**13** Also, they learn to be lazy. They go from house to house. They are not only lazy. They also talk too much and put themselves into the business of other people. They say things that they must not say.

**14** Thus I want the younger widows to marry and have children. They must manage their homes. They must not give the enemy a reason to speak badly about us.

**15** Some widows already left the correct way to follow Satan.

**16** If a believer has widows in his or her family, the believer must help them. Do not give the church this expense. Then the church can help the widows who are truly alone.

**17** The elders who lead the church well must get double honor. This is especially true of the elders who work hard to preach and teach.

**18** The Scripture says, "Do not put a cover on the mouth of an ox when it walks on the grain." It also says, "A worker must get his pay."

**19** If a person says that an elder did wrong, do not accept it. Accept it only if 2 or 3 witnesses say it.

**20** If elders continue to sin, tell them that they are wrong in front of all the church. Then the other people will also be afraid to sin.

**21** I give you a serious command before God, the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels. Obey these instructions without a wrong opinion. Do not do anything to give an advantage to one person.

**22** Do not be quick to put your hands on a person and give him a position in the church. Do not share in the sins of other people. Keep yourself pure.

**23** Do not drink only water. Drink a little wine for your stomach, because you are often sick.

**24** The sins of some people are easy to see. These sins go before them to the judgment. But the sins of other people become known later.

**25** In the same way, the good works of some people are easy to see. The other good works cannot stay hidden.

## Chapter 6

**1** All slaves must think that their masters are worthy of all honor. Then no one will speak against the name of God and our message.

**2** Some slaves have masters who are believers. These slaves must not think less of their masters because the masters are brothers. They must serve them better, because the masters are believers and loved. The masters get the advantage of their good work. Teach these things and tell the people to do them.

**3** A person can teach a different message. He can refuse the true words of our Lord Jesus Christ. He can refuse the lessons that agree with a life that obeys God.

**4** Such a person is proud and knows nothing. He likes arguments about questions and words. These arguments cause jealousy, fights, insults, and evil suspicions.

**5** These arguments also cause bad quarrels among men with bad minds. Those men do not know the truth. They think that religion is a way to get money. Stay away from such people.

**6** But a life that obeys God, with a satisfied mind, is a large advantage.

**7** We brought nothing into the world. We surely cannot take anything out of the world.

**8** If we have food and clothes, we must be happy with these things.

**9** But people who want to become rich fall into temptation and into a trap. They get many foolish and harmful desires. These desires pull people down into ruin and destruction.

**10** The love of money is the cause of all types of evil. Some people wanted money very much. Thus they went away from the faith. They caused much pain for themselves.

**11** But you are a man of God. Run away from these things. Try to be good, to obey God, and to have faith and love. Try to be patient and gentle.

**12** Fight the good fight of the faith. Hold on to the life that does not end. God called you to this life. You said that you believe, in front of many witnesses.

**13** I give you a command before God, who gives life to all things. I also give it before Christ Jesus. Jesus spoke the truth well before Pontius Pilate.

**14** Obey this command completely. Do not let anyone find a fault in you. Obey it until our Lord Jesus Christ appears.

**15** God will make Christ appear at the correct time. God is the blessed and only ruler. He is the King of kings and the Lord of lords.

**16** Only God cannot die. He lives in a light that no one can come near. No one saw him, and no one can see him. Give him honor and power always. Amen.

**17** Give a command to the people who are rich in this world. Tell them not to be proud. Tell them not to trust in money, because money does not last. Tell them to trust in God. God gives us all things richly for our pleasure.

**18** Tell them to do good. Tell them to be rich in good works. They must give freely and share with other people.

**19** Thus they will keep a treasure for themselves in the future. It will be a strong base. Then they will hold on to the true life.

**20** Timothy, keep safe the things that God gave you as a trust. Stay away from foolish talk that is not holy. Stay away from the false ideas that some people call knowledge.

**21** Some people said that they had this knowledge. Thus they went away from the faith. I ask that grace be with you. Amen.

---

# 2 Timothy

## Chapter 1

**1** I am Paul. I am an apostle of Jesus Christ because God wants this. God sent me to tell about the promise of life that is in Christ Jesus.

**2** I write to Timothy, my dear son. I pray that God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord will give you grace, mercy, and peace.

**3** I serve God with a clean conscience, as my ancestors did. I thank God because I always remember you in my prayers, at night and in the day.

**4** I remember your tears. I want very much to see you, because then I will have much joy.

**5** I remember your true faith. This faith lived first in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice. I am sure that the same faith lives in you also.

**6** Thus I tell you to make the gift of God strong again. God gave you this gift when I put my hands on you.

**7** God did not give us a spirit of fear. God gave us a spirit of power, of love, and of self-control.

**8** Thus do not feel shame to tell about our Lord. Do not feel shame because of me, his prisoner. With the power of God, accept your part of the pain for the gospel.

**9** God saved us and called us to a holy life. He did not do this because of our works. He did this because of his own purpose and grace. God gave us this grace in Christ Jesus before time started.

**10** But now God shows this grace clearly, because our Savior Jesus Christ came. Christ stopped the power of death. Through the gospel, he shows the way to life that does not end.

**11** God chose me to preach this gospel. He made me an apostle and a teacher of the Gentiles.

**12** For this reason I also suffer these things. But I do not feel shame. I know the person that I believe in. I am sure that he can keep safe what I gave to him until that day.

**13** Keep the pattern of the correct words that you heard from me. Keep them with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

**14** God gave you a good thing to keep. Keep it safe with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives in us.

**15** You know that all the people in Asia turned away from me. Phygelus and Hermogenes are 2 of those people.

**16** I pray that the Lord will give mercy to the family of Onesiphorus. Onesiphorus often gave me new strength. He did not feel shame because of my chain.

**17** When he was in Rome, he looked for me very carefully, and he found me.

**18** I pray that the Lord will give him mercy on that day. You know very well how much he helped me in Ephesus.

## Chapter 2

**1** Thus, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

**2** You heard many things from me in front of many witnesses. Give these things to faithful men. These men must be able to teach other people also.

**3** Accept your part of the hard life, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ does.

**4** A soldier does not let the matters of normal life control him. He wants to please the officer who chose him to be a soldier.

**5** Also, an athlete does not get the prize if he does not obey the rules.

**6** The farmer who works hard must be the first to get a part of the crops.

**7** Think about what I tell you. The Lord will help you to understand all things.

**8** Remember Jesus Christ. He came from the family of David. God made him alive again after his death. This is the gospel that I preach.

**9** Because of this gospel, I suffer. People put me in chains as a criminal. But nobody can put the word of God in chains.

**10** Thus I accept all things for the people that God chose. I want them also to get the salvation that is in Christ Jesus, with glory that does not end.

**11** This statement is true: "If we died with him, we will also live with him.

**12** If we continue to suffer, we will also rule with him. If we say that we do not know him, he also will say that he does not know us.

**13** If we are not faithful, he continues to be faithful. He cannot go against his own nature."

**14** Tell the people these things again. In front of the Lord, warn them not to argue about words. Such arguments do not help. They destroy the people who hear them.

**15** Work hard to show yourself as a worker that God accepts. Be a worker who has no reason to feel shame. Teach the word of truth correctly.

**16** Do not take part in foolish talk that is not holy. Such talk causes people to go more and more away from God.

**17** Their words will spread like a disease that eats the body. Hymenaeus and Philetus are 2 of these teachers.

**18** These men went away from the truth. They say that the resurrection from the dead already occurred. Thus they destroy the faith of some people.

**19** But the strong foundation of God does not move. These words are on it like a seal: "The Lord knows the people who are his." Also: "Each person who speaks the name of the Lord must stop doing evil."

**20** In a large house, there are containers of gold and of silver. There are also containers of wood and of clay. Some containers are for special use, and some are for common use.

**21** If a person makes himself clean from these bad things, he will be a container for special use. He will be holy and useful to the master. He will be ready for each good work.

**22** Run away from the bad desires of young people. Follow what is right. Follow faith, love, and peace with the people who call on the Lord with a clean heart.

**23** Do not take part in foolish and stupid arguments. You know that these arguments cause fights.

**24** The servant of the Lord must not fight. He must be kind to all people. He must be able to teach, and he must be patient.

**25** He must teach the people who oppose him with a gentle attitude. Possibly God will let them change their minds. Then they will know the truth.

**26** Then they will become sensible again and escape from the trap of the devil. The devil caught them to do what he wants.

## Chapter 3

**1** Know this: in the last days there will be times of much trouble.

**2** People will love only themselves. They will love money. They will be boastful and proud. They will speak against God. They will not obey their parents. They will not be thankful or holy.

**3** They will have no natural love. They will not make peace. They will say false things about other people. They will have no self-control. They will be cruel. They will hate good things.

**4** They will betray their friends. They will act without thought and they will be very proud. They will love pleasure more than they love God.

**5** They will seem to have a holy life, but they will refuse its power. Stay away from such people.

**6** Some of these men go into houses secretly. They get control of weak women. These women have many sins and many different bad desires control them.

**7** These women always learn, but they never come to know the truth.

**8** Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses. Thus these men also oppose the truth. Their minds are bad. They failed the test of faith.

**9** But they will not go much farther. All people will see their foolishness clearly, as the people saw the foolishness of Jannes and Jambres.

**10** But you know my lessons, my way of life, and my purpose. You know my faith, my patience, my love, and my endurance.

**11** You know about my persecutions and my pain. You know what occurred to me in Antioch, in Iconium, and in Lystra. I endured much persecution, but the Lord saved me from all of it.

**12** All people who want to live a holy life in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

**13** But bad people and false teachers will become worse and worse. They will deceive other people, and other people will deceive them.

**14** But you must continue in the things that you learned. You are sure that these things are true. You know the people who taught you.

**15** Since you were a child, you knew the holy scriptures. The scriptures can make you wise for salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

**16** God gave all scripture through his breath. Scripture is useful to teach and to show errors. It is useful to correct people and to train them to do what is right.

**17** Thus the man of God will be complete. He will have all that is necessary for each good work.

## Chapter 4

**1** God and the Lord Jesus Christ see me. Christ will judge the people who live and the dead people when he comes and starts to rule as king. Thus I give you this order:

**2** Preach the word. Be ready at all times. Correct people, warn them, and encourage them. Do this with much patience and careful instruction.

**3** A time will come when people will not accept correct lessons. They will want to hear new things. Thus they will get many teachers who say what the people want.

**4** They will stop their ears to the truth. They will turn to stories that are not true.

**5** But you must think clearly in all things. Accept pain and trouble. Do the work of an evangelist. Do all the tasks of your ministry.

**6** My life is now like an offering that a priest pours out. The time for me to die is near.

**7** I fought the good fight. I completed the race. I kept the faith.

**8** Now a crown of righteousness waits for me. The Lord, the judge who is fair, will give it to me on that day. He will not give it only to me. He will also give it to all people who want him to come.

**9** Try hard to come to me soon.

**10** Demas left me because he loves this world. He went to Thessalonica. Crescens went to Galatia, and Titus went to Dalmatia.

**11** Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and bring him with you, because he is useful to me in the work.

**12** I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

**13** I left my coat with Carpus at Troas. When you come, bring the coat with you. Also bring the books, and most of all the parchments.

**14** Alexander, the man who works with copper, did many bad things to me. The Lord will pay him back for what he did.

**15** You also must be careful of Alexander, because he strongly opposed our message.

**16** At my first defense in court, nobody stood with me. All people left me. I pray that God will not hold this against them.

**17** But the Lord stood with me and gave me strength. Through me, the Lord made the full message known, and all the Gentiles heard it. The Lord saved me from the mouth of the lion.

**18** The Lord will save me from all evil attacks. He will bring me safely into his kingdom in heaven. Glory to him for all time. Amen.

**19** Say hello to Prisca and Aquila, and to the family of Onesiphorus.

**20** Erastus stayed in Corinth. Trophimus was sick, and I left him in Miletus.

**21** Try hard to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers say hello to you.

**22** I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be with your spirit. I pray that grace will be with you all. Amen.

---

# Titus

## Chapter 1

**1** I am Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. God sent me to help the faith of the people that he chose. God sent me to help them know the truth that leads to a holy life.

**2** This faith and truth give hope of life that does not end. God, who cannot lie, promised this life before time started.

**3** At the correct time, God showed his word through the message that I preach. God our Savior gave me this work, and he ordered me to do it.

**4** I write to Titus. You are my true son in the faith that we share. I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior will give you grace, mercy, and peace.

**5** I left you in Crete for this reason: you must put in order the things that are not complete. Also, you must choose elders in each city, as I told you.

**6** An elder must have no fault. He must have only 1 wife. His children must believe. People must not say that his children are wild or disobedient.

**7** A bishop is a manager for God. Thus he must have no fault. He must not be proud or quickly angry. He must not drink too much wine. He must not be violent. He must not try to get money in dishonest ways.

**8** He must be glad to receive guests in his home. He must love what is good. He must have self-control. He must be fair and holy. He must control his desires.

**9** He must hold firmly to the true message, as people taught it to him. Then he will be able to encourage people with correct lessons. He will also be able to show the errors of the people who oppose it.

**10** Many people do not obey. They talk foolishly and deceive other people. This is true most of all for the people of the circumcision group.

**11** You must stop their mouths. They teach things that they must not teach, because they want dishonest money. Thus they destroy whole families.

**12** One of the people of Crete, their own prophet, said, "The people of Crete always lie. They are like bad animals. They are lazy and they eat too much."

**13** This statement is true. Thus correct them strongly. Then they will have a correct faith.

**14** They must not pay attention to Jewish stories that are not true. They must not obey the commands of people who turn away from the truth.

**15** To clean people, all things are clean. But to people who are not clean and who do not believe, nothing is clean. Their minds and their consciences are not clean.

**16** They say that they know God, but their works show that they do not know him. They are hateful and disobedient. They are not fit to do any good work.

## Chapter 2

**1** But you must teach the things that agree with correct lessons.

**2** Teach the old men to have self-control. They must be serious and sensible. They must have a correct faith, love, and patience.

**3** Also teach the old women to live in a holy way. They must not say false things about other people. They must not drink too much wine. They must teach what is good.

**4** Then they can train the young women to love their husbands and their children.

**5** The young women must be sensible and pure. They must do good work in their homes. They must be kind and obey their husbands. Then nobody will speak against the word of God.

**6** Also encourage the young men to have self-control.

**7** In all things, show yourself as an example of good works. When you teach, be honest and serious.

**8** Speak correct words that nobody can criticize. Then the people who oppose you will feel shame, because they will have nothing bad to say about us.

**9** Tell slaves to obey their masters. They must please their masters in all things. They must not argue with them.

**10** They must not steal from their masters. They must show that they are always faithful. Then in all things they will make the message of God our Savior attractive.

**11** The grace of God came, and it gives salvation to all people.

**12** This grace teaches us to refuse evil and bad worldly desires. It teaches us to live with self-control, to do what is right, and to live a holy life now in this world.

**13** We wait for the hope that gives joy. We wait for the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ, to appear.

**14** Jesus Christ gave himself for us. He did this to free us from all evil. He did this to make us clean. We are his own people, and we want to do good works.

**15** Teach these things. Encourage and correct people with all authority. Do not let anybody think that you are not important.

## Chapter 3

**1** Tell the people that they must obey rulers and those who have authority. They must be ready to do each good work.

**2** They must not speak bad things about anybody. They must not fight. They must be kind and gentle to all people.

**3** In the past, we also were foolish and disobedient. People deceived us. Many bad desires and pleasures controlled us. We lived with evil and envy. People hated us, and we hated each other.

**4** But then God our Savior showed his kindness and his love for people.

**5** He saved us. He did not save us because of the good things that we did. He saved us because of his mercy. He washed us and gave us a new birth and a new life through the Holy Spirit.

**6** God gave the Holy Spirit to us in a large quantity through Jesus Christ our Savior.

**7** Thus, because of his grace, God accepts us as right with him. We will receive life that does not end, as we hope.

**8** This statement is true. I want you to teach these things with confidence. Then the people who believe in God will be careful to do good works. These things are good and useful for people.

**9** But do not take part in foolish arguments and arguments about lists of ancestors. Do not argue or fight about the law. These arguments are useless and they do not help.

**10** Warn a person who causes division 1 time, then warn him a 2nd time. After that, have nothing to do with him.

**11** You know that such a person turned away from the truth. He sins, and his actions show that he is guilty.

**12** I will send Artemas or Tychicus to you. When I send him, try hard to come to me at Nicopolis. I decided to stay there during the winter.

**13** Do all that you can to help Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey. Make sure that they have all that they need.

**14** Our people also must learn to do good works for necessary needs. Then their lives will produce good results.

**15** All the people who are with me say hello to you. Say hello to the people who love us in the faith. I pray that grace will be with you all. Amen.

---

# Philemon

## Chapter 1

**1** I am Paul, a prisoner for Jesus Christ. Our brother Timothy is with me. We write to Philemon, our dear friend who works with us.

**2** We also write to our dear sister Apphia, and to Archippus, who fights with us like a soldier. We also write to the church that meets in your house.

**3** I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give you grace and peace.

**4** I always thank my God when I remember you in my prayers.

**5** I hear about your love and your faith. You have faith in the Lord Jesus, and you love all the saints.

**6** I pray that the faith that you share with other people will be effective. Then you will know fully each good thing that we have in Christ Jesus.

**7** Brother, your love gives me much joy and comfort. You gave new strength to the hearts of the saints.

**8** Because I am in Christ, I can boldly order you to do what is correct.

**9** But because of love, I ask you instead. I am Paul, an old man, and now also a prisoner for Jesus Christ.

**10** I ask you to help my son Onesimus. He became my son in the faith while I was in chains.

**11** In the past, he was not useful to you. But now he is useful to you and to me.

**12** I send him back to you. Accept him, because he is very dear to me, like my own heart.

**13** I wanted to keep him with me. Then he could help me in your place while I am in chains for the gospel.

**14** But I did not want to do anything if you did not agree. I want your good act to come from your own choice, not because you must do it.

**15** Possibly he went away from you for a short time for this reason: then you can have him back for all time.

**16** Now he is not only a slave. He is more than a slave. He is a dear brother. He is very dear to me, but he is even more dear to you. He is dear to you as a man and as a brother in the Lord.

**17** If you think of me as a partner, accept him as you will accept me.

**18** If he did something wrong to you, or if he owes you money, put that cost on my account.

**19** I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will pay it back. I do not tell you that you owe me your own life.

**20** Yes, brother, I want to get some benefit from you in the Lord. Give my heart new strength in Christ.

**21** I write to you because I am sure that you will obey. I know that you will do more than I ask.

**22** Also, prepare a room for me. I hope that God will answer your prayers and let me come to you.

**23** Epaphras says hello to you. He is in prison with me for Christ Jesus.

**24** Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke also say hello. They work with me.

**25** I pray that the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ will be with your spirit. Amen.

---

# Hebrews

## Chapter 1

**1** In the past, God spoke to our ancestors many times and in many different ways. He spoke to them through the prophets.

**2** But now, in these last days, God spoke to us through his Son. God made the Son the heir of all things. God also made the worlds through the Son.

**3** The Son shows the bright glory of God. He is the exact image of the nature of God. He holds all things together by his powerful word. He made people clean from their sins. Then he sat down at the right hand of the Majesty in heaven.

**4** Thus the Son became much better than the angels. The name that he received from his Father is much better than the name of the angels.

**5** God never said to an angel, "You are my Son. Today I became your Father." God also never said about an angel, "I will be his Father, and he will be my Son."

**6** Also, when God brings his firstborn Son into the world, he says, "All the angels of God must worship him."

**7** About the angels God says, "God makes his angels winds. He makes his servants flames of fire."

**8** But about the Son God says, "Your throne, O God, will continue for all time. You will rule your kingdom with justice.

**9** You loved what is right, and you hated what is wrong. Thus God, your God, put the oil of joy on you. He put you above your companions."

**10** God also says, "Lord, at the start, you made the base of the earth. Your hands made the heavens.

**11** The heavens and the earth will come to an end, but you will continue. They will all become old like a garment.

**12** You will fold them up like a coat. You will change them like clothes. But you stay the same. Your years will never end."
