# 2 John

## Chapter 1

**1** I, the elder, write to the lady whom God chose, and to her children. I truly love you. I am not the only person who loves you. All the people who know the truth also love you.

**2** We love you because of the truth. The truth lives in us, and it will be with us for all time.

**3** Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us. They come from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father. They come with truth and love.

**4** I was very happy because I found some of your children. They live in the truth, as the Father commanded us.

**5** Now, lady, I ask you this: We must love each other. This is not a new commandment that I write to you. We had this commandment from the start.

**6** This is love: We live as God commands. This is the commandment that you heard from the start: You must live in love.

**7** Many people who deceive went out into the world. They do not confess that Jesus Christ came in a human body. Such a person is a deceiver and an antichrist.

**8** Be careful. Do not lose the things that we worked for. Make sure that you get your full reward.

**9** A person who goes too far does not stay in the message of Christ. That person does not have God. A person who stays in the message of Christ has the Father and the Son.

**10** A person can come to you who does not bring this message. Do not let him into your house. Do not welcome him.

**11** A person who welcomes him shares in his evil actions.

**12** I have many things to write to you. But I do not want to write them with paper and ink. I hope to visit you and speak to you face to face. Then our joy will be full.

**13** The children of your sister, whom God chose, send you their greetings. Amen.

---

# 3 John

## Chapter 1

**1** The elder writes to Gaius, my dear friend. I love you in the truth.

**2** Dear friend, I pray that all things go well for you. I pray that your body is healthy, as your soul is healthy.

**3** Some brothers came to me. They told me about your loyalty to the truth. They told me that you live in the truth. This news gave me much joy.

**4** Nothing gives me more joy than this news: my children live in the truth.

**5** Dear friend, you are loyal in all the work that you do for the brothers. You do this work also for strangers.

**6** These brothers told the church about your love. Help them on their journey in a manner that pleases God. If you do this, you do well.

**7** They went out to work for the name of Christ. They took no help from the Gentiles.

**8** Thus we must welcome and help men such as these. Then we work together with them for the truth.

**9** I wrote a letter to the church. But Diotrephes wants to be the most important person among them. He does not accept us.

**10** Thus, if I come, I will speak about the things that he does. He speaks bad and false words against us. That is not enough for him. He does not welcome the brothers. He also stops the people who want to welcome them. He puts those people out of the church.

**11** Dear friend, do not copy what is bad. Copy what is good. The person who does good is from God. The person who does bad did not see God.

**12** All people speak well of Demetrius. The truth also speaks well of him. We also speak well of him. You know that our words are true.

**13** I have many things to write to you. But I do not want to write them with pen and ink.

**14** I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace to you. Our friends send you their greetings. Greet each of our friends by name.

---

# Jude

## Chapter 1

**1** Jude writes this letter. I am a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. I write to the people whom God called. God the Father loves them and makes them holy. Jesus Christ keeps them safe.

**2** I pray that God gives you more and more mercy, peace, and love.

**3** Dear friends, I wanted very much to write to you about the salvation that we all share. But I find it necessary to write to you about a different thing. I tell you to fight hard for the faith. God gave this faith to his holy people one time for all time.

**4** Some men came in secretly among you. Long ago, the scriptures wrote about the punishment of these men. These men do not respect God. They change the grace of our God into a reason for sexual sin. They refuse to accept Jesus Christ, our only Master and Lord.

**5** You already know all these things. But I want to cause you to remember them. The Lord saved his people out of the land of Egypt. But after that, he destroyed the people who did not believe.

**6** Some angels did not stay in their position of authority. They left their correct home. God keeps these angels in chains that last forever, in darkness. He keeps them there until the judgment on the great day.

**7** Also remember Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities near them. The people of those cities did sexual sins, as those angels did. They followed unnatural sexual desires. God punished them with fire that lasts forever. They are an example for all people.

**8** These men do the same things. They follow their dreams. They make their bodies unclean. They refuse authority. They speak bad words against the glorious beings.

**9** Michael, the chief angel, argued with the devil about the body of Moses. But Michael did not speak bad words of judgment against the devil. He said, "The Lord will correct you."

**10** But these men speak bad words against things that they do not understand. They are like animals that cannot think. They know some things by instinct. But these things destroy them.

**11** Terrible things will happen to them! They live as Cain lived. They hurry to do the wrong thing that Balaam did, because they want money. They will die, as Korah died when he fought against authority.

**12** These men are a danger at your meals of love. They eat with you without shame. They take care only of themselves. They are like clouds that the wind blows, but the clouds give no rain. They are like trees in autumn that give no fruit. Someone pulled out these trees by the roots. Thus they are completely dead.

**13** They are like the wild waves of the sea. The waves throw up foam, and their shameful acts are like this foam. They are like stars that move away from their correct path. God keeps the blackest darkness for them forever.

**14** Enoch was in the seventh generation from Adam. He spoke a prophecy about these men. He said, "Look! The Lord comes with many thousands of his holy ones.

**15** He comes to judge all people. He will show that all the godless people are guilty. They did godless acts in a godless manner. Godless sinners also spoke hard words against him. He will find them guilty for all these things."

**16** These men always complain and find fault with others. They follow their own bad desires. They speak proud words about themselves. They praise other people to get an advantage.

**17** But dear friends, remember the words that the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ spoke before.

**18** They told you, "In the last time, there will be people who laugh at God. They will follow their own godless desires."

**19** These men cause divisions among you. They follow their natural desires. They do not have the Spirit.

**20** But you, dear friends, make yourselves strong in your most holy faith. Pray with the help of the Holy Spirit.

**21** Stay in the love of God. Wait for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ. He will give you life that continues forever.

**22** Show mercy to some people. Know the difference between people.

**23** Save other people. Pull them out of the fire. Do this with fear. Hate even the clothes that their sinful bodies made dirty.

**24** God can keep you from a fall into sin. He can bring you in front of his glory with no fault and with much joy.

**25** He is the only wise God and our Savior. Glory, honor, power, and authority belong to him, now and forever. Amen.

---

# Revelation

## Chapter 1

**1** This is the revelation of Jesus Christ. God gave the revelation to him to show his servants the things that must happen soon. Christ sent his angel to his servant John to make these things known.

**2** John told about the word of God and about the testimony of Jesus Christ. He told about all the things that he saw.

**3** God blesses the person who reads the words of this prophecy aloud. God blesses the people who hear the words and obey them. The time is near.

**4** John writes to the 7 churches in the province of Asia. I pray that grace and peace come to you from God. He is, he was, and he will come. Grace and peace also come from the 7 Spirits in front of his throne.

**5** Grace and peace also come from Jesus Christ. He is the loyal witness. He is the first to come back to life from death. He is the ruler of the kings of the earth. He loves us. He made us free from our sins with his blood.

**6** He made us kings and priests for God, his Father. Glory and power belong to Jesus Christ forever and ever. Amen.

**7** Look! He comes with the clouds. All people will see him. The people who put a spear into him will also see him. All the tribes of the earth will cry because of him. Yes, this will happen. Amen.

**8** The Lord God says, "I am the Alpha and the Omega. I am the start and the end. I am, I was, and I will come. I am the Almighty."

**9** I, John, am your brother. I share with you in the trouble, in the kingdom, and in the patience that we have in Jesus. I was on the island of Patmos. I was there because I told people the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.

**10** On the Lord's day, the Spirit controlled me. I heard a loud voice behind me. The voice was like the sound of a trumpet.

**11** The voice said, "I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last. Write in a book the things that you see. Send the book to the 7 churches in Asia. Send it to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea."

**12** I turned to see who spoke to me. When I turned, I saw 7 gold lampstands.

**13** In the middle of the lampstands, I saw a person who was like a son of man. He wore a long robe that went down to his feet. He had a gold belt around his chest.

**14** The hair on his head was white, as white as wool or snow. His eyes were like flames of fire.

**15** His feet were like bright bronze that burns in a furnace. His voice was like the sound of a large quantity of water that flows fast.

**16** He held 7 stars in his right hand. A sharp sword with 2 edges came out of his mouth. His face was as bright as the sun at noon.

**17** When I saw him, I fell down at his feet like a dead man. He put his right hand on me and said, "Do not be afraid. I am the first and the last.

**18** I am the one who lives. I was dead, but look, I am alive forever and ever. I have the keys of death and of the place of the dead.

**19** Thus, write the things that you saw. Write the things that are now and the things that will happen after this.

**20** I will tell you the secret meaning of the 7 stars that you saw in my right hand. I will also tell you the secret of the 7 gold lampstands. The 7 stars are the angels of the 7 churches. The 7 lampstands are the 7 churches."

## Chapter 2

**1** "Write this to the angel of the church in Ephesus: The one who holds the 7 stars in his right hand says these things. He walks among the 7 gold lampstands. He says:

**2** I know the things that you do. I know your hard work and your patience. I know that you do not accept bad people. You tested the people who say that they are apostles, but they are not. You found that they are liars.

**3** You have patience. You had much trouble because of my name, but you did not become tired.

**4** But I have this against you: you do not love me as you loved me at the start.

**5** Thus, remember the high position that you fell from. Repent and do the things that you did at the start. If you do not repent, I will come to you. I will remove your lampstand from its place.

**6** But you have this good thing: you hate the things that the Nicolaitans do. I also hate those things.

**7** If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let the person who wins the victory eat from the tree of life. The tree is in the paradise of God."

**8** "Write this to the angel of the church in Smyrna: The first and the last says these things. He was dead and came back to life. He says:

**9** I know your troubles and that you are poor. But really, you are rich. Some people say that they are Jews, but they are not. They speak bad words against you. They are a synagogue of Satan.

**10** Do not be afraid of the things that you will suffer. Look, the devil will put some of you in prison to test you. You will have trouble for 10 days. Stay loyal to me, even if you must die. Then I will give you life as your crown.

**11** If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The second death will not hurt the person who wins the victory."

**12** "Write this to the angel of the church in Pergamum: The one who has the sharp sword with 2 edges says these things:

**13** I know where you live. Satan has his throne there. But you stay loyal to my name. You did not refuse your faith in me. You stayed loyal at the time when people killed Antipas in your city. Antipas was my loyal witness. Satan lives in your city.

**14** But I have a few things against you. Some of you follow the message of Balaam. Balaam taught Balak to cause the people of Israel to sin. He caused them to eat food that people offered to idols. He caused them to do sexual sins.

**15** Also, some of you follow the message of the Nicolaitans.

**16** Thus, repent! If you do not repent, I will come to you soon. I will fight against those people with the sword of my mouth.

**17** If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will give some of the hidden manna to the person who wins the victory. I will also give that person a white stone. A new name is on the stone. Only the person who gets the stone knows the name."

**18** "Write this to the angel of the church in Thyatira: The Son of God says these things. His eyes are like flames of fire. His feet are like bright bronze. He says:

**19** I know the things that you do. I know your love, your faith, your service, and your patience. You do more now than you did at the start.

**20** But I have this against you: you let that woman Jezebel teach. She says that she is a prophet. But she teaches my servants wrong things. She causes them to do sexual sins and to eat food that people offered to idols.

**21** I gave her time to repent, but she does not want to stop her sexual sins.

**22** Look, I will put her on a bed of pain. The people who do adultery with her will also have much trouble. This will happen if they do not repent of the things that she does.

**23** I will kill her children. Then all the churches will know that I examine the thoughts and the hearts of people. I will pay each of you for the things that you did.

**24** Now I speak to the other people in Thyatira. You do not follow the message of Jezebel. You did not learn what some people call the deep secrets of Satan. I will not put any other load on you.

**25** But hold tightly to the truth that you have until I come.

**26** I will give authority over the nations to the person who wins the victory. That person must do the things that I want until the end.

**27** That person will rule the nations with an iron rod. He will break them into pieces as a person breaks clay pots. My Father gave me this authority.

**28** I will also give that person the morning star.

**29** If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."

## Chapter 3

**1** "Write this to the angel of the church in Sardis. The one who has the 7 Spirits of God and the 7 stars says these things. I know the things that you do. People say that you are alive, but you are dead.

**2** Wake up! Make strong the things that remain, because they will soon die. In the view of my God, your work is not complete.

**3** Thus, remember what you got and heard. Obey it and repent. If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief. You will not know the hour when I come to you.

**4** But you have a few people in Sardis who did not make their clothes dirty. They will walk with me in white clothes, because they deserve it.

**5** The person who wins the victory will wear white clothes. I will not remove the name of that person from the book of life. I will say his name in front of my Father and his angels.

**6** If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."

**7** "Write this to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: The one who is holy and true says these things. He has the key of David. When he opens a door, no person can close it. When he closes a door, no person can open it. He says:

**8** I know the things that you do. Look, I put an open door in front of you. No person can close it. You have only a little strength. But you obeyed my word, and you did not refuse my name.

**9** Look, some people are from the synagogue of Satan. They say that they are Jews, but they are not. They are liars. I will cause them to come and bow down at your feet. They will know that I love you.

**10** You obeyed my command to have patience. Thus, I will keep you safe from the time of temptation. That time will come to the whole world. It will test the people who live on the earth.

**11** I come soon. Hold tightly to what you have. Then no person can take your crown.

**12** I will make the person who wins the victory a pillar in the temple of my God. He will never go out of the temple. I will write on him the name of my God. I will write on him the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem. The city comes down out of heaven from my God. I will also write on him my new name.

**13** If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."

**14** "Write this to the angel of the church in Laodicea: The Amen says these things. He is the loyal and true witness. He is the ruler of all that God made. He says:

**15** I know the things that you do. You are not cold or hot. I want you to be cold or hot!

**16** But you are only warm, not hot or cold. Thus, I will spit you out of my mouth.

**17** You say, 'I am rich. I have much money. I need nothing.' But you do not know that you are in a very bad condition. You are poor, blind, and naked. People must feel sorry for you.

**18** I tell you to buy gold from me. Fire made this gold pure. Then you will be rich. Buy white clothes from me to wear. Then people will not see the shame of your naked body. Buy medicine to put on your eyes. Then you will see.

**19** I correct and punish all the people whom I love. Thus, be serious about this and repent.

**20** Look, I stand at the door and knock. If a person hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in. I will eat with that person, and that person will eat with me.

**21** I will let the person who wins the victory sit with me on my throne. In the same manner, I won the victory and sat down with my Father on his throne.

**22** If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches."

## Chapter 4

**1** After these things, I looked and saw an open door in heaven. I heard the same voice that I heard before. The voice was like a trumpet. The voice said, "Come up here. I will show you the things that must happen after this."

**2** Immediately the Spirit controlled me. I saw a throne in heaven, and a person sat on the throne.

**3** The person on the throne looked like jasper and carnelian stones. A rainbow was all around the throne. The rainbow looked like an emerald.

**4** Around the throne were 24 other thrones. 24 elders sat on these thrones. They wore white clothes and had gold crowns on their heads.

**5** Lightning flashes, sounds, and thunder came out of the throne. 7 lamps of fire burned in front of the throne. These lamps are the 7 Spirits of God.

**6** In front of the throne was a sea of glass, clear as crystal. In the center, around the throne, were 4 creatures. They had many eyes on their front and on their back.

**7** The first creature was like a lion. The second was like a young bull. The third had a face like a man. The fourth was like an eagle that flies.

**8** Each of the 4 creatures had 6 wings. They had eyes all around and inside. Day and night they do not stop. They say, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty. He was, he is, and he will come."

**9** The creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to the person who sits on the throne. He lives forever and ever.

**10** When the creatures do this, the 24 elders bow down in front of him. They worship the one who lives forever and ever. They put their crowns in front of the throne and say,

**11** "Our Lord and God, you deserve to get glory, honor, and power. You made all things. All things exist because you wanted them. You made them because you wanted them."

## Chapter 5

**1** Then I saw a scroll in the right hand of the person who sat on the throne. The scroll had words on the inside and on the outside. 7 seals closed the scroll.

**2** I saw a strong angel. He spoke with a loud voice. He said, "Who deserves to break the seals and open the scroll?"

**3** But no person in heaven, on the earth, or under the earth could open the scroll or look inside it.

**4** I cried very much, because no person deserved to open the scroll or look inside it.

**5** Then one of the elders said to me, "Do not cry. Look! The Lion from the tribe of Judah won the victory. He is the Root of David. He can open the scroll and its 7 seals."

**6** Then I saw a Lamb. He stood in the center, near the throne and the 4 creatures and among the elders. The Lamb looked as if someone killed him. He had 7 horns and 7 eyes. The eyes are the 7 Spirits of God. God sends them out into all the earth.

**7** The Lamb came and took the scroll from the right hand of the person who sat on the throne.

**8** When the Lamb took the scroll, the 4 creatures and the 24 elders bowed down in front of him. Each elder had a harp. Each elder also had gold bowls full of incense. The incense is the prayers of God's holy people.

**9** They sang a new song: "You deserve to take the scroll and to open its seals. People killed you. With your blood you bought us for God. We are from every tribe, language, people, and nation.

**10** You made us kings and priests for our God. We will rule on the earth."

**11** Then I looked, and I heard the voices of many angels. They stood around the throne, the creatures, and the elders. There were thousands and thousands of angels. There were millions of angels.

**12** They said with a loud voice, "People killed the Lamb. He deserves to get power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise!"

**13** Then I heard all creatures in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, and in the sea. All the creatures in those places spoke. They said, "Praise, honor, glory, and power belong to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb, forever and ever!"

**14** The 4 creatures said, "Amen." Then the 24 elders bowed down. They worshiped the one who lives forever and ever.

## Chapter 6

**1** I watched when the Lamb opened the first of the 7 seals. Then I heard one of the 4 creatures speak with a voice like thunder. It said, "Come!"

**2** I looked and saw a white horse. The rider of the horse had a bow. God gave him a crown. He went out to win battles. He wanted to win the victory.

**3** The Lamb opened the second seal. Then I heard the second creature say, "Come!"

**4** Then another horse came out. It was red. God gave its rider power to take peace from the earth. The rider caused people to kill each other. God gave him a large sword.

**5** The Lamb opened the third seal. Then I heard the third creature say, "Come!" I looked and saw a black horse. Its rider held a pair of scales in his hand.

**6** Then I heard a sound like a voice among the 4 creatures. The voice said, "A quart of wheat costs the pay for 1 day of work. 3 quarts of barley cost the pay for 1 day of work. But do not damage the olive oil and the wine!"

**7** The Lamb opened the fourth seal. Then I heard the voice of the fourth creature say, "Come!"

**8** I looked and saw a pale horse. The name of its rider was Death. Hades followed close behind him. God gave them power over a fourth of the earth. They killed people with the sword, with hunger, with disease, and with the wild animals of the earth.

**9** The Lamb opened the fifth seal. Then I saw under the altar the souls of people. People killed them because they told the word of God. They stayed loyal to their testimony.

**10** These souls shouted with a loud voice. They said, "Holy and true Lord, how long will you wait? When will you judge the people who live on the earth? When will you punish them because they killed us?"

**11** Then God gave each of the souls a white robe. God told them to rest a short time more. Some of their fellow servants and brothers must die as they died. They must wait until that number is complete.

**12** I watched when the Lamb opened the sixth seal. There was a large earthquake. The sun became black like a cloth of black hair. The whole moon became red like blood.

**13** The stars in the sky fell to the earth. They fell as figs that are not ripe fall from a fig tree in a strong wind.

**14** The sky went away like a scroll that a person rolls up. Every mountain and island moved from its place.

**15** Then the kings of the earth, the rulers, and the army commanders hid in caves and among the rocks of the mountains. The rich people, the powerful people, all slaves, and all free people also hid there.

**16** They said to the mountains and the rocks, "Fall on us! Hide us from the face of the one who sits on the throne. Hide us from the anger of the Lamb!

**17** The great day of their anger has come. No person can stand against it."

## Chapter 7

**1** After this, I saw 4 angels. They stood at the 4 corners of the earth. They held back the 4 winds of the earth. They stopped the wind. Thus no wind blew on the land, on the sea, or on any tree.

**2** Then I saw another angel. He came up from the east. He had the seal of the God who lives. God gave the 4 angels power to damage the land and the sea. The other angel shouted with a loud voice to them.

**3** He said, "Do not damage the land, the sea, or the trees yet. First we must put a seal on the foreheads of the servants of our God."

**4** Then I heard the number of the people who got the seal. There were 144,000 people. They were from all the tribes of Israel.

**5** 12,000 were from the tribe of Judah. 12,000 were from the tribe of Reuben. 12,000 were from the tribe of Gad.

**6** 12,000 were from the tribe of Asher. 12,000 were from the tribe of Naphtali. 12,000 were from the tribe of Manasseh.

**7** 12,000 were from the tribe of Simeon. 12,000 were from the tribe of Levi. 12,000 were from the tribe of Issachar.

**8** 12,000 were from the tribe of Zebulun. 12,000 were from the tribe of Joseph. 12,000 were from the tribe of Benjamin.

**9** After this, I looked and saw a very large crowd. No person could count the people in it. They were from every nation, tribe, people, and language. They stood in front of the throne and in front of the Lamb. They wore white robes. They held palm branches in their hands.

**10** They shouted with a loud voice, "Our God, who sits on the throne, and the Lamb have the power to save!"

**11** All the angels stood around the throne, the elders, and the 4 creatures. The angels bowed down with their faces to the ground in front of the throne. They worshiped God.

**12** They said, "Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever. Amen!"

**13** Then one of the elders asked me, "Who are these people in white robes? Where did they come from?"

**14** I said to him, "Sir, you know." He said to me, "These are the people who came out of the time of great trouble. They washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb. The blood made the robes white.

**15** Thus they are in front of the throne of God. They serve God day and night in his temple. The one who sits on the throne will protect them with his presence.

**16** They will never be hungry again. They will never be thirsty again. The sun and the hot wind will not burn them.

**17** The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to springs of the water of life. God will remove all tears from their eyes."

## Chapter 8

**1** The Lamb opened the seventh seal. Then heaven was silent for about half an hour.

**2** Then I saw the 7 angels who stand in front of God. God gave them 7 trumpets.

**3** Another angel came and stood at the altar. He had a gold container for incense. Someone gave him much incense to offer with the prayers of all God's holy people. He offered it on the gold altar in front of the throne.

**4** The smoke of the incense went up with the prayers of God's holy people. The smoke went up from the hand of the angel to God.

**5** Then the angel took the container for incense. He filled it with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Then there was thunder, loud sounds, lightning, and an earthquake.

**6** Then the 7 angels who had the 7 trumpets got ready to blow them.

**7** The first angel blew his trumpet. Then hail and fire, mixed with blood, came down on the earth. A third of the trees burned. All the green grass burned.

**8** The second angel blew his trumpet. Then something like a large mountain that burned with fire fell into the sea. A third of the sea became blood.

**9** A third of the creatures in the sea died. The fire destroyed a third of the ships.

**10** The third angel blew his trumpet. Then a large star fell from the sky. It burned like a torch. It fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.

**11** The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the water became bitter like wormwood. Many people died because they drank the bitter water.

**12** The fourth angel blew his trumpet. Then God struck a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars. Thus a third of them became dark. For a third of the day there was no light. The night was the same.

**13** As I watched, I heard an angel that flew high in the sky. He said with a loud voice, "Terrible! Terrible! Terrible things will happen to the people who live on the earth! These things will happen when the other 3 angels blow their trumpets."

## Chapter 9

**1** The fifth angel blew his trumpet. Then I saw a star that fell from the sky to the earth. God gave the star the key to the shaft of the bottomless pit.

**2** The star opened the shaft of the bottomless pit. Smoke came up out of the shaft, like smoke from a large furnace. The smoke from the shaft made the sun and the air dark.

**3** Locusts came out of the smoke and went down onto the earth. God gave them power like the power of scorpions.

**4** God told the locusts not to damage the grass, the plants, or the trees. They could hurt only the people who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.

**5** God did not let the locusts kill these people. But the locusts could cause them pain for 5 months. The pain was like the pain from the sting of a scorpion.

**6** At that time, people will try to find death, but they will not find it. They will want to die, but death will run away from them.

**7** The locusts looked like horses that are ready for battle. On their heads they had something like crowns of gold. Their faces were like the faces of people.

**8** They had hair like the hair of women. Their teeth were like the teeth of lions.

**9** They had armor on their chests like iron armor. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many horses and chariots that run into battle.

**10** They had tails with stings like scorpions. They had power in their tails to hurt people for 5 months.

**11** The locusts had a king over them. He is the angel of the bottomless pit. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon. In Greek, his name is Apollyon. These names mean "Destroyer."

**12** The first terrible event is past. After it, 2 more terrible events will come.

**13** The sixth angel blew his trumpet. Then I heard a voice from the 4 horns of the gold altar in front of God.

**14** The voice spoke to the sixth angel who had the trumpet. It said, "Release the 4 angels who are tied at the large river Euphrates."

**15** The sixth angel released the 4 angels. God kept them ready for this hour, day, month, and year. They were ready to kill a third of the people.

**16** I heard the number of soldiers on horses in their army. There were 200 million.

**17** In my vision, I saw the horses and their riders. The riders had armor on their chests. The armor was red like fire, dark blue, and yellow like sulfur. The heads of the horses were like the heads of lions. Fire, smoke, and sulfur came out of their mouths.

**18** The fire, the smoke, and the sulfur came out of the mouths of the horses. These 3 terrible things killed a third of the people.

**19** The power of the horses was in their mouths and in their tails. Their tails were like snakes, with heads. They hurt people with these heads.

**20** These terrible things did not kill all the other people. But those people did not repent of the things that they did. They did not stop their worship of demons. They did not stop their worship of idols of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. These idols cannot see, hear, or walk.

**21** The people did not repent of their murders or their magic. They did not repent of their sexual sins or their thefts.

## Chapter 10

**1** Then I saw another strong angel. He came down from heaven. A cloud was around him. A rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun. His legs were like columns of fire.

**2** He held a small scroll in his hand. The scroll was open. He put his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.

**3** He shouted with a loud voice, like the roar of a lion. When he shouted, the 7 thunders spoke.

**4** When the 7 thunders spoke, I started to write. But I heard a voice from heaven. The voice said, "Keep secret the things that the 7 thunders said. Do not write them."

**5** Then the angel that I saw on the sea and on the land lifted his hand to heaven.

**6** He made a promise in the name of God, who lives forever and ever. God made heaven, the earth, the sea, and all things in them. The angel said, "There will be no more delay.

**7** The seventh angel will soon blow his trumpet. At that time, God will complete his secret plan. He told this plan to his servants the prophets."

**8** Then the voice from heaven spoke to me again. It said, "Go and take the open scroll. The angel who stands on the sea and on the land holds it in his hand."

**9** I went to the angel and told him to give me the small scroll. He said to me, "Take it and eat it. It will be as sweet as honey in your mouth. But it will make your stomach bitter."

**10** I took the small scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. In my mouth it was as sweet as honey. But after I ate it, my stomach became bitter.

**11** Then someone said to me, "You must speak a prophecy again about many peoples, nations, languages, and kings."

## Chapter 11

**1** Someone gave me a stick like a rod to measure with. The angel said to me, "Go and measure the temple of God and the altar. Count the people who worship there.

**2** But do not measure the court outside the temple. God gave that court to the Gentiles. They will walk on the holy city and damage it for 42 months.

**3** I will give power to my 2 witnesses. They will speak prophecy for 1,260 days. They will wear sackcloth, rough clothes that show sorrow."

**4** These 2 witnesses are the 2 olive trees and the 2 lampstands. They stand in front of the God of the earth.

**5** If any person tries to hurt the witnesses, fire comes out of their mouths and destroys their enemies. Any person who tries to hurt them must die in this manner.

**6** The witnesses have power to close the sky. Then no rain falls during the time of their prophecy. They have power to change water into blood. They can strike the earth with every type of disaster. They can do this as often as they want.

**7** When the 2 witnesses complete their testimony, the beast will attack them. The beast comes up from the bottomless pit. It will win the fight against them and kill them.

**8** Their dead bodies will lie in the street of the great city. People call that city Sodom and Egypt, as a symbol. That city is also where people nailed our Lord to a cross.

**9** For 3 and a half days, people from every people, tribe, language, and nation will look at their dead bodies. They will not let anyone bury the bodies.

**10** The people who live on the earth will be happy because the 2 witnesses are dead. They will have a celebration. They will send gifts to each other. They do this because these 2 prophets caused much pain to the people who live on the earth.

**11** But after the 3 and a half days, the breath of life from God went into the 2 witnesses. They stood up on their feet. The people who saw them were very afraid.

**12** Then the 2 witnesses heard a loud voice from heaven. It said to them, "Come up here!" They went up to heaven in a cloud. Their enemies watched them.

**13** At that same hour there was a strong earthquake. A tenth of the city fell down. The earthquake killed 7,000 people. The other people were afraid. They gave glory to the God of heaven.

**14** The second terrible event is past. The third terrible event will come soon.

**15** The seventh angel blew his trumpet. Then there were loud voices in heaven. They said, "The kingdom of the world now belongs to our Lord and to his Christ. He will rule forever and ever."

**16** The 24 elders sat on their thrones in front of God. They bowed down with their faces to the ground and worshiped God.

**17** They said, "Lord God Almighty, we thank you. You are, and you were, and you will come. You took your great power and started to rule.

**18** The nations were angry, but now the time of your anger is here. It is the time to judge the dead. It is the time to reward your servants the prophets and your holy people. You will reward all people who respect your name, the small and the great. It is the time to destroy the people who destroy the earth."

**19** Then God opened his temple in heaven. I saw the ark of his covenant in his temple. There was lightning, loud sounds, thunder, an earthquake, and a large storm of hail.

## Chapter 12

**1** Then a great sign appeared in heaven. I saw a woman. The sun was around her like clothes. The moon was under her feet. A crown of 12 stars was on her head.

**2** She was pregnant. She cried out with pain because she was about to give birth.

**3** Then another sign appeared in heaven. I saw a large red dragon. It had 7 heads and 10 horns. It had 7 crowns on its heads.

**4** The tail of the dragon pulled a third of the stars out of the sky. It threw them down to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth. It wanted to eat her child immediately after the birth.

**5** The woman gave birth to a son. He will rule all the nations with an iron rod. God took her child up to himself and to his throne.

**6** The woman ran away into the desert. God prepared a place for her there. There, people will give her food for 1,260 days.

**7** Then there was a war in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon. The dragon and its angels fought back.

**8** But the dragon was not strong enough. The dragon and its angels lost their place in heaven.

**9** God threw the large dragon down to the earth. The dragon is the old snake. People call it the devil and Satan. It deceives the whole world. God threw its angels down to the earth with it.

**10** Then I heard a loud voice in heaven. It said, "Now the salvation, the power, and the kingdom of our God are here. The authority of his Christ is here. God threw down the accuser of our brothers. The accuser said bad things about them in front of our God, day and night.

**11** Our brothers won the victory over the accuser because of the blood of the Lamb. They won because of the message that they told. They did not love their lives so much that they were afraid to die.

**12** Thus, be happy, heaven and all who live there! But terrible things will happen to the earth and the sea. The devil came down to you. He is very angry, because he knows that he has only a short time."

**13** The dragon saw that God threw it down to the earth. Then it chased the woman who gave birth to the son.

**14** God gave the woman the 2 wings of a large eagle. Thus she could fly to her place in the desert. There, God takes care of her for a time, times, and half a time. The snake cannot get to her there.

**15** Then the snake sent water like a river out of its mouth after the woman. It wanted the water to carry her away.

**16** But the earth helped the woman. The earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river that came out of the mouth of the dragon.

**17** Then the dragon was angry with the woman. It went away to fight against the other children of the woman. These children obey the commands of God. They hold to the testimony of Jesus Christ.

## Chapter 13

**1** I stood on the sand at the edge of the sea. I saw a beast come up out of the sea. It had 10 horns and 7 heads. It had 10 crowns on its horns. On its heads were names that insulted God.

**2** The beast that I saw was like a leopard. Its feet were like the feet of a bear. Its mouth was like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave the beast its power, its throne, and much authority.

**3** One of the heads of the beast looked as if it had a wound that can kill it. But the wound became well. The whole world was full of wonder and followed the beast.

**4** People worshiped the dragon, because it gave its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast. They said, "Who is like the beast? Who can fight against it?"

**5** God let the beast speak proud words and words that insulted God. God let it use its authority for 42 months.

**6** The beast opened its mouth to insult God. It insulted the name of God and the place where God lives. It insulted all the beings who live in heaven.

**7** God let the beast fight against his holy people and win the victory over them. God gave it authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation.

**8** All the people who live on the earth will worship the beast. These people do not have their names in the book of life. This book belongs to the Lamb. People killed the Lamb, and God planned this from the start of the world.

**9** If you have ears, listen.

**10** If a person takes people as prisoners, then that person will become a prisoner. If a person kills with the sword, then someone will kill that person with the sword. Thus God's holy people must have patience and faith.

**11** Then I saw another beast. It came up out of the earth. It had 2 horns like a lamb, but it spoke like a dragon.

**12** It uses all the authority of the first beast in the presence of the first beast. It causes the earth and all the people on the earth to worship the first beast. The first beast had a wound that can kill, but the wound became well.

**13** The second beast does great miracles. It causes fire to come down from the sky to the earth. People see this.

**14** It deceives the people who live on the earth with the miracles. God lets it do these miracles in the presence of the first beast. It tells the people to make a statue of the first beast. A sword wounded that beast, but it lived.

**15** God let the second beast give breath to the statue of the first beast. Thus the statue could speak. The statue caused all people who did not worship it to die.

**16** The second beast causes all people to get a mark on their right hand or on their forehead. It does this to the small and the great, the rich and the poor, the free and the slaves.

**17** No person can buy or sell without the mark. The mark is the name of the beast or the number of its name.

**18** Here you need wisdom. A person with wisdom can calculate the number of the beast. It is the number of a man. The number is 666.

## Chapter 14

**1** Then I looked and saw the Lamb. He stood on Mount Zion. 144,000 people were with him. The name of the Father of the Lamb was on their foreheads.

**2** I heard a sound from heaven. It was like the sound of a large quantity of water that flows fast. It was like loud thunder. The sound that I heard was like the sound of many people who play harps.

**3** They sang a new song in front of the throne, the 4 creatures, and the elders. Only the 144,000 people could learn the song. God bought them from the earth.

**4** These people did not make themselves unclean with women. They are pure like virgins. They follow the Lamb to all places where he goes. God bought them from among all people. They are the first part of the harvest for God and for the Lamb.

**5** They did not tell lies. They have no fault in front of the throne of God.

**6** Then I saw another angel. He flew high in the sky. He had the gospel that continues forever. He told the gospel to the people who live on the earth. He told it to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

**7** He said with a loud voice, "Respect God and give him glory. The hour of his judgment is here. Worship the God who made heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of water."

**8** A second angel followed him. He said, "Babylon fell! The great city Babylon fell! She caused all the nations to drink the wine of her sexual sins. This wine brings the anger of God."

**9** A third angel followed them. He said with a loud voice, "A person must not worship the beast and its statue. A person must not get its mark on the forehead or on the hand.

**10** If a person does these things, then that person will drink the wine of God's anger. God will pour this strong wine into the cup of his anger. That person will feel pain in fire and sulfur. This will happen in the presence of the holy angels and the Lamb.

**11** The smoke from their pain goes up forever and ever. The people who worship the beast and its statue have no rest, day or night. The people who get the mark of its name also have no rest."

**12** Thus God's holy people must have patience. They obey the commands of God and keep their faith in Jesus.

**13** Then I heard a voice from heaven. It said, "Write this: From now on, God blesses the dead people who die as believers in the Lord." The Spirit says, "Yes. They will rest from their hard work. The good things that they did go with them."

**14** Then I looked and saw a white cloud. A person like a son of man sat on the cloud. He had a gold crown on his head. He had a sharp sickle in his hand.

**15** Then another angel came out of the temple. He shouted with a loud voice to the person who sat on the cloud. He said, "Use your sickle and cut the harvest. The time to cut the harvest is here. The harvest of the earth is ripe."

**16** Thus the person who sat on the cloud swung his sickle over the earth. He cut the harvest of the earth.

**17** Then another angel came out of the temple in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

**18** Then another angel came out from the altar. He had authority over the fire. He shouted with a loud voice to the angel with the sharp sickle. He said, "Use your sharp sickle. Cut the bunches of grapes from the vine of the earth. The grapes are ripe."

**19** The angel swung his sickle over the earth. He cut the grapes from the vine of the earth. He threw them into the large winepress of the anger of God.

**20** Someone crushed the grapes in the winepress outside the city. Blood came out of the winepress. It was as high as the bridles of horses. It flowed for about 1,600 stadia (300 kilometers).

## Chapter 15

**1** Then I saw another sign in heaven. It was great and wonderful. I saw 7 angels with the 7 last disasters. These disasters are the last, because they complete the anger of God.

**2** I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire. Some people stood on the sea of glass. They won the victory over the beast, its statue, its mark, and the number of its name. They held harps that God gave them.

**3** They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb. They said, "Lord God Almighty, the things that you do are great and wonderful. King of the holy people, your ways are fair and true.

**4** Lord, all people will respect you and give glory to your name. Only you are holy. All nations will come and worship you. All people can see that your judgments are correct."

**5** After this I looked, and God opened the temple in heaven. The temple is the tent of the testimony.

**6** The 7 angels with the 7 disasters came out of the temple. They wore clean, bright linen. They had gold belts around their chests.

**7** Then one of the 4 creatures gave 7 gold bowls to the 7 angels. The bowls were full of the anger of God, who lives forever and ever.

**8** Smoke from the glory and the power of God filled the temple. No person could go into the temple until the 7 angels completed the 7 disasters.

## Chapter 16

**1** Then I heard a loud voice from the temple. The voice said to the 7 angels, "Go and pour out the 7 bowls of the anger of God on the earth."

**2** The first angel went and poured out his bowl on the land. Then bad and painful sores came on the people who had the mark of the beast. The sores also came on the people who worshiped its statue.

**3** The second angel poured out his bowl on the sea. The sea became like the blood of a dead person. Every creature that lived in the sea died.

**4** The third angel poured out his bowl on the rivers and the springs of water. They became blood.

**5** Then I heard the angel who has authority over the waters. He said, "Lord, you are, you were, and you will be. You are fair, because you judged in this manner.

**6** These people poured out the blood of your holy people and your prophets. Thus you gave them blood to drink. They deserve this."

**7** Then I heard another angel from the altar say, "Yes, Lord God Almighty, your judgments are true and fair."

**8** The fourth angel poured out his bowl on the sun. God let the sun burn people with fire.

**9** The strong heat burned the people. They spoke bad words against the name of God. God has authority over these disasters. But the people did not repent and give him glory.

**10** The fifth angel poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast. Then the kingdom of the beast became dark. People bit their tongues because of the pain.

**11** They spoke bad words against the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. But they did not repent of the things that they did.

**12** The sixth angel poured out his bowl on the large river Euphrates. The water of the river dried up. This prepared the road for the kings from the east.

**13** Then I saw 3 unclean spirits that looked like frogs. They came out of the mouth of the dragon, the mouth of the beast, and the mouth of the false prophet.

**14** These are spirits of demons. They do miracles. They go out to the kings of the whole world. They gather the kings for the battle on the great day of God Almighty.

**15** "Look! I will come as a thief comes, when people do not expect him. God blesses the person who stays awake and keeps his clothes on. That person will not walk naked. People will not see his shame."

**16** Then the spirits gathered the kings at a place that has the name Armageddon in Hebrew.

**17** The seventh angel poured out his bowl into the air. Then a loud voice came out of the temple, from the throne. It said, "It is the end!"

**18** Then there were lightning flashes, loud sounds, and thunder. There was a very strong earthquake. No earthquake was this strong at any time since people lived on the earth.

**19** The great city broke into 3 parts. The cities of the nations fell down. God remembered Babylon the great. He gave her the cup of the wine of his strong anger.

**20** Every island went away. People did not find the mountains any more.

**21** Large hailstones fell from the sky on people. Each hailstone weighed about 100 pounds (45 kilograms). People spoke bad words against God because of the hail. The hail was a very terrible disaster.

## Chapter 17

**1** One of the 7 angels with the 7 bowls came and spoke to me. He said, "Come here. I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute. She sits on many waters.

**2** The kings of the earth did sexual sins with her. The people who live on the earth became drunk with the wine of her sexual sins."

**3** Then the Spirit controlled me, and the angel carried me away into a desert. There I saw a woman. She sat on a red beast. Names that insulted God covered the beast. The beast had 7 heads and 10 horns.

**4** The woman wore purple and red clothes. She wore gold, valuable stones, and pearls. She held a gold cup in her hand. The cup was full of hateful things and the dirty things of her sexual sins.

**5** A name was on her forehead. The name has a secret meaning: BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE DISGUSTING THINGS OF THE EARTH.

**6** I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of God's holy people. She was drunk with the blood of the people who told others about Jesus and died for it. When I saw her, I was very surprised.

**7** The angel said to me, "Why are you surprised? I will tell you the secret meaning of the woman and of the beast that carries her. The beast has 7 heads and 10 horns.

**8** The beast that you saw was alive at one time, but now it is not. It will come up out of the bottomless pit and go to its destruction. Some people who live on the earth will see the beast. They will be full of wonder, because it was, and it is not, and it will come. Their names are not in the book of life since the start of the world.

**9** To understand this, you must have wisdom. The 7 heads are 7 mountains. The woman sits on these mountains.

**10** They are also 7 kings. 5 of the kings fell. 1 king rules now. The other king did not come yet. When he comes, he must stay only a short time.

**11** The beast that was alive at one time, but now is not, is an eighth king. It is one of the 7 kings. It goes to its destruction.

**12** The 10 horns that you saw are 10 kings. They do not have a kingdom yet. But they will get authority to rule as kings with the beast for 1 hour.

**13** These kings all have the same purpose. They will give their power and authority to the beast.

**14** They will fight against the Lamb, but the Lamb will win the victory over them. He is Lord of lords and King of kings. The people with him are the people whom God called and chose. They are loyal to him."

**15** Then the angel said to me, "You saw the waters where the prostitute sits. The waters are peoples, crowds, nations, and languages.

**16** The 10 horns that you saw on the beast will hate the prostitute. They will take all that she has and leave her naked. They will eat her flesh and burn her with fire.

**17** God put a purpose in their hearts to do what he wants. Thus they will agree to give their kingdom to the beast. They will do this until the words of God come true.

**18** The woman that you saw is the great city. That city rules over the kings of the earth."

## Chapter 18

**1** After these things, I saw another angel come down from heaven. He had much authority. His glory made the earth bright.

**2** He shouted with a strong voice. He said, "Babylon the great fell! She fell! She became a home for demons. She became a place for every unclean spirit. She became a place for every unclean bird that people hate.

**3** All the nations drank the wine of her sexual sins. This wine brings the anger of God. The kings of the earth did sexual sins with her. The merchants of the earth became rich because she spent very much money on luxury."

**4** Then I heard another voice from heaven. It said, "My people, come out of the city of Babylon! Do not share in her sins. Then you will not get her disasters.

**5** Her sins are as high as heaven. God remembered the bad things that she did.

**6** Do to her as she did to other people. Pay her back 2 times for the things that she did. Mix for her a drink 2 times as strong as the drink that she mixed for others.

**7** She gave herself glory and lived in luxury. Give her the same quantity of pain and sorrow. In her heart she says, 'I sit as a queen. I am not a widow. I will never feel sorrow.'

**8** Thus her disasters will come in 1 day. Death, sorrow, and hunger will come. Fire will burn her completely. The Lord God who judges her is strong."

**9** The kings of the earth did sexual sins with her and lived in luxury with her. They will see the smoke when she burns. Then they will cry and show sorrow for her.

**10** They will be afraid of her pain. Thus they will stand far away from her. They will say, 'Terrible! Terrible! Babylon, the great city, the strong city! In 1 hour your punishment came!'

**11** The merchants of the earth will cry and feel sorrow for her. No person buys their goods any more.

**12** They sold gold, silver, valuable stones, and pearls. They sold fine linen, purple cloth, silk, and red cloth. They sold all types of wood with a sweet smell. They sold all types of objects made of ivory, valuable wood, bronze, iron, and marble.

**13** They sold cinnamon, spice, incense, perfume, and frankincense. They sold wine, olive oil, fine flour, and wheat. They sold cattle, sheep, horses, and chariots. They sold slaves, and they sold the souls of people.

**14** The merchants will say, "Babylon, the good things that you wanted went away from you. All your luxury and beautiful things are gone. You will never find them again."

**15** The merchants who sold these things became rich because of her. They will be afraid of her pain. Thus they will stand far away. They will cry and show sorrow.

**16** They will say, 'Terrible! Terrible! The great city wore fine linen, purple, and red clothes. She wore gold, valuable stones, and pearls!

**17** In 1 hour all that wealth is gone!' Every ship captain, every person who travels by ship, every sailor, and every person who earns money from the sea stood far away.

**18** They saw the smoke when she burned. They shouted, 'No city was like this great city!'

**19** They threw dust on their heads to show their sorrow. They cried and shouted, 'Terrible! Terrible! All the people with ships on the sea became rich because of the wealth of the great city. But in 1 hour God destroyed her!'

**20** Heaven, be happy because God destroyed her! Holy people, apostles, and prophets, be happy! God punished her because of what she did to you.

**21** Then a strong angel picked up a large stone like a millstone. He threw it into the sea. He said, "In the same manner, God will throw down the great city Babylon with force. People will never find her again.

**22** People will never again hear in you the music of harps, of musicians, of flutes, or of trumpets. People will never again find a worker of any trade in you. People will never again hear the sound of a millstone in you.

**23** The light of a lamp will never again shine in you. People will never again hear the voices of a bridegroom and a bride in you. Your merchants were the most important men of the earth. You deceived all the nations with your magic.

**24** In the city of Babylon, people found the blood of prophets and of God's holy people. They found the blood of all the people whom others killed on the earth."

## Chapter 19

**1** After these things, I heard a loud sound in heaven. The sound was like the voice of a large crowd of people. They said, "Alleluia! Salvation, glory, honor, and power belong to the Lord our God.

**2** His judgments are true and correct. He judged the famous prostitute. She made the earth bad with her sexual sins. God punished her because she killed his servants."

**3** Again the people said, "Alleluia!" The smoke from the city goes up for all time.

**4** The 24 elders and the 4 creatures fell down. They worshipped God, who sat on the throne. They said, "Amen. Alleluia!"

**5** Then a voice came from the throne. The voice said, "Praise our God, all you servants of God. Praise him, all you who fear him, the small people and the great people."

**6** Then I heard a sound like the voice of a large crowd. It was like the sound of much water and like the sound of loud thunder. The crowd said, "Alleluia! The Lord our God, who has all power, is king.

**7** Let us be glad and full of joy. Let us give honor to him. The time for the marriage of the Lamb is here. His wife made herself ready.

**8** God gave her fine linen clothes to wear. The linen is clean and white." The fine linen shows the correct actions of the saints.

**9** Then the angel said to me, "Write this: God blesses the people who get an invitation to the marriage meal of the Lamb." He also said to me, "These are the true words of God."

**10** I fell down at the feet of the angel to worship him. But he said to me, "Do not do this! I am a servant, the same as you. I am a servant with your brothers who hold to the testimony about Jesus. Worship God! The testimony about Jesus is the spirit of prophecy."

**11** Then I saw heaven open. I saw a white horse there. The name of the rider on the horse is Faithful and True. He judges and makes war in a correct and fair way.

**12** His eyes were like flames of fire. He had many crowns on his head. He had a name written on him. No person knew the name, but he knew it.

**13** He wore a robe that had blood on it. His name is The Word of God.

**14** The armies of heaven followed him on white horses. The soldiers wore fine linen that was white and clean.

**15** A sharp sword comes out of his mouth. He will use the sword to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He will crush the grapes in the winepress of the strong anger of Almighty God.

**16** He has a name written on his robe and on his upper leg: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.

**17** Then I saw an angel who stood in the sun. He spoke with a loud voice to all the birds that fly high in the sky. He said, "Come! Gather together for the great meal of God.

**18** Come and eat the bodies of kings, army commanders, and strong men. Eat the bodies of horses and their riders. Eat the bodies of all people, free people and slaves, small people and great people."

**19** Then I saw the beast and the kings of the earth with their armies. They gathered together to make war against the rider on the horse and against his army.

**20** But the rider caught the beast. He also caught the false prophet. The false prophet did miracles for the beast. With these miracles, he deceived the people who took the mark of the beast and worshipped the image of the beast. The rider threw the beast and the false prophet alive into a lake of fire. Sulfur burns in that lake.

**21** The rider on the horse killed all the other people with the sword that came out of his mouth. All the birds ate the bodies of these people until the birds were full.

## Chapter 20

**1** Then I saw an angel come down from heaven. He held the key to the bottomless pit and a large chain in his hand.

**2** He caught the dragon. The dragon is the old snake, who is the Devil and Satan. The angel tied him with the chain for 1,000 years.

**3** The angel threw him into the bottomless pit. He closed the pit and put a seal on it above Satan. Thus Satan cannot deceive the nations until the 1,000 years are complete. After that time, Satan must go free for a short time.

**4** Then I saw thrones. People sat on the thrones, and God gave them the authority to judge. I also saw the souls of the people whose heads their enemies cut off. Their enemies killed them because they spoke the truth about Jesus and the word of God. These people did not worship the beast or its image. They did not take the mark of the beast on their foreheads or on their hands. They came back to life and ruled with Christ for 1,000 years.

**5** The other dead people did not come back to life until the 1,000 years were complete. This is the first resurrection.

**6** God blesses the people who have a part in the first resurrection. These people are holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests of God and of Christ. They will rule with Christ for 1,000 years.

**7** When the 1,000 years are complete, God will let Satan out of his prison.

**8** Satan will go out to deceive the nations in all parts of the earth, Gog and Magog. He will gather them together for battle. The number of their soldiers will be as large as the number of the grains of sand by the sea.

**9** The armies went across the whole earth. They went around the camp of the saints and the city that God loves. But fire came down from heaven and destroyed the armies.

**10** Then God threw the Devil, who deceived them, into the lake of fire and sulfur. The beast and the false prophet are also in that lake. They will feel pain day and night for all time.

**11** Then I saw a large white throne and the person who sat on it. The earth and the sky went away from him. There was no place for them.

**12** I saw the dead people, the small and the great. They stood in front of God. Then the books were open. Another book was also open, which is the book of life. God judged the dead people by their actions. He used the records in the books.

**13** The sea gave up the dead people that were in it. Death and Hades also gave up the dead people that were in them. God judged each person by his or her actions.

**14** Then God threw death and Hades into the lake of fire. The lake of fire is the second death.

**15** If the name of a person was not in the book of life, God threw that person into the lake of fire.

## Chapter 21

**1** Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth went away. Also, there was no more sea.

**2** I, John, saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem. The city came down out of heaven from God. It was ready, like a bride who wears beautiful clothes for her husband.

**3** I heard a loud voice from heaven. The voice said, "Look! The home (tabernacle) of God is with people. God will live with them. They will be his people. God himself will be with them and be their God.

**4** God will remove all tears from their eyes. There will be no more death. There will be no more sadness, no more tears, and no more pain. The old things are gone."

**5** The person who sat on the throne said, "Look! I make all things new." He also said, "Write this, because these words are true and you can trust them."

**6** He said to me, "It is complete! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the start and the end. I will give water from the spring of the water of life to each person who is thirsty. I will give it free of cost.

**7** The person who wins the fight will get all these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

**8** But some people will have their place in the lake of fire and sulfur. These are the cowards, the people who do not believe, and the people who do hateful things. They are also the murderers and the people who commit sexual sins. They are also the people who use magic, the people who worship idols, and all liars. The lake of fire is the second death."

**9** One of the 7 angels came to me. These angels held the 7 bowls full of the 7 last plagues. The angel said to me, "Come here. I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb."

**10** The Spirit took control of me, and the angel carried me away to a large and high mountain. He showed me the great city, the holy Jerusalem. The city came down out of heaven from God.

**11** The city had the glory of God. Its light was like a very valuable stone, like a jasper stone. The light was as clear as crystal.

**12** The city had a large, high wall with 12 gates. There were 12 angels at the gates. On the gates were the names of the 12 tribes of Israel.

**13** There were 3 gates on the east side and 3 gates on the north side. There were 3 gates on the south side and 3 gates on the west side.

**14** The wall of the city had 12 foundation stones. On the stones were the 12 names of the 12 apostles of the Lamb.

**15** The angel who spoke with me had a gold rod. He used the rod to measure the city, its gates, and its wall.

**16** The city had 4 sides of equal length. The length was the same as the width. The angel measured the city with the rod. The city was 12,000 stadia (about 2,200 kilometers) long. Its length, width, and height were equal.

**17** The angel measured the wall of the city. The wall was 144 cubits (about 65 meters) thick. The angel used the same measurement that people use.

**18** The builders made the wall from jasper. They made the city from pure gold that was as clear as glass.

**19** The builders put all types of valuable stones on the foundations of the city wall. The first foundation was jasper. The second was sapphire. The third was chalcedony. The fourth was emerald.

**20** The fifth was sardonyx. The sixth was carnelian. The seventh was chrysolite. The eighth was beryl. The ninth was topaz. The tenth was chrysoprase. The eleventh was jacinth. The twelfth was amethyst.

**21** The 12 gates were 12 pearls. Each gate was 1 pearl. The street of the city was pure gold. The gold was as clear as glass.

**22** I did not see a temple in the city. The Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of the city.

**23** The city does not need the sun or the moon to give it light. The glory of God gives the city light, and the Lamb is its lamp.

**24** The nations will walk in the light of the city. The kings of the earth will bring their glory into the city.

**25** The gates of the city will never close during the day. There will be no night there.

**26** The people will bring the glory and the honor of the nations into the city.

**27** Nothing unclean will go into the city. No person who does hateful things or tells lies will go into the city. Only the people whose names are in the book of life of the Lamb will go in.

## Chapter 22

**1** Then the angel showed me the river of the water of life. The river was as clear as crystal. The river came from the throne of God and of the Lamb.

**2** The river flowed through the middle of the street of the city. The tree of life was on each side of the river. The tree gives 12 types of fruit. It gives new fruit each month. The leaves of the tree are for the health of the nations.

**3** There will be no more curse. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in the city. The servants of God will serve him.

**4** They will see his face. His name will be on their foreheads.

**5** There will be no night there. The people will not need the light of a lamp or the light of the sun. The Lord God will give them light. They will rule for all time.

**6** The angel said to me, "These words are true, and you can trust them. The Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to show his servants the things that must occur soon."

**7** "Look! I will come soon! God blesses the person who obeys the words of the prophecy in this book."

**8** I, John, am the person who heard and saw these things. After I heard and saw them, I fell down to worship at the feet of the angel. He was the angel who showed me these things.

**9** But the angel said to me, "Do not do this! I am a servant, the same as you. I am a servant with your brothers the prophets. I am a servant with all the people who obey the words of this book. Worship God!"

**10** Then the angel said to me, "Do not keep the words of the prophecy of this book secret. The time is near.

**11** Let the person who does wrong continue to do wrong. Let the person who is not clean stay unclean. Let the person who does right continue to do right. Let the person who is holy stay holy."

**12** "Look! I will come soon! I will bring my reward with me. I will give each person a reward for the things that he or she did.

**13** I am the Alpha and the Omega, the first and the last, the start and the end.

**14** God blesses the people who obey his commands. They will have the right to eat from the tree of life. They will go through the gates into the city.

**15** Outside the city are the dogs, the people who use magic, and the people who commit sexual sins. Also outside are the murderers, the people who worship idols, and all the people who love lies and tell lies.

**16** I, Jesus, sent my angel to tell you these things for the churches. I am the root and the descendant of David. I am the bright morning star."

**17** The Spirit and the bride say, "Come!" Let each person who hears say, "Come!" Let each person who is thirsty come. Let each person who wants the water of life take it free of cost.

**18** I warn each person who hears the words of the prophecy of this book. If a person adds to these words, then God will add to him the plagues in this book.

**19** If a person removes words from the book of this prophecy, then God will remove his part in the book of life. God will also remove his part in the holy city. These things are in this book.

**20** Jesus, who tells these things, says, "Yes, I will come soon." Amen. Come, Lord Jesus!

**21** Let the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you. Amen.
